    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1685"

  events:
    $hostname = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `^powershell\s+Set-(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{4}){2,}(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{4}|[A-Za-z0-9+/]{3}=|[A-Za-z0-9+/]{2}==)\s+-(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{4}){2,}(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{4}|[A-Za-z0-9+/]{3}=|[A-Za-z0-9+/]{2}==)\s+2\s*$`) nocase

    $hostname over 5m

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.windows_sid)
    $result = array_distinct($e.security_result.summary)
    $result_time = array_distinct($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

  condition:
    $e

rules.text:
rule ttp_windows_powershell_defender_eventlog_discovery {
  meta:
    rule_name = "PowerShell Windows Defender Event Log Discovery"
    description = "Detects PowerShell commands querying Windows Defender operational event logs (such as Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender/Operational). Threat actors often query Windows Defender event logs post-execution to verify if their payloads or malicious behaviors have triggered security alerts or quarantine actions."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0007"
    technique = "T1082"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"
    ) and
    (
      $e.target.process.file.full_path = /\b(powershell|pwsh|cmd)\.exe$/ nocase or
      $e.target.process.command_line = /\b(powershell|pwsh|cmd)(\.exe)?\b/ nocase
    ) and
    $e.target.process.command_line = /\bGet-WinEvent\b.*-FilterHashtable.*(Microsoft-Windows-Windows Defender|Windows Defender\/(Operational|WHC))/ nocase and
    $e.principal.process.command_line != /\.claude\/shell-snapshots\/snapshot-/ nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1
    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e
}

Threat actors often query Windows Defender event logs post-execution to verify if their payloads or malicious behaviors have triggered security alerts or quarantine actions.

rule ttp_windows_susp_cmds_40 {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Systeminfo Command Execution"
    description = "Detection for Security Validation VID A104-083. Detects the execution of the systeminfo command followed by the findstr command with specific arguments to extract OS Name and OS Version information. This behavior is commonly used by attackers to gather system information for reconnaissance purposes."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0004"
    technique = "T1541"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\bsysteminfo\s+\|+\s+findstr\s+\/B\s+\/C:OS\s+Name\s+\/C:OS\s+Version\s*$`) nocase

    $adv_uid = strings.coalesce($e.principal.asset.product_object_id, $e.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $adv_netid = strings.coalesce($e.principal.asset.ip, $e.principal.asset.mac, $e.principal.ip, $e.principal.mac)
    $adv_name = strings.coalesce($e.principal.asset.hostname, $e.principal.hostname)
    $vic_uid = strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.product_object_id, $e.principal.user.employee_id)
    $vic_netid = strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.email_addresses, $e.principal.user.windows_sid)
    $vic_name = strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.userid, $e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $asset = strings.coalesce($e.principal.asset.product_object_id, $e.principal.asset.asset_id, $e.principal.asset.hostname, $e.principal.hostname)

  match:
    $asset over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 20
    $vendor_name = array($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array($e.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_uid = array($vic_uid)
    $victim_name = array($vic_name)
    $victim_netid = array($vic_netid)
    $adversary_uid = array($adv_uid)
    $adversary_name = array($adv_name)
    $adversary_netid = array($adv_netid)
    $is_successful = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 1))
    $result = if($is_successful > 0, "succeeded", "failed")
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: Detection for Security Validation VID A104-083.     $tmp1 = max(

      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)

rule ttp_sharepoint_cve_2025_49706_exploitation {

    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1210"
    false_positives = "Legitimate administrative actions to the specified URL should be rare. Some penetration testing activity could trigger this rule. In some cases, specific third party applications could generate similar requests, but this should be rare."

rule ttp_windows_local_account_created_via_net_on_workstation {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Local Account Created via Net Command on Workstation"
    description = "Detects on the creation of a local user account on a workstation using the Windows command shell to launch a net.exe command. Threat actors may create a new local account with elevated permissions to execute commands with higher privileges."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1136.001"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    (
      $e.principal.asset.type = "WORKSTATION" or
      $e.principal.asset.type = "LAPTOP" or
      $e.principal.asset.platform_software.platform_patch_level = /Windows\s+\d/ nocase
    )
    (
      $e.target.process.file.full_path = /(^|\\)net\.exe$/ nocase or
      (
        $e.target.process.file.full_path = /(^|\\)net1\.exe$/ nocase and
        $e.principal.process.file.full_path != /(^|\\)net\.exe$/ nocase
      )
    )
    $e.target.process.command_line = /\suser\s/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line = /\/ad(d|\b)/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line != /\/do/
    $e.principal.asset_id = $asset_id

  match:
    $asset_id over 30m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 25
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.windows_sid)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $hostname = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = array($e.principal.process.command_line)
    $principal_process_file_full_path = array($e.principal.process.file.full_path)
    $target_process_command_line = array($e.target.process.command_line)
    $target_process_file_full_path = array($e.target.process.file.full_path)
    $threat_verdict_malicious = max(if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0))
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = max(if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0))
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))
    $recent_compile_time = max(if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0))
    $invalid_cert = max(if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0))
    $system_user_file_write = max(if($e.principal.user.userid = "system", 1, 0))
    $sus_file_name_architecture = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\[^\/]+(32|64).[^\/.]+$/), 1, 0))
    $single_double_char_filename = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*([^\/]{1,2}.[^\/.]+)$/), 1, 0))
    $double_extensions = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+.[a-zA-Z]{3}.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0))
    $all_numbers_file_name = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\d+.[a-zA-Z]{3}$/), 1, 0))
    $common_malicious_file_names = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup.exe|update.js|lsass.dmp|1.txt|ntds.dit|logs.dat|sqlite3.dll|pass_1234|system.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0))
    $is_archive_file = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0))
    $is_executable_file = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0))
    $asset_is_server = max(if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0))
    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $recent_compile_time + $system_user_file_write + $sus_file_name_architecture + $common_malicious_file_names + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_filename + $double_extensions + $sus_vt_tags + $all_numbers_file_name + $is_executable_file + $is_archive_file + $invalid_cert
    $likely_security_testing = max(if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0))

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_double_extension_execution_masquerading {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Execution of File with Double Extension Masquerading"
    description = "Detects the execution of a process where the executable file name contains a double extension, masquerading as a benign document type (e.g., .pdf, .txt) before the actual executable extension (e.g., .exe, .scr). This is a common defense evasion technique."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1036.007"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `\.(pdf|txt|jpg|png|doc|docx|xls|xlsx|ppt|pptx|rtf|csv)\s*\.(exe|scr|pif|com|bat|cmd|vbs|ps1|lnk)$`) nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $principal_process_command_line = array_distinct($e.principal.process.command_line)
    $principal_process_file_path = array_distinct($e.principal.process.file.full_path)
    $target_file_path = array_distinct($e.target.process.file.full_path)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct(if($e.principal.platform = "WINDOWS", $e.principal.user.windows_sid, $e.principal.user.email_addresses))
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result_time = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp_success = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION" and $e.security_result.action != "FAIL", 1, 0))
    $tmp_failed = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK" or $e.security_result.action = "FAIL", 1, 0))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), ($tmp_success * 2) + $tmp_failed)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_fakeupdates_local_data_staging {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Fakeupdates Local Data Staging"
    description = "Detects wscript.exe spawning cmd.exe and redirecting output to a temp file, a behavior consistent with Fakeupdates (also known as SocGholish) malware data staging. FAKEUPDATES is a downloader written in JavaScript that communicates via HTTP. Supported payload types include executables and JavaScript. It writes the payloads to disk prior to launching them. FAKEUPDATES has lead to further compromise via additional malware families that include CHTHONIC, DRIDEX, EMPIRE, KOADIC, DOPPELPAYMER, and AZORULT."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0009"
    technique = "T1074.001"

  events:
    (
      (
        $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION"
        or $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MODIFICATION"
        or $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MOVE"
      ) and
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)cmd\.exe$`) nocase and
      re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, `>`) nocase and
      re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `([A-Z]:)?\\Users\\[^\\\/]+\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\rad[A-F0-9]+\.tmp$`) nocase and
      re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)wscript.exe$`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.command_line, `WScript.exe.*?\\(\\)?User\\(\\)?Scripts\\(\\)?Logon\\(\\)?user_notification\.vbs`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.command_line, `wscript.exe"?.*\\Program Files\\Windows Azure VM Agent.*\\InstallOrUpdateGA\.vbs`) nocase
    ) or
    (
      (
        $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
        or $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"
        or $e.metadata.event_type = "SCAN_UNCATEGORIZED"
      ) and
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)wscript.exe$`) nocase and
      re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)cmd\.exe$`) nocase and
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `cmd(\.exe)?.*(\/c|\/k).*>\s*"?([A-Z]:)?\\Users\\[^\\]+\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\rad[A-F0-9]+\.tmp"?\s*&\s*exit\s*$`) nocase
    )

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 85
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1

    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $threat_verdict_malicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))
    $recent_compile_time = if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)
    $invalid_cert = if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $system_user_file_write = if($e.principal.user.userid = "system", 1, 0)
    $sus_file_name_architecture = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\[^\/]+(32|64)\.[^\/.]+$/), 1, 0)
    $single_double_char_filename = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*([^\/]{1,2}\.[^\/.]+)$/), 1, 0)
    $double_extensions = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+\.[a-zA-Z]{3}\.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_file_name = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\d+\.[a-zA-Z]{3}$/), 1, 0)
    $common_malicious_file_names = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup\.exe|update\.js|lsass\.dmp|1\.txt|ntds\.dit|logs\.dat|sqlite3\.dll|pass_1234|system\.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $is_archive_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0)
    $is_executable_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0)
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)
    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $recent_compile_time + $system_user_file_write + $sus_file_name_architecture + $common_malicious_file_names + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_filename + $double_extensions + $sus_vt_tags + $all_numbers_file_name + $is_executable_file + $is_archive_file + $invalid_cert
    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e
}

FAKEUPDATES is a downloader written in JavaScript that communicates via HTTP. Supported payload types include executables and JavaScript. It writes the payloads to disk prior to launching them. FAKEUPDATES has lead to further compromise via additional malware families that include CHTHONIC, DRIDEX, EMPIRE, KOADIC, DOPPELPAYMER, and AZORULT.

    description = "Detects boot configuration changes via cmd.exe or other suspiciously staged processes. This utility is commonly used in legitimate procedures, however, these TTPs may be used to disable system recovery, the windows recovery screen, and additionally boot the computer into safe-mode to run malicious code. This TTP has been seen in ransomware families such as the AGAIN, REVIL, and RANSOMHUB family."

      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or

    $common_malicious_file_names = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup\.exe|update\.js|lsass\.dmp|1\.txt|ntds\.dit|logs\.dat|sqlite3\.dll|pass_1234|system\.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0)

rule ttp_python_staged_compressed_base64_in_memory_execution {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Python Staged Compressed Base64 In-Memory Execution"
    description = "Detects Python inline execution (-c) decompressing and decoding base64-encoded payloads via zlib.decompress and base64.b64decode, then spawning child processes via subprocess (Popen/run) or sys.executable. Threat actors commonly leverage this multi-stage in-memory execution pattern to evade static disk-based detections and execute compressed C2 stagers."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059.006"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"
    ) and
    $e.target.process.command_line = /\b(iron)?python[0-9\.]*(w)?(\.exe)?\b/ nocase and
    $e.target.process.command_line = /\bzlib\.decompress\b/ nocase and
    $e.target.process.command_line = /\b(base64\.)?b64decode\s*\(\s*['"]?[A-Za-z0-9+\/=]{15,}/ nocase and
    $e.target.process.command_line = /\bsys\.executable\b/ nocase and
    $e.target.process.command_line = /s\.(Popen|call|run|check_output)\b/ nocase

  outcome:

    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id

    $tmp1 = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

    technique = "T1074.001"

    $e.target.process.file.full_path = /(powershell|cmd)\.exe$/ nocase

    $e.principal.process.file.full_path != /(^|\\)ADDMRemQuery_x86_64_v2\.exe$/ nocase
    $e.principal.asset_id = $asset_id

  match:
    $asset_id over 10m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)

    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.windows_sid)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $hostname = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = array($e.principal.process.command_line)
    $principal_process_file_full_path = array($e.principal.process.file.full_path)
    $target_process_command_line = array($e.target.process.command_line)
    $target_process_file_full_path = array($e.target.process.file.full_path)
    $threat_verdict_malicious = max(if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0))
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = max(if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0))
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))
    $recent_compile_time = max(if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0))
    $invalid_cert = max(if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0))
    $system_user_file_write = max(if($e.principal.user.userid = "system", 1, 0))
    $sus_file_name_architecture = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\[^\/]+(32|64).[^\/.]+$/), 1, 0))
    $single_double_char_filename = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*([^\/]{1,2}.[^\/.]+)$/), 1, 0))
    $double_extensions = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+.[a-zA-Z]{3}.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0))
    $all_numbers_file_name = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\d+.[a-zA-Z]{3}$/), 1, 0))
    $common_malicious_file_names = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup.exe|update.js|lsass.dmp|1.txt|ntds.dit|logs.dat|sqlite3.dll|pass_1234|system.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0))
    $is_archive_file = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0))
    $is_executable_file = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0))
    $asset_is_server = max(if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0))
    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $recent_compile_time + $system_user_file_write + $sus_file_name_architecture + $common_malicious_file_names + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_filename + $double_extensions + $sus_vt_tags + $all_numbers_file_name + $is_executable_file + $is_archive_file + $invalid_cert
    $likely_security_testing = max(if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0))

  condition:

}

rule ttp_windows_suspicious_windows_defender_tampering_commands_methodology {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Suspicious Windows Defender Tampering Commands"
    description = "Detects suspicious syntax used in conjunction with the Windows Defender Set-MpPreference command. Set-MpPreference configures preferences for Windows Defender and can be used by threat actors to disable or modify key settings."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1685"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"
    )
    $e.principal.process.command_line != /\\Tanium\\Tanium Client\\/ nocase
    $e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path != /tpython/ nocase
    (
      $e.target.process.command_line = /Set\-MpPreference/ nocase and
      $e.target.process.command_line = /DisableRealTimeMonitoring/ nocase and
      $e.target.process.command_line = /\%ProgramFiles\%\\RocketAgent\\rocketagent/ nocase and
      (
        $e.target.process.command_line = /MAPSReporting (0|Disable)/ nocase or
        $e.target.process.command_line = /-SubmitSamplesConsent (2|Neversend)/ nocase or
        $e.target.process.command_line = /\-AttackSurfaceReductionOnlyExclusions/ nocase or
        $e.target.process.command_line = /-Disable([A-Za-z])+ \$true/ nocase or
        $e.target.process.command_line = /-(Low|Moderate|High|Severe|Unknown)ThreatDefaultAction 6/ nocase
      )
    ) or
    (
      $e.target.process.command_line = /reg\s+add/ nocase and
      (
        $e.target.process.command_line = /\/v (\")?SubmitSamplesConsent(\")? \/t REG_DWORD \/d (\")?2(\")?/ nocase or
        $e.target.process.command_line = /\/v (\")?(DisableEnhancedNotifications|DisableAntiSpyware|DisableAntiVirus|DisableBehaviorMonitoring|DisableIOAVProtection|DisableBlockAtFirstSeen|DisableScanOnRealtimeEnable|DisableRoutinelyTakingAction|DisableOnAccessProtection|DisableRealtimeMonitoring)(\")? \/t REG_DWORD \/d (\")?1(\")?/ nocase or

rule ttp_windows_schtasks_self_deleting_command_chain {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Scheduled Task Self-Deleting Command Chain"
    description = "Detects on a command using the schtasks.exe utility where a Windows Scheduled Task creation and deletion parameter are chained together. Threat actors may execute a scheduled task a single time followed by a deletion of the task to avoid detection."
    severity = "Medium"

    $e.target.process.command_line != /taskkill \/f \/im explorer\.exe|Tanium Client Factory Reset/ nocase
    $e.principal.asset_id = $asset_id

  match:
    $asset_id over 30m

    $risk_score = 65
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)

    $principal_process_command_line = array($e.principal.process.command_line)
    $principal_process_file_full_path = array($e.principal.process.file.full_path)
    $target_process_command_line = array($e.target.process.command_line)
    $target_process_file_full_path = array($e.target.process.file.full_path)
    $threat_verdict_malicious = max(if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0))
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = max(if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0))
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))
    $recent_compile_time = max(if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0))
    $invalid_cert = max(if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0))
    $system_user_file_write = max(if($e.principal.user.userid = "system", 1, 0))
    $sus_file_name_architecture = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\[^\/]+(32|64).[^\/.]+$/), 1, 0))
    $single_double_char_filename = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*([^\/]{1,2}.[^\/.]+)$/), 1, 0))
    $double_extensions = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+.[a-zA-Z]{3}.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0))
    $all_numbers_file_name = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\d+.[a-zA-Z]{3}$/), 1, 0))
    $common_malicious_file_names = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup.exe|update.js|lsass.dmp|1.txt|ntds.dit|logs.dat|sqlite3.dll|pass_1234|system.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0))
    $is_archive_file = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0))
    $is_executable_file = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0))
    $asset_is_server = max(if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0))
    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $recent_compile_time + $system_user_file_write + $sus_file_name_architecture + $common_malicious_file_names + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_filename + $double_extensions + $sus_vt_tags + $all_numbers_file_name + $is_executable_file + $is_archive_file + $invalid_cert
    $likely_security_testing = max(if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0))

  condition:
    $e
}

rules.text:
rule ttp_windows_schtask_created_and_deleted_quickly_by_staged_file {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Scheduled Task Created and Deleted Quickly by Staged File"
    description = "Detects the creation and deletion of a scheduled task within a 5-minute window from a process staged in a suspicious location. This behavior is suspicious and could indicate that an adversary is using a scheduled task to execute a payload and then deleting the task to remove traces of their activity. Verify whether the scheduled task is legitimate."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1053.005"

  events:
    $e1.metadata.event_type = "SCHEDULED_TASK_CREATION"
    $e1.target.process.file.full_path = /(\\AppData\\Roaming|ProgramData|\\Users\\Public|C:\\Temp)\\/ nocase
    $e1.principal.user.userid != /\$$/
    $task = $e1.target.resource.name
    $user = $e1.principal.user.userid
    $e2.metadata.event_type = "SCHEDULED_TASK_DELETION"
    $task = $e2.target.resource.name
    $user = $e2.principal.user.userid
    $e1.target.resource.name != /^\\SigniantApp_auto-launch_|\\ZoomUpdateTaskUser/

  match:
    $task over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e1.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e1.principal.asset.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array($e1.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e1.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e1.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e1.principal.user.windows_sid)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e1.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e1.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e1.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = min($e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count($e1.metadata.id)

    $target_process_file_full_path = array_distinct($e1.target.process.file.full_path)
    $taskname = array_distinct($task)

  condition:
    $e1 and $e2
}

rule ttp_windows_discovery_of_privileged_permission_groups_by_web_server_process {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Discovery of Privileged Permission Groups by Web Server Process"
    description = "This rule is designed to detect on web server processes executing discovery commands to display information about privileged permission groups, such as Domain Admins. Threat actors may use a web shell to collect information on permission groups to determine next steps, including credential harvesting or lateral movement. To further investigate this detection, analysts should review other commands executed by the web server process to determine if they are consistent with threat actor discovery or persistence techniques."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0007"
    technique = "T1069"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    (
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `w3wp\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `httpd\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `tomcat(\d{0,})?\.exe`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `nginx\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `javaw\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `php\-cgi\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `coldfusion\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `ruby\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `wlsvcX64\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `beasvcX64\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `\\Oracle\\`) nocase or
      (
        re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `java\.exe$`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `^net localgroup Administrators$`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `^\"net\" localgroup administrators$`) nocase
      )
    )
    re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `\\net\.exe$`) nocase
    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\b(localgroup|group)\b`) nocase
    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `exchange trusted subsystem|hyper-v administrators|event log readers|schema admins|server operators|backup operators|administrators|domain admins|serviceaccounts|enterprise admins`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `/ad|/de`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `\\Tripwire\\|:\\Users\\|\\Puppet Labs\\Puppet\\puppet\\bin\\ruby\.exe`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, `-DTlcInstallDir=|\\opscode\\chef\\`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `w7rz5w6`) nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 85
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1

    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $threat_verdict_malicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))
    $recent_compile_time = if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)
    $invalid_cert = if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $system_user_file_write = if($e.principal.user.userid = "system", 1, 0)
    $sus_file_name_architecture = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\[^\/]+(32|64).[^\/.]+$/), 1, 0)
    $single_double_char_filename = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*([^\/]{1,2}.[^\/.]+)$/), 1, 0)
    $double_extensions = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+.[a-zA-Z]{3}.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_file_name = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\d+.[a-zA-Z]{3}$/), 1, 0)
    $common_malicious_file_names = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup\.exe|update\.js|lsass\.dmp|1\.txt|ntds\.dit|logs\.dat|sqlite3\.dll|pass_1234|system\.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $is_archive_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0)
    $is_executable_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0)
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)
    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $recent_compile_time + $system_user_file_write + $sus_file_name_architecture + $common_malicious_file_names + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_filename + $double_extensions + $sus_vt_tags + $all_numbers_file_name + $is_executable_file + $is_archive_file + $invalid_cert
    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_windows_plink_exe_tunneler {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Plink Tunneler Execution"
    description = "Plink is a command line network traffic tunneling utility that is part of the PuTTY suite. While it has legitimate uses, attackers often use it to tunnel traffic to evade defenses (e.g. SSH over a port other than 22, RDP forwarding of port 3389 to localhost)."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1090"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, ` [-/]R `)
    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, ` [-/]pw `)
    (
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, ` \d{1,5}:`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, ` \d{1,5}:[^:\s]+:\d{1,5}(\s.*)?$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, ` [\d.]{5,15}:\d{1,5}:[\d.]{5,15}:\d{1,5}(\s.*)?$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `:\d{1,5}(\s.*)?$`) nocase
    )
    not re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\ShowMyPC\\\-ShowMyPc\\spcplink\.exe$`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\ShowMyPC\\\-ShowMyPc\\SMPCSetup\.exe$`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `hyper-remote-install\.exe$`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, `hyper-remote-install\.exe`) nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1

    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $threat_verdict_malicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))
    $recent_compile_time = if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)
    $invalid_cert = if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $system_user_file_write = if($e.principal.user.userid = "system", 1, 0)
    $sus_file_name_architecture = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\[^\/]+(32|64).[^\/.]+$/), 1, 0)
    $single_double_char_filename = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*([^\/]{1,2}.[^\/.]+)$/), 1, 0)
    $double_extensions = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+.[a-zA-Z]{3}.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_file_name = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\d+.[a-zA-Z]{3}$/), 1, 0)
    $common_malicious_file_names = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup\.exe|update\.js|lsass\.dmp|1\.txt|ntds\.dit|logs\.dat|sqlite3\.dll|pass_1234|system\.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $is_archive_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0)
    $is_executable_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0)
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)
    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $recent_compile_time + $system_user_file_write + $sus_file_name_architecture + $common_malicious_file_names + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_filename + $double_extensions + $sus_vt_tags + $all_numbers_file_name + $is_executable_file + $is_archive_file + $invalid_cert
    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_screenconnect_network_connection_to_newly_created_domain {
  meta:
    rule_name = "ScreenConnect Network Connection to Newly Created Domain"
    description = "Detects a ScreenConnect process initiating outbound network connections to a domain registered within the last 30 days. Adversaries frequently abuse legitimate remote monitoring and management (RMM) tools like ScreenConnect configured to communicate with newly registered attacker-controlled relay domains to maintain persistent remote access and evade command-and-control detections."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1204.002"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_HTTP" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_DNS"
    )
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /screenconnect/ nocase
    $e.principal.hostname = $hostname
    $remote_domain = strings.coalesce(
      strings.extract_hostname($e.target.url),
      $e.network.dns.questions.name,
      $e.target.hostname
    )
    $remote_domain != ""
    $remote_domain = $whois_domain.graph.entity.domain.name
    $whois_domain.graph.metadata.entity_type = "DOMAIN_NAME"
    $whois_domain.graph.metadata.vendor_name = "WHOIS"
    $whois_domain.graph.metadata.product_name = "WHOISXMLAPI Simple Whois"
    $whois_domain.graph.metadata.source_type = "GLOBAL_CONTEXT"
    $whois_domain.graph.entity.domain.creation_time.seconds > 0
    $creationdate = $whois_domain.graph.entity.domain.creation_time.seconds
    2592000 > timestamp.current_seconds() - $whois_domain.graph.entity.domain.creation_time.seconds

  match:
    $hostname over 30m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.windows_sid)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $principal_hostname = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)
    $principal_process_command_line = array_distinct($e.principal.process.command_line)

    $target_url = array_distinct($e.target.url)
    $domain = array_distinct($remote_domain)
    $target_domain = array_distinct($e.target.hostname)
    $dns_question_name = array_distinct($e.network.dns.questions.name)
    $domain_creation_date = array($creationdate)

  condition:
    $e and $whois_domain
}

rules.text:
rule hunting_t1071_001_unknown_endpoint_generating_doh_and_web_development_services_communication {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Unknown Endpoint Generating DNS-over-HTTPS and Web Application Development Services Communication"
    description = "Detects on requests by an unknown source IP address to multiple DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) resolver services and web application development services, such as Cloudflare Workers or Heroku hosted web applications. To investigate this activity further, determine the source of the network activity and verify if the communication is consistent with the device's intended use and standard allow-list domains."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1071.001"
    reference = "https://blog.nviso.eu/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/NVISO-BRICKSTORM-Report.pdf"

  events:
    $c1.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
    $c1.target.ip = /^(8\.8\.8\.8|8\.8\.4\.4|9\.9\.9\.9|9\.9\.9\.11|1\.1\.1\.1|1\.0\.0\.1|45\.90\.28\.160|45\.90\.30\.160|149\.112\.112\.112|149\.112\.112\.11)$/ nocase
    $c1.principal.hostname = ""
    $c1.principal.asset_id = ""
    (
      $c1.target.port = 443 or
      $c1.target.url = /dns-query|:443\/$|\d\.\d\.\d\.\d\/$/ nocase
    )
    $c1.principal.process.file.full_path != /Google Chrome Helper|io\.tailscale\.ipn\.macsys\.network-extension|opera_autoupdate|mDNSResponder|\\aakore\.exe|\\opera\.exe$/ nocase
    $c1.principal.administrative_domain != /jac-visitor/ nocase
    $c1.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path != /\\opera\.exe$/ nocase
    $c1.additional.fields["devtype"] != /Mobile Generic|Phone/ nocase
    $c1.additional.fields["applist"] != /GUEST/ nocase
    $c1.extracted.fields["device_name"] != /ipad/ nocase
    $c1.extracted.fields["os_type"] != /OS_IOS/ nocase
    $c1.security_result.rule_name != /GUEST|BYOD/ nocase
    $c2.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
    $c2.target.hostname = /\.workers\.dev$|\.herokuapp\.com$/ nocase
    $c2.principal.hostname = ""
    $c2.principal.asset_id = ""
    $c2.target.port = 443
    $c2.target.url = $url
    $source_entity = $c1.principal.ip
    $source_entity = $c2.principal.ip

  match:
    $source_entity over 24h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(35)
    $unique_ips = array_distinct($c1.target.ip)
    $unique_doh_ips_count = count_distinct($c1.target.ip)
    $unique_urls = array_distinct($c1.target.url)
    $unique_urls_count = count_distinct($c1.target.url)
    $event_count = count_distinct($c1.metadata.id)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($c1.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $c1.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($c1.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = min($c1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($c1.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($c1.principal.asset.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($c1.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($c1.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($c1.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($c1.principal.user.windows_sid)

  condition:
    $c1 and $c2 and $unique_doh_ips_count >= 3

  options:
    allow_zero_values = true
}

rule ttp_windows_windows_defaultaccount_activation {
  meta:

    description = "This signature detects on the activation of the built-in account DEFAULTACCOUNT (c:_Users_Default). This account is a standard account on Windows 10 and Windows Server 2016 and serves as the model for what standard user accounts may look like. The account is typically disabled and does not require a password for usage. Threat actors have been observed enabling this account, and subsequently adding it to privileged groups such as Remote Desktop Users or Administrators"
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1078.001"
    reference = "https://thedfirreport.com/2021/11/15/exchange-exploit-leads-to-domain-wide-ransomware/"

    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `DefaultAccount`) nocase
    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `active:yes`) nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 85
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id

    $tmp1 = max(

    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1

    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $threat_verdict_malicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))
    $recent_compile_time = if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)
    $invalid_cert = if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $system_user_file_write = if($e.principal.user.userid = "system", 1, 0)
    $sus_file_name_architecture = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\[^\/]+(32|64).[^\/.]+$/), 1, 0)
    $single_double_char_filename = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*([^\/]{1,2}.[^\/.]+)$/), 1, 0)
    $double_extensions = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+.[a-zA-Z]{3}.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_file_name = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\d+.[a-zA-Z]{3}$/), 1, 0)
    $common_malicious_file_names = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup\.exe|update\.js|lsass\.dmp|1\.txt|ntds\.dit|logs\.dat|sqlite3\.dll|pass_1234|system\.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $is_archive_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0)
    $is_executable_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0)
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)
    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $recent_compile_time + $system_user_file_write + $sus_file_name_architecture + $common_malicious_file_names + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_filename + $double_extensions + $sus_vt_tags + $all_numbers_file_name + $is_executable_file + $is_archive_file + $invalid_cert

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_windows_cmd_spawning_curl_wget {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Windows Command Shell Spawning Download Utility Followed by Exit"
    description = "Detects when the Windows Command Shell (cmd.exe) finishes execution with an 'exit' command after spawning a download utility (curl/wget). This pattern is often used in download cradles to minimize interactive footprint."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1105"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MODIFICATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MOVE" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_UNCATEGORIZED" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_HTTP" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_DNS" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_UNCATEGORIZED"
    ) and
    (
      $e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path = /\bcmd\.exe$/ nocase or
      $e.principal.process.parent_process.file.names = /\bcmd\.exe$/ nocase
    ) and
    $e.principal.process.parent_process.command_line = /exit"?\s*$/ nocase and
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /\b(curl|wget)(\.exe)?$/ nocase and
    $e.principal.process.command_line != /artifactory\.dev\.osii\.com/ nocase

    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname

  match:
    $hostname over 10m

    $risk_score = 65
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $tmp1 = max(

    $event_count = count($e.metadata.id)
    $principal_hostname = array_distinct($hostname)

    $target_hostname = array_distinct($e.target.hostname)
    $network_dns_question_name = array_distinct($e.network.dns.questions.name)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_windows_art_cmds_12 {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Add netsh portproxy v4tov4"
    description = "Detects the execution of a command that creates a port proxy using the netsh command-line tool. This behavior is often associated with attackers attempting to establish remote access to a system. The command is identified by matching indicators in the command line of a process."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1090"

  events:
    $hostname = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `^cmd\.+exe\s+/c\s+["']?netsh\s+interface\s+portproxy\s+add\s+v4tov4\s+listenaddress=(?:(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)\.){3}(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)\s+listenport=9999\s+connectaddress=(?:(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)\.){3}(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)\s+connectport=8443\s+protocol=tcp["']?\s*$`) nocase

  match:
    $hostname over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 20
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.hostname)

rule ttp_windows_remote_desktop_enable_methodology {
  meta:

    description = "This signature is designed to detect on command line arguments designed to enable remote desktop access via registry. This technique is commonly seen being utilized by attackers in order to elevate privileges, maintain access, or deploy ransomware."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1112"
  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    ) and
    (
      re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `reg\.exe$`) nocase and

      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `HKLM\\system\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Terminal Server`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, `BESClient\.exe`) nocase and
      (
        (
          re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `fDenyTSConnections`) nocase and
          re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `REG_DWORD \/d 0x0`) nocase
        ) or

    $target_process_file_full_paths = array($e.target.process.file.full_path)
    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
  condition:
    $e

rule ttp_windows_susp_cmds_37 {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Attrib Hiding Regular File"
    description = "Detection for Security Validation VID A104-072. Detects the use of the attrib command with the +h flag to hide a file. This behavior is often associated with attackers attempting to hide malicious files on a system."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1036"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\battrib\s+\++h\s+\w+\.\w+\s*$`) nocase

    $adv_uid = strings.coalesce($e.principal.asset.product_object_id, $e.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $adv_netid = strings.coalesce($e.principal.asset.ip, $e.principal.asset.mac, $e.principal.ip, $e.principal.mac)
    $adv_name = strings.coalesce($e.principal.asset.hostname, $e.principal.hostname)
    $vic_uid = strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.product_object_id, $e.principal.user.employee_id)
    $vic_netid = strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.email_addresses, $e.principal.user.windows_sid)
    $vic_name = strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.userid, $e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $asset = strings.coalesce($e.principal.asset.product_object_id, $e.principal.asset.asset_id, $e.principal.asset.hostname, $e.principal.hostname)

  match:
    $asset over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 20
    $vendor_name = array($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array($e.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_uid = array($vic_uid)
    $victim_name = array($vic_name)
    $victim_netid = array($vic_netid)
    $adversary_uid = array($adv_uid)
    $adversary_name = array($adv_name)
    $adversary_netid = array($adv_netid)

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_windows_wmi_event_consumer_creation_powershell_cmdlet {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Windows WMI Event Consumer Creation via PowerShell Cmdlet"
    description = "Detects on a Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI) event consumer creation with the New-CimInstance or Register-WmiEvent PowerShell cmdlets. Threat actors can use WMI to create persistent event subscriptions that execute a file or command upon a specific trigger event."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1546.003"
    reference = "https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/threat-intelligence/dissecting-one-ofap"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    (
      $e.target.process.command_line = /Register-WmiEvent/ nocase or
      (
        $e.target.process.command_line = /New-CimInstance/ nocase and
        $e.target.process.command_line = /-Property\s/ nocase and
        $e.target.process.command_line != /-Action\s/ nocase
      )
    )
    $e.target.process.command_line = /ActiveScriptEventConsumer|CommandLineEventConsumer|ScriptFilename|ScriptText|\bExecutablePath|CommandLineTemplate|-Action/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line != /Write-MTRPLog|\s\.SYNOPSIS\s/
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path != /Waves Central.exe/ nocase
    $e.principal.asset_id = $asset_id

  match:
    $asset_id over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)

    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)

      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $hostname = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = array($e.principal.process.command_line)
    $principal_process_file_full_path = array($e.principal.process.file.full_path)
    $target_process_command_line = array($e.target.process.command_line)
    $target_process_file_full_path = array($e.target.process.file.full_path)
    $threat_verdict_malicious = max(if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0))
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = max(if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0))
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))
    $recent_compile_time = max(if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0))
    $invalid_cert = max(if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0))
    $system_user_file_write = max(if($e.principal.user.userid = "system", 1, 0))
    $sus_file_name_architecture = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\[^\/]+(32|64).[^\/.]+$/), 1, 0))
    $single_double_char_filename = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*([^\/]{1,2}.[^\/.]+)$/), 1, 0))
    $double_extensions = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+.[a-zA-Z]{3}.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0))
    $all_numbers_file_name = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\d+.[a-zA-Z]{3}$/), 1, 0))
    $common_malicious_file_names = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup.exe|update.js|lsass.dmp|1.txt|ntds.dit|logs.dat|sqlite3.dll|pass_1234|system.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0))
    $is_archive_file = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0))
    $is_executable_file = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0))
    $asset_is_server = max(if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0))
    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $recent_compile_time + $system_user_file_write + $sus_file_name_architecture + $common_malicious_file_names + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_filename + $double_extensions + $sus_vt_tags + $all_numbers_file_name + $is_executable_file + $is_archive_file + $invalid_cert
    $likely_security_testing = max(if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0))

  condition:
    $e
}

    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1074.001"

    $e2.principal.process.file.full_path = /\\(Users|Downloads|AppData|Desktop)\\/ nocase // Enforce on this event

rule ttp_windows_windows_web_server_process_echo_base64_encoded_string {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Windows Web Server Process Echo Base64 Encoded String"
    description = "This signature is designed to detect on a web server process executing a Windows command shell 'echo' command to write a base64 string to a file on disk. Threat actors may use command line utilities and a base64 encoded string to create test files or web shells following web application exploitation."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1505.003"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `^.{0,100}(\/[cr][\s"]+)?echo\s+[a-zA-Z0-9+\/]{20,}={0,2}(\s+)?>{1,2}`) nocase
    (
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `w3wp\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `httpd\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `tomcat(\d{0,})?\.exe`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `java\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `nginx\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `javaw\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `php\-cgi\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `coldfusion\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `ruby\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `wlsvcX64\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `beasvcX64\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `\\Oracle\\`) nocase
    )
    not re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `\\Tripwire\\`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `echo exit >>c:\\[^\\\/]+\\bin\\ThrottleReset\.cmd|> D:\\Olympus\\Logs\\SystemBackup\\|echo 2228 > D:\\oracle\\app\\Admin_|echo exploited >/dev/tcp`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, `\\Tripwire\\|Esprida LiveControl Agent\\bin\\EspridaAgent`) nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 85
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1

    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $threat_verdict_malicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))
    $recent_compile_time = if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)
    $invalid_cert = if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $system_user_file_write = if($e.principal.user.userid = "system", 1, 0)
    $sus_file_name_architecture = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\[^\/]+(32|64).[^\/.]+$/), 1, 0)
    $single_double_char_filename = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*([^\/]{1,2}.[^\/.]+)$/), 1, 0)
    $double_extensions = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+.[a-zA-Z]{3}.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_file_name = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\d+.[a-zA-Z]{3}$/), 1, 0)
    $common_malicious_file_names = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup\.exe|update\.js|lsass\.dmp|1\.txt|ntds\.dit|logs\.dat|sqlite3\.dll|pass_1234|system\.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $is_archive_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0)
    $is_executable_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0)
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)
    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $recent_compile_time + $system_user_file_write + $sus_file_name_architecture + $common_malicious_file_names + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_filename + $double_extensions + $sus_vt_tags + $all_numbers_file_name + $is_executable_file + $is_archive_file + $invalid_cert
    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_windows_explorer_spawning_pak_filewrite_to_locals_methodology {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Explorer.exe Writing Pak File to Locals Directory Indicative of Vidar Malware"
    description = "Detects on processes being spawned by the parent process Explorer.exe that write 'pak' files to the 'locals' directory. These files are commonly delivered as part of a malicious archive. This technique is associated with the Vidar information stealer malware."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1204.002"
  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MODIFICATION"
    ) and
    re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `pak$`) nocase
    re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `Locals`) nocase
    re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `explorer\.exe`) nocase
  outcome:
    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $risk_score = 35
    $vendor_name = array($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: Detects on processes being spawned by the parent process Explorer.exe that write 'pak' files to the 'locals' directory. These files are commonly delivered as part of a malicious archive. This technique is associated with the Vidar information stealer malware.
rules.author: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence

rules.display_name: Suspicious File Write by Bun Package Runner
rules.text:
rule ttp_bun_suspicious_file_write {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Suspicious File Write by Bun Package Runner"
    description = "Detects instances where the Bun JavaScript runtime (bun) is executed with command-line arguments indicating package runner actions (_npx) and performs a file creation, modification, or move. Adversaries or compromised dependencies can abuse the bun runtime and package manager utilities to fetch and install malicious packages (supply chain compromise) or drop/write secondary payloads to evade standard application monitoring and restrictions."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059.007"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MODIFICATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MOVE"
    )
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /\bbun(\.exe)?$/ nocase
    $e.principal.process.command_line = /_npx[\/\\].*\.js\b/ nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1
    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_file_path = $e.target.file.full_path
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: Detects instances where the Bun JavaScript runtime (bun) is executed with command-line arguments indicating package runner actions (_npx) and performs a file creation, modification, or move. Adversaries or compromised dependencies can abuse the bun runtime and package manager utilities to fetch and install malicious packages (supply chain compromise) or drop/write secondary payloads to evade standard application monitoring and restrictions.
