rules.display_name: Suspicious Dns Lookup Events To C2 Top Level Domains
rules.text:
rule ttp_windows_suspicious_dns_lookup_events_to_c2_top_level_domains {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Suspicious Dns Lookup Events To C2 Top Level Domains"
    description = "Detects network requests to top-level domains such as .fun or .shop. This technique has been previously associated with various malware families, enabling them to send updates, receive instructions, and steal data."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1071.001"
    reference = "https://www.googlecloudcommunity.com/gc/Community-Blog/Finding-Malware-Unveiling-LUMMAC-V2-with-Google-Security/ba-p/899110"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_DNS"
    (
      re.regex($e.network.dns.questions.name, `(\.(store|click|live|bet|help|zip|digital|today|fun|shop|cfd|sbs|cyou|xyz|icu)$|b-cdn\.net|.{40,}\.(it|ru)$)`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.network.dns.questions.name, `(^[^\.]+\.site$|^[^\.]+\.top$|^[a-z0-9]{3}\.[^\.]+\.top$)`) nocase
    )
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path != ""
    $e.principal.process.command_line != ""
    (
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)MSBuild\.EXE$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)RunOnce\.EXE$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)RegSvcs\.EXE$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)Sc\.EXE$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)wab\.EXE$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)RoboCopy\.EXE$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)OpenWith\.EXE$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)Forfiles\.EXE$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)MakeCab\.EXE$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)Autoit3\.EXE$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)Wscript\.EXE$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `\.pif$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)Setup\.exe`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `\\BitLocker`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)regsvr32\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)rundll32\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)mshta\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)powershell\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)SearchIndexer\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)msiexec\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)FileHistory\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)wsmprovhost\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `Microsoft\.NET\\Framework`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)PsExec\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)TrustedInstaller\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|^[A-Z]:)\\Programdata\\[^\\\/]+$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `\.com$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `\\AppData\\Roaming\\[^\\\/]+\\[^\\\/]+$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\[^\\\/]+\\[^\\\/]+$`) nocase
    )
    $e.principal.process.command_line != /(PcaSvc\.dll,PcaPatchSdbTask|Updateandremovethumbnailphoto\.ps1)/ nocase
    $e.principal.process.command_line != /C:\\Program Files\\WindowsPowerShell\\Modules\\gytpol\\TaskEnv\\/ nocase
    $e.principal.process.command_line != /\\Program Files\\qcloud\\tat_agent\\tat_install\\install\.ps1/ nocase
    $e.principal.process.command_line != /C:\\ProgramData\\Amazon\\SSM\\InstanceData\\[^\\]+\\document\\orchestration\\[^\\]+\\PatchWindows\\_script\.ps1/ nocase
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path != /\\AppData\\Roaming\\Spotify\\Spotify\.exe$/ nocase
    $e.network.dns.questions.name != /(\.logitechg\.com\.cn|\.amazonaws\.com\.cn|testimo-check\.evotec\.xyz|\.windowsupdate\.com|ascii.live)/ nocase
    $e.target.hostname != /(fastweb|sslvpn)/ nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1

    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $dns_questions_name = array_distinct($e.network.dns.questions.name)
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)
    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $suppression_key = $hostname

  condition:
    $e

  options:
    suppression_window = 10m
}

rule ttp_windows_art_cmds_17 {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Powershell delete shadow copies"
    description = "Detects when PowerShell is used to delete shadow copies on a system. Shadow copies are used to create backups of files and folders, and deleting them can make it more difficult to recover data in the event of a ransomware attack or other data loss scenario. This behavior is often associated with attackers attempting to cover their tracks or prevent data recovery."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0040"
    technique = "T1490"

  events:
    $hostname = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\bpowershell(\.exe)?\s+-Command\s+["']?Get-WmiObject\s+Win32_Shadowcopy\s+\|\s+Remove-WmiObject["']?\s*$`) nocase

  match:
    $hostname over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 20
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.windows_sid)
    $result = array_distinct($e.security_result.summary)
    $result_time = array_distinct($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule hunting_t1071_001_slack_api_private_workspace_communication {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Slack API Private Workspace Communication"
    description = "Detects communication with the Slack API involving a private workspace, which can be used by threat actors as a mechanism for data exfiltration or command and control."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1071.001"
    reference = "https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/19/c/new-slub-backdoor-uses-github-communicates-via-slack.html"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
    $e.target.url = /(api|methods)\/(chat\.postMessage|conversations\.history|channels\.history|files\.upload)/ nocase
    $e.target.hostname = /^(api\.)?slack\.com$/ nocase
    $e.target.port = 443
    $e.target.url = $url
    $source_entity = strings.coalesce($e.principal.ip, $e.principal.asset_id)

  match:
    $source_entity over 1m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(65)
    $unique_ips = array_distinct($e.target.ip)
    $unique_ips_count = count_distinct($e.target.ip)
    $unique_urls = array_distinct($e.target.url)
    $unique_urls_count = count_distinct($e.target.url)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.windows_sid)

  condition:
    $e

  options:
    allow_zero_values = true
}
rules.description: Detects communication with the Slack API involving a private workspace, which can be used by threat actors as a mechanism for data exfiltration or command and control.

rules.text:
rule ttp_windows_service_creation_via_cli_service_control_app {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Service Creation via CLI with Service Control Application"
    description = "Detects on a command using the Service Control application sc.exe to create a Windows Service."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1543.003"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"

rule ttp_windows_windows_registry_query_for_uninstall_string {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Windows Registry Query for Uninstall String"
    description = "Detects short command execution of the registry query command to enumerate a program's uninstaller executable via the uninstaller registry key which may be used to attempt to disable security software."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0007"
    technique = "T1012"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $e.target.process.command_line = /reg query.*\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\(uninstall|Run)\\[^\{].*(quiet)?uninstallstring(\"+)$/ nocase
    $e.principal.process.command_line != /\\AppData\\Local\\8x8-Work\\[a-z0-9\-\.]+\\8x8 Work\.exe/ nocase
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path != /\\AppData\\Local\\8x8-Work\\[a-z0-9\-\.]+\\8x8 Work\.exe/ nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1

    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $threat_verdict_malicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))
    $recent_compile_time = if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)
    $invalid_cert = if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $system_user_file_write = if($e.principal.user.userid = "system", 1, 0)
    $sus_file_name_architecture = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\[^\/]+(32|64).[^\/.]+$/), 1, 0)
    $single_double_char_filename = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*([^\/]{1,2}.[^\/.]+)$/), 1, 0)
    $double_extensions = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+.[a-zA-Z]{3}.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_file_name = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\d+.[a-zA-Z]{3}$/), 1, 0)
    $common_malicious_file_names = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup\.exe|update\.js|lsass\.dmp|1\.txt|ntds\.dit|logs\.dat|sqlite3\.dll|pass_1234|system\.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $is_archive_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0)
    $is_executable_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0)
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)
    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $recent_compile_time + $system_user_file_write + $sus_file_name_architecture + $common_malicious_file_names + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_filename + $double_extensions + $sus_vt_tags + $all_numbers_file_name + $is_executable_file + $is_archive_file + $invalid_cert
    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_windows_account_added_to_permissions_group_by_web_server_process {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Account Added to Permissions Group by Web Server Process"
    description = "Detects on the addition of a user account to a local or domain permissions group by a web server process. A threat actor may use a web shell to add a user account to a privileged security group, such as the local administrators group. To further investigate this alert, analysts should review other commands executed by the web server process to determine if they are consistent with threat actor discovery or persistence techniques."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0004"
    technique = "T1098.007"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    (
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `w3wp\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `httpd\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `tomcat(\d{0,})?\.exe`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `nginx\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `javaw\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `php\-cgi\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `coldfusion\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `ruby\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `wlsvcX64\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `beasvcX64\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `\\Oracle\\`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `java\.exe$`)
    )
    re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `\\net\.exe$`) nocase
    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\b(localgroup|group)\b`) nocase
    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `/ad`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `^net localgroup DccService /add$|\"net\" localgroup \"Performance Monitor Users\"|powerschool|psinstaller|ora_dba`) nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 85
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1

    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $threat_verdict_malicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))
    $recent_compile_time = if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)
    $invalid_cert = if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $system_user_file_write = if($e.principal.user.userid = "system", 1, 0)
    $sus_file_name_architecture = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\[^\/]+(32|64).[^\/.]+$/), 1, 0)
    $single_double_char_filename = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*([^\/]{1,2}.[^\/.]+)$/), 1, 0)
    $double_extensions = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+.[a-zA-Z]{3}.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_file_name = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\d+.[a-zA-Z]{3}$/), 1, 0)
    $common_malicious_file_names = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup\.exe|update\.js|lsass\.dmp|1\.txt|ntds\.dit|logs\.dat|sqlite3\.dll|pass_1234|system\.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $is_archive_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0)
    $is_executable_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0)
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)
    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $recent_compile_time + $system_user_file_write + $sus_file_name_architecture + $common_malicious_file_names + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_filename + $double_extensions + $sus_vt_tags + $all_numbers_file_name + $is_executable_file + $is_archive_file + $invalid_cert
    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_windows_process_execution_with_recycler_bin_in_commandline {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Process Execution with Recycler Bin in Commandline"
    description = "Detect on process execution with RECYCLER.BIN or RECYCLERS.BIN in the command line arguments. This activity has been observed in SOGU and FLOOPYSTAMP compromises."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0009"
    technique = "T1074.001"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = `PROCESS_LAUNCH`
    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `RECYCLERS?\.BIN`) nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1

    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $threat_verdict_malicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))
    $recent_compile_time = if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)
    $invalid_cert = if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $system_user_file_write = if($e.principal.user.userid = "system", 1, 0)
    $sus_file_name_architecture = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\[^\/]+(32|64).[^\/.]+$/), 1, 0)
    $single_double_char_filename = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*([^\/]{1,2}.[^\/.]+)$/), 1, 0)
    $double_extensions = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+.[a-zA-Z]{3}.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_file_name = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\d+.[a-zA-Z]{3}$/), 1, 0)
    $common_malicious_file_names = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup\.exe|update\.js|lsass\.dmp|1\.txt|ntds\.dit|logs\.dat|sqlite3\.dll|pass_1234|system\.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $is_archive_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0)
    $is_executable_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0)
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)
    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $recent_compile_time + $system_user_file_write + $sus_file_name_architecture + $common_malicious_file_names + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_filename + $double_extensions + $sus_vt_tags + $all_numbers_file_name + $is_executable_file + $is_archive_file + $invalid_cert
    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_windows_wscript_launching_cmd_with_recon_commands_methodology {

    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `wscript\.exe$`) nocase
    re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `cmd\.exe$`) nocase
    (
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `>>\s*["](?:[A-Z]:|\\Device\\HarddiskVolume\d+)\\.*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\`) nocase and
      (
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `whoami`) nocase or
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `(?:[A-Z]:|\\Device\\HarddiskVolume\d+)\\windows\\temp\\`) nocase or
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `nltest`) nocase or

      )
    ) or

      (
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\.js`) nocase or
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\.dll`) nocase
      ) and

    ) or
    (
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `powershell`) nocase and

    ) or
    (
      re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, `\.js`) nocase and

    )
  outcome:
    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $risk_score = 35
    $vendor_name = array($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(

    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

    $event_count = 1
  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_windows_susp_cmds_10 {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Net Group Domain Enumeration"
    description = "Detection for Security Validation VID A104-025. Detects when the net group /domain command is executed on a host. This command is often used by attackers to enumerate domain groups and users, which can be used to identify targets for further attacks."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0043"
    technique = "T1592"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\bnet\s+group\s+\/domain\s*$`) nocase

    $adv_uid = strings.coalesce($e.principal.asset.product_object_id, $e.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $adv_netid = strings.coalesce($e.principal.asset.ip, $e.principal.asset.mac, $e.principal.ip, $e.principal.mac)
    $adv_name = strings.coalesce($e.principal.asset.hostname, $e.principal.hostname)
    $vic_uid = strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.product_object_id, $e.principal.user.employee_id)
    $vic_netid = strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.email_addresses, $e.principal.user.windows_sid)
    $vic_name = strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.userid, $e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $asset = strings.coalesce($e.principal.asset.product_object_id, $e.principal.asset.asset_id, $e.principal.asset.hostname, $e.principal.hostname)

  match:
    $asset over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 20
    $vendor_name = array($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array($e.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_uid = array($vic_uid)
    $victim_name = array($vic_name)
    $victim_netid = array($vic_netid)
    $adversary_uid = array($adv_uid)
    $adversary_name = array($adv_name)
    $adversary_netid = array($adv_netid)
    $is_successful = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 1))
    $result = if($is_successful > 0, "succeeded", "failed")
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_windows_powershell_launching_mshta {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Powershell Launching Mshta"
    description = "Detects on mshta.exe execution where the parent process is powershell.exe. This suspicious parent-child relationship is a known TTP for proxying the execution of malicious scripts or remote payloads through a trusted Windows binary."
    severity = "Info"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1218.005"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `mshta\.exe$`) nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line != ""
    (
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `powershell\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `pwsh\.exe$`) nocase
    ) and
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `teckcominco`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `a200\-`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `LdapWrite`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `^"C:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\mshta\.exe" "javascript:alert`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\\SysWOW64\\mshta.exe" "([CEF]:\\(Service\\)?EA_\d.*\\|[FG]:\\(AIM)?)Setup\.hta"`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\\Prod\\Common\\AppstatusW10\\AppStatus\.hta`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\\Prod\\Common\\TsIsRunning\\TsIsRunning\.hta`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\mshta\.exe" "C:\\PROGRA\~1\\PTC\\procom\\bin\\START_\~1\.HTA"`) nocase

    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `"C:\\Windows\\SysWOW64\\mshta\.exe" "C:\\PVSTools\\vDiskReplicator\\VdisRepl\.hta"`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `VOLVO\.NET\\MyPlace\\mpsys\\PreProd\\Common\\AppstatusW10\\AppStatus\.hta`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\\Tools\\Bios Tool\\_ThinkBiosConfig\.hta`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `:\\SOLIDWORKS 2022 SP5\\StartSWInstall\.hta`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `:\\Program Files \(x86\)\\Visage Imaging\\Visage PACS\\Tools\\LicenseManager\.hta`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `_Process\.hta /process`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\\AppData\\Roaming\\IBM\\GettingStarted\\SplashPage\.hta`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\\20003_Process_UN\.hta /process`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `"C:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\mshta\.exe" C:\\Temp\\QA\\Published\\20007_Process_UN\.hta /process`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `C:\\WINDOWS\\ccmcache\\o\\20008_Process_UN\.hta /process`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `Process_Un\.hta /process`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `Progressbar\\d\?_Install\\\.hta \\/process`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\\ProgressBar\d?_Install\.hta \/process `) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `C:\\ProgramData\\...\\banner\\(\w{2,4}\\)?LogonSecBanner([\w]+)?\.hta`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\\scripts\\ps\-admin\_menu\_ultrabook\_DellUltrabookLightMode\.hta`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\-SAP\-EasyDMS\-\d`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\\EasyDmsBU\.hta" \/Process`) nocase

    not re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, `\\Citrix_PROD\\CONTENT\\GPD\\GPD_SIGMA_PROD\\LaunchApp`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, `\\Microsoft Intune Management Extension\\Policies\\Scripts\\[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-([0-9a-fA-F]{4}-){3}[0-9a-fA-F]{12}_[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-([0-9a-fA-F]{4}-){3}[0-9a-fA-F]{12}\.ps1`) nocase

    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line

    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $threat_verdict_malicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))
    $recent_compile_time = if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)
    $invalid_cert = if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $system_user_file_write = if($e.principal.user.userid = "system", 1, 0)
    $sus_file_name_architecture = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\[^\/]+(32|64).[^\/.]+$/), 1, 0)
    $single_double_char_filename = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*([^\/]{1,2}.[^\/.]+)$/), 1, 0)
    $double_extensions = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+.[a-zA-Z]{3}.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_file_name = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\d+.[a-zA-Z]{3}$/), 1, 0)
    $common_malicious_file_names = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup\.exe|update\.js|lsass\.dmp|1\.txt|ntds\.dit|logs\.dat|sqlite3\.dll|pass_1234|system\.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $is_archive_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0)
    $is_executable_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0)
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)
    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $recent_compile_time + $system_user_file_write + $sus_file_name_architecture + $common_malicious_file_names + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_filename + $double_extensions + $sus_vt_tags + $all_numbers_file_name + $is_executable_file + $is_archive_file + $invalid_cert
    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e
}

    $victim_name = $e.principal.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct(
      if($e.principal.platform = "WINDOWS",
        $e.principal.user.windows_sid,  // Value if TRUE
        $e.principal.user.email_addresses       // Value if FALSE (covers LINUX and MAC in this case)
      )
    )
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)

      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)

    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

rule ttp_windows_lolbin_network_connection_to_newly_created_domain {
  meta:

    description = "Detects native Windows utilities and LOLBins such as (powershell.exe, curl.exe, etc.) initiating outbound network connections to a domain with a suspicious top-level domain (TLD) registered within the last 30 days.     severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1105"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_DNS" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_HTTP"
    )
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /(?:^|[\\\/])(powershell|pwsh|curl|msiexec|MSBuild|regasm|regsvcs|regsvr32|schtasks|mshta|rundll32)\.exe$/ nocase
    $e.principal.hostname = $hostname
    $remote_domain = strings.coalesce(
      strings.extract_hostname($e.target.url),
      $e.network.dns.questions.name,
      $e.target.hostname
    )
    $remote_domain = /\.(top|buzz|xyz|rest|ml|cf|gq|ga|onion|monster|cyou|quest|cc|bar|cfd|click|cam|surf|tk|shop|club|icu|pw|ws|online|fun|life|boats|store|hair|skin|motorcycles|christmas|lol|makeup|mom|bond|beauty|biz|live|work|zip|country|accountant|date|party|science|loan|win|men|faith|review|racing|download|host|zone)$/ nocase
    $remote_domain = $whois_domain.graph.entity.domain.name
    $whois_domain.graph.metadata.entity_type = "DOMAIN_NAME"
    $whois_domain.graph.metadata.vendor_name = "WHOIS"
    $whois_domain.graph.metadata.product_name = "WHOISXMLAPI Simple Whois"
    $whois_domain.graph.metadata.source_type = "GLOBAL_CONTEXT"
    $whois_domain.graph.entity.domain.creation_time.seconds > 0
    $creationdate = $whois_domain.graph.entity.domain.creation_time.seconds
    2592000 > timestamp.current_seconds() - $whois_domain.graph.entity.domain.creation_time.seconds

  match:
    $hostname over 30m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.windows_sid)
    $tmp1 = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $result_time = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $principal_hostname = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = array_distinct($e.principal.process.command_line)
    $principal_process_file_full_path = array_distinct($e.principal.process.file.full_path)

    $target_url = array_distinct($e.target.url)
    $domain = array_distinct($remote_domain)
    $target_domain = array_distinct($e.target.hostname)
    $dns_question_name = array_distinct($e.network.dns.questions.name)
    $domain_creation_date = array($creationdate)
    $asset_is_server = max(if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0))

  condition:
    $e and $whois_domain
}

rule ttp_windows_encoded_powershell_webrequest_abbreviated_integer_ipv4 {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Encoded PowerShell Web Request to Abbreviated Integer IPv4 Address"
    description = "Detects Base64-encoded PowerShell (-EncodedCommand) payloads executing web requests to an abbreviated multi-octet integer IPv4 address (2-part A.X or 3-part A.B.X) or a bare/scheme-prefixed 32-bit DWORD decimal IPv4 address (e.g., 392073696/123) rather than standard dotted-quad format. Threat actors use abbreviated and DWORD integer IP representations alongside PowerShell cmdlet or alias obfuscation inside encoded commands to conceal C2 IP addresses and bypass network and command-line signatures."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059.001"

    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"

    re.replace(
      strings.base64_decode(
        re.capture(
          $e.target.process.command_line,
          /(?i)-(?:e|ec|en|enc|enco|encod|encode|encoded|encodedc|encodedco|encodedcom|encodedcomm|encodedcomma|encodedcomman|encodedcommand)\s+['"]?([A-Za-z0-9+\/]{16,}={0,2})/
        )

      /\x00/,

    re.replace(
      strings.base64_decode(
        re.capture(
          $e.target.process.command_line,
          /(?i)-(?:e|ec|en|enc|enco|encod|encode|encoded|encodedc|encodedco|encodedcom|encodedcomm|encodedcomma|encodedcomman|encodedcommand)\s+['"]?([A-Za-z0-9+\/]{16,}={0,2})/
        )

    $risk_score = 65
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1
    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line

    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)

    $e

rule ttp_windows_suspicious_sap_binary_command_execution {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Suspicious SAP Binary Command Execution"
    description = "Detects suspicious command execution spawning from binaries associated with SAP Netweaver servers and has been associated with CVE-2025-31324 exploitation."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0004"
    technique = "T1068"
    reference = "https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-31324"
  events:
    (
      $e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path = /sap.*(jstart|forkhelper)/ nocase or
      $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /sap.*(jstart|forkhelper)/ nocase or

    )
    (
      $e.target.process.command_line = /(curl|nc\s\d|echo\s[a-zA-Z0-9]+$|wget|Invoke-WebRequest|\|\s?bash|base64,?\s?-d|^ls(\s-[a-z]+)$|whoami|gzip$|^pwd$|^tar\s)/ nocase or
      $e.principal.process.command_line = /(curl|nc\s\d|echo\s[a-zA-Z0-9]+$|wget|Invoke-WebRequest|\|\s?bash|base64,?\s?-d|^ls(\s-[a-z]+)$|whoami|gzip$|^pwd$|^tar\s)/ nocase
    )
    $e.target.process.command_line != /cmd\.exe \/c ECHO. \|\s?(time|date)/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line != /\\Microsoft Intune Management Extension\\/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line != /\\Windows Defender Advanced Threat Protection\\DataCollection\\/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line != /\\PI_GIS\\PICD2\.bat/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line != /echo %date% %time%/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line != /-File .\\get-listening-process-info\.ps1/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line != /169\.254\.169\.254/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line != /qualys/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line != /dispatcher/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line != /InformationSteward\/MM\/lib\/MMLoader\.jar/ nocase
    $e.principal.process.command_line != /dispatcher/ nocase
    $e.principal.process.command_line != /cmd\.exe \/c ECHO. \|\s?(time|date)/ nocase
    $e.principal.process.command_line != /169\.254\.169\.254/ nocase
    $e.principal.process.command_line != /\\Microsoft Intune Management Extension\\/ nocase
    $e.principal.process.command_line != /\\Windows Defender Advanced Threat Protection\\DataCollection\\/ nocase
    $e.principal.process.command_line != /\\PI_GIS\\PICD2\.bat/ nocase
    $e.principal.process.command_line != /\/usr\/bin\/osconfig-platform/ nocase
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path != /\/run\/schroot\/mount\/var_opt_ibm_datapower_datapower_img/ nocase
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path!= /\\Microsoft Intune Management Extension\\/ nocase
    $e.principal.process.command_line != /http:\/\/metadata\.google\.internal\/computeMetadata\//
    $e.principal.process.command_line != /\/var\/tmp\/insights-/ nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 85
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1
    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $threat_verdict_malicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))
    $recent_compile_time = if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)
    $invalid_cert = if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $system_user_file_write = if($e.principal.user.userid = "system", 1, 0)
    $sus_file_name_architecture = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\[^\/]+(32|64).[^\/.]+$/), 1, 0)
    $single_double_char_filename = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*([^\/]{1,2}.[^\/.]+)$/), 1, 0)
    $double_extensions = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+.[a-zA-Z]{3}.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_file_name = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\d+.[a-zA-Z]{3}$/), 1, 0)
    $common_malicious_file_names = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup\.exe|update\.js|lsass\.dmp|1\.txt|ntds\.dit|logs\.dat|sqlite3\.dll|pass_1234|system\.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $is_archive_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0)
    $is_executable_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0)
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)
    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $recent_compile_time + $system_user_file_write + $sus_file_name_architecture + $common_malicious_file_names + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_filename + $double_extensions + $sus_vt_tags + $all_numbers_file_name + $is_executable_file + $is_archive_file + $invalid_cert
    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0)
  condition:
    $e
}

    re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `curl\.exe$`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `Cloudamize`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `conda`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\-\-ntlm`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\/ssp\/\!directupload\.[A-Za-z]{6} -k\s?$`) nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname

    )

      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )

      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )

    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $threat_verdict_malicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))

    $is_archive_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0)

    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "REGISTRY_CREATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "REGISTRY_MODIFICATION"
    )
    re.regex($e.target.registry.registry_value_data, `\-W`) nocase
    re.regex($e.target.registry.registry_value_data, `Hidden`) nocase
    (
      re.regex($e.target.registry.registry_value_data, `Invoke\-WebRequest`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.registry.registry_value_data, `\-UseBasicParsing`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.registry.registry_value_data, `\s\-e(n|c|\s)`) nocase
    )
    $e.target.registry.registry_value_data != /UWPAppInstall\.ps1|Platform\\CertInstall\.ps1|\\PingTargetHost\.ps1|\\MimicaRecorder|\\WalkMeEdgePlayerExtension_|ConnectivityCheckFormUI\.ps1|WinUserLanguageList\.ps1|\\Scripts\\DesktopBackground\.ps1|Enable-CtxDesktopExperienceUser\.ps1|\\Internet Explorer\\edgescript\.ps1|BitLockerEncryptionTrigger\.ps1|Podman_Install\.ps1|\-MainPackage\sMSTeams_|VmoverFileAssociationsCleanup|Managetaskbar\\taskband\.ps1|RemoveLyncCert_new|Lync2013LookupUserAttribute|\\Citrix\\UserProfileManager\\RegUwpApps|C:\\ProgramData\\Panasonic\\VVork|VisualStudio-ActiveSetup\.ps1|\\1stlauncherscript\.ps1|Call-UpgradeSuccessfulNotification\.ps1|\\Webex\\WebexInstaller\.ps1|\\CreateReboot|ControlledAccess_Collect_Device_Details\.ps1/ nocase

    $e.principal.process.command_line != /(C:\\windows\\system32\\svchost\.exe -k GPSvcGroup|C:\\windows\\system32\\svchost\.exe -k netsvcs -p -s gpsvc)/ nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1

    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $threat_verdict_malicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))
    $recent_compile_time = if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)

    $double_extensions = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+.[a-zA-Z]{3}.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_file_name = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\d+.[a-zA-Z]{3}$/), 1, 0)
    $common_malicious_file_names = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup\.exe|update\.js|lsass\.dmp|1\.txt|ntds\.dit|logs\.dat|sqlite3\.dll|pass_1234|system\.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $is_archive_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0)
    $is_executable_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0)
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)
    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $recent_compile_time + $system_user_file_write + $sus_file_name_architecture + $common_malicious_file_names + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_filename + $double_extensions + $sus_vt_tags + $all_numbers_file_name + $is_executable_file + $is_archive_file + $invalid_cert
    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e

    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)

rule ttp_windows_powershell_net_webclient_download_methodology {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Powershell Net Webclient Download"
    description = "This rule is designed to detect the use of Powershell to download a file using the System.Net.Webclient object. While not inherently malicious, this technique is commonly used by adversaries to transfer tools or files from an external system into a compromised environment."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1105"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" and
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `(powershell|pwsh)`) nocase and
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `New\-Object Net\.WebClient`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `chocolatey\.org`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, `C:\\EunityHealthCheck\\eunitycheck\.bat`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\.citrite\.net/`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `api-deploymonkey\.services`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `https://conemu\.github\.io`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `H:\\OWHFloorMaps\\`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `nativescript\.org\/setup\/win`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `https:\/\/agencymosaic\.com`) nocase
    ) and
    (
      (
        (
          re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, ` IEX`) nocase or
          re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\(iex`) nocase or
          re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `'iex\(`) nocase or
          re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `"iex\(`) nocase or
          re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `  iex;`) nocase or
          re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\s"?iex\s`) nocase or
          re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `(\/c|^)\s*(pwsh|powershell) -Command`) nocase or
          re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `(\/c|^)\s*(pwsh|powershell).*-w(in)?\s`) nocase
        ) or
        (
          re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `invoke`) nocase and
          re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `(hidden|\sh\s)`) nocase
        )
      ) and
      (
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `Download.*String`) nocase or
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `Download.*File`) nocase
      )
    )

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 85
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name

    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $is_successful = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 1))
    $result = if($is_successful > 0, "succeeded", "failed")
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1

    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname

  condition:
    $e
}

rule hunting_t1071_001_nip_io_ip_resolution_request {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Nip.io IP Address Resolution Request"
    description = "Detects on the use of the nip.io IP address resolution service. Nip.io is a free wildcard DNS service that maps any IP address to a hostname, allowing users to create a domain name for an IP without any registration. Threat actors abuse this service to quickly generate disposable domains for phishing and command-and-control (C2) infrastructure."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1071.001"
    reference = "https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/threat-intelligence/brickstorm-espionage-campaign"

  events:
    (
      $c.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION" or
      $c.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_DNS"
    )
    (
      $c.target.hostname = /\.nip\.io$/ or
      $c.network.dns.questions.name = /\.nip\.io$/
    )
    $c.principal.process.file.full_path != /(?:\\Microsoft\\Edge\\Application\\|\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\|\/Applications\/Firefox|\/Applications\/Google Chrome|\\Mozilla Firefox\\firefox|(?:^|[\\\/])(?:msedge|chrome|firefox)(?:\.exe)?$)/ nocase
    $c.principal.process.command_line != /(?:\\Microsoft\\Edge\\Application\\|\\Google\\Chrome\\Application\\|\/Applications\/Firefox|\/Applications\/Google Chrome|\\Mozilla Firefox\\firefox|(?:^|[\\\/])(?:msedge|chrome|firefox)(?:\.exe)?$)/ nocase
    $source_entity = strings.coalesce($c.principal.ip,$c.principal.asset_id,$c.principal.hostname)

  match:
    $source_entity over 12h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(35)
    $event_count = count_distinct($c.metadata.id)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($c.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($c.metadata.product_name)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($c.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $c.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($c.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = min($c.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($c.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($c.principal.asset.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($c.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($c.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($c.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($c.principal.user.windows_sid)

  condition:
    $c

  options:
    allow_zero_values = true
}

rule ttp_windows_rubeus_indicators {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Rubeus Indicators"
    description = "This signature detects the Rubeus Utility being executed on a host. Rubeus is a C# toolset for raw Kerberos interaction and abuses. It is heavily adapted from Benjamin Delpy's Kekeo project."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0006"
    technique = "T1558"
    reference = "https://github.com/GhostPack/Rubeus?tab=readme-ov-file#rubeus"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    (
      re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `\\Rubeus([0-9]{1,2})?\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `\\Rubeus([0-9]{1,2})?\.exe$`) nocase or
      (
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\s(asktgt|asktgs|tgssub|createnetonly|preauthscan|s4u|golden|silver|diamond|tgtdeleg|dump)\s`) nocase and
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\s\/(user[\s:]|enctype|rc4|aes128|aes256|domain|dc|outfile|ptt|luid|certificate|nowrap|getcredentials|servicekey|service|ticket)`) nocase
      ) or
      (
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\s(kerberoast|asreproast)\s`) nocase and
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\/(spns?|user|domain|dc|ou|ldaps|creduser|rc4opsec|ldapfilter|nowrap|outfile)`) nocase
      )
    )

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 85
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1

    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $threat_verdict_malicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))
    $recent_compile_time = if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)
    $invalid_cert = if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $system_user_file_write = if($e.principal.user.userid = "system", 1, 0)
    $sus_file_name_architecture = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\[^\/]+(32|64).[^\/.]+$/), 1, 0)
    $single_double_char_filename = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*([^\/]{1,2}.[^\/.]+)$/), 1, 0)
    $double_extensions = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+.[a-zA-Z]{3}.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_file_name = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\d+.[a-zA-Z]{3}$/), 1, 0)
    $common_malicious_file_names = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup\.exe|update\.js|lsass\.dmp|1\.txt|ntds\.dit|logs\.dat|sqlite3\.dll|pass_1234|system\.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $is_archive_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0)
    $is_executable_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0)
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)
    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $recent_compile_time + $system_user_file_write + $sus_file_name_architecture + $common_malicious_file_names + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_filename + $double_extensions + $sus_vt_tags + $all_numbers_file_name + $is_executable_file + $is_archive_file + $invalid_cert
    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_windows_certutil_urlcache_downloader_methodology {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Certutil Urlcache Downloader"
    description = "Detects on certutil usage with the urlcache flag. Certutil.exe may download a file from a remote destination using -urlcache. This behavior does require a URL to be passed on the command-line. In addition, -f (force) and -split (Split embedded ASN.1 elements, and save to files) will be used. It is not entirely common for certutil.exe to contact public IP space. However, it is uncommon for certutil.exe to write files to world writeable paths. During triage, capture any files on disk and review. Review the reputation of the remote IP or domain in question."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0011"
  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    ) and
    (
      (re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `\\certutil\.exe$`) nocase or
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `certutil`) nocase
      ) and
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\-urlcache`) nocase and
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `http`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `eicar`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `ocsp`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `digicert\.com`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\/\/(10|172\.16|192\.168)\.`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\.crl`) nocase and

rule ttp_windows_scheduled_task_delayed_trigger {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Scheduled Task Configured with Delayed Future Trigger"
    description = "Detects Windows Scheduled Task creation or modification events configuring shell commands (cmd, pwsh, or powershell) with a StartBoundary calendar trigger scheduled between 5 and 30 days in advance of the event creation time."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1053.005"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "SCHEDULED_TASK_MODIFICATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "SCHEDULED_TASK_CREATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "SCHEDULED_TASK_UNCATEGORIZED"
    )
    and
    (
      $e.additional.fields["TaskContent"] = /Triggers.*StartBoundary.*ScheduleByDay.*DaysInterval.*Exec.*Command.*\b(cmd|pwsh|powershell|wscript|cscript|mshta|rundll32|regsvr32|certutil|bitsadmin|vssadmin|curl)\b\.exe?|(\\Users\\\\*Public|\\AppData\\\\*Local|\\ProgramData\\|\\PerfLogs\\|\\Temp\\)/ nocase or
      $e.about.labels["AdditionalFields"] = /Triggers.*StartBoundary.*ScheduleByDay.*DaysInterval.*Exec.*Command.*\b(cmd|pwsh|powershell|wscript|cscript|mshta|rundll32|regsvr32|certutil|bitsadmin|vssadmin|curl)\b\.exe?|(\\Users\\\\*Public|\\AppData\\\\*Local|\\ProgramData\\|\\PerfLogs\\|\\Temp\\)/ nocase
    )
    $start_boundary = strings.coalesce(
      re.capture($e.additional.fields["TaskContent"], `StartBoundary\\?":\s*\\?"([^"\\]+)`),
      re.capture($e.about.labels["AdditionalFields"], `StartBoundary\\*":\s*\\*"([^"\\]+)`)
    )

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1
    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)

    $task_start_boundary = $start_boundary
    $min_start_boundary = timestamp.get_timestamp($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds + 432000, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")
    $max_start_boundary = timestamp.get_timestamp($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds + 2592000, "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")
    $is_delayed_trigger = if($task_start_boundary >= $min_start_boundary and $task_start_boundary <= $max_start_boundary, 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e and $is_delayed_trigger = 1
}
rules.description: Detects Windows Scheduled Task creation or modification events configuring shell commands (cmd, pwsh, or powershell) with a StartBoundary calendar trigger scheduled between 5 and 30 days in advance of the event creation time.

    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0007"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
    $e.target.port = 445
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path != /(^|\\|\/)(opt\/meridian\/|TaniumCX\.exe|Thycotic\.DistributedEngine\.Service\.exe|ntoskrnl\.exe|collectoragent\.exe|System$|SHDelegator\.exe|VPlatform\.exe|Orchestrator\.Sandbox\.exe|outpostworker\.exe|TaniumClient|SentinelAgent\.exe|Microsoft\.Tri\.Sensor\.Deployment\.Deployer\.exe|spiceworks-finder\.exe|SentinelRanger\.exe|SWJobEngineWorker2\.exe|csfalconservice\.exe|Microsoft\.Tri\.Sensor\.exe)/ nocase
    $e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path != /(^|\\|\/)(TaniumCX|AgentlessEngine\.exe|ProbeService.exe|BMC Software|SQLAGENT\.EXE|wrapper-windows-x86-64\.exe|discovery_probe\.exe)/ nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $target_ip_dc = count_distinct($e.target.ip)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.asset_id)

    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)

    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $hostname = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = array($e.principal.process.command_line)
    $principal_process_file_full_path = array($e.principal.process.file.full_path)
    $target_process_command_line = array($e.target.process.command_line)
    $target_process_file_full_path = array($e.target.process.file.full_path)
    $threat_verdict_malicious = max(if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0))
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = max(if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0))
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))
    $recent_compile_time = max(if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0))
    $invalid_cert = max(if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0))
    $system_user_file_write = max(if($e.principal.user.userid = "system", 1, 0))
    $sus_file_name_architecture = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\[^\/]+(32|64).[^\/.]+$/), 1, 0))
    $single_double_char_filename = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*([^\/]{1,2}.[^\/.]+)$/), 1, 0))
    $double_extensions = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+.[a-zA-Z]{3}.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0))
    $all_numbers_file_name = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\d+.[a-zA-Z]{3}$/), 1, 0))
    $common_malicious_file_names = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup.exe|update.js|lsass.dmp|1.txt|ntds.dit|logs.dat|sqlite3.dll|pass_1234|system.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0))
    $is_archive_file = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0))
    $is_executable_file = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0))
    $asset_is_server = max(if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0))
    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $recent_compile_time + $system_user_file_write + $sus_file_name_architecture + $common_malicious_file_names + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_filename + $double_extensions + $sus_vt_tags + $all_numbers_file_name + $is_executable_file + $is_archive_file + $invalid_cert
    $likely_security_testing = max(if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0))

  condition:
    $e and $target_ip_dc >= 500
}

rules.text:
rule hunting_t1071_001_unknown_endpoint_generating_google_doh_and_cloudflare_communication {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Unknown Endpoint Generating Google DNS-over-HTTPS and Cloudflare Hosted IP Communication"
    description = "Detects on requests by an unknown source IP address to Google DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) resolver service and a Cloudflare hosted IP address. To investigate this activity further, determine the source of the network activity and verify if the communication is consistent with the device's intended use and standard allow-list domains."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1071.001"
    reference = "https://blog.nviso.eu/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/NVISO-BRICKSTORM-Report.pdf"

  events:
    $c1.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
    $c1.target.ip = /^(8\.8\.8\.8|8\.8\.4\.4)$/ nocase
    $c1.principal.hostname = ""
    $c1.principal.asset_id = ""
    (
      $c1.target.port = 443 or
      $c1.target.url = /dns-query|:443\/$|\d\.\d\.\d\.\d\/$/ nocase
    )
    $c1.principal.process.file.full_path != /Google Chrome Helper|io\.tailscale\.ipn\.macsys\.network-extension|opera_autoupdate|mDNSResponder|(?:\\|^)aakore\.exe|(?:\\|^)opera\.exe$/ nocase
    $c1.principal.administrative_domain != /jac-visitor/ nocase
    $c1.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path != /(?:\\|^)opera\.exe$/ nocase
    $c1.additional.fields["devtype"] != /Mobile Generic|Phone/ nocase
    $c1.additional.fields["applist"] != /GUEST/ nocase
    $c1.extracted.fields["device_name"] != /ipad/ nocase
    $c1.extracted.fields["os_type"] != /OS_IOS/ nocase
    $c1.security_result.rule_name != /GUEST|BYOD/ nocase
    $c2.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
    $c2.principal.hostname = ""
    $c2.principal.asset_id = ""
    $c2.target.ip_geo_artifact.network.carrier_name = /cloudflare/ nocase
    $c2.target.port = 443
    $c2.target.url = $url
    $source_entity = $c1.principal.ip
    $source_entity = $c2.principal.ip

  match:
    $source_entity over 1h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(35)
    $vendor_name = array($c1.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array($c1.metadata.product_name)
    $unique_ips = array_distinct($c1.target.ip)
    $unique_doh_ips_count = count_distinct($c1.target.ip)
    $unique_urls = array_distinct($c1.target.url)
    $unique_urls_count = count_distinct($c1.target.url)
    $event_count = count_distinct($c1.metadata.id)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($c1.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $c1.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($c1.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = min($c1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($c1.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($c1.principal.asset.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($c1.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($c1.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($c1.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($c1.principal.user.windows_sid)
    $time_diff = math.abs(min($c1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds) - min($c2.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds))

  condition:
    $c1 and $c2 and $time_diff <= 2

  options:
    allow_zero_values = true
}

    $common_malicious_file_names = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup\.exe|update\.js|lsass\.dmp|1\.txt|ntds\.dit|logs\.dat|sqlite3\.dll|pass_1234|system\.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e
}
