rule md_t1204_002_filename_with_password_string_to_users_methodology {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Filename with Password String In Users Directory"
    description = "Detects on a filewrite event for a file with a file name containing an alphanumeric password string followed by three to six digits to the Users directory. This technique was commonly observed being utilised by various infostealer malware families including Vidar and Redline."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1204.002"
  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MODIFICATION"
    )
    (
      (
        re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `Users`) nocase and
        re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `\.rar`) nocase and
        (
          re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `^P[a@][s$]{2}(w((o|0)rd))?(.)?[-_\s]*[0-9]{3,6}(([-_]+[\w]{2,15})|(\.[a-z]{3}))`) nocase or
          re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `([_\s-]+)P[a@][s$]{2}(w((o|0)rd))?(.)?[-_\s]*[0-9]{3,6}((\.[a-z]{3}(\.[a-z]{3})?)|([-_\s]*[A-Za-z]{4,10}\.[a-z]{3}))`) nocase or
          re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `([_\s-]+)P[a@][s$]{2}(w((o|0)rd))?(.)?([-_\s]+)?[0-9]{3,6}[_\s]+[(]`) nocase or
          re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `(Set[-]?up(s)?|activate|main|file)[_\s-]+[0-9]{3,4}[_\s-]+P[a@][s$]{2}(w((o|0)rd))?(.)?([-_\s]+|\.rar)`) nocase or
          re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `(Set[-]?up(s)?|activate|main|file)((.){2})?[_-]+P[a@][s$]{2}(w((o|0)rd))?(.)?[_-]*[0-9]{3,6}[_-]+(.){3,4}\.rar`) nocase or
          re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `P[a@][s$]{1,2}w0rd(.)?`) nocase or
          re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `[0-9]{3,6}([-_\s]+)?As([-_\s]+)?P[a@][s$]{1,}`) nocase
        ) and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `pass_1111_6rv4w`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `\.cap\s*([\(][0-9]{1,3}[\)])\.zip`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `\.txt\.zip`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `_log\.7z$`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `Chamber`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `[_][0-9]{4}[-][0-9]{3}[_]Password[_]`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `Pass C\.V\.`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `pass board daily`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{3}_PASS_[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}_`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `\s[0-9]{4}\sPass\sC\.V\.`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `[0-9]{10}_[A-Z]{3}_PASS_[0-9]{6}\.log\.zip`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `Canstar`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `[-\s_][0-9]{7,}[-\s_]PASS`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `Vacation`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `\.[a-z]{3}_pass_123(\s[(][0-9]{1}[)])?\.(lnk|zip)`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `\.7z_pass_123\.(lnk|zip)`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `Restriction`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `Password and Login`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `9943_PASS_C10\.rar$`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `Maheshwari`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `password_protected_files`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `PASS_FAIL REPORT`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `MultiDPU`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `New Build`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `Production DB`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `Year and Record`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `_PASS_NOTIFICATION`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `PASS_VG1`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `LACKING DOCS`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `3rd party`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `filezilla\.exe$`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `edpa\.exe$`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `git\.exe$`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `Syncplicity\.exe$`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `WinSCP\.exe$`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `WINWORD\.EXE$`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `Discharge`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `\.rar_pass`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `[A-Za-z]{4,15}_[A-Za-z]{2,8}_[A-Za-z]{2,8}_[A-Za-z]{2,8}_[A-Za-z]{2,15}`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `[A-Za-z0-9]{2,8}_[A-Za-z0-9]{2,8}_[A-Za-z0-9]{2,8}_[A-Za-z0-9]{2,8}_[A-Za-z0-9]{2,15}_[A-Za-z0-9]{2,15}`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `[A-Za-z0-9]{4,8}-[A-Za-z0-9]{4,8}-[A-Za-z0-9]{4,8}-[A-Za-z0-9]{4,8}-[A-Za-z0-9]{4,15}`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `[A-Za-z]{3,4}_[A-Za-z]{3,4}_[0-9]{2,8}-[0-9]{2,4}-[0-9]{2,4}_[0-9]{2,4}-[0-9]{2,4}`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `[A-Za-z0-9]{5,15}_[0-9]{3,4}-[0-9]{2,4}-[0-9]{2,4}`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `[A-Za-z0-9]{3,8}-[A-Za-z0-9]{3,8}-[0-9]{1,4}-[A-Za-z0-9]{1,4}_pass`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `[A-Za-z0-9]{3,8}_[0-9]{1,2}_[0-9]{1,2}_[0-9]{1,2}`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `Password\s[0-9]{3}[a-z]{4,15}`) nocase
      ) or
      (
        re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `Users`) nocase and
        re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\Temp1`) nocase and
        re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `([_\s-]+)P[a@][s$]{2}(w((o|0)rd))?([-_\s]*)?[0-9]{3,6}\.[a-z]{3}(\.[a-z]{3})?(:Zone.Identifier)?\\[A-Za-z]{4,10}\.[a-z]{3,4}$`) nocase
      ) or
      (
        re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `Users`) nocase and
        (
          re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `^P[a@][s$]{2}(w((o|0)rd))?[s$]?[-_\s]*[0-9]{3,6}\.zip`) nocase or
          re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `(Set[-]?up(s)?|activate|main)[_-]{1}P[a@][s$]{2}(w((o|0)rd))?[s$]?[_-]+[0-9]{3,4}.*\.((zip))`) nocase
        ) and
        (
          re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `\\AppData\\Roaming`) nocase or
          re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `\\Downloads`) nocase or
          re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `\\Desktop`) nocase
        )
      ) or
      (
        re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `(Downloads|Desktop)`) nocase and
        re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `Users`) nocase and
        re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `\.7z`) nocase and
        (
          re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `^P[a@][s$]{2}(w((o|0)rd))?[s$]?[-_\s]*[0-9]{3,6}(([-_]+[\w]{2,15})|(\.[a-z]{3}))`) nocase or
          re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `([_\s-]+)P[a@][s$]{2}(w((o|0)rd))?[s$]?[-_\s]*[0-9]{3,6}((\.[a-z]{3}(\.[a-z]{3})?)|([-_\s]*[A-Za-z]{4,10}\.7z))`) nocase
        )
      )
    )
  outcome:
    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $risk_score = 35
    $event_count = 1
    $vendor_name = array($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array($e.metadata.product_name)

    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

    description = "Detects creation of a copy of the Volume Shadow. NTDS.DIT is locked when in use, therefore threat actors may create copies in order to extract ntds.dit or the SYSTEM registry hive."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0006"
    technique = "T1003.003"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(powershell|wmi|cmd|wsm)`) nocase
    re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `(vssadmin|cmd)`)
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, ` \/AutoRetry=\d`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, `(\\|^)Iperius\.exe`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, `AttackIQ\\FiredrillAgent`) nocase

      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `vssadmin(\.exe)?.? create shadow \/for=[A-Za-z]:`) nocase or

    )

    $risk_score = 85
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1

    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $threat_verdict_malicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))
    $recent_compile_time = if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)

    $single_double_char_filename = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*([^\/]{1,2}.[^\/.]+)$/), 1, 0)
    $double_extensions = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+.[a-zA-Z]{3}.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_file_name = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\d+.[a-zA-Z]{3}$/), 1, 0)
    $common_malicious_file_names = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup\.exe|update\.js|lsass\.dmp|1\.txt|ntds\.dit|logs\.dat|sqlite3\.dll|pass_1234|system\.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $is_archive_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0)
    $is_executable_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0)
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)
    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $recent_compile_time + $system_user_file_write + $sus_file_name_architecture + $common_malicious_file_names + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_filename + $double_extensions + $sus_vt_tags + $all_numbers_file_name + $is_executable_file + $is_archive_file + $invalid_cert

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_windows_rundll32_davsetcookie_after_web3_network {
  meta:

    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1218.011"

    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_DNS" or

    $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /\b(chrome|firefox|msedge|iexplore|opera|safari|brave|whale|browser|vivaldi)(\.exe)?$/ nocase and
    (
      $e.network.dns.questions.name = /(?:bsc-dataseed\.bnbchain\.org|bsc-testnet\.drpc\.org|data-seed-prebsc-1-s1\.bnbchain\.org|data-seed-prebsc-1-s1\.binance\.org|polygon\.api\.onfinality\.io|kong\.eu\.onfinality\.io|rpc-mainnet\.polygon\.technology|polygon\.drpc\.org|polygon-bor\.publicnode\.com|polygon-rpc\.com|polygon-bor-rpc\.publicnode\.com|rpc-mainnet\.matic\.(?:network|vigil\.com|quiknode\.pro)|matic-mainnet\.(?:chainstacklabs\.com|-full-rpc\.bwarelabs\.com)|polygon\.gateway\.tenderly\.co|rpc\.ankr\.com\/polygon|bsc-testnet(-rpc)?\.publicnode\.com)/ nocase or
      $e.target.url = /(?:bsc-dataseed\.bnbchain\.org|bsc-testnet\.drpc\.org|data-seed-prebsc-1-s1\.bnbchain\.org|data-seed-prebsc-1-s1\.binance\.org|polygon\.api\.onfinality\.io|kong\.eu\.onfinality\.io|rpc-mainnet\.polygon\.technology|polygon\.drpc\.org|polygon-bor\.publicnode\.com|polygon-rpc\.com|polygon-bor-rpc\.publicnode\.com|rpc-mainnet\.matic\.(?:network|vigil\.com|quiknode\.pro)|matic-mainnet\.(?:chainstacklabs\.com|-full-rpc\.bwarelabs\.com)|polygon\.gateway\.tenderly\.co|rpc\.ankr\.com\/polygon|bsc-testnet(-rpc)?\.publicnode\.com)/ nocase

    (
      $proc.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or

    $proc.target.process.command_line = /(\bDavSetCookie\b|(\\|\/)[^\\\/]+@.*\,\s*#)/ nocase

    $e.principal.hostname = $hostname
    $e.principal.user.userid = $user

    $proc.principal.hostname = $hostname
    $proc.principal.user.userid = $user
    $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds <= $proc.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

  match:
    $hostname, $user over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($proc.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($proc.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($proc.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($proc.principal.asset.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($proc.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($proc.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($proc.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($proc.principal.user.windows_sid)
    $tmp1 = max(if($proc.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $proc.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2))
    $tmp2 = max(if($proc.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $result_time = max($proc.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $principal_hostname = array_distinct($proc.principal.hostname)
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = array_distinct($proc.principal.process.command_line)
    $principal_process_file_full_path = array_distinct($proc.principal.process.file.full_path)
    $target_process_command_line = array_distinct($proc.target.process.command_line)
    $target_process_file_full_path = array_distinct($proc.target.process.file.full_path)
    $asset_is_server = max(if($proc.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0))

  condition:
    $e and $proc
}

rule ttp_windows_process_exclusion_added_to_windows_defender {
  meta:

    description = "This signature is designed to detect on threat actors excluding specific processes from Windows Defender scanning. Threat actors will modify the Windows Defender service settings to prevent detection and quarantine of their malware and utilities."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1685"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `-ExclusionPr`) nocase
    re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `.`) nocase
    $e.principal.asset_id = $asset_id
    (
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `Add\-MpPreference`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `Set\-MpPreference`) nocase
    )
    (
      $e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path != /^aiptraced\.exe/ nocase and
      $e.principal.process.file.full_path != /\\Salt Project\\Salt\\Scripts\\python\.exe$|\\jonas\\jonasagentservice\.exe|\\Cristie\\CoBMR\\|\\anypointstudio\\plugins\\|\\POS\\bin\\aiptraced\.exe/ nocase and
      $e.principal.process.command_line != /\\Huntress\\HuntressAgent\.exe|\\Jonas\\ExecuteModuleFunction\.ps1|-ExclusionProcess radtec_adapter\.exe$|\\SP2\\Scripts\\Exceptions\.vbs|-ExclusionProcess winds_nl2_adapter.exe|-ExclusionProcess\s+aiptraced\.exe\"|\\Program Files\\RMS Agent\\|\\Milestone\\Husky Services\\HardwareAbstractionService\\HardwareAbstractionService\.exe|C:\\ProgramData\\Citrix\\VMStartup\\Temp\\PowerShell-WindowsDefenderExclusions-/ nocase and
      $e.target.process.command_line != /-ExclusionProcess AnypointStudio\.exe|-ExclusionProcess ETAPS64\.EXE|-ExclusionProcess\s+\"FDRSVC\.exe\"$|-ExclusionProcess\s+\"FDRS\.exe\"$|\\Oxygen Forensics\\Oxygen Forensic Detective|:\\ProgramData\\Seeq\\data|\\AppData\\Local\\sf\"\}|\\AnypointStudio\\studio-workspace|E:\\Jenkins\\workspace|C:\\Program Files\\Windows Event Reporting\\/ nocase
    )

  match:
    $asset_id over 10m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)

    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)

    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = 1
    $hostname = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = array($e.principal.process.command_line)
    $principal_process_file_full_path = array($e.principal.process.file.full_path)
    $target_process_command_line = array($e.target.process.command_line)
    $target_process_file_full_path = array($e.target.process.file.full_path)
    $threat_verdict_malicious = max(if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0))
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = max(if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0))
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))
    $recent_compile_time = max(if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0))
    $invalid_cert = max(if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0))
    $system_user_file_write = max(if($e.principal.user.userid = "system", 1, 0))
    $sus_file_name_architecture = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\[^\/]+(32|64).[^\/.]+$/), 1, 0))
    $single_double_char_filename = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*([^\/]{1,2}.[^\/.]+)$/), 1, 0))
    $double_extensions = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+.[a-zA-Z]{3}.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0))
    $all_numbers_file_name = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\d+.[a-zA-Z]{3}$/), 1, 0))
    $common_malicious_file_names = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup.exe|update.js|lsass.dmp|1.txt|ntds.dit|logs.dat|sqlite3.dll|pass_1234|system.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0))
    $is_archive_file = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0))
    $is_executable_file = max(if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0))
    $asset_is_server = max(if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0))
    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $recent_compile_time + $system_user_file_write + $sus_file_name_architecture + $common_malicious_file_names + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_filename + $double_extensions + $sus_vt_tags + $all_numbers_file_name + $is_executable_file + $is_archive_file + $invalid_cert
    $likely_security_testing = max(if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0))

  condition:
    $e
}

rules.display_name: Anomalous Network Bytes Inbound By Asset ID
rules.text:
rule ueba_anomalous_inbound_bytes_by_device_asset_id {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Anomalous Network Bytes Inbound By Asset ID"
    description = "Detects anomalous (2 standard deviations away from the historical average, if the entity has a coefficient of variation < 0.1 and was observed for at least 9 of the last 30 days) network bytes inbound by device asset ID. This may be indicative of potential Exfiltration behavior."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0010"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
    $e.network.received_bytes > 0
    $asset_id = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $asset_id != ""
    optimization.sample_rate($e.metadata.id, 1, 25)

    $principal_ns = $e.principal.namespace

  match:
    $asset_id, $principal_ns over 24h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $usage_past_24h = sum(25.0 * $e.network.received_bytes)
    $num_stddevs_away = max(2)

    $historical_stddev = max(metrics.network_bytes_inbound(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:stddev,
        principal.asset.asset_id:$asset_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))

    $historical_avg = max(metrics.network_bytes_inbound(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:avg,
        principal.asset.asset_id:$asset_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))

    $historical_max = max(metrics.network_bytes_inbound(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:max,
        principal.asset.asset_id:$asset_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))

    $historical_observations = max(metrics.network_bytes_inbound(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:num_metric_periods,
        principal.asset.asset_id:$asset_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))

    $historical_coefficient_of_variation = max(
      metrics.network_bytes_inbound(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:stddev,
        principal.asset.asset_id:$asset_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns) /
      metrics.network_bytes_inbound(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:avg,
        principal.asset.asset_id:$asset_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))
    $observation_threshold = max(9)

    $coefficient_of_variation_threshold = max(1/10)

    $historical_threshold = max(
      metrics.network_bytes_inbound(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:avg,
        principal.asset.asset_id:$asset_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns)+ 2 * metrics.network_bytes_inbound(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:stddev,
        principal.asset.asset_id:$asset_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e and ($usage_past_24h > $historical_threshold) and ($historical_coefficient_of_variation < $coefficient_of_variation_threshold) and ($historical_observations >= $observation_threshold) and $event_count >= 100

  options:
    allow_zero_values = true
}
rules.description: Detects anomalous (2 standard deviations away from the historical average, if the entity has a coefficient of variation < 0.1 and was observed for at least 9 of the last 30 days) network bytes inbound by device asset ID. This may be indicative of potential Exfiltration behavior.

  events:

    $e.security_result.severity = "INFORMATIONAL"
    $entity_name = strings.coalesce(
      re.capture($e.principal.asset_id, ":(.*)"),
      re.capture($e.principal.asset.asset_id, ":(.*)"),
      $e.principal.hostname,
      $e.principal.asset.hostname,

      $e.target.hostname,
      $e.target.asset.hostname,

      $e.target.asset.ip,
      $e.target.user.user_display_name,
      $e.target.user.userid,
      $e.target.user.email_addresses
    )

    $entity_name != ""

    $threat_name = strings.coalesce(
      $e.security_result.summary,
      strings.concat(
        strings.coalesce(
          $e.security_result.detection_fields["Tactic"],
          $e.security_result.attack_details.tactics.name
        ),
        " via ",
        $e.security_result.rule_name
      )
    )

    $threat_name != ""

  match:
    $entity_name, $threat_name by 1d

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 10
    $vendor_name = "Crowdstrike"
    $product_name = "EDR"
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $entity = array_distinct($entity_name)

      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)

Attackers may use custom script extensions to execute malicious code on your virtual machines via the Azure Resource Manager."

    tactic = "TA0002"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Microsoft"

      $e.metadata.log_type = "MICROSOFT_GRAPH_ALERT" or

  outcome:
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $risk_score = max(0 +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "HIGH", 85, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "MEDIUM", 65, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "LOW", 35, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "INFORMATIONAL", 10, 0)

    $event_count = 1
    $product_urls = array_distinct($e.security_result.url_back_to_product)
    $security_result_summary = array_distinct($e.security_result.summary)
    $security_result_description = array_distinct($e.security_result.description)
    $security_result_severity = array_distinct($e.security_result.severity)
    $security_remediation_details = array_distinct($e.security_result.action_details)
    $security_result_threat_name = array_distinct($e.security_result.threat_name)
    $adversary_names = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.userid, $e.principal.hostname, $e.principal.resource.name))

    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $victim_names = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.target.user.userid, $e.target.hostname, $e.target.resource.name))
    $victim_uid = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.target.user.product_object_id, $e.target.asset_id, $e.target.resource.product_object_id))
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.target.ip)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

    $e

rules.text:
rule ttp_vendor_cs_alerts_severity_info {
  meta:
    rule_name = "CrowdStrike Alerts: Informational Alert"
    description = "Surfacing Informational Alerts from CrowdStrike's CS_ALERTS log type"
    severity = "Info"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "CS_ALERTS"
    $e.security_result.severity = "INFORMATIONAL"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type != "cwpp"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type != "idp"
    $asset_id = strings.ltrim(
      strings.coalesce($e.principal.asset_id, $e.target.asset_id),
      re.capture(strings.coalesce($e.principal.asset_id, $e.target.asset_id), ".*:")
    )

    $threat_name = strings.coalesce(
      $e.security_result.summary,
      re.replace(strings.concat(
          $e.security_result.attack_details.tactics.name,
          " via ",
          $e.security_result.rule_name
        ), "^ via ", "")
    )

  match:
    $threat_name, $asset_id by 1d

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 10
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $mitre_tactic = array_distinct($e.security_result.attack_details.tactics.id)
    $mitre_technique = array_distinct($e.security_result.attack_details.techniques.id)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $signature_name = array_distinct($threat_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $rule_category = "vendor"
    $update_detection = true
    $update_managed_defense_aggregations = true
    $event_min_timestamp = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_max_timestamp = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_azure_defender_for_cloud_ddos_attack_detected_for_public_ip {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Azure Defender for Cloud: DDoS Attack detected for Public IP"
    description = "DDoS Attack detected for Public IP (IP address) and being mitigated."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0043"
    reference = "https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/alerts-reference"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    (
      $e.metadata.log_type = "MICROSOFT_GRAPH_ALERT" or
      $e.metadata.log_type = "MICROSOFT_DEFENDER_CLOUD_ALERTS"
    )
    $e.security_result.rule_name = "DDoS Attack detected for Public IP"

    $product_event_type = $e.security_result.rule_name

  outcome:
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $risk_score = max(0 +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "HIGH", 85, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "MEDIUM", 65, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "LOW", 35, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "INFORMATIONAL", 10, 0)
    )
    $event_count = 1
    $product_urls = array_distinct($e.security_result.url_back_to_product)
    $security_result_summary = array_distinct($e.security_result.summary)
    $security_result_description = array_distinct($e.security_result.description)
    $security_result_severity = array_distinct($e.security_result.severity)
    $security_remediation_details = array_distinct($e.security_result.action_details)
    $security_result_threat_name = array_distinct($e.security_result.threat_name)
    $adversary_names = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.userid, $e.principal.hostname, $e.principal.resource.name))
    $adversary_uid = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.product_object_id, $e.principal.asset_id, $e.principal.resource.product_object_id))
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $victim_names = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.target.user.userid, $e.target.hostname, $e.target.resource.name))
    $victim_uid = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.target.user.product_object_id, $e.target.asset_id, $e.target.resource.product_object_id))
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.target.ip)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ueba_auth_fails_then_success_by_user_email_address {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Successful auth after brute force, by user email address"
    description = "A single IP address had several failed authentication attempts within 5 minutes, to a single user email address for a single application before successfully logging in."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0006"
    technique = "T1110"

  events:
    $auth_success.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $auth_success.security_result.action = "ALLOW"

    $auth_fail.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $auth_fail.security_result.action = "BLOCK"

    $email_address = $auth_success.target.user.email_addresses
    $email_address != ""
    $email_address = $auth_fail.target.user.email_addresses
    $product_match = $auth_success.metadata.product_name
    $product_match != ""
    $product_match = $auth_fail.metadata.product_name

    $remote_ip = $auth_success.principal.ip
    $remote_ip != ""
    $remote_ip = $auth_fail.principal.ip
    $target_ns = $auth_success.target.namespace
    $principal_ns = $auth_success.principal.namespace

  match:
    $email_address, $product_match, $remote_ip, $target_ns, $principal_ns over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($auth_success.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $auth_fails_after_auth_success = count_distinct(if(
        ($auth_fail.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds > $auth_success.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds) or
        ($auth_fail.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds = $auth_success.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds and
          $auth_fail.metadata.event_timestamp.nanos > $auth_success.metadata.event_timestamp.nanos), $auth_fail.metadata.product_log_id, ""))

    $total_auth_fails = count_distinct($auth_fail.metadata.product_log_id)

    $auth_fails_before_auth_success = $total_auth_fails - $auth_fails_after_auth_success + if($total_auth_fails = $auth_fails_after_auth_success, 0, 1)

    $auth_fails_before_auth_success_threshold = 25

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($auth_success.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($auth_success.metadata.product_name)

  condition:
    $auth_success and $auth_fail and $auth_fails_before_auth_success > $auth_fails_before_auth_success_threshold

  options:
    allow_zero_values = true
}

rules.text:
rule active_breach_ioc_eg_src_ip {
  meta:
    rule_name = "ATI Active Breach Rule Match for Ip Address IoCs (src.ip)"
    description = "This rule matches indicators of compromise from Google Applied Threat Intelligence."
    severity = "Critical"
    feed = "gti"

  events:
    $gti.graph.metadata.product_name = "GTI_IOC"
    $gti.graph.metadata.vendor_name = "GTI_IOC"
    $gti.graph.metadata.entity_type = "IP_ADDRESS"
    $gti.graph.metadata.source_type = "GLOBAL_CONTEXT"
    $gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.gti_verdict = 16
    $ioc = $gti.graph.entity.ip
    $ioc = $e.src.ip

    $gti.graph.entity.ip != ""
    $e.src.ip != ""
    $e.metadata.product_name != /RECORDED_FUTURE_IOC/ nocase
    $e.metadata.product_name != /stix/ nocase
    $e.metadata.event_type != "ENTITY_RISK_CHANGE"
    (
      $gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.gti_update_time.seconds <=
      (timestamp.current_seconds() - (7 * 24 * 60 * 60)) OR
      $gti.graph.metadata.collected_timestamp.seconds <=
      (timestamp.current_seconds() - (7 * 24 * 60 * 60)) OR
      $gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.reviewed = true
    )

  match:
    $ioc by 1h

  outcome:
    $active_ir_pwn = max(if($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.active_ir = true, 1, 0))
    $active_ir_confidence_score = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.mandiant_analyst_confidence)
    $global_customer_count = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.global_customer_count)
    $global_hits_count = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.global_hit_count)
    $attributed_malware = max(if(any $gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.attributed_malware.name != "", 1, 0))
    $attributed_actor = max(if(any $gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.attributed_threat_actors.name != "", 1, 0))
    $pwn_event_time = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $pwn_added_time = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.active_ir_first_tagged_time.seconds)
    $pwn_time_diff = $pwn_event_time - $pwn_added_time
    $exclusive_label = max(if($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.exclusive = true, 1, 0))
    $exclusive_actor = $exclusive_label + $attributed_actor
    $gti_verdict = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.gti_verdict)
    $gti_severity = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.gti_severity)
    $gti_threat_score = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.gti_threat_score)
    $commodity = max(if($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.osint = true, 1, 0))
    $scanner = max(if($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.scanner = true, 1, 0))
    $active_ir = if($active_ir_pwn = 1, 1, 0)
    $high_prevalence = if($global_customer_count >= 3, 1, 0)
    +
    if($global_hits_count > 50000, 1, 0)
    $attributed = if($attributed_malware = 1, 1, 0)
    +
    if($attributed_actor = 1, 1, 0)
    $pwn_old = if($pwn_event_time - $pwn_added_time > 7689600,1,0)
    $exclusive = if($exclusive_actor = 2, 1, 0)
    +
    if($attributed_malware = 1, 1, 0)
    $blocked = max(0 +
      if(any $e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.action = "QUARANTINE", 1, 0)
    )
    $entity_type = array_distinct($gti.graph.metadata.entity_type)
    $event_time = array_distinct($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $log_source = array_distinct($e.metadata.log_type)
    $asset_hostname = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)
    $user_id = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $ioc_value =  array_distinct($ioc)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $risk_score = max(95)
    $priority = if(
      $gti_verdict = 16 AND
      $gti_severity = 16 AND
      $high_prevalence != 2 AND
      $active_ir = 1 AND
      $pwn_old = 0 AND
      $event_count > 2 AND
      $blocked = 0 AND
      $exclusive >= 1,
      4,
      0
    )

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if(any $e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and any $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if(any $e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e AND $gti AND $priority = 4
}

    $high_prevalence = if($global_customer_count >= 3, 1, 0)
    +
    if($global_hits_count > 50000, 1, 0)
    $attributed = if($attributed_malware = 1, 1, 0)
    +
    if($attributed_actor = 1, 1, 0)
    $pwn_old = if($pwn_event_time - $pwn_added_time > 7689600,1,0)
    $exclusive = if($exclusive_actor = 2, 1, 0)
    +
    if($attributed_malware = 1, 1, 0)
    $blocked = max(0 +
      if(any $e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.action = "QUARANTINE", 1, 0)
    )
    $entity_type = array_distinct($gti.graph.metadata.entity_type)
    $event_time = array_distinct($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $log_source = array_distinct($e.metadata.log_type)
    $asset_hostname = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)
    $user_id = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $ioc_value =  array_distinct($ioc)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $risk_score = max(95)
    $priority = if(
      $gti_verdict = 16 AND
      $gti_severity = 16 AND
      $high_prevalence != 2 AND
      $active_ir = 1 AND
      $pwn_old = 0 AND
      $blocked = 0 AND
      $exclusive >= 1,
      4,
      0
    )

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(

    $tmp2 = max(
      if(any $e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)

  condition:

}

rule i_methodology_t1078_004_gcp_cloudsql_instances_login_success {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Gcp Cloudsql Instances Login Success"
    description = "This detects on the execution of the cloudsql.instances.login API command"
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0001"
    technique = "T1078.004"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "GCP_CLOUDAUDIT"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = /cloudsql.instances.login/
    $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW"

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1

    $base_risk_score = .40 * 100
    $user_agent_risk_score = max(
      if( //Increase risk score if user agent is associated with an automated routine such as scripting language client
        $e.network.http.user_agent = /(python|curl|go-|wget|selenium|aiohttp|Headless)/ nocase,
        .25,
        0
      ) +
      if( //Increase risk score if user agent is associated with an offensive security tool like Kali
        $e.network.http.user_agent = /(kali|scoutsuite|trufflehog|autodiscoverclient|microburst|AADinternals|Stormspotter|ROADtools|Steam-pipe|Monkey365|GraphRunner|SkyArk|Cloudsploit|MFASweep|CloudBrute|CloudEnum|gstrike|gcp_scanner|PurplePanda|Gcphound|Forsetisecurity|gcp_enum|BucketLoot|Trivy|Pacu|awspx|Slyther|Invictus-|Cloudfox|Prowler)/ nocase,
        .50,
        0
      ) +
      if( //Increase risk score if user agent is associated with a command line tool
        $e.network.http.user_agent = /(aws-cli)/ nocase,
        .25,
        0
      )
    ) * 100
    $action_allowed_risk_score = max(
      if( //Increase risk score if the action was performed successfully
        $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW",
        .10,
        0
      )
    ) * 100
    $longterm_credential_risk_score = max(
      if( //Increase risk score if the action was performed by a long term access key
        $e.additional.fields["accessKeyId"] = /^AKIA/,
        .10,
        0
      )
    ) * 100
    $mfa_authenticated_risk_score = max(
      if( //Increase risk score if the action was performed while the user was not authenticated via MFA
        $e.principal.user.attribute.labels["mfaAuthenticated"] = "false",
        .10,
        0
      )
    ) * 100
    $mitre_technique = "T1078.004"
    $mitre_tactic = "Defense Evasion, Persistence, Privilege Escalation, Initial Access"
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $temp_risk_score = $action_allowed_risk_score + $user_agent_risk_score + $longterm_credential_risk_score + $mfa_authenticated_risk_score + $base_risk_score
    $producer_risk_score = if(
      $temp_risk_score > 100,
      100,
      $temp_risk_score
    )

  condition:
    $e
}

rules.text:
rule i_github_high_volume_github_repos_cloned_by_pat_user {
  meta:
    rule_name = "High Volume Github Repository Clone by PAT User"
    description = "Detects when a non-bot user with a Personal Access Token (PAT) clones a large amount of Github repos in a short period of time. Threat actors may attempt to clone repos to exfiltrate data or disrupt operations. Validate if the activity is authorized."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0009"
    technique = "T1213.003"

  events:
    $e.metadata.product_name = "GITHUB"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = /clone/ nocase
    $e.additional.fields["programmatic_access_type"] = "Personal access token (classic)" nocase
    $e.target.resource.name = $github_repo_name
    $e.principal.user.userid = $user_id
    $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.carrier_name != /(google|amazon|microsoft|zscaler)/
    $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.carrier_name != ""
    $e.principal.user.userid != /\[bot\]/ nocase
    $e.principal.user.user_display_name != /\[bot\]/ nocase

  match:
    $user_id over 15m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $result = array_distinct($e.security_result.summary)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $product_event_type = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_event_type)
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $principal_user_userid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $principal_user_display_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $access_type = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["programmatic_access_type"])
    $token_id = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["token_id"])
    $principal_ip = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $principal_ip_carrier_name = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.carrier_name)
    $principal_ip_carrier_asn = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.asn)
    $principal_ip_country = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region)
    $network_user_agents = array_distinct($e.network.http.user_agent)
    $github_repo_names = array_distinct($github_repo_name)
    $repository_is_public = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["repository_public"])
    $github_repo_name_distinct_count = count_distinct($github_repo_name)

  condition:
    $e and $github_repo_name_distinct_count > 50
}
rules.description: Detects when a non-bot user with a Personal Access Token (PAT) clones a large amount of Github repos in a short period of time. Threat actors may attempt to clone repos to exfiltrate data or disrupt operations. Validate if the activity is authorized.

rule i_o365_anomalous_ip_userloggedin_officehome {
  meta:
    rule_name = "O365 UserLoggedIn to OfficeHome from Anomalous IP"
    description = "This rule detects on successful O365 user logins to the O365 OfficeHome application from a source IP address that the user has not logged in from over the previous 30 days."
    severity = "Info"
    tactic = "TA0001"
    technique = "T1078.004"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "OFFICE_365"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "UserLoggedIn"
    $e.target.resource.product_object_id = "4765445b-32c6-49b0-83e6-1d93765276ca" // OfficeHome
    $target_user = $e.target.user.userid
    $source_ip = $e.principal.ip
    $ip_network_name = $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.organization_name
    $ip_network_name != ""
    not net.ip_in_range_cidr($e.principal.ip, "10.0.0.0/8")
    not net.ip_in_range_cidr($e.principal.ip, "172.16.0.0/12")
    not net.ip_in_range_cidr($e.principal.ip, "192.168.0.0/16")
    $e.principal.ip != "0.0.0.0"

  match:
    $target_user,$source_ip over 1h

  outcome:
    $days_success = max(metrics.auth_attempts_success(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:first_seen,
        agg:min,
        target.user.userid:$target_user,
        principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.organization_name:$ip_network_name))
    $risk_score = 0
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.target.user.userid)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.target.user.userid)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.target.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.target.user.userid)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $e and $days_success = 0
}

rule i_confluence_high_risk_action_by_risky_user {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Confluence High Risk Action by Risky User"
    description = "Detects high-impact administrative and data access actions performed by automated or unauthenticated accounts within Confluence. Validate that the activity is authorized."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1098"

  events:
    $e.metadata.product_name = "CONFLUENCE"
    $e.extracted.fields["author.name"] = /(System|Anonymous)/ nocase
    (
      (
        $e.security_result.summary = "User details updated" and
        $e.principal.resource.attribute.labels["changedValue_0 from"] = "No" and
        $e.principal.resource.attribute.labels["changedValue_0 key"] = "Active" and
        $e.principal.resource.attribute.labels["changedValue_0 to"] = "Yes"
      ) or
      (
        $e.security_result.summary = "User added to group" and
        $e.principal.resource.attribute.labels["affectedObject name"]= /admin/ nocase
      ) or
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = /(Space export|Page exported|permission added|User reactivated|Content restriction removed|Content archived|Global Administration)/ nocase or
      $e.security_result.summary = /(Space export|Page exported|permission added|User reactivated|Content restriction removed|Content archived|Global Administration)/ nocase or
      $e.security_result.category_details = /(Space export|Page exported|permission added|User reactivated|Content restriction removed|Content archived|Global Administration)/ nocase
    )

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $result = array($e.security_result.action_details)
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $vendor_name = array($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array($e.metadata.product_name)
    $product_event_type = array($e.metadata.product_event_type)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $metadata_event_type = array($e.metadata.event_type)
    $metadata_product_event_type = array($e.metadata.event_type)

    $principal_user = array($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $principal_ip = array($e.principal.ip)
    $author_name = array($e.extracted.fields["author.name"])
    $affected_object_id = array($e.principal.resource.attribute.labels["affectedObject id"])
    $affected_object_name = array($e.principal.resource.attribute.labels["affectedObject name"])
    $affected_object_type = array($e.principal.resource.attribute.labels["affectedObject type"])
    $security_result_category_details = array($e.security_result.category_details)
    $security_result_summary = array($e.security_result.summary)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule i_github_risky_action_by_pat_user {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Github Risky Action by PAT User"
    description = "Detects actions taken by a user authenticated to GitHub via personal access tokens (PAT). Threat actors may abuse stolen PAT tokens to disrupt operations and exfiltrate data."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1078"

  events:
    $e.metadata.product_name = "GITHUB"
    $e.additional.fields["programmatic_access_type"] = "Personal access token (classic)" nocase

    (
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = /member_invited|org.invite_member/ or
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = /(audit_log_stream|business|secret_scanning|repo\.|repository_(security|vulnerability_alerts)|protected_branch).*(disable|delete|destroy)/ or
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = /update_branch_protection|user.new_device_used|user.sign_in_from_unrecognized_device|personal_access_token.create/ or
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = /ip_allow_list\.(create|update)/
    )

    $e.target.resource.name = $github_repo_name
    $e.principal.user.userid = $user_id

  match:
    $user_id over 15m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $result = array_distinct($e.security_result.summary)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $product_event_type = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_event_type)
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $principal_user_userid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $principal_user_display_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $access_type = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["programmatic_access_type"])
    $token_id = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["token_id"])
    $principal_ip = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $principal_ip_carrier_name = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.carrier_name)
    $principal_ip_carrier_asn = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.asn)
    $principal_ip_country = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region)
    $network_user_agents = array_distinct($e.network.http.user_agent)
    $github_repo_names = array_distinct($github_repo_name)
    $repository_is_public = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["repository_public"])

  condition:
    $e
}

rule i_github_org_invite_to_potential_external_user {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Github Org Invite to Potential External User"
    description = "Detects potential GitHub invites to external users by comparing the domain of the invited user to the domains from the principal user. This detection may have a high false positive rate as legitimate domains may not match the format of the compared fields and may also capture partner organizations. Validate the invitee_email user for legitimacy"
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1136.003"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "GITHUB"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "org.invite_member"
    $e.principal.user.email_addresses != ""
    $e.additional.fields["invitee_email"] = /@/

    $principal_domain = strings.to_lower(re.capture($e.principal.user.email_addresses, `@(?:(?:in|en|u|eu|i|ap)\.)?([^.]+)\.`))
    $target_email = $e.target.user.user_display_name
    $invitee_domain = strings.to_lower(re.capture($e.additional.fields["invitee_email"], `@(?:(?:in|en|u|eu|i|ap)\.)?([^.]+)\.`))

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $result = array_distinct($e.security_result.summary)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $product_event_type = array($e.metadata.product_event_type)
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $principal_user_userid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $principal_user_display_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $access_type = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["programmatic_access_type"])
    $token_id = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["token_id"])
    $principal_ip = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $principal_ip_carrier_name = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.carrier_name)
    $principal_ip_carrier_asn = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.asn)
    $principal_ip_country = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region)
    $network_user_agents = array_distinct($e.network.http.user_agent)

    $principal_domains = array_distinct($principal_domain)
    $invitee_domains = array_distinct($invitee_domain)
    $invitee_email = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["invitee_email"])
    $is_internal = max(if($invitee_domain = $principal_domain, 1, 0))

  condition:
    $e and $is_internal = 0
}

rule i_gcp_bq_cross_project_table_copy {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Potential BigQuery Cross Project Table Copy"
    description = "Detects potential cross project table copies in BigQuery. Threat actors may attempt to exfiltrate data by copying tables to projects they control. Validate whether the activity is authorized."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0010"
    technique = "T1537"
    reference = "https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/exporting-data"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "GCP_CLOUDAUDIT"
    $e.metadata.product_name = /BigQuery/ nocase

    $e.target.resource_ancestors.attribute.labels["jobinsertion_jobconfig_type"] = /COPY/
    $source_project_id = re.capture($e.target.resource_ancestors.attribute.labels["jobinsertion_jobconfig_tablecopyconfig_sourcetables"], "projects/([^/]+)/")
    $dest_project_id = re.capture($e.target.resource_ancestors.attribute.labels["jobinsertion_jobconfig_tablecopyconfig_destinationtable"], "projects/([^/]+)/")

    $userid = $e.principal.user.userid

    $e.principal.ip != /^10\./

  match:
    $userid over 15m

    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)

    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.email_addresses)
    $result = array_distinct($e.security_result.action_details)

    $resource_name = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)
    $cloud_proj_name = array_distinct($e.target.cloud.project.name)
    $jobname = array_distinct($e.target.resource_ancestors.name)
    $resource = array_distinct($e.target.resource.resource_type)
    $operation_id = array_distinct($e.about.labels["operation_id"])
    $type = array_distinct($e.target.resource_ancestors.attribute.labels["jobinsertion_jobconfig_type"])
    $status = array_distinct($e.target.resource.attribute.labels["job_insertion_job_job_status_job_state"])
    $data_src = array_distinct($e.target.resource_ancestors.attribute.labels["jobinsertion_jobconfig_tablecopyconfig_sourcetables"])
    $data_dest = array_distinct($e.target.resource_ancestors.attribute.labels["jobinsertion_jobconfig_tablecopyconfig_destinationtable"])
    $table_count = count_distinct($e.target.resource_ancestors.attribute.labels["jobinsertion_jobconfig_tablecopyconfig_sourcetables"])

rules.text:
rule i_o365_anomalous_ip_userloggedin_exchange_online {
  meta:
    rule_name = "O365 UserLoggedIn to Exchange Online from Anomalous IP"
    description = "This rule detects on successful O365 user logins to the O365 Exchange Online application from a source IP address that the user has not logged in from over the previous 30 days."
    severity = "Info"
    tactic = "TA0001"
    technique = "T1078.004"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "OFFICE_365"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "UserLoggedIn"
    $e.target.resource.product_object_id = "00000002-0000-0ff1-ce00-000000000000" // Office 365 Exchange Online
    $target_user = $e.target.user.userid
    $source_ip = $e.principal.ip
    $ip_network_name = $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.organization_name
    $ip_network_name != ""
    not net.ip_in_range_cidr($e.principal.ip, "10.0.0.0/8")
    not net.ip_in_range_cidr($e.principal.ip, "172.16.0.0/12")
    not net.ip_in_range_cidr($e.principal.ip, "192.168.0.0/16")
    $e.principal.ip != "0.0.0.0"

  match:
    $target_user,$source_ip over 1h

  outcome:
    $days_success = max(metrics.auth_attempts_success(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:first_seen,
        agg:min,
        target.user.userid:$target_user,
        principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.organization_name:$ip_network_name))
    $risk_score = 0
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.target.user.userid)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.target.user.userid)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.target.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.target.user.userid)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $e and $days_success = 0
}
rules.description: This rule detects on successful O365 user logins to the O365 Exchange Online application from a source IP address that the user has not logged in from over the previous 30 days.

    $device_name = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["target_display_name_UDDevice_0"])

rule i_github_high_volume_repos_destroyed_by_pat_user {
  meta:
    rule_name = "High Volume GitHub Repository Destroyed by PAT User"
    description = "Detects when a non-bot user with a Personal Access Token (PAT) destroys a large amount of GitHub repos in a short period of time. Threat actors may attempt to destroy repos to disrupt operations. Validate if the activity is authorized."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0009"
    technique = "T1213.003"

  events:
    $e.metadata.product_name = "GITHUB"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = /repo.destroy/ nocase
    $e.additional.fields["programmatic_access_type"] = "Personal access token (classic)" nocase
    $e.target.resource.name = $github_repo_name
    $e.principal.user.userid = $user_id

  match:
    $user_id over 15m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $result = array_distinct($e.security_result.summary)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $product_event_type = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_event_type)
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $principal_user_userid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $principal_user_display_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $access_type = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["programmatic_access_type"])
    $token_id = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["token_id"])
    $principal_ip = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $principal_ip_carrier_name = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.carrier_name)
    $principal_ip_carrier_asn = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.asn)
    $principal_ip_country = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region)
    $network_user_agents = array_distinct($e.network.http.user_agent)
    $github_repo_names = array_distinct($github_repo_name)
    $repository_is_public = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["repository_public"])
    $github_repo_name_distinct_count = count_distinct($github_repo_name)

  condition:
    $e and $github_repo_name_distinct_count > 10
}

rule i_github_action_with_suspicious_user_agent {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Github Actions with Suspicious UserAgent"
    description = "Detects when actions are taken via User Agents affiliated with tools that can exploit GitHub services. This may include tools such as lightweightgitdumper or repodumper that can be used to dump GitHub repositories. Validate if the activity is legitimate."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0009"
    technique = "T1213.003"

  events:
    $e.metadata.product_name = "GITHUB"
    $e.network.http.user_agent = /(dumper|repodump)/ nocase
    $e.target.resource.name = $github_repo_name
    $e.principal.user.userid = $user_id

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $result = array_distinct($e.security_result.summary)
    $vendor_name = array($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array($e.metadata.product_name)
    $product_event_type = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_event_type)
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $principal_user_userid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $principal_user_display_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $access_type = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["programmatic_access_type"])
    $token_id = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["token_id"])
    $principal_ip = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $principal_ip_carrier_name = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.carrier_name)
    $principal_ip_carrier_asn = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.asn)
    $principal_ip_country = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region)
    $network_user_agents = array_distinct($e.network.http.user_agent)
    $github_repo_names = array_distinct($github_repo_name)
    $repository_is_public = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["repository_public"])

  condition:
    $e
}

rule i_github_repo_downloads_by_pat_user {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Github Repository Downloaded by PAT User"
    description = "Detects when a non-bot user with a Personal Access Token (PAT) downloads a github repository. PAT may be stolen and abused by threat actors and used to exfiltrate data or disrupt operations. Validate if the activity is authorized."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0009"
    technique = "T1213.003"

  events:
    $e.metadata.product_name = "GITHUB"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = /download/ nocase
    $e.additional.fields["programmatic_access_type"] = "Personal access token (classic)" nocase
    $e.principal.user.userid = $user_id
    $e.target.resource.name = $github_repo_name
    $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.carrier_name != /(google|amazon|microsoft|zscaler)/
    $e.principal.user.userid != /\[bot\]/ nocase
    $e.principal.user.user_display_name != /\[bot\]/ nocase

  match:
    $user_id over 15m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $result = array_distinct($e.security_result.summary)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $principal_user_userid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $principal_user_display_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $access_type = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["programmatic_access_type"])
    $token_id = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["token_id"])
    $principal_ip = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $principal_ip_carrier_name = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.carrier_name)
    $principal_ip_carrier_asn = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.asn)
    $principal_ip_country = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region)
    $network_user_agents = array_distinct($e.network.http.user_agent)

    $github_repo_name_distinct_count = count_distinct($github_repo_name)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule i_github_high_volume_github_repos_fetched_by_pat_user {
  meta:
    rule_name = "High Volume GitHub Repository Fetched by PAT User"
    description = "Detects when a non-bot user with a Personal Access Token (PAT) fetches a large amount of GitHub repos in a short period of time. Threat actors may attempt to fetch repos to exfiltrate data or disrupt operations. Validate if the activity is authorized."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0009"
    technique = "T1213.003"

  events:
    $e.metadata.product_name = "GITHUB"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = /fetch/ nocase
    $e.additional.fields["programmatic_access_type"] = "Personal access token (classic)" nocase
    $e.target.resource.name = $github_repo_name
    $e.principal.user.userid = $user_id
    $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.carrier_name != /(google|amazon|microsoft|zscaler)/
    $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.carrier_name != ""
    $e.principal.user.userid != /\[bot\]/ nocase
    $e.principal.user.user_display_name != /\[bot\]/ nocase

  match:
    $user_id over 15m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $result = array_distinct($e.security_result.summary)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $product_event_type = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_event_type)
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $principal_user_userid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)

rules.display_name: Rare Login to Application by User Logging in from Multiple Locations
rules.text:
rule ueba_ws_rare_app_login_multiple_locations {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Rare Login to Application by User Logging in from Multiple Locations"
    description = "Detects when a user logs in to an application that has never been logged against before and when the user is observed to be logging in from multiple locations that are more than the past 30 days"
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0001"
    technique = "T1078"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Workspace"
    $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $user = $e.target.user.email_addresses
    $product_event_type = $e.metadata.product_event_type
    $target_application = $e.target.application
    $ip_country = $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region
    $ip_country != ""
    $ip = $e.principal.ip

  match:
    $user, $target_application, $ip over 48h

  outcome:
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $num_distinct_ip_countries = count_distinct($ip_country)
    $ip_countries = array_distinct($ip_country)
    $ips = array_distinct($ip)
    $num_distinct_ips = count_distinct($ip)
    $historical_max_country_count = max(
      metrics.auth_attempts_total(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum,agg:num_metric_periods,
        target.user.email_addresses: $user, principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region:$ip_country))
    $historical_max_app_access = max(
      metrics.auth_attempts_total(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum,agg:max,
        target.application: $target_application, target.user.email_addresses:$user))
    $num_distinct_auth_activities = count_distinct($product_event_type)
    $num_auth_activities = count($product_event_type)
    $auth_activities = array_distinct($product_event_type)
    $risk_score = max(45)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $result = array_distinct(if($e.security_result.action="ALLOW", "succeeded", "failed"))
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $e and
    ($historical_max_app_access = 0) and
    ($num_distinct_ip_countries > $historical_max_country_count) and
    ($num_distinct_ip_countries > 1)
}
rules.description: Detects when a user logs in to an application that has never been logged against before and when the user is observed to be logging in from multiple locations that are more than the past 30 days

rules.text:
rule ttp_gcp_ws_suslogin_accountcreate {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Account Creations Observed after a Successful Suspicious Login"
    description = "Detects when account creations happen after a user's login was detected as suspicious."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1136"

  events:
    $login_event.about.labels["is_suspicious"] = "true"
    $login_event.metadata.product_name = "login"
    $login_event.metadata.product_event_type = "login_success"
    $login_event.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Workspace"

    $ip = $login_event.principal.ip
    $user = $login_event.target.user.userid
    $ip_country = $login_event.principal.location.country_or_region

    $suspicious_event.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Workspace"
    (
      $suspicious_event.metadata.product_name = "admin" and
      $suspicious_event.metadata.product_event_type = "CREATE_USER"
    )

    $login_event.target.user.userid = $suspicious_event.principal.user.userid

    $target_email = $suspicious_event.target.user.email_addresses

  match:
    $user, $ip over 1h after $login_event

  outcome:
    $target_emails = array_distinct($target_email)
    $ips = array_distinct($ip)
    $ip_countries = array_distinct($ip_country)
    $risk_score = max( 55
      + if($suspicious_event.principal.user.attribute.roles.type = "ADMINISTRATOR",20)
      - if(($suspicious_event.principal.user.attribute.labels["isDelegatedAdmin"] = "true"),5)
    )
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($login_event.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($login_event.metadata.product_name)
    $result = array_distinct(if($login_event.security_result.action="ALLOW", "succeeded", "failed"))
    $result_time = min($login_event.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $login_event and $suspicious_event
}

rule ueba_ws_anomalous_increase_in_2fa_bypass {
  meta:

    description = "Detects when a higher than normal number of successful logins occur after 2-step verification is disabled."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1548.002"

  events:
    $bypass_event.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Workspace"
    $bypass_event.metadata.product_event_type = "2sv_disable"
    $bypass_event.metadata.product_name = "login"
    $user_id = $bypass_event.principal.user.userid
    $login_event.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Workspace"
    $login_event.metadata.product_name = "login"
    $login_event.metadata.product_event_type = "login_success"

    $product_event_type = $login_event.metadata.product_event_type
    $event_product_name = $login_event.metadata.product_name
    $user_id = $login_event.principal.user.userid

  match:
    $user_id over 24h after $bypass_event // Currently only 48 hour match windows are supported

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 85
    $historical_max = max(metrics.workspace_total_change_actions(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:max,
        principal.user.userid:$user_id, metadata.product_event_type:$product_event_type, metadata.product_name:$event_product_name))
    $current_total_logins = count_distinct($login_event.metadata.id)

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($bypass_event.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($bypass_event.metadata.product_name)
    $result = array_distinct(if($bypass_event.security_result.action="ALLOW", "succeeded", "failed"))
    $result_time = min($bypass_event.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $bypass_event and $login_event and ($current_total_logins > $historical_max)

rule ttp_azure_compute_connection_from_tor {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Azure Compute Connection from Tor"
    description = "Detects a successful operation on Azure Compute services where the originating IP address is a known Tor exit node."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0001"
    technique = "T1078"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "AZURE_ACTIVITY"
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "Azure Activity"

    (
      $e.target.resource.id = /MICROSOFT\.COMPUTE/ nocase or
      $e.target.resource.name = /MICROSOFT\.COMPUTE/ nocase
    )

    $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    $principalIp = $e.principal.ip
    $principalAccountId = $e.principal.user.userid
    $principalIp = $gcti.graph.entity.artifact.ip
    $gcti.graph.metadata.entity_type = "IP_ADDRESS"
    $gcti.graph.metadata.threat.threat_feed_name = "Tor Exit Nodes"
    $gcti.graph.metadata.product_name = "GCTI Feed"
    $gcti.graph.metadata.source_type = "GLOBAL_CONTEXT"

  match:
    $principalAccountId over 12h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 85
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $e and $gcti
}

rule ttp_azure_offsec_user_agent_activity {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Azure Offsec User Agent Activity"
    description = "Detects unblocked user agent activity from offensive security tools and is a strong indicator of attempted malicious activity."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0042"
    technique = "T1650"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = /azure/ nocase
    $e.security_result.action != "BLOCK"
    $e.network.http.user_agent = /(azurehound|pentoo|scout-suite|\bkali|scoutsuite|trufflehog|autodiscoverclient|microburst|AADinternals|Stormspotter|ROADtools|Steam-pipe|Monkey365|GraphRunner|SkyArk|Cloudsploit|MFASweep|CloudBrute|CloudEnum|gstrike|gcp_scanner|PurplePanda|Gcphound|Forsetisecurity|gcp_enum|BucketLoot|Trivy|\bPacu|awspx|Slyther|Invictus-|Cloudfox|Prowler|Fuzz Faster U Fool)/ nocase
    $e.network.http.user_agent != /fhir-sync-agent/ nocase
    $e.network.http.user_agent != /(\$\{(.+?):-([^}]+)\})/ nocase
    $principal_ip = $e.principal.ip

  match:
    $principal_ip over 4h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $vendor_name = "Azure"
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.target.user.userid)

    $product_event_type = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_event_type)
    $user_agents = array_distinct($e.network.http.user_agent)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.target.ip)
    $result = "success"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
