rules.display_name: Azure Function App Attack with FuncoPop
rules.text:
rule ttp_azure_function_app_attack_funcopop {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Azure Function App Attack with FuncoPop"
    description = "This alert indicates FuncoPop was used to attack an Azure Function App by identifying specific actions using the Microsoft Graph API"
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0001"
    technique = "T1078"

  events:
    $e1.metadata.log_type = "AZURE_ACTIVITY"
    $e1.metadata.vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    $e1.metadata.product_name = "Azure Activity"
    $e1.metadata.product_event_type = "MICROSOFT.STORAGE/STORAGEACCOUNTS/LISTKEYS/ACTION"
    $e1.security_result.action_details = "Success"

    $e2.metadata.log_type = "MICROSOFT_GRAPH_ACTIVITY_LOGS"
    $e2.metadata.vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    $e2.metadata.product_name = "Microsoft Graph"
    (
      $e2.target.url = /https:\/\/graph\.microsoft\.com\/.*\/\$batch/ or
      $e2.target.url = /https:\/\/graph\.microsoft\.com\/.*\/devices/ or
      $e2.target.url = /https:\/\/graph\.microsoft\.com\/.*\/groups/ or
      $e2.target.url = /https:\/\/graph\.microsoft\.com\/.*\/servicePrincipals/ or
      $e2.target.url = /https:\/\/graph\.microsoft\.com\/.*\/administrativeUnits/ or
      $e2.target.url = /https:\/\/graph\.microsoft\.com\/.*\/applications/ or
      $e2.target.url = /https:\/\/graph\.microsoft\.com\/.*\/subscribedSkus/ or
      $e2.target.url = /https:\/\/graph\.microsoft\.com\/.*\/users/ or
      $e2.target.url = /https:\/\/graph\.microsoft\.com\/.*\/\roleManagement\/directory\/estimateAccess/
    )

    $principalUserObjectId = $e1.principal.user.product_object_id
    $principalUserObjectId = $e2.principal.user.product_object_id

  match:
    $principalUserObjectId over 1h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 75
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = arrays.concat(array_distinct($e1.metadata.product_name), array_distinct($e2.metadata.product_name))
    $event_count = count_distinct($e1.metadata.id) + count_distinct($e2.metadata.id)

    $victim_name = array_distinct($e1.target.resource.name)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e1.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e1.principal.user.product_object_id)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $api_call_count = count_distinct($e2.network.http.referral_url)

  condition:
    $e1 and $e2 and $api_call_count >= 9
}
rules.description: This alert indicates FuncoPop was used to attack an Azure Function App by identifying specific actions using the Microsoft Graph API
rules.author: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence

rules.text:
rule ttp_azure_successful_command_intepreter_login_from_tor {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Azure Successful Command Intepreter Login from Tor"
    description = "Detects an Azure account successfully logging in to any Azure CLI, Powershell or Azure AD powershell where the source IP address is a known Tor exit node."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1090.003"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "AZURE_AD"
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "Azure AD"
    (
      $e.target.application = "Microsoft Azure PowerShell" or
      $e.target.application = "Microsoft Azure CLI" or
      $e.target.application = "Azure Active Directory PowerShell"
    )
    $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN" and
    $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW"

    $principalIp = $e.principal.ip
    $targetAccountId = strings.coalesce($e.target.user.userid, $e.target.user.email_addresses, $e.target.user.product_object_id)
    $principalIp = $gcti.graph.entity.artifact.ip
    $gcti.graph.metadata.entity_type = "IP_ADDRESS"
    $gcti.graph.metadata.threat.threat_feed_name = "Tor Exit Nodes"
    $gcti.graph.metadata.product_name = "GCTI Feed"
    $gcti.graph.metadata.source_type = "GLOBAL_CONTEXT"

  match:
    $targetAccountId over 12h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 85
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct(strings.coalesce($e.target.user.userid, $e.target.user.email_addresses, $e.target.user.product_object_id))
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $e and $gcti
}

rule ttp_azure_resource_enumeration_powerzure {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Azure Resource Enumeration with PowerZure"
    description = "This rule detects behavior indicative of PowerZure recon activity being ran against Azure"
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0007"
    technique = "T1069"
    reference = "https://github.com/hausec/PowerZure"

  events:
    $e1.metadata.product_name = "Microsoft Graph"
    $e1.metadata.product_event_type = "Microsoft Graph Activity"
    $e1.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_HTTP"
    $e1.network.http.method = "GET"

    (
      re.regex($e1.target.url, `https:\/\/graph\.microsoft\.com\/.*\/applications\/.*\/owners`) or
      re.regex($e1.target.url, `https:\/\/graph\.microsoft\.com\/.*\/applications`) or
      re.regex($e1.target.url, `https:\/\/graph\.microsoft\.com\/.*\/applications\/\$count`) or
      re.regex($e1.target.url, `https:\/\/graph\.microsoft\.com\/.*\/users\/.*\/MemberOf`) or
      re.regex($e1.target.url, `https:\/\/graph\.microsoft\.com\/.*\/me`)
    )

    $e2.metadata.product_name = "Microsoft Graph"
    $e2.metadata.product_event_type = "Microsoft Graph Activity"
    $e2.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_HTTP"
    $e2.network.http.method = "POST"
    re.regex($e2.target.url, `https:\/\/graph\.microsoft\.com\/.*\/directoryObjects\/microsoft\.graph\.getByIds`)

    $activity_id = $e1.network.session_id
    $activity_id = $e2.network.session_id

  match:
    $activity_id over 12h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(35)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.vendor_name)

    $victim_name = array_distinct($e1.target.resource.name)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e1.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e1.principal.user.product_object_id)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $product_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.product_name)

  condition:
    $e1 and $e2
}

rule ttp_azure_resource_enumeration_scoutsuite {
  meta:

    description = "This rule detects behavior indicative of the recon tool ScouteSuite being ran against Azure"
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0007"
    technique = "T1069"
    reference = "https://github.com/nccgroup/ScoutSuite/wiki/Azure"

  events:
    $e.metadata.product_name = "Microsoft Graph"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "Microsoft Graph Activity"
    $e.network.http.method = "GET"
    $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_HTTP"

      re.regex($e.target.url, `https://graph\.microsoft\.com/.*/policies/authorizationPolicy`) or
      re.regex($e.target.url, `https://graph\.microsoft\.com/.*/groups`) or
      re.regex($e.target.url, `https://graph\.microsoft\.com/.*/applications`) or
      re.regex($e.target.url, `https://graph\.microsoft\.com/.*/servicePrincipals`)
    )
    $activity_id = $e.network.session_id

  match:
    $activity_id over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(35)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)

    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.product_object_id)

rule ttp_azure_obufscated_user_agent_exploit_attempt {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Azure Obfuscated User Agent"
    description = "Detects specific obfuscated segments using the ${junk:-char} methodology along with http response codes indicative of potential successful exploitation. This pattern has been observed in attempts to exploit vulnerabilities like Log4Shell (CVE-2021-44228) by obfuscating payloads in User-Agent strings or other logged data."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0001"
    technique = "T1190"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = /azure|office/ nocase
    $e.security_result.action != "BLOCK"
    $e.network.http.user_agent = /(\$\{(.+?):-([^}]+)\})/ nocase
    (
      $e.network.http.response_code = 500 or
      $e.network.http.response_code = 200 or
      $e.network.http.response_code = 201 or
      $e.network.http.response_code = 204 or
      $e.network.http.response_code = 301
    )
    $principal_ip = $e.principal.ip

  match:
    $principal_ip over 4h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 20
    $vendor_name = "Azure"
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.target.user.userid)
    $event_type = array_distinct($e.metadata.event_type)
    $product_event_type = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_event_type)
    $user_agents = array_distinct($e.network.http.user_agent)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.target.ip)
    $result = "success"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: Detects specific obfuscated segments using the ${junk:-char} methodology along with http response codes indicative of potential successful exploitation. This pattern has been observed in attempts to exploit vulnerabilities like Log4Shell (CVE-2021-44228) by obfuscating payloads in User-Agent strings or other logged data.

rule ttp_gcp_scc_log4j_malware_bad_domain {
  meta:
    rule_name = "SCC: Log4j Malware: Bad Domain"
    description = "Detection of Log4j exploit traffic based on a connection to, or a lookup of, a known domain used in Log4j attacks."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1568"
    reference = "https://cloud.google.com/security-command-center/docs/how-to-investigate-threats"

  events:
    $e1.metadata.product_name = "Security Command Center"
    $e1.metadata.product_event_type = "Log4j Malware: Bad Domain"
    $e1.security_result.detection_fields["mute"] != "MUTED"
    $resource_name = $e1.target.resource.name
    $rule_name = $e1.metadata.product_event_type

  match:
    $rule_name over 1h

  outcome:
    $resource_names = array_distinct($resource_name)
    $cloud_projects = array_distinct(if($e1.target.resource_ancestors.resource_type = "CLOUD_PROJECT",$e1.target.resource_ancestors.name, ""))
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.product_name)
    $risk_score = max(0 +
      if(any $e1.security_result.severity = "CRITICAL", 95, 0) +
      if(any $e1.security_result.severity = "HIGH", 85, 0) +
      if(any $e1.security_result.severity = "MEDIUM", 65, 0) +
      if(any $e1.security_result.severity = "LOW", 35, 0) +
      if(any $e1.security_result.severity = "INFORMATIONAL", 10, 0)
    )
    $threat_category = array_distinct($e1.metadata.product_event_type)
    $scc_product = array_distinct($e1.metadata.description)
    $severity = array_distinct($e1.security_result.severity)
    $url_back_to_product = array_distinct($e1.security_result.url_back_to_product)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e1.metadata.id)

    $result_time = min($e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e1.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e1.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e1.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e1
}
rules.description: Detection of Log4j exploit traffic based on a connection to, or a lookup of, a known domain used in Log4j attacks.
rules.author: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence

rule mal_leovbs_downloader {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Fin7 VBScript Downloader"
    description = "This analytic detects Fin7 VBScript file downloader."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059.005"

  events:
    $wsf_launch.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $wsf_launch.target.process.file.full_path = /C:\\Windows\\System32\\wscript\.exe/ nocase
    $wsf_launch.target.process.command_line = /\.wsf/ nocase
    $wsf_launch.target.process.pid = $pid
    $hostname = $wsf_launch.principal.hostname

    $c2_request.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_DNS"
    $c2_request.principal.process.file.full_path = /C:\\Windows\\System32\\wscript\.exe/ nocase
    $c2_request.principal.process.pid = $pid
    $c2_request.network.dns.questions.name = $domain
    $hostname = $c2_request.principal.hostname

    $dropped_temp.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION"
    $dropped_temp.principal.process.file.full_path = /C:\\Windows\\System32\\wscript\.exe/ nocase
    $dropped_temp.principal.process.pid = $pid
    $dropped_temp.target.file.full_path = /AppData\\Local\\Temp/ nocase and
    $dropped_temp.target.file.full_path = $file_path
    $hostname = $dropped_temp.principal.hostname
    $wsf_launch.principal.process.command_line != /LiteTouch\.wsf/ nocase
    $wsf_launch.target.process.command_line != /LiteTouch\.wsf/ nocase
    $wsf_launch.target.process.command_line != /LTICleanup\.wsf/ nocase

  match:
    $hostname, $pid, $domain, $file_path over 2m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(35)
    $event_count = count_distinct($wsf_launch.metadata.id) + count_distinct($c2_request.metadata.id) + count_distinct($dropped_temp.metadata.id)

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($wsf_launch.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($wsf_launch.metadata.product_name)

    $result = "succeeded"
  condition:
    $wsf_launch and $c2_request and $dropped_temp
}

rules.text:
rule ttp_gcp_ws_chrome_malware_transfer_event {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Malware Transfer Event in Google Workspace Activity (Chrome)"
    description = "Detects malware transfer events in Google Workspace Activity logs for Chrome, which occur when content uploaded or downloaded by a user has been identified as malicious, dangerous, or unwanted."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1204.002"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Workspace"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "chrome"
    (
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "malwareTransferEvent" or
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "Malware Transfer" or
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "Malware_Transfer" or
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "MALWARE_TRANSFER"
    )
    $tab_url = strings.coalesce($e.extracted.fields["tab_url"], $e.additional.fields["tab_url"], $e.about.url)

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $event_count = 1
    $victim_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.email_addresses)
    $victim_uid = strings.coalesce($e.principal.asset.asset_id, $e.principal.asset_id, $e.principal.resource.id)
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

    $hostname = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $is_admin_user = $e.principal.user.attribute.labels["is_admin"]
    $action_details = array_distinct($e.security_result.action_details)
    $file_path = $e.target.file.full_path
    $file_type = $e.target.file.file_type
    $file_hash = $e.target.file.sha256
    $file_size_bytes = $e.target.file.size
    $source_tab_url = $tab_url
    $file_transfer_method = $e.extracted.fields["content_transfer_method"]
    $action_destination_url = $e.target.url

    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: Detects malware transfer events in Google Workspace Activity logs for Chrome, which occur when content uploaded or downloaded by a user has been identified as malicious, dangerous, or unwanted.

rules.display_name: Anomalous Google Workspace Downloads Total by a User after Unsafe or Dangerous Chrome Event
rules.text:
rule ueba_ws_anomalous_downloads_after_unsafe_chrome {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Anomalous Google Workspace Downloads Total by a User after Unsafe or Dangerous Chrome Event"
    description = "Detects anomalous (4 standard deviations higher than the user's 30 day historical average) Google Workspace downloads total by a user after an unsafe Chrome Event for that user."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0042"
    technique = "T1586.002"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Workspace"

    $product_event_type = $e.metadata.product_event_type
    $product_event_type = "download"

    $user_email = $e.principal.user.email_addresses
    $resource = $e.target.resource.name

    $d.metadata.product_name = "Chrome Management"
    (
      $d.metadata.product_event_type = "badNavigationEvent" or
      $d.metadata.product_event_type = "UNSAFE_SITE_VISIT" or
      $d.metadata.product_event_type = "dangerousDownloadEvent"
    )
    $d.principal.user.email_addresses = $user_email
    $target_url = $d.target.url

  match:
    $user_email over 24h after $d

  outcome:
    $usage_past_24h = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $num_stddevs_away = max(4)

    $historical_avg = max(
      metrics.workspace_total_download_actions(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum,agg:avg,
        principal.user.email_addresses:$user_email))

    $historical_stddev = max(
      metrics.workspace_total_download_actions(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum,agg:stddev,
        principal.user.email_addresses:$user_email))
    $historical_threshold = max(
      4*metrics.workspace_total_download_actions(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:stddev,
        principal.user.email_addresses:$user_email)
      + metrics.workspace_total_download_actions(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:avg,
        principal.user.email_addresses:$user_email))

    $files = array_distinct($resource)
    $sites_visited = array_distinct($target_url)
    $risk_score = max(45)

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $result = array_distinct(if($e.security_result.action="ALLOW", "succeeded", "failed"))
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $e and $d and ($usage_past_24h > $historical_threshold) and $historical_threshold > 0
}
rules.description: Detects anomalous (4 standard deviations higher than the user's 30 day historical average) Google Workspace downloads total by a user after an unsafe Chrome Event for that user.
rules.author: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence

rules.text:
rule ttp_gcp_gke_approve_csr_forbidden{
  meta:
    rule_name = "Failed Attempt to Approve Kubernetes Certificate Signing Request (CSR)"
    description = "Detects a failed attempt to approve a CSR due to permission limitations, which may be indicative of a user attempting to escalate privileges or persist across the Cluster environment. A user with the proper permissions allows them to create and approve a CSR for any user and group, and cause the Certificate Authority to issue a certificate that is trusted across the Cluster."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0006"
    technique = "T1649"
    false_positives = "This could be a benign action depending on the baseline activity of the organization."
    reference = "https://blog.aquasec.com/kubernetes-rbac-privilige-escalation"

  events:
    $e.security_result.detection_fields["mute"] != "MUTED"
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Cloud Platform"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "Google Kubernetes Engine"
    $e.metadata.log_type = "GCP_CLOUDAUDIT"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = /certificatesigningrequests\.approval\.update/
    any $e.security_result.action = "BLOCK"
    $e.security_result.detection_fields["response_code"] = "403"
    $e.principal.user.userid != /^system:serviceaccount:kube-system:default/ nocase
    $principal = $e.principal.user.userid
    $csr_name = re.capture($e.security_result.detection_fields["resource_name"], `\/certificatesigningrequests\/(.+)\/approval`)

  match:
    $principal over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(35)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.product_object_id)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.email_addresses)

    $result = "failed"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $principal_ips = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $target_projects = array_distinct($e.target.cloud.project.name)
    $cluster_names = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)
    $csr_names = array_distinct($csr_name)

  condition:
    $e
}

    description = "A new RBAC ClusterRole policy was created to allow a user or group to approve certificate signing requests (CSRs) within the cluster. This is a highly sensitive action as the user or group that approves CSR's can decide who trusts whom in the entire cluster environment, and can therefore severely limit or grant authenticated communications."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1098.003"
    false_positives = "This could be a benign action depending on the baseline activity of the organization."
    reference = "https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/tls/managing-tls-in-a-cluster/#approving-certificate-signing-requests"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Cloud Platform"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "Google Kubernetes Engine"
    $e.metadata.log_type = "GCP_CLOUDAUDIT"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = /clusterroles\.create/ nocase
    (
      $e.security_result.rule_labels["req_rule_0_resource_0"] = "certificatesigningrequests/approval" or
      $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["req_rule_0_resource_0"] = "certificatesigningrequests/approval"
    )
    $e.principal.user.userid != /^system:serviceaccount:kube-system:default/ nocase
    $principal = $e.principal.user.userid

  match:
    $principal over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(20 + (if($e.security_result.action = "ALLOW", 15)) + (if($e.target.user.userid = $e.principal.user.email_addresses, 15)))
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.product_object_id)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.email_addresses)

    $result = "attempted"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $results = array_distinct($e.security_result.action)
    $target_users = array_distinct($e.target.user.userid)
    $rbac_policies = array_distinct($e.security_result.detection_fields["resource_name"])
    $target_projects = array_distinct($e.target.cloud.project.name)
    $cluster_names = array_distinct($e.target.resource.attribute.labels["cls_name"])

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_o365_multiple_accounts_clicking_suspicious_url {
  meta:
    rule_name = "O365 Multiple Accounts Clicking Suspicious URL"
    description = "This detects multiple Office 365 accounts clicking on Safe Links URL click events where an account clicks on a link that was determined to be malicious or suspicious per Threat Intelligence."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0001"
    technique = "T1566.002"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "OFFICE_365"
    $e.target.application = "ThreatIntelligence"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "TIUrlClickData"
    $url_domain = strings.to_lower(re.capture($e.target.url, /:\/\/([^\/]+)\//))
    not $e.target.url = /\/\/u47401039\.ct\.sendgrid\.net|\/\/1tc\.us\/|tivusbenefits\.com\/|\.cs\.oneadp\.com\/|\.adp\.com\// nocase

  match:
    $url_domain over 60m

  outcome:
    $vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    $product_name = "Office 365"
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $risk_score = 35
    $result = "succeeded"
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $victim_count = count_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)

  condition:
    $e and $victim_count >= 4
}

  meta:

    description = "An API commonly used to obtain persistent access to a Kubernetes cluster was invoked from a known malicious IP address."

    tactic = "TA0003"

    $product_event_type over 1h

rules.text:
rule i_methodology_t1204_002_process_from_programdata_writing_to_recycler {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Process From Programdata Writing To Recycler"
    description = "Detects on a process from 'ProgramData' directory writing files to RECYCLER. This technique was previously associated with SOGU malware, writing files with Base64 encoded filenames consistent with data theft staging."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1204.002"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MOVE" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MODIFICATION"
    ) and
    re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `(^|:)\\RECYCLER.BIN`) nocase
    re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `\\ProgramData\\`) nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1

    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $threat_verdict_malicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))
    $recent_compile_time = if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)
    $invalid_cert = if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $system_user_file_write = if($e.principal.user.userid = "system", 1, 0)
    $sus_file_name_architecture = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\[^\/]+(32|64).[^\/.]+$/), 1, 0)
    $single_double_char_filename = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*([^\/]{1,2}.[^\/.]+)$/), 1, 0)
    $double_extensions = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+.[a-zA-Z]{3}.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_file_name = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\d+.[a-zA-Z]{3}$/), 1, 0)
    $common_malicious_file_names = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup\.exe|update\.js|lsass\.dmp|1\.txt|ntds\.dit|logs\.dat|sqlite3\.dll|pass_1234|system\.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $is_archive_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0)
    $is_executable_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0)
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)
    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $recent_compile_time + $system_user_file_write + $sus_file_name_architecture + $common_malicious_file_names + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_filename + $double_extensions + $sus_vt_tags + $all_numbers_file_name + $is_executable_file + $is_archive_file + $invalid_cert
    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: Detects on a process from 'ProgramData' directory writing files to RECYCLER. This technique was previously associated with SOGU malware, writing files with Base64 encoded filenames consistent with data theft staging.
rules.author: Mandiant Managed Defense

rule i_methodology_t1647_suspicious_plist_file_conversion_macos {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Suspicious Plist File Conversion Macos"
    description = "Detects the use of plutil to convert plist files. Attackers might use this to modify plist files in different formats, potentially for obfuscation or to bypass security tools that only focus on specific plist formats."

        not re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, `/Library/Application Support/JAMF/tmp/McK Set Default Browser`)

rule i_methodology_t1059_003_wmi_target_invocation_accepteula_argument {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Wmi Target Invocation Accepteula Argument"
    description = "Several tools such as Sysinternals procdump require an -AcceptEula argument to be specified during the first execution to avoid an interactive prompt to accept the EULA. Attackers often include this argument to allow their command to run non-interactively. This alert looks for WMI (Windows Management Instrumentation) used to execute a binary including this -AcceptEula argument. If being used to move laterally then this alert will occur on the target system."

    not re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `/(Grammarly Installer.app|Grammarly Desktop.app)/Contents/MacOS/Grammarly Desktop$`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, `/Applications/Grammarly Desktop.app/Contents/MacOS/Grammarly Desktop`) nocase

    $target_file = $e.target.file.full_path

    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)

    $recent_compile_time = if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)

    $sus_process_path = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /\/(private|Desktop|Downloads|Shared|tmp|Temporary\s*Items|var\/folders)\//) nocase, 1, 0)
    $system_process = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(^|\/)(unzip|python|bash|zsh|perl|ruby|sh|osascript|mktemp|curl)$/) nocase, 1, 0)

rule i_methodology_t1071_001_suspicious_payload_downloads_by_explorer {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Suspicious Payload Downloads By Explorer"
    description = "Detects on suspicious payload downloads by explorer.exe, which have been observed in a variety of Infostealer compromises. Determine maliciousness of the observed traffic and conduct further analysis on the endpoint."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1071.001"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_DNS" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_HTTP"
    ) and
    $e.network.http.method = "GET" nocase
    re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)explorer\.exe$`) nocase
    (
      re.regex($e.target.url, `value=1`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.url, `payout=`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.url, `%3D%3D$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.url, `id=\d{1,2}$`) nocase
    ) and
    (
      re.regex($e.target.url, `\.php\?cnv_id=`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.url, `\.php\?(\n)?a=`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.url, `\.php\?X\-OpenDNS`) nocase
    )

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1

    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $threat_verdict_malicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))
    $recent_compile_time = if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)
    $invalid_cert = if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $system_user_file_write = if($e.principal.user.userid = "system", 1, 0)
    $sus_file_name_architecture = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\[^\/]+(32|64).[^\/.]+$/), 1, 0)
    $single_double_char_filename = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*([^\/]{1,2}.[^\/.]+)$/), 1, 0)
    $double_extensions = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+.[a-zA-Z]{3}.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_file_name = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\d+.[a-zA-Z]{3}$/), 1, 0)
    $common_malicious_file_names = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup\.exe|update\.js|lsass\.dmp|1\.txt|ntds\.dit|logs\.dat|sqlite3\.dll|pass_1234|system\.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $is_archive_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0)
    $is_executable_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0)
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)
    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $recent_compile_time + $system_user_file_write + $sus_file_name_architecture + $common_malicious_file_names + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_filename + $double_extensions + $sus_vt_tags + $all_numbers_file_name + $is_executable_file + $is_archive_file + $invalid_cert
    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: Detects on suspicious payload downloads by explorer.exe, which have been observed in a variety of Infostealer compromises. Determine maliciousness of the observed traffic and conduct further analysis on the endpoint.

rule ttp_macos_shell_cloud_credential_copying {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Macos Shell Cloud Credential Copying"
    description = "Detects instances where a Unix shell or osascript is used to copy local cloud service provider credential configurations (AWS, Azure, GCP) to a temporary staging path. Adversaries routinely copy these configurations to staging directories before exfiltrating or parsing them in order to steal active command-line sessions or service account tokens."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0006"
    technique = "T1552.001"

    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"
    )
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /\b(sh|dash|bash|zsh|osascript)$/ nocase
    (
      $e.target.process.command_line = /\b(cp|ditto|rsync|tar|zip)\s.*["']?\/Users\/[^\/]+\/\.config\/gcloud\/(credentials\.db|application_default_credentials\.json)\b.*\/(private\/tmp|tmp|users\/shared)\/.*/ nocase or

    )
    $e.principal.process.command_line != /(\.claude\/shell-snapshots\/snapshot|Do not use zip deploy|__CODEX_SNAPSHOT_PROXY_OVERRIDE_)/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line != /(\.claude\/shell-snapshots\/snapshot|Do not use zip deploy|__CODEX_SNAPSHOT_PROXY_OVERRIDE_)/ nocase

    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1
    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)

rule i_windows_filewrite_to_users_public_music {
  meta:
    rule_name = "File Write to Users Public Music"

    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )

      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)

rules.text:
rule ttp_windows_ds_replication_get_changes_by_standard_user_account {
  meta:
    rule_name = "DS Replication Get Changes All by Standard User Account"
    description = "Detects when a standard User account initiates the DS-Replication-Get-Changes replication process in either low or high volume. This TTP has been observed in DCSync attacks to gain access to Domain data such as password hashes and Kerberos keys. Validate that the User and Host requesting the replication is legitimate."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0006"
    technique = "T1003.006"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "4662" and
      $e.additional.fields["xml_AccessMask"] = "0x100" and
      $e.additional.fields["xml_Properties"] = /1131f6ad-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2|1131f6aa-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2|89e95b76-444d-4c62-991a-0facbeda640c/ nocase
    )
    $e.principal.user.userid != /\$$|^MSOL_|^(Azure)?ADConnect|srv|service|sync/ nocase

    $user = $e.principal.user.userid
    $target_dc = $e.principal.hostname

  match:
    $user over 10m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.windows_sid)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

  condition:
    $e and ($event_count < 15 or $event_count > 100)
}

rule i_registry_change_to_lsa_authentication_packages {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Registry Write to LSA Authentication Packages"
    description = "Detects the creation, modification, or deletion of 2 registry keys: HKLM\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Lsa\\Authentication Packages and HKLM\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Lsa\\OSConfig\\Authentication Packages. These are registry key changes that have been observed in Mandiant investigations. Registry writes to this key/value aren't inherently malicious and should be correlated with addtitional security signal."
    severity = "Info"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1547.002"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "REGISTRY_CREATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "REGISTRY_MODIFICATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "REGISTRY_DELETION"
    )
    (
      $e.target.registry.registry_key = /\\Lsa\\Authentication Packages/ nocase or
      $e.target.registry.registry_key = /\\Lsa\\OSConfig\\Authentication Packages/ nocase or
      $e.target.registry.registry_value_name = "Authentication Packages" nocase
    )
    $e.target.registry.registry_value_data = /[a-z0-9]/ nocase

    $vt_tags = strings.coalesce($e.principal.process.file.tags, "None")
    $asset = $e.principal.asset.asset_id

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "tracker"
    $principal_process = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_registry_key = $e.target.registry.registry_key
    $target_registry_value = $e.target.registry.registry_value_name
    $target_value_data = $e.target.registry.registry_value_data
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_type = $e.metadata.event_type
    $event_count = 1
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $recent_compile_time = if($e.principal.process.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)
    $invalid_cert = if(any $e.principal.process.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $principal_process_vt_tags = if(re.regex($vt_tags, /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|invalid-signature|via-tor)/), 1, 0)
    $principal_process_security_result_threat_verdict = if($e.principal.process.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS" or $e.principal.process.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $known_suspicious_registry_text = if(re.regex(strings.to_lower($target_value_data), /(admin\$|\%systemroot\%|\\appData\\local\\temp\\)/), 1, 0)
    $sus_process_name_architecture = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /^.*\\[^\/]+(32|64)\.exe$/), 1, 0)
    $single_double_char_process_name = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /^.*\\([^\/]{1,2}\.exe)$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_process_name = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /\\\d+\.exe$/), 1, 0)
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)

    $producer_risk_score = $recent_compile_time + $sus_process_name_architecture + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_process_name + $all_numbers_process_name + $invalid_cert + $known_suspicious_registry_text

    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0)

    $summary = strings.concat("The process ", strings.to_upper($principal_process), " changed the ", $e.target.registry.registry_key, " under the User context of ", strings.to_upper($adversary_uid))

  condition:
    $e
}

Registry writes to this key/value aren't inherently malicious and should be correlated with addtitional security signal.

rule i_methodology_t1195_002_3cx_desktop_application_dns_request_for_known_bad_domain {
  meta:
    rule_name = "3Cx Desktop Application Dns Request For Known Bad Domain"
    description = "Detects on DNS requests performed by the 3CX Desktop Application for known-bad domains. This activity is associated with malicious DLLs that are downloaded to the system following an update to 3CX Desktop Application versions on Windows and Mac. Per public reporting, following a seven day sleep period, the backdoor DLL will download an icon file stored in a Github repository that contains a hard-coded command and control address. To investigate this detection further, analysts should determine if malicious versions of the files ffmpeg.dll or d3dcompiler_47.dll are present under the 3CXDesktopApp directory and investigate activity related to potential web browser credential theft."

    tactic = "TA0001"
    technique = "T1195.002"

    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_DNS" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_HTTP"

    (
      $e.network.dns.questions.name = `akamaicontainer.com` nocase or
      $e.network.dns.questions.name = `akamaitechcloudservices.com` nocase or

rule i_methodology_t1071_001_ducktail_network_connections_credtheft {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Ducktail Network Connections Credtheft"
    description = "Detects on network events related to DUCKTAIL. DUCKTAIL is a credential stealer written in .NET Core that targets individuals and organizations that operate on Facebook's Business/Ads platform."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1071.001"
    reference = "https://www.zscaler.com/blogs/security-research/new-php-variant-ducktail-infostealer-targeting-facebook-business-accounts"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_DNS" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_HTTP"
    ) and
    (
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `\\AppData\\Local\\Packages\\[^\\\/]+\\[^\\\/]+\\php\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|[A-Z]:)\\[^\\\/]+\\[^\\\/]+\\AppData\\Local\\[^\\\/]+\\[^\\\/]+\\php\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `\\AppData\\Roaming\\[^\\\/]+\\[^\\\/]+\\php\.exe$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `\\AppData\\(Roaming|Local)\\.{1,8}Content\\php\.exe$`) nocase or
      (
        not re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `\\AppData\\Local\\php\\php\-`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `\\AppData\\Local\\Programs\\php`) nocase and
        (
          re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|[A-Z]:)\\[^\\\/]+\\[^\\\/]+\\AppData\\Local\\Packages\\[^\\\/]+\\[^\\\/]+\\php\.exe$`) nocase or
          re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|[A-Z]:)\\[^\\\/]+\\[^\\\/]+\\AppData\\Local\\[^\\\/]+\\[^\\\/]+\\php\.exe$`) nocase or
          re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|[A-Z]:)\\[^\\\/]+\\[^\\\/]+\\AppData\\Roaming\\[^\\\/]+\\v[0-9]{4}\\php\.exe$`) nocase or
          re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `\\AppData\\(Roaming|Local)\\.{1,8}Content\\php\.exe$`) nocase
        )
      ) or
      (
        re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `.`) nocase and
        re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `\\AppData\\(Roaming|Local)\\(ContentCloud|CloudContent)\\[^\\\/]+\.\w{2,4}$`) nocase
      ) or
      (
        re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `_sys_\d{2,3}\.exe$`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.network.http.user_agent, `.`) nocase and
        $e.target.url = `^http(s)?:\/\/(?:[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?\.)+[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9]/xml/$` nocase
      )
    )

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0

rule i_methodology_t1204_002_wmiprvse_suspicious_filewrite {

    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1204.002"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MOVE"
    ) and
    (
      (
        re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `(\\(C|IPC|ADMIN)\$|Windows)\\__\d+\.\d+`) nocase and
        (
          $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /(^|\\)WmiPrvSE\.exe/ nocase or
          $e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path = /(^|\\)WmiPrvSE\.exe/
        )
      ) or
      (
        re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `(\\[^\.]+$|exe|js|bat|dll|htm|jpg|zip|dat)$`) nocase and
        re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `C:\\[^\\]+(\\[\w\-\_\.]+\.[A-Za-z]{3,4})?$|\\(C|IPC|ADMIN)\$`) nocase and
        not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `(PyDWM|SMSPKOC|DeployAgent|Temp\\FXS|FSLogix|Microsoft\\Installer|Windows\\(Temp|Installer)|\\SystemTemp\\|CCM|PSScriptPolicy|sccm|config\\systemprofile)`) nocase and
        (
          $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /(^|\\)WmiPrvSE\.exe/ nocase or
          $e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path = /(^|\\)WmiPrvSE\.exe/
        )
      )
    )

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid

      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)

    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

    $base_risk_score = .60 * 1000
    $user_agent_risk_score = max(
      if( //Increase risk score if user agent is associated with an automated routine such as scripting language client
        $e.network.http.user_agent = /(python|curl|go-|wget|selenium|aiohttp|Headless)/ nocase,
        .25,
        0
      ) +
      if( //Increase risk score if user agent is associated with an offensive security tool like Kali
        $e.network.http.user_agent = /(kali|scoutsuite|trufflehog|autodiscoverclient|microburst|AADinternals|Stormspotter|ROADtools|Steam-pipe|Monkey365|GraphRunner|SkyArk|Cloudsploit|MFASweep|CloudBrute|CloudEnum|gstrike|gcp_scanner|PurplePanda|Gcphound|Forsetisecurity|gcp_enum|BucketLoot|Trivy|Pacu|awspx|Slyther|Invictus-|Cloudfox|Prowler)/ nocase,

        0
      ) +
      if( //Increase risk score if user agent is associated with a command line tool
        $e.network.http.user_agent = /(aws-cli)/ nocase,
        .25,
        0
      )
    ) * 1000
    $action_allowed_risk_score = max(
      if( //Increase risk score if the action was performed successfully
        $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW",
        .10,
        0
      )

    $longterm_credential_risk_score = max(
      if( //Increase risk score if the action was performed by a long term access key
        $e.additional.fields["accessKeyId"] = /^AKIA/,
        .10,
        0
      )
    ) * 1000
    $mfa_authenticated_risk_score = max(
      if( //Increase risk score if the action was performed while the user was not authenticated via MFA
        $e.principal.user.attribute.labels["mfaAuthenticated"] = "false",
        .10,
        0
      )
    ) * 1000
    $mitre_tactic = "Execution"
    $mitre_technique = "T1204.002"
    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line

rules.text:
rule i_methodology_t1059_001_cobalt_strike_sysnative_spawnto_x64_post_exploitation {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Cobalt Strike Sysnative Spawnto X64 Post Exploitation"
    description = "Cobalt Strike post-exploitation activity creates child processes (post-exploitation binaries, aka, spawnto_*) from the parent Beacon process. These processes are set in Cobalt Strike's CSBundle and the spawnto_x64 value is often set with a path including SysNative instead of SysWOW64. This IOC detects PowerShell event logs where the host application running the unmanaged PowerShell is a binary with this SysNative defined in the path. E.g. C:\\Windows\\SysNative\\rundll32.exe, C:\\Windows\\SysNative\\dllhost.exe, C:\\Windows\\SysNative\\SearchProtocolHost.exe, etc."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059.001"

  events:
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "400" and
    $e.additional.fields["Channel"] = `Windows PowerShell` nocase and
    re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, `[A-Z]:\\Windows\\SysNative\\`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, `[A-Z]:[\\/]+(Windows|WINDOW~\d)[\\/]+SysNative[\\/]+(WindowsPowerShell|WINDOW~\d)[\\/]+v1\.0[\\/]+(powershell|POWERS~\d)`) nocase and
    not re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, `[A-Z]:[\\/]+(Windows|WINDOW~\d)[\\/]+SysNative[\\/]+(dsac)\.exe`) nocase

  outcome:

rules.text:
rule i_methodology_t1105_powershell_invoke_webrequest_output_into_suspicious_location {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Powershell Invoke Webrequest Output Into Suspicious Location"
    description = "Detects command line arguments where powershell Invoke-WebRequest output is being written to a location typically used by attackers."
    severity = "Info"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1105"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `powershell`) nocase
    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `http`) nocase
    (
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `Invoke\-WebRequest`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\biwr `) nocase
    ) and
    (
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `[-]O(utfile)?\s*.{0,2}(\w:(\\|\/){1,2}(ProgramData|Users\\Public|\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\))`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `[-]O(utfile)?\s*(\w:\\)?[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,15}\.\w{3,4}`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `[-]O(utfile)?\s*.?\%.*\%(\\|\/)`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `[-]O(utfile)?\s*\$env:(COMPUTERNAME|APPDATA|TEMP)`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `[-]O(utfile)?\s*\$[\w]{1,3}[;\s$]`) nocase
    )

rule i_methodology_t1087_002_net_group_domain_account_discovery {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Domain Account Discovery via Net Group Command"
    description = "Detects on the execution of the Windows net.exe utility to enumerate members of the Domain Users group."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0007"
    technique = "T1087.002"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    (
      $e.target.process.file.full_path = /net\.exe$/ nocase or
      (
        $e.target.process.file.full_path = /net1\.exe$/ nocase and
        not $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /net\.exe$/ nocase
      )
    )
    (//net group or groups (launched on the domain controller)
      $e.target.process.command_line = /\sgroup/ nocase or
      ( //net localgroup /domain
        $e.target.process.command_line = /\slocalgroup\s/ nocase and
        $e.target.process.command_line = /\/do/ nocase
      )
    )
    $e.target.process.command_line != /\s\/(ad|de)/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line = /Domain Users/ nocase
    $e.principal.asset_id = $asset_id

  match:
    $asset_id over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)

    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $hostname = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)

    $principal_process_file_full_path = array($e.principal.process.file.full_path)

rule i_methodology_netsh_add_allowedprogram_via_firewall {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Netsh Add Allowedprogram Via Firewall"
    description = "Detects on parent processes spawning netsh.exe with command line arguments designed to modify the Windows Firewall to allow a process to communicate through the firewall. This technique has been previously observed being utilised by malicious actors."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1686.003"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"
    ) and
    re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)netsh\.exe$`) nocase and
    (
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `firewall add allowedprogram.*\\(windows\\system32\\|AppData\\Local\\Temp|Windows\\SysWOW64).*\.exe"?\s+.*\sENABLE\s*$`) nocase or
      (

rule i_windows_filewrite_to_inetpub_wwwroot {
  meta:
    rule_name = "File Write to Inetpub Wwwroot"
    description = "Detects file creation or file move events in the Windows IIS web root directory (inetpub\\wwwroot). Threat actors frequently stage web shells or utilities in accessible web directories following exploitation."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1204.002"
    false_positives = "Legitimate web application updates, deployments, or IIS administrative activities may occasionally create or modify files in the wwwroot directory."

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MOVE"
    )
    $e.target.file.full_path = /([A-Z]:|^|\\Device\\HarddiskVolume\d+)\\inetpub\\wwwroot\\[^\\]+\.(dll|bin|txt)$/ nocase
    all $e.target.file.tags != /(trusted|legit|known-distributor|nsrl)/ nocase

    $vt_tags = strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None")
    $file_type = strings.coalesce($e.target.file.mime_type, "UNKNOWN")
    $asset = $e.principal.asset.asset_id

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $principal_process = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_file = $e.target.file.full_path
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $summary = strings.concat("The process ", strings.to_upper($principal_process), " wrote an ", strings.to_upper($file_type), " to ", $target_file, " under the User context of ", strings.to_upper($adversary_uid))
    $suppression_key = strings.concat($principal_process, $target_file)

  condition:
    $e

  options:
    suppression_window = 10m
}

rules.text:
rule ttp_windows_short_filename_vbscript_in_startup {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Short Filename VBScript Persistence in Startup"
    description = "Detects Windows Script Host executing a .vbs script with a 1 to 3 character filename from the Startup directory. Attackers use these shortened names to minimize their footprint in process logs and to blend into administrative noise."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1547.001"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"
    )
    re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `(?:^|\\)(?:wscript|cscript)(?:\.exe)?$`) nocase
    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\\Programs\\Startup\\[^\\]{1,3}\.vbs\b`) nocase

    $e.principal.hostname = $hostname

  match:
    $hostname over 10m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)

      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $principal_hostname = array_distinct($hostname)
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = array($e.principal.process.command_line)
    $principal_process_file_full_path = array($e.principal.process.file.full_path)
    $target_process_command_line = array($e.target.process.command_line)

    $asset_is_server = max(if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0))

  condition:
    $e
}

rules.text:
rule i_methodology_t1059_004_global_socket_toolkit_download_and_execution {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Global Socket Toolkit Download And Execution"
    description = "Detects on the installation and execution of the Global Socket Toolkit, which can be used to proxy network traffic, transfer files, and establish a reverse shell that acts as a backdoor to a system. The Global Socket Toolkit consists of multiple tools, including a tunneler application called gsocket to redirect network traffic over a TCP connection using the Global Socket Relay Network (GSRN), which operates similar to a Virtual Private Network (VPN) or Tor network. The Global Socket Toolkit also includes a version of the Netcat networking utility, an SFTP server application, a remote file share mounting application, and other utilities. To investigate this activity further, analysts should review the command line arguments to determine if they are consistent with the installation of the Global Socket Toolkit and look for suspicious command execution under the same user context."
    severity = "Info"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059.004"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" and
    (
      not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `conda/include/`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `/anaconda`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `/python/`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `conda/pkgs`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `logsocket`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `(libgio|glib)`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `^ls \-Lnd /opt/`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, `\/workspaces?\/`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\/workspaces?\/`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, `Jenkin`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `Jenkin`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\/Applications\/Blitz\.app\/Contents\/`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `LeagueClientUx`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\/exe\/blitz`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `syslog\-ng`) nocase and
      not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\/build.*arrisatom\/`) nocase and
      (
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `gsocket\.io`) nocase or
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\/gsocket`) nocase or
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `(\s|\/)GSOCKET_`) nocase or
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `install\s+gsocket\b`) nocase or
        re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `gsexec$`) nocase or
        re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `gs\-netcat$`) nocase or
        re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `gsocket$`) nocase or
        re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `blitz$`) nocase or
        re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `gs\-sftp$`) nocase or
        re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `gs\-mount$`) nocase or
        re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `gs\-full\-pipe$`) nocase or
        re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `gsexec$`) nocase or
        re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `gsocket$`) nocase or
        re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `gs\-netcat$`) nocase or
        re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `blitz$`) nocase or
        re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `gs\-sftp$`) nocase or
        re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `gs\-mount$`) nocase or
        re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `gs\-full\-pipe$`) nocase
      )
    )

  outcome:

rule i_methodology_t1036_007_windows_screensaver_file_writes_with_double_extension {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Windows Screensaver File Writes With Double Extension"
    description = "Detects on Windows screensaver (.scr) file write events with double extension."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1036.007"

  events:
    ($e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MOVE" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MODIFICATION") and
    re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `\.(bat|dat|js|vbs|wsf|vbe|dat|jse|exe|dll)\.scr$`) nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1

    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $threat_verdict_malicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))
    $recent_compile_time = if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)
    $invalid_cert = if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $system_user_file_write = if($e.principal.user.userid = "system", 1, 0)
    $sus_file_name_architecture = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\[^\/]+(32|64).[^\/.]+$/), 1, 0)
    $single_double_char_filename = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*([^\/]{1,2}.[^\/.]+)$/), 1, 0)
    $double_extensions = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+.[a-zA-Z]{3}.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_file_name = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\d+.[a-zA-Z]{3}$/), 1, 0)
    $common_malicious_file_names = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup\.exe|update\.js|lsass\.dmp|1\.txt|ntds\.dit|logs\.dat|sqlite3\.dll|pass_1234|system\.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $is_archive_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0)
    $is_executable_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0)
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)
    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $recent_compile_time + $system_user_file_write + $sus_file_name_architecture + $common_malicious_file_names + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_filename + $double_extensions + $sus_vt_tags + $all_numbers_file_name + $is_executable_file + $is_archive_file + $invalid_cert
    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e
}

    technique = "T1127.001"

    not re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `\\Windows\\System32\\cmd\.exe`) nocase

    $sus_file_name_architecture = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\[^\/]+(32|64).[^\/.]+$/), 1, 0)
    $single_double_char_filename = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*([^\/]{1,2}.[^\/.]+)$/), 1, 0)
    $double_extensions = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+.[a-zA-Z]{3}.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0)

    $is_executable_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0)

rule ttp_potential_macos_infostealer_activity {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Potential macOS Infostealer Activity"
    description = "Detects activity associated with macOS infostealer variants, which are designed to harvest and exfiltrate sensitive data, including browser credentials, cryptocurrency wallet secrets, and detailed system metadata. Additionally, the malware scans for and captures user files within the Desktop and Documents directories. The gathered intelligence is typically staged locally before being transmitted to a command-and-control (C2) server via HTTP."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059.002"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MODIFICATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MOVE"
    ) and
    (
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `^bash \-c \"system_profiler SPHardwareDataType\"`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `curl -X POST.*--data-binary.*http(s)?://([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}/(sendlog|p2p|joinsystem)`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `bash -c.*security 2.*\/dev\/null find-generic-password -ga .Chrome`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `"?ditto \-c \-k \-\-sequesterRsrc \-\-keepParent .*/Users/[^\\\/]+/[^\\\/]+\.zip \-\-norsrc \-\-noextattr"?$`) nocase or
      (
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `osascript`) nocase and
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\-e `) nocase and
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `(password|passphrase)`) nocase and
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `display dialog`) nocase and
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `web data|login data|cookies|System Preferences|Required System Upgrade`) nocase
      ) or
      (
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `osascript \-e`) nocase and
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `set username`) nocase and
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `set homePath`) nocase and
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `set fileSize`) nocase and
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `set extensionsList`) nocase and
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `Cookies\.binarycookies`) nocase and
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `fileGrabberFolderPath`) nocase
      ) or
      (
        re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `.`) nocase and
        (
          re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `^/Users/[^\\\/]+/\d{10,}/FileGrabber/.DS_Store$`) nocase or
          re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `^/Users/[^\\\/]+/\d{10,}/Chromium/Chrome/(Password|Autofill|Cookies)\d{1,2}$`) nocase or
          re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `^/Users/[^\\\/]+/\d{10,}/(login-keychain|password-entered|Sysinfo.txt)$`) nocase
        )
      )
    )

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0

  meta:

    description = "Detects modifications to the SchUseStrongCrypto registry key which enforces strong cryptography settings for all .NET applications. Specifically, this alert looks for references to this registry key in base64 encoded process arguments (UTF8 and Unicode) as there have been observations of attackers modifying this registry key via PowerShell encoded commands."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1112"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    (
      (
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `XE1pY3Jvc29mdFwuTkVURnJhbWV3b3Jr|aWNyb3NvZnRcLk5FVEZyYW1ld29y|TWljcm9zb2Z0XC5ORVRGcmFtZXdvcmtc`) and

        not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `/C echo `)

rule ttp_windows_cmd_suspicious_script_write_from_temp {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Command Prompt Suspicious Script Write from Temp"
    description = "Detects when Command Prompt (cmd.exe) creates, modifies, or moves scripting or executable files (such as .vbs, .ps1, etc inside the AppData Local Temp directory, when cmd.exe itself was spawned by a process running out of the AppData Local Temp directory. This behavior is highly indicative of multi-stage stagers or downloaders landing in the user profile space and launching command prompts to write or execute additional malicious modules."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059.003"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MODIFICATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MOVE"
    ) and
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /\bcmd\.exe$/ nocase
    $e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path = /\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\/ nocase
    $e.target.file.full_path = /\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\.*\.(cmd|vbs|vbe|js|jse|wsf|com|lnk|ps1|dat|pif|exe|scr)$/ nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1
    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_file_full_path = $e.target.file.full_path
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e

  options:
    suppression_window = 10m
}
