rules.text:
rule ttp_python_connection_to_newly_registered_domain {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Python Connection to Newly Registered Domain"
    description = "Detects Python processes communicating with a domain registered in the last 24 hours."
    severity = "Info"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1071"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION" OR
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_DNS" OR
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_HTTP"
    )

    $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /python/ nocase
    $e.target.hostname != ""
    not net.ip_in_range_cidr($e.target.ip, "10.0.0.0/8")
    not net.ip_in_range_cidr($e.target.ip, "172.16.0.0/12")
    not net.ip_in_range_cidr($e.target.ip, "192.168.0.0/16")

    $whois.graph.metadata.entity_type = "DOMAIN_NAME"
    $whois.graph.entity.domain.name = $e.target.hostname
    $whois.graph.entity.domain.creation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 24) // last 24 hours

    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname

  match:
    $hostname over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $principal_hostname = array_distinct($hostname)
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_type = array_distinct($e.metadata.event_type)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.windows_sid)
    $is_successful = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 1))
    $result = if($is_successful > 0, "succeeded", "failed")
    $result_time = array($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

    $principal_process_command_line = array_distinct($e.principal.process.command_line)

rule i_registry_change_to_image_file_execution_options_debugger {

    description = "Detects on a registry changes to the security relevant keyPath Microsoft\\\\windows Nt\\\\currentversion\\\\image File Execution Options\\debugger. These are registry key changes that have been observed in Mandiant investigations. Registry writes to this key/value aren't inherently malicious and should be correlated with addtitional security signal."
    severity = "Info"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1546.012"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "REGISTRY_CREATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "REGISTRY_MODIFICATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "REGISTRY_DELETION"
    )

    $e.target.registry.registry_value_name = "Debugger" nocase

    $vt_tags = strings.coalesce($e.principal.process.file.tags, "None")
    $asset = $e.principal.asset.asset_id

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "tracker"
    $principal_process = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_registry_key = $e.target.registry.registry_key
    $target_registry_value = $e.target.registry.registry_value_name
    $target_value_data = $e.target.registry.registry_value_data
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id

    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_type = $e.metadata.event_type
    $event_count = 1
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $recent_compile_time = if($e.principal.process.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)
    $invalid_cert = if(any $e.principal.process.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $principal_process_vt_tags = if(re.regex($vt_tags, /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|invalid-signature|via-tor)/), 1, 0)
    $principal_process_security_result_threat_verdict = if($e.principal.process.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS" or $e.principal.process.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $registry_text_length_score = if(strings.count_substrings($target_value_data,/./) > 100, 1, 0)
    $known_suspicious_registry_text = if(re.regex(strings.to_lower($target_value_data), /(\%comspec\%|admin\$|\%systemroot\%|lsass|\\Temp\\|mshta|echo)/), 1, 0) nocase
    $sus_process_name_architecture = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /^.*\\[^\/]+(32|64)\.exe$/), 1, 0)
    $single_double_char_process_name = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /^.*\\([^\/]{1,2}\.exe)$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_process_name = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /\\\d+\.exe$/), 1, 0)
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)

    $producer_risk_score = $recent_compile_time + $sus_process_name_architecture + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_process_name + $all_numbers_process_name + $invalid_cert + $known_suspicious_registry_text + $registry_text_length_score

    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0)

    $summary = strings.concat("The process ", strings.to_upper($principal_process), " changed the ", $e.target.registry.registry_key, " under the User context of ", strings.to_upper($adversary_uid))

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_windows_network_requests_from_temp_to_ip_as_hostname {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Network Requests From Temp To IP As Hostname"
    description = "Detects on a process executing from common temporary directories such as C:\\Windows\\Temp, AppData\\Local\\Temp, or temporary archive extraction folders that is initiating an outbound network connection where the destination hostname is a raw IP address. Adversaries frequently abuse these temporary folders to blend in with legitimate system activity or stage malicious binaries."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1071.001"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_HTTP" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_UNCATEGORIZED"
    ) and
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /(^|[A-Z]:|\\Device\\HarddiskVolume\d+)(\\Windows\\Temp\\|\\[^\\\/]+\\[^\\\/]+\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\)/ nocase and

      $e.network.http.method = "POST" nocase or
      $e.network.http.method = "GET" nocase or

One example is the IKEEXT service that attempts to load a file named wlbsctrl.dll. A threat actor can create a malicious DLL using a phantom DLL file name and place it in the System32 directory for execution and persistence. To investigate this activity further, analysts should acquire the DLL file and determine its functionality and purpose. There may be true positive innocuous results related to legacy Windows operating systems, such as Windows Server 2003.

    description = "Detects on the execution of a Windows system binary by rundll32.exe without command-line parameters. rules.display_name: Xagt Launching Command Shell or Scripting Interpreter
rules.text:
rule i_multi_methodology_t1072_xagt_launch_cmd_or_script_interpreter {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Xagt Launching Command Shell or Scripting Interpreter"
    description = "Detects the use of the Trellix Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) agent process (xagt) to launch a command shell or scripting interpreter on an endpoint. While the Trellix EDR Controller natively uses the Host Remediation module to execute actions, certain telemetry events may lack the explicit '-mode HostRemediation' command-line flag while still capturing the underlying shell execution. Threat actors who gain administrative access to centralized security management systems can abuse the tool's high privileges to spawn interactive shells (such as cmd.exe, PowerShell, or bash) across target systems, bypassing standard network boundaries to execute malicious scripts and move laterally."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0008"
    technique = "T1072"
    false_positives = "Administrators may use the Host Remediation module for data collection or endpoint remediation."
    reference = "https://docs.trellix.com/bundle/hr_2-0-0_ug/page/module-overview.html"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    (
      $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /\bxagt(\.exe)?$/ nocase or
      $e.principal.process.file.names = /^xagt(\.exe)?$/ nocase
    )
    $e.principal.process.command_line != /\bHostRemediation\b/ nocase
    (
      $e.target.process.command_line = /\b(cmd\.exe|powershell\.exe|pwsh\.exe)\b/ nocase or
      $e.target.process.file.full_path = /\b(cmd\.exe|powershell\.exe|pwsh\.exe)\b/ nocase or
      $e.target.process.file.names = /\b(cmd\.exe|powershell\.exe|pwsh\.exe)\b/ nocase or
      $e.target.process.command_line = /\b(bash|sh|zsh|dash|ksh|tcsh|csh)\b/ nocase or
      $e.target.process.file.full_path = /\b(bash|sh|zsh|dash|ksh|tcsh|csh)\b/ nocase or
      $e.target.process.file.names = /\b(bash|sh|zsh|dash|ksh|tcsh|csh)\b/ nocase or
      $e.target.process.command_line = /\b(osascript|python|perl|ruby|php)\b/ nocase or
      $e.target.process.file.full_path = /\b(osascript|python|perl|ruby|php)\b/ nocase or
      $e.target.process.file.names = /\b(osascript|python|perl|ruby|php)\b/ nocase
    )
    $e.target.process.command_line != /process == \"sshd\" \|\| process == \"screensharingd\"|\/usr\/bin\/log stream --level info|FireEye\/xagt\/exts\/|\/usr\/local\/dgagent\/|debian-sa1 > \/dev\/null && debian-sa1|FireEye\\FeAmsiProvider\.dll|Get-WmiObject win32_logicaldisk|conhost\.exe\s+0xffffffff|\\ProgramData\\FireEye\\xagt\\exts\\|^sh -c$|cmd.exe \/c wmic os get LocalDateTime \/VALUE 2>NUL|\bcmd.exe \/c ver$|&& export IFS=\"\$1\"|^\/bin\/rpm\s|^\/usr\/bin\/dpkg-query\s|^\/opt\/fireeye\/bin\/xagt\s|WerFault\.exe\s+-u\s+-p\s+\d+\s+-s\s+\d+/ nocase
    $principal_process = strings.coalesce($e.principal.process.file.full_path, $e.principal.process.file.names[0])
    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname

  match:
    $principal_hostname,$principal_process over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.windows_sid)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $hostname = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = array($e.principal.process.command_line)
    $principal_process_file_full_path = array($e.principal.process.file.full_path)
    $asset_is_server = max(if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0))

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_windows_script_host_spawns_powershell_staged_script {
  meta:

    description = "Detects Windows Script Host (wscript.exe or cscript.exe) executing a script located in AppData\\Local that spawns PowerShell with the -File parameter to execute a .ps1 script staged in AppData\\Local."

rule ttp_macos_suspicious_adhoc_code_signing {
  meta:
    rule_name = "macOS Suspicious Ad-Hoc Code Signing"
    description = "Detects the execution of ad-hoc code signing which may allow for bypass of Gatekeeper. Providing the detached hyphen(-) after the --sign flag creates an anonymous signature which may allow bypass of code signatures required by MacOS."
    severity = "Info"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1553.001"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"
    )
    $e.target.process.command_line = /codesign/
    $e.target.process.command_line = /--force/
    $e.target.process.command_line = /--deep/
    $e.target.process.command_line = /--sign -\s/
    $e.target.process.command_line = /(\/((private\/)?tmp|Users\/Shared|(private\/)?var\/folders|Library\/(Launch(Agents|Daemons)|Application\sSupport))\/|~\/\.)/ nocase
    $e.principal.hostname = $hostname

  match:
    $hostname over 10m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 15
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($hostname)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count($e.metadata.id)
    $principal_hostname = array_distinct($hostname)
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = array_distinct($e.principal.process.command_line)
    $principal_process_file_full_path = array_distinct($e.principal.process.file.full_path)
    $target_process_file_full_path = array_distinct($e.target.process.file.full_path)
    $target_process_command_line = array_distinct($e.target.process.command_line)
    $target_ip = array_distinct($e.target.ip)
    $target_url = array_distinct($e.target.url)
  condition:
    $e
}

rule i_methodology_t1497_virtualization_environment_discovery_using_ioreg_macos {
  meta:

    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `-(l|c) `) nocase

        not $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /\/Resources\/Python\.app\/Contents\/MacOS\/Python$/ nocase and

  meta:

    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0007"
    technique = "T1083"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
      or  $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"

rule i_methodology_t1059_004_bash_pause_and_decode_base64_encoded_string {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Bash Pause And Decode Base64 Encoded String"
    description = "Detects on bash being launched with commands that will pause execution for a certain amount of time (usually seconds), decode the base64 string and execute its contents. This technique has been previously associated with OUTLAW BOTNET, where Perl was utilised to execute obfuscated commands. Decode and verify maliciousness."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059.004"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `(^|\/)bash$`) nocase

    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\-\-decode`) nocase
    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `echo `) nocase
    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\-c `) nocase

rule i_methodology_t1135_sharpfinder_command_line_parameters {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Share File Finder Command Line Parameters"
    description = "Detects the use of SharpFinder or Invoke-FileFinder to search for sensitive files on network shares by identifying command line parameters associated with their execution. SharpFinder and Invoke-FileFinder are open source, offensive security tools that can be used to search for files matching specific criteria on network shares."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0007"
    technique = "T1135"
    reference = "https://github.com/s0lst1c3/SharpFinder"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    (
      $e.principal.platform = "WINDOWS" or
      $e.principal.asset.platform_software.platform = "WINDOWS" or
      $e.principal.asset.platform_software.platform_patch_level = /Windows/ nocase
    )
    $e.target.process.command_line = /\s(\/|-{1,2})((keywords|path|extensions|input-file)(:|=)|(readable|writeable|grepable|exclude-hidden|acl-filter-mode-and|sharelist|terms|outfile)(\s|$))/ nocase
    $principal_process = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $asset_id = $e.principal.asset_id

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)

    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.windows_sid)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $hostname = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = array($e.principal.process.command_line)
    $principal_process_file_full_path = array($e.principal.process.file.full_path)
    $target_process_command_line = array($e.target.process.command_line)
    $target_process_file_full_path = array($e.target.process.file.full_path)
    $asset_is_server = max(if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0))
    $keyword_count = max(
      if(re.regex(strings.to_lower($e.target.process.command_line), `\s[\/-]+keywords`), 1, 0 ) +
      if(re.regex(strings.to_lower($e.target.process.command_line), `\s[\/-]+path`), 1, 0 ) +
      if(re.regex(strings.to_lower($e.target.process.command_line), `\s[\/-]+extensions`), 1, 0 ) +
      if(re.regex(strings.to_lower($e.target.process.command_line), `\s[\/-]+input-file`), 1, 0 ) +
      if(re.regex(strings.to_lower($e.target.process.command_line), `\s[\/-]+readable`), 1, 0 ) +
      if(re.regex(strings.to_lower($e.target.process.command_line), `\s[\/-]+writeable`), 1, 0 ) +
      if(re.regex(strings.to_lower($e.target.process.command_line), `\s[\/-]+grepable`), 1, 0 ) +
      if(re.regex(strings.to_lower($e.target.process.command_line), `\s[\/-]+exclude-hidden`), 1, 0 ) +
      if(re.regex(strings.to_lower($e.target.process.command_line), `\s[\/-]+acl-filter-mode-and`), 1, 0 ) +
      if(re.regex(strings.to_lower($e.target.process.command_line), `\s[\/-]+sharelist`), 1, 0 ) +
      if(re.regex(strings.to_lower($e.target.process.command_line), `\s[\/-]+terms`), 1, 0 ) +
      if(re.regex(strings.to_lower($e.target.process.command_line), `\s[\/-]+outfile`), 1, 0 )
    )

  condition:
    $e and $keyword_count >= 3
}

    description = "Detects instances where command-line interpreters or shells (powershell.exe, cmd.exe, sh, bash, zsh, dash) spawn curl to download Deno runtime binaries or release archives from dl.deno.land.     $tmp1 = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2))

    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

rules.text:
rule i_multi_methodology_t1072_xagt_hostremediation_launch_cmd {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Xagt Host Remediation Module Launching Command"
    description = "Detects the use of the Trellix Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) agent process (xagt) to remotely execute a command on an endpoint using the Host Remediation module. The Trellix EDR Controller provides the capability to connect to a remote endpoint and run remediation scripts or commands, such as deleting files or terminating processes. Threat actors may abuse administrative access to centralized management systems to execute malicious commands and move laterally within a network."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0008"
    technique = "T1072"
    false_positives = "Administrators may use the Host Remediation module for data collection or endpoint remediation."
    reference = "https://docs.trellix.com/bundle/hr_2-0-0_ug/page/module-overview.html"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"
    )
    (
      $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /\bxagt(\.exe)?$/ nocase or
      $e.principal.process.file.names = /\bxagt(\.exe)?$/ nocase
    )
    $e.principal.process.command_line = /\b-mode\s+HostRemediation\b/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line != /conhost\.exe\s+0xffffffff|\/plugin\/HostRemediation\/HostRemediation\.so|^\/bin\/rpm\s|^\/usr\/bin\/dpkg-query\s|^\/opt\/fireeye\/bin\/xagt\s|WerFault\.exe\s+-u\s+-p\s+\d+\s+-s\s+\d+/ nocase
    $principal_process = strings.coalesce($e.principal.process.file.full_path, $e.principal.process.file.names[0])
    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname

  match:
    $principal_hostname,$principal_process over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.windows_sid)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $hostname = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = array($e.principal.process.command_line)
    $principal_process_file_full_path = array($e.principal.process.file.full_path)
    $target_process_command_line = array($e.target.process.command_line)
    $target_process_file_full_path = array($e.target.process.file.full_path)
    $asset_is_server = max(if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0))

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_windows_cmd_launching_application_self_delete {
  meta:
    rule_name = "CMD Launching Application Self Delete"
    description = "Detects a command shell executing a sequence that uses a controlled delay (ping) immediately followed by a destructive action: either file content wiping ('fsutil setZeroData') or a silent, forced file deletion ('Del /f /q')."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1070.004"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"

    $e.target.process.command_line = /\bcmd(\.exe)?/ nocase and
    $e.target.process.command_line = /ping/ nocase  and
    $e.target.process.file.full_path != "" nocase and
    (
      (
        $e.target.process.command_line = /fsutil\s+file\s+setZeroData\s+offset=0/ nocase
      ) or
      (
        $e.target.process.command_line = />\s*Nul\s*&\s*Del\s/ nocase and
        $e.target.process.command_line = /\/f\s/ nocase and
        $e.target.process.command_line = /\/q\s/ nocase and

    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name

    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname

    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name

rule i_methodology_t1082_seatbelt_command_line_parameters {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Seatbelt Command Line Parameters"
    description = "Detects the use of Seatbelt by identifying command line parameters associated with its execution. Seatbelt is an open source, offensive security tool that can be used to dump user and system data that can be used to identify privilege escalation paths."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0007"
    technique = "T1082"
    reference = "https://github.com/GhostPack/Seatbelt"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    (
      $e.principal.platform = "WINDOWS" or
      $e.principal.asset.platform_software.platform = "WINDOWS" or
      $e.principal.asset.platform_software.platform_patch_level = /Windows/ nocase
    )
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path != /(\b(EMSAgent|Worksoft\.CTMAgent\.Executor)\.exe$|C:\\Program Files\\Git\\usr\\bin\\)/ nocase
    $e.target.process.file.full_path != /\bNDThumbnail\.exe$|specBuilder\.exe/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line = /\s(\/|-{1,2})((outputfile|computername|username|password)(:|=)|full(\s|$)|group[:=](all|system|remote|user))/ nocase
    $principal_process = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $asset_id = $e.principal.asset_id

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.windows_sid)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $hostname = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = array($e.principal.process.command_line)
    $principal_process_file_full_path = array($e.principal.process.file.full_path)
    $target_process_command_line = array($e.target.process.command_line)
    $target_process_file_full_path = array($e.target.process.file.full_path)
    $asset_is_server = max(if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0))
    $keyword_score = max(
      if(re.regex(strings.to_lower($e.target.process.command_line), `\s[\/-]+group`), 5, 0 ) +
      if(re.regex(strings.to_lower($e.target.process.command_line), `\s[\/-]+outputfile`), 5, 0 ) +
      if(re.regex(strings.to_lower($e.target.process.command_line), `\s[\/-]+computername`), 1, 0 ) +
      if(re.regex(strings.to_lower($e.target.process.command_line), `\s[\/-]+username`), 1, 0 ) +
      if(re.regex(strings.to_lower($e.target.process.command_line), `\s[\/-]+password`), 1, 0 ) +
      if(re.regex(strings.to_lower($e.target.process.command_line), `\s[\/-]+full`), 1, 0 )
    )

  condition:
    $e and $keyword_score >= 6
}

rule i_methodology_t1059_001_sqlserver_launching_powershell {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Sqlserver Launching Powershell"
    description = "Detects on a Microsoft SQL Server process (sqlservr.exe) spawning a PowerShell process to execute commands."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059.001"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $e.target.process.file.full_path = /(^|\\)(cmd|powershell)\.exe$/ nocase
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /(^|\\)sqlservr\.exe$/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line = /powershell/ nocase
    ( // matching on common strings associated with PowerShell command execution
      $e.target.process.command_line = /\b(Invoke|Stop)-/ nocase or
      $e.target.process.command_line = /\b(-enc|-ec|-en\s|-e\s|-encodedcommand)/ nocase or
      $e.target.process.command_line = /\b(IEX|iwr|\swhoami|gwmi win32_group \-filter|Net\.(WebClient|Sockets)\.TCPClient|DownloadString|DownloadFile)/ nocase or
      $e.target.process.command_line = /\bGet-(Command|ComputerInfo|HotFix|NetworkAdapter|Process|NetworkAdapter|NetRoute|NetTCPConnection|DnsClientCache|Local|AD|Clipboard|History|Variable|SmbShare)/ nocase or
      $e.target.process.command_line = /\bTest-WSMan/ nocase or
      $e.target.process.command_line = /\bSet-(MpPreference|ExecutionPolicy|ItemProperty|Service|MpThreat)/ nocase or
      $e.target.process.command_line = /\bNew-(Service|ScheduledTask|LocalUser|ADUser|PSSession)/ nocase or
      $e.target.process.command_line = /\bResolve-DnsName\W+[^\s]+\.[^\s]+\b/ nocase or
      (
        $e.target.process.command_line = /Get-WmiObject/ nocase and
        $e.target.process.command_line = /-ComputerName.*\-list|Win32_LoggedOnUser/ nocase
      )  or
      ( // filtering for file discovery involving sensitive keywords
        $e.target.process.command_line = /Get-ChildItem/ nocase and
        $e.target.process.command_line = /-(Include|Filter)[^\*]+\*(password|config|cred|secret|key\*|token|login|shadow|sam|id_rsa|\.pfx|\.p12|\.kdbx|\.vbp|\.sln)/ nocase
      )  or
      ( // filtering for specific file extensions during path discovery
        $e.target.process.command_line = /Test-Path/ nocase and
        $e.target.process.command_line = /\.(config|pfx|psafe3)/ nocase
      )  or
      ( // filtering for Security service discovery on local system
        $e.target.process.command_line = /Get-Service/ nocase and
        $e.target.process.command_line != /-computername|ConvertTo-Csv -NoTypeInformation/ nocase
      )  or
      ( // filtering for non-innocuous internal network connection testing
        $e.target.process.command_line = /Test-NetConnection/ nocase and
        $e.target.process.command_line != /-Port 10101/ nocase
      )  or
      $e.target.process.command_line = /\b(Select-String|sls)\W+(password|config|cred|secret|key|token|login|shadow|sam|id_rsa|\.pfx|\.p12|\.kdbx|\.vbp|\.sln)/ nocase
    )
    $e.target.process.command_line != /get-service \| C:\\PowerShell\\SendEmail\.ps1|\$_\.DistinguishedName -split|\$query1=\'INSERT INTO|Invoke-RestMethod|is missing in local administrators group in the windows server|\(Get-Date\)\.AddMinutes\(-30\)|-Name IS\*\|Select-object ID/ nocase
    $target_process_cmd = $e.target.process.command_line
    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `Invoke-Sqlcmd.*##Performance.*PerformanceLog\.csv`) nocase

  match:
    $principal_hostname,$target_process_cmd over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.windows_sid)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $hostname = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = array($e.principal.process.command_line)
    $principal_process_file_full_path = array($e.principal.process.file.full_path)
    $target_process_command_line = array($e.target.process.command_line)
    $asset_is_server = max(if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0))
    $unique_target_ports = count_distinct($e.target.port)
    $time_diff = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds) - min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_linux_sudo_shell_spawn_recon {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Sudo Shell Spawning Reconnaissance Tools"
    description = "Detects a non-root user executing an interactive sudo shell which subsequently launches reconnaissance commands. While not inherently malicious, this is a common tactic used by threat actors to gain further access to a system and gather critical information."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0004"
    technique = "T1548.003"

  events:
    $e1.principal.user.userid != ""
    $e1.principal.user.userid != "root" nocase
    (
      $e1.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
      $e1.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"
    )
    (
      $e1.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path = /\b(sh|bash|zsh|dash|fish)$/ nocase or
      $e1.principal.process.parent_process.file.names = /\b(sh|bash|zsh|dash|fish)$/ nocase
    )
    $e1.principal.process.command_line = /^(?:sudo\s+(?:su\b|.*-(?:i|s)\b))\s*$/ nocase
    $e1.target.process.file.full_path = /\b(sh|bash|zsh|dash|fish)$/ nocase

    $root_shell_pid = $e1.target.process.pid
    $hostname = $e1.principal.hostname
    $user_id = $e1.principal.user.userid

    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e2.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = array($e2.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e2.metadata.id)
    $principal_hostname = array_distinct($hostname)
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = array_distinct($e2.principal.process.command_line)
    $principal_process_file_full_path = array_distinct($e2.principal.process.file.full_path)
    $target_process_command_line = array_distinct($e2.target.process.command_line)
    $target_process_file_full_path = array_distinct($e2.target.process.file.full_path)
    $asset_is_server = max(if($e2.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0))

  condition:
    $e1 and $e2

    description = "Detects on a process launched with the 'DllRegisterServer' string in its command line. This is a potential indicator of a custom dropper or malware attempting to mimic system registration functionality. DllRegisterServer is a DLL export function intended for use with regsvr32.exe, often used by adversaries to bypass application controls via rundll32.exe."

    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1218.011"

    $e.target.process.file.full_path != ""

rule i_methodology_t1033_whoami_fqdn_discovery {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Whoami Fqdn Discovery"
    description = "Detects enumeration attempts by threat actors to determine if the victim  host is joined to the domain and additionally return the FQDN."
    severity = "Info"
    tactic = "TA0007"
    technique = "T1033"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    not re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, `cvd\.exe`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `cvd\.exe`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, `Poly Lens`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `Poly Lens`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, `Poly Lens`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, `VUEMUIAgent\.exe`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `VUEMUIAgent\.exe`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `CvEdgeMonitor.exe`) nocase

    (
      (
        re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `whoami\.exe`) nocase and
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `^\/fqdn$`) nocase

rule ttp_linux_node_ethereum_rpc_connection {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Node.js Process Connection to Ethereum RPC Endpoint"
    description = "Detects when the Node.js Linux runtime process (node) initiates a network connection, HTTP session, or DNS query targeting public Ethereum blockchain Remote Procedure Call (RPC) endpoints. Adversaries often spawn Node.js utilities to execute hostile smart contracts, participate in decentralized dApp exploitation, execute cryptomining payloads (cryptojacking), or establish stealthy command and control tunnels."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1071.001"
  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_DNS" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_HTTP" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_UNCATEGORIZED"
    )
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /\bnode$/ nocase
    (
      any $e.network.dns.questions.name = /(?:^|\.)(?:eth-[^\\\/]+\.nodereal\.io|getblock\.io|llamarpc\.com|drpc\.org|publicnode\.com|quicknode\.com|(?:gateway|rpc)\.tenderly\.co|flashbots\.net|mevblocker\.io|blastapi\.io|payload\.de|merkle\.io)$/ nocase or
      $e.target.url = /(?:^|\/\/|\.)(?:eth-[^\\\/]+\.nodereal\.io|getblock\.io|llamarpc\.com|drpc\.org|publicnode\.com|quicknode\.com|(?:gateway|rpc)\.tenderly\.co|flashbots\.net|mevblocker\.io|blastapi\.io|payload\.de|merkle\.io)(?:[\/\\:\?#]|$)/ nocase or
      $e.target.hostname = /(?:^|\/\/|\.)(?:eth-[^\\\/]+\.nodereal\.io|getblock\.io|llamarpc\.com|drpc\.org|publicnode\.com|quicknode\.com|(?:gateway|rpc)\.tenderly\.co|flashbots\.net|mevblocker\.io|blastapi\.io|payload\.de|merkle\.io)(?:[\/\\:\?#]|$)/ nocase
    )
  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1
    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)
  condition:
    $e
  options:
    suppression_window = 1h
}

rules.text:
rule i_methodology_t1059_003_cmd_exe_invoking_suspicious_hex_arguments {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Cmd Exe Invoking Suspicious Hex Arguments"
    description = "Detects on suspicious hex arguments passed to cmd.exe, observed in FIN11 adjacent intrusions. May be indicative of interactive attacker command activity. The commands will consist of the /I flag followed by 32 hexadecimal characters, then the /O flag followed by another 32 hexadecimal characters."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059.003"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `cmd\.exe$`) nocase
    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `/I`) nocase
    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `/O`) nocase
    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `cmd\.exe\s+\/I\s[A-F0-9]{32}\s\/O\s[A-F0-9]{32}`) nocase

rule i_methodology_t1059_001_potential_manipulation_of_powershell_window_title {
  meta:

    description = "Detects potential abuse of the Windows PowerShell console title (host.ui.RawUI.WindowTitle). Attackers often try to combine manipulation of the window title with other techniques to evade detection and further their objectives. Determine maliciousness of the observed command line arguments and conduct further analysis on the endpoint. "
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059.001"

    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"

    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `(-nop|echo) `) nocase
    (
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\s[-/]w(((((((((i)?n?)d?)o?)w?)s?)t?)y?)l?)\s+(hidden|1)`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\biex`) nocase
    )

  outcome:

rule i_filewrite_to_users_shared {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Filewrite To Users Shared"
    description = "Detects on a filewrite to the security relevant directory users/shared. These are directories that have been observed in Mandiant investigations. Filewrites to this directory aren't inherently malicious and should be correlated with addtitional security signal."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1204.002"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MOVE"
    )
    $e.target.file.full_path = /^\/users\/shared(\/\.[a-z0-9A-Z]+|(\/[^\\\/]+){2}|\/[^\\\/]+\.(pdf|txt|sh))$/ nocase
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path != ""
    $e.target.file.md5 != "d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e"
    not $e.target.file.full_path = /\/(\.BC\.T\_\w{2,8}|\.dat\.nosync\w{2,8}.\w{2,8})$/ nocase
    not $e.target.file.full_path = /\/Users\/Shared\/JSS_Scripts_Dump-PROD-/ nocase
    not $e.target.file.full_path = /\/SEPRemoteInstaller\/NISInstaller$/ nocase
    $e.target.file.full_path != "/Users/Shared/AdobeGCData/AdobeNGLAppIDMap.db-journal" nocase
    $e.target.file.full_path != "/Applications/Cyberhaven.app/Contents/MacOS/CyberhavenSessionMonitor" nocase
    not $e.principal.process.command_line = /\/Applications\/.com\.bomgar\.scc\.[^\\\/]+\/Remote Support Customer Client.app\/Contents\/MacOS\/sdcust/ nocase
    not $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /\/Users\/[^\\\/]+\/Applications\/.com.bomgar.scc.[^\\\/]+\/Remote Support Customer Client.app\/Contents\/MacOS\/sdcust/ nocase
    not $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /\/Volumes\/bomgar-scc-[^\\\/]+\.dmg\/Double-Click To Start Support Session.app\/Contents\/MacOS\/sdcust$/ nocase
    not $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /\/Applications\/.com.bomgar.bomgar-pec\/Privileged Remote Access Endpoint Client.app\/Contents\/MacOS\/bomgar-scc/ nocase
    not $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /\/Applications\/.com.bomgar.bomgar-pec\/Privileged Remote Access Endpoint Client.app\/Contents\/MacOS\/bomgar-scc/ nocase

    all $e.target.file.tags != /(trusted|legit|known-distributor)/ nocase

    $vt_tags = strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None")
    $process_vt_tags = strings.coalesce($e.principal.process.file.tags, "None")
    $file_type = strings.coalesce($e.target.file.mime_type, "UNKNOWN")

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "tracker"
    $principal_process = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_file = $e.target.file.full_path
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $threat_verdict_malicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $sus_vt_tags = if(re.regex($vt_tags, /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor|service-scan|dropper|html)/), 1, 0)

    $recent_compile_time = if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)
    $invalid_cert = if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $single_double_char_filename = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\/([^\/]{1,2}(\.[^\/.]+)?)$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_file_name = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\/\d+(\.[^\/.]+)?$/), 1, 0)
    $hidden_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\/\.[^\\\/]+$/), 1, 0)
    $common_suspicious_file_names = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\/(password|cookies|Keychain|credentials)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $sus_process_path = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /\/(private|Desktop|Downloads|Shared|tmp|Temporary\s*Items|var\/folders)\//) nocase, 1, 0)
    $system_process = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(^|\/)(unzip|python|bash|zsh|perl|ruby|sh|osascript|mktemp|curl)$/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $single_char_process = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(^|\/)[A-Za-z0-9]{1}$/), 1, 0)

    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $sus_vt_tags + $sus_process_vt_tags + $recent_compile_time + $invalid_cert + $single_double_char_filename + $all_numbers_file_name  + $hidden_file + $common_suspicious_file_names + $sus_process_path + $system_process + $single_char_process

    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0)

    $summary = strings.concat("The process ", strings.to_upper($principal_process), " wrote an ", strings.to_upper($file_type), " to ", $target_file, " under the User context of ", strings.to_upper($adversary_uid))

  condition:
    $e
}

rule i_methodology_t1219_meshagent_indicators {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Meshagent Indicators"
    description = "Detects indicators on events involving artifacts known to MeshAgent, a remote access tool. MeshAgent is not inherently malicious, but is an open source, free to download tool and can be abused by threat actors allowing attackers to gain unauthorized access to infected computers."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1219"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MODIFICATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MOVE" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "REGISTRY_CREATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "REGISTRY_DELETION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "REGISTRY_MODIFICATION"
    ) and
    (
      $e.target.process.command_line = /\.(exe|msi).*\/qb ACCEPTEULA=\d LicenseAccepted=\d/ nocase or
      $e.target.process.command_line = /(Mesh|\.(exe|msi)).* -fullinstall --installPath/ nocase or
      $e.target.process.command_line = /\bmesh(central(assistant|installer)|agent)([a-z0-9_\-\\\/]*)\.(db|msh|exe)/ nocase or
      $e.target.file.full_path = /\bmesh(central(assistant|installer)|agent)([a-z0-9_\-\\\/]*)\.(db|msh|exe)/ nocase or
      (
        $e.target.registry.registry_key = /((?:CurrentControlSet|ControlSet\d*)\\Services\\Mesh Agent|\\SafeBoot\\Network\\MeshAgent|\\Schedule\\TaskCache\\Tree\\MeshUserTask|\\Open Source\\MeshCentral Assistant)/ nocase and
        $e.target.registry.registry_value_data = /MeshAgent\.exe/ nocase
      )
    )
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path != /werfault\.exe/ nocase

rule ttp_kubernetes_clusterwide_secret_enumeration {

    description = "Detects a process launching kubectl to globally enumerate Kubernetes secret objects across all namespaces. rule ttp_windows_potential_tor_proxy_download {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Potential Tor Proxy Download"
    description = "Detects on network events to a TOR domain and then subsequently an ingress tool transfer via downloading from Tor2web proxies."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1204.002"

  events:
    $e1.principal.hostname = $targetHost
    $e1.principal.process.file.full_path = $proc
    $e2.principal.hostname = $targetHost
    $e2.principal.process.file.full_path = $proc
    (
      $e1.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_HTTP" or
      $e1.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_DNS" or
      $e1.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
    )
    (
      $e1.target.url = /(tor2web|\.onion|torlink|\.t2w|tor-gateways|hiddenservice)\.\w+/ nocase or
      $e1.target.hostname = /(tor2web|\.onion|torlink|\.t2w|tor-gateways|hiddenservice)\.\w+/ nocase
    )

    (
      (
        $e2.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION" and
        $e2.metadata.log_type = /SENTINELONE/ nocase and
        $e2.target.file.full_path = /\.(zip|rar|exe|hta|html|vbs|bat|lnk|ps1|wsf)$/ nocase
      ) or
      (
        (
          $e2.metadata.event_type = "STATUS_UPDATE" or
          $e2.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION"
        ) and
        $e2.target.file.full_path = /\.(zip|rar|exe|hta|html|vbs|bat|lnk|ps1|wsf)$/ nocase and
        (
          $e2.target.url = /(tor2web|\.onion|torlink|\.t2w|tor-gateways|hiddenservice)/ nocase or
          $e2.principal.url = /(tor2web|\.onion|torlink|\.t2w|tor-gateways|hiddenservice)/ nocase or
          $e2.network.http.referral_url = /(tor2web|\.onion|torlink|\.t2w|tor-gateways|hiddenservice)/ nocase
        )
      )
    )

    $e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds < $e2.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

  match:
    $targetHost, $proc over 2m after $e1

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $network_event_type = array_distinct($e1.metadata.event_type)
    $tor_network_url = array_distinct($e1.target.url)
    $tor_network_hostname = array_distinct($e1.target.hostname)
    $source_ip_e1 = array_distinct($e1.principal.ip)
    $http_user_agent = array_distinct($e1.network.http.user_agent)
    $product_event_type = array_distinct($e2.metadata.product_event_type)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e2.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e2.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e2.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e2.principal.asset.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e2.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e2.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e2.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e2.principal.user.windows_sid)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e2.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e2.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e2.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = array($e2.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e2.metadata.id)
    $principalHostname = array_distinct($targetHost)
    $principalIp = array_distinct($e2.principal.ip)
    $targetFileMd5 = array_distinct($e2.target.file.md5)
    $targetFileSha1 = array_distinct($e2.target.file.sha1)
    $targetFileSha256 = array_distinct($e2.target.process.file.sha256)
    $rule_category = "vendor"
    $principal_process_command_line = array_distinct($e2.principal.process.command_line)
    $principal_process_file_full_path = array_distinct($proc)
    $target_process_command_line = array_distinct($e2.target.process.command_line)
    $target_process_file_full_path = array_distinct($e2.target.process.file.full_path)
    $target_file_full_path = array_distinct($e2.target.file.full_path)

  condition:
    $e1 and $e2
}

    tactic = "TA0002"

    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"

      ( // nohup launching an interactive reverse shell via tty
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\bnohup\s+.*\b(sh|bash|zsh)\b`) nocase and
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\btty\b`) nocase and

rule i_filewrite_to_library_caches {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Filewrite To Library Caches"
    description = "Detects on a filewrite to the security relevant directory '/library/caches/'. These are directories that have been observed in Mandiant investigations. Filewrites to this directory aren't inherently malicious and should be correlated with additional security signal."

    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1204.002"

      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION" or

    ) and
    (
      $e.target.file.full_path = /^(\/Users\/[^\/]+)?\/Library\/Caches\/(com\.apple\.[^\/\.]+\.[a-z]{1,2}|com\.apple\.[a-zA-Z]{1,2}\/[^\/\.]+\.plist)$/ nocase or
      $e.target.file.full_path = /^(\/Users\/[^\/]+)?\/Library\/Caches\/[^\\\/]+\.py$/ nocase
    ) and
    not $e.target.file.full_path = /(\/Library\/Caches\/Homebrew\/\.cleaned|\/com\.apple\.SystemMigrationUserSizeCache|\/\.lockfile|\/Caches\/com\.apple\.TV\/HSTS\.plist)$/ nocase and

    $process_vt_tags = strings.coalesce($e.principal.process.file.tags, "None")
    $file_type = strings.coalesce($e.target.file.mime_type, "UNKNOWN")

    $risk_score = 0
    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "tracker"
    $principal_process = $e.principal.process.file.full_path

    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)

      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )

    $threat_verdict_malicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $sus_vt_tags = if(re.regex($vt_tags, /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor|service-scan|dropper|html)/), 1, 0)
    $sus_process_vt_tags = if(re.regex($process_vt_tags, /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor|service-scan|dropper|html)/), 1, 0)
    $recent_compile_time = if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)
    $invalid_cert = if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $single_double_char_filename = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\/([^\/]{1,2}(\.[^\/.]+)?)$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_file_name = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\/\d+(\.[^\/.]+)?$/), 1, 0)
    $hidden_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\/\.[^\\\/]+$/), 1, 0)
    $common_suspicious_file_names = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\/(password|cookies|Keychain|credentials|.*\.finder\/.*Launchpad)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $sus_process_path = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /\/(private|Desktop|Downloads|Shared|tmp|Temporary\s*Items|var\/folders)\//) nocase, 1, 0)
    $system_process = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(^|\/)(unzip|python|bash|zsh|perl|ruby|sh|osascript|mktemp|curl)$/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $single_char_process = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(^|\/)[A-Za-z0-9]{1}$/), 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule i_methodology_t1014_nidhogg_rootkit {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Nidhogg Rootkit"
    description = "Detects on use of the Nidhogg rootkit on a host. NIDHOGG is a multi-functional rootkit designed for Windows 10 and 11 x64 systems that operates at the kernel level, providing a wide array of malicious capabilities that allow attackers to maintain persistence, evade detection, and perform various malicious activities on compromised systems. The rootkit's modular nature and script execution capabilities enable attackers to customize and expand its functionality, potentially leading to long-term compromises and data exfiltration."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1014"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" and
      (
        $e.target.process.command_line = /sc\s+(start|create)\s+Nidhogg/ nocase or
        $e.target.process.command_line = /\.exe\s+(process|thread)\s+add\s+\d{1,6}\s*$/ nocase or
        $e.target.process.command_line = /\.exe\s+driver\s+hide\s.*\.dll"?\s*$/ nocase or
        $e.target.process.command_line = /\.exe\s+process\s+hide\s+\d{1,6}\s*$/ nocase or
        $e.target.process.command_line = /\\Windows NT\\curl\.dll/ nocase or
        $e.target.process.command_line = /\\Nidhogg\.sys/ nocase or
        $e.target.process.file.full_path = /(^|\\)hotdog\.exe$/ nocase or
        $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /(^|\\)hotdog\.exe$/ nocase
      )
    ) or
    (
      (
        $e.metadata.event_type = "REGISTRY_CREATION" or
        $e.metadata.event_type = "REGISTRY_MODIFICATION"
      ) and
      $e.target.registry.registry_key = /\\Services\\Nidhogg/ nocase
    ) or
    (
      (
        $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION" or
        $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MODIFICATION" or
        $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MOVE"
      ) and
      (
        $e.target.file.full_path  = /\\hotdog\.exe$/ nocase or
        $e.target.file.full_path  = /\\Windows NT\\curl\.dll$/ nocase
      )
    )

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1

    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $threat_verdict_malicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))
    $recent_compile_time = if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)
    $invalid_cert = if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $system_user_file_write = if($e.principal.user.userid = "system", 1, 0)
    $sus_file_name_architecture = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\[^\/]+(32|64).[^\/.]+$/), 1, 0)
    $single_double_char_filename = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*([^\/]{1,2}.[^\/.]+)$/), 1, 0)
    $double_extensions = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+.[a-zA-Z]{3}.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_file_name = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\d+.[a-zA-Z]{3}$/), 1, 0)
    $common_malicious_file_names = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup\.exe|update\.js|lsass\.dmp|1\.txt|ntds\.dit|logs\.dat|sqlite3\.dll|pass_1234|system\.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $is_archive_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0)
    $is_executable_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0)
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)
    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $recent_compile_time + $system_user_file_write + $sus_file_name_architecture + $common_malicious_file_names + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_filename + $double_extensions + $sus_vt_tags + $all_numbers_file_name + $is_executable_file + $is_archive_file + $invalid_cert
    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule i_methodology_t1204_002_suspicious_filewrites_from_appsupport_frameworks {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Suspicious Filewrites From Appsupport Frameworks"
    description = "Detects processes originating from system or user-level '/Application Support/Frameworks/' directories writing files. Adversaries may create and use this source directory to masquerade as legitimate system frameworks while staging malicious payloads."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1204.002"

  events:
    ($e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION" or $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MOVE" or $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MODIFICATION")
    re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `^(\/users\/[^\/]+)?\/Library\/Application Support\/Frameworks\/`) nocase
    $e.target.file.full_path != ""

    all $e.target.file.tags != /(trusted|legit|known-distributor)/ nocase
    $vt_tags = strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None")
    $process_vt_tags = strings.coalesce($e.principal.process.file.tags, "None")
    $file_type = strings.coalesce($e.target.file.mime_type, "UNKNOWN")

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $principal_process = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_file = $e.target.file.full_path
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

    $threat_verdict_malicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $sus_vt_tags = if(re.regex($vt_tags, /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor|service-scan|dropper|html)/), 1, 0)
    $sus_process_vt_tags = if(re.regex($process_vt_tags, /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor|service-scan|dropper|html)/), 1, 0)

    $recent_compile_time = if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)
    $invalid_cert = if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0)

    $single_double_char_filename = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\/([^\/]{1,2}(\.[^\/.]+)?)$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_file_name = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\/\d+(\.[^\/.]+)?$/), 1, 0)
    $hidden_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\/\.[^\\\/]+$/), 1, 0)
    $common_suspicious_file_names = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\/(password|cookies|Keychain|credentials)/) nocase, 1, 0)

    $system_process = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(^|\/)(unzip|python|bash|zsh|perl|ruby|sh|osascript|mktemp|curl)$/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $single_char_process = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /\/[A-Za-z0-9]{1}$/), 1, 0)

    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $sus_vt_tags + $sus_process_vt_tags + $recent_compile_time + $invalid_cert + $single_double_char_filename + $all_numbers_file_name  + $hidden_file + $common_suspicious_file_names + $system_process + $single_char_process

    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend|safebreach|attackiq|\/tmp\sb-sim-temp)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend|safebreach|attackiq|\/tmp\sb-sim-temp)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend|safebreach|attackiq|\/tmp\sb-sim-temp)/) nocase, 1, 0)

    $summary = strings.concat("The process ", strings.to_upper($principal_process), " wrote an ", strings.to_upper($file_type), " to ", $target_file, " under the User context of ", strings.to_upper($adversary_uid))

  condition:
    $e
}

rule i_methodology_t1087_001_suspicious_sensitive_file_access_via_ssh {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Suspicious Sensitive File Access Via SSH"
    description = "Detect when a shell, launched by an 'sshd' process, executes a cat with administrative privileges to access sensitive files like /etc/hosts, /etc/passwd, or /etc/shadow. While not inherently malicious, this activity might be indicative of an attacker attempting to escalate privileges or perform reconnaissance to read sensitive system files (e.g., /etc/shadow, /etc/passwd, configuration files, logs) after gaining initial access."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0007"
    technique = "T1087.001"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    ($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path = /^sshd$|\/sshd$/ nocase or $e.principal.process.parent_process.file.names = /^sshd$|\/sshd$/ nocase)
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /(^|\/)(bash|sh|zsh)$/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line  = /sudo\s.*cat\s.*(\/etc\/hosts|\/etc\/passwd|\/etc\/shadow)/ nocase
    $e.principal.process.command_line != "bash -c PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin;sudo cat /etc/shadow"

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1

    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $threat_verdict_malicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))
    $recent_compile_time = if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)
    $invalid_cert = if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $system_user_file_write = if($e.principal.user.userid = "system", 1, 0)
    $sus_file_name_architecture = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\[^\/]+(32|64).[^\/.]+$/), 1, 0)
    $single_double_char_filename = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*([^\/]{1,2}.[^\/.]+)$/), 1, 0)
    $double_extensions = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+.[a-zA-Z]{3}.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_file_name = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\d+.[a-zA-Z]{3}$/), 1, 0)
    $common_malicious_file_names = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup\.exe|update\.js|lsass\.dmp|1\.txt|ntds\.dit|logs\.dat|sqlite3\.dll|pass_1234|system\.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $is_archive_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0)
    $is_executable_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0)
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)
    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $recent_compile_time + $system_user_file_write + $sus_file_name_architecture + $common_malicious_file_names + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_filename + $double_extensions + $sus_vt_tags + $all_numbers_file_name + $is_executable_file + $is_archive_file + $invalid_cert
    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e
}

    $known_suspicious_value_name = if(re.regex(strings.to_lower($target_registry_value), /(wextract|svchost|explorer|filecopy|ctfmon$|realtek hd audio|microsoft windows|startup|execctrl)/), 1, 0) nocase
    $sus_process_name_architecture = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /^.*\\[^\/]+(32|64)\.exe$/), 1, 0)
    $single_double_char_process_name = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /^.*\\([^\/]{1,2}\.exe)$/), 1, 0)

    $producer_risk_score = $recent_compile_time + $sus_process_name_architecture + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_process_name + $all_numbers_process_name + $invalid_cert + $known_suspicious_registry_text + $known_suspicious_value_name + $registry_text_length_score

  condition:
    $e and $producer_risk_score > 1
}

rule i_registry_change_to_software_microsoft_netsh {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Registry Write to Software Microsoft Netsh"
    description = "Detects on a registry changes to the security relevant keyPath Software\\\\microsoft\\\\netsh. These are registry key changes that have been observed in Mandiant investigations. Registry writes to this key/value aren't inherently malicious and should be correlated with addtitional security signal."
    severity = "Info"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1546.007"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "REGISTRY_CREATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "REGISTRY_MODIFICATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "REGISTRY_DELETION"
    )
    $e.target.registry.registry_key = /software\\Microsoft\\Netsh/ nocase

    $vt_tags = strings.coalesce($e.principal.process.file.tags, "None")
    $asset = $e.principal.asset.asset_id

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "tracker"
    $principal_process = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_registry_key = $e.target.registry.registry_key
    $target_registry_value = $e.target.registry.registry_value_name
    $target_value_data = $e.target.registry.registry_value_data
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_type = $e.metadata.event_type
    $event_count = 1
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $recent_compile_time = if($e.principal.process.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)
    $invalid_cert = if(any $e.principal.process.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $principal_process_vt_tags = if(re.regex($vt_tags, /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|invalid-signature|via-tor)/), 1, 0)
    $principal_process_security_result_threat_verdict = if($e.principal.process.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS" or $e.principal.process.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $registry_text_length_score = if(strings.count_substrings($target_value_data,/./) > 100, 1, 0)
    $known_suspicious_registry_text = if(re.regex(strings.to_lower($target_value_data), /(admin\$|\%systemroot\%|\\appData\\local\\temp\\)/), 1, 0)
    $registry_value_name_length_score = if(strings.count_substrings($target_registry_value,/./) > 100, 1, 0)
    $known_suspicious_value_name = if(re.regex(strings.to_lower($target_registry_value), /(wextract|svchost|explorer|filecopy|ctfmon|realtek hd audio|microsoft windows|startup|execctrl)/), 1, 0)
    $sus_process_name_architecture = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /^.*\\[^\/]+(32|64)\.exe$/), 1, 0)
    $single_double_char_process_name = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /^.*\\([^\/]{1,2}\.exe)$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_process_name = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /\\\d+\.exe$/), 1, 0)
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)

    $producer_risk_score = $recent_compile_time + $sus_process_name_architecture + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_process_name + $all_numbers_process_name + $invalid_cert + $known_suspicious_registry_text + $known_suspicious_value_name + $registry_text_length_score + $registry_value_name_length_score

    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0)

    $summary = strings.concat("The process ", strings.to_upper($principal_process), " changed the ", $e.target.registry.registry_key, " under the User context of ", strings.to_upper($adversary_uid))

  condition:
    $e
}
