rule i_methodology_t1102_002_ngrok_tunnel_fqdn_in_process_commandline_event_tunneler {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Ngrok Tunnel Fqdn In Process Commandline Event Tunneler"
    description = "Detects on process cmdline events related to NGROK tunneling infrastructure. NGROK is a publicly available utility that can expose local servers behind NATs and firewalls to the public internet over secure tunnels. Using NGROK on a victim system, the attacker can then connect to a subdomain on ngrok.com to tunnel their connection to services on the victim system that would not otherwise be accessible from the internet."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1102.002"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" and
    (
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `tunnel\.us\.`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `tunnel\.eu\.ngrok\.com`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `tunnel\.ap\.ngrok\.com`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `tunnel\.au\.ngrok\.com`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `tunnel\.sa\.ngrok\.com`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `tunnel\.jp\.ngrok\.com`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `tunnel\.in\.ngrok\.com`) nocase
    )

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1

    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $threat_verdict_malicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))
    $recent_compile_time = if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)
    $invalid_cert = if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $system_user_file_write = if($e.principal.user.userid = "system", 1, 0)
    $sus_file_name_architecture = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\[^\/]+(32|64).[^\/.]+$/), 1, 0)
    $single_double_char_filename = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*([^\/]{1,2}.[^\/.]+)$/), 1, 0)
    $double_extensions = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+.[a-zA-Z]{3}.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_file_name = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\d+.[a-zA-Z]{3}$/), 1, 0)
    $common_malicious_file_names = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup\.exe|update\.js|lsass\.dmp|1\.txt|ntds\.dit|logs\.dat|sqlite3\.dll|pass_1234|system\.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $is_archive_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0)
    $is_executable_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0)
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)
    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $recent_compile_time + $system_user_file_write + $sus_file_name_architecture + $common_malicious_file_names + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_filename + $double_extensions + $sus_vt_tags + $all_numbers_file_name + $is_executable_file + $is_archive_file + $invalid_cert
    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule i_methodology_t1055_simple_shellcode_injector_utility {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Simple Shellcode Injector Utility"
    description = "Simple Shellcode Injector is an open source tool designed to load and execute hexidecimal encoded shellcode passed to the binary as a command line argument. This alert looks for various shellcode bytes that have been converted to hexidecimal being passed on the command line."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1055"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" and
    re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `.`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)iexplore\.exe$`) nocase and
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `http|https`) nocase and
    not re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)cqcscodec\.exe`) nocase and
    not (re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `perl -X -e GNU_Parallel_worker`) nocase and $e.principal.user.userid = "support" nocase) and
    (
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `6c696b65204765636b6f`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `57696e646f7773204e5420`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `4d6f7a696c6c612f`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `535668129689e2`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `0000006089e531`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `686e6574006877696e6954684c77260`) nocase
    )

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1

    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $threat_verdict_malicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))
    $recent_compile_time = if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)
    $invalid_cert = if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $system_user_file_write = if($e.principal.user.userid = "system", 1, 0)
    $sus_file_name_architecture = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\[^\/]+(32|64).[^\/.]+$/), 1, 0)
    $single_double_char_filename = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*([^\/]{1,2}.[^\/.]+)$/), 1, 0)
    $double_extensions = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+.[a-zA-Z]{3}.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_file_name = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\d+.[a-zA-Z]{3}$/), 1, 0)
    $common_malicious_file_names = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup\.exe|update\.js|lsass\.dmp|1\.txt|ntds\.dit|logs\.dat|sqlite3\.dll|pass_1234|system\.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $is_archive_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0)
    $is_executable_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0)
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)
    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $recent_compile_time + $system_user_file_write + $sus_file_name_architecture + $common_malicious_file_names + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_filename + $double_extensions + $sus_vt_tags + $all_numbers_file_name + $is_executable_file + $is_archive_file + $invalid_cert
    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: Simple Shellcode Injector is an open source tool designed to load and execute hexidecimal encoded shellcode passed to the binary as a command line argument. This alert looks for various shellcode bytes that have been converted to hexidecimal being passed on the command line.

rule i_methodology_t1218_010_regsvr32_launching_executable_from_local_temp_folder {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Regsvr32 Launching Executable From Local Temp Folder"
    description = "Detects on regsvr32.exe launching child processes with command line arguments designed to launch process or DLL from '_AppData_Local_Temp_' directory. This technique is commonly observed being utilised by the Emotet malware."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1218.010"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `regsvr32\.exe$`) nocase

rule i_registry_change_to_currentcontrolset_services {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Registry Change to CurrentControlSet Services"
    description = "Detects on a registry changes to the security relevant keyPath \\CurrentControlSet\\Services. These are registry key changes that have been observed in Mandiant investigations. Registry writes to this key/value aren't inherently malicious and should be correlated with addtitional security signal."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1543.003"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "REGISTRY_CREATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "REGISTRY_MODIFICATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "REGISTRY_DELETION"
    )
    $e.target.registry.registry_key = /CurrentControlSet\\Services/ nocase
    $e.target.registry.registry_value_name = /(servicedll|imagepath)/ nocase
    $e.target.registry.registry_value_data = /./ nocase

    $vt_tags = strings.coalesce($e.principal.process.file.tags, "None")
    $asset = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    not (
      $e.principal.process.file.full_path = "C:\\Windows\\System32\\services.exe" nocase and
      $e.target.registry.registry_value_name = "ImagePath" nocase and
      re.regex($e.target.registry.registry_value_data, `svchost\.exe`) nocase and
      re.regex($e.target.registry.registry_key, `\\Services\\[a-zA-Z]+_[a-f0-9]+`) nocase
    )

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "tracker"
    $principal_process = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_registry_key = $e.target.registry.registry_key
    $target_registry_value = $e.target.registry.registry_value_name
    $target_value_data = $e.target.registry.registry_value_data
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_type = $e.metadata.event_type
    $event_count = 1
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $recent_compile_time = if($e.principal.process.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)
    $invalid_cert = if(any $e.principal.process.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $principal_process_vt_tags = if(re.regex($vt_tags, /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|invalid-signature|via-tor)/), 1, 0)
    $principal_process_security_result_threat_verdict = if($e.principal.process.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS" or $e.principal.process.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $registry_text_length_score = if(strings.count_substrings($target_value_data,/./) > 100, 1, 0)
    $known_suspicious_registry_text = if(re.regex($target_value_data, /(\%comspec\%|admin\$|\%systemroot\%|lsass|\\Temp\\|mshta|echo)/), 1, 0) nocase
    $all_numbers_service_name = if(re.regex($target_registry_key, /\\\d+$/), 1, 0)
    $sus_service_name_architecture = if(re.regex($target_registry_key, /services\\[^\\\d]+(32|64)\\/), 1, 0) nocase
    $sus_process_name_architecture = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /^.*\\[^\/]+(32|64)\.exe$/), 1, 0)
    $single_double_char_process_name = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /^.*\\([^\/]{1,2}\.exe)$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_process_name = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /\\\d+\.exe$/), 1, 0)
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)

    $producer_risk_score = $recent_compile_time + $invalid_cert + $principal_process_vt_tags + $principal_process_security_result_threat_verdict + $sus_process_name_architecture + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_process_name + $all_numbers_process_name + $invalid_cert + $known_suspicious_registry_text + $registry_text_length_score + $all_numbers_service_name + $sus_service_name_architecture

    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0)

    $summary = strings.concat("The process ", strings.to_upper($principal_process), " changed the registry key:", $e.target.registry.registry_key, " under the User context of ", strings.to_upper($adversary_uid))

  condition:
    $e
}

    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1

    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $threat_verdict_malicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))
    $recent_compile_time = if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)
    $invalid_cert = if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $system_user_file_write = if($e.principal.user.userid = "system", 1, 0)
    $sus_file_name_architecture = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\[^\/]+(32|64).[^\/.]+$/), 1, 0)
    $single_double_char_filename = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*([^\/]{1,2}.[^\/.]+)$/), 1, 0)
    $double_extensions = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+.[a-zA-Z]{3}.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_file_name = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\d+.[a-zA-Z]{3}$/), 1, 0)
    $common_malicious_file_names = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup\.exe|update\.js|lsass\.dmp|1\.txt|ntds\.dit|logs\.dat|sqlite3\.dll|pass_1234|system\.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $is_archive_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0)
    $is_executable_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0)
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)
    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $recent_compile_time + $system_user_file_write + $sus_file_name_architecture + $common_malicious_file_names + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_filename + $double_extensions + $sus_vt_tags + $all_numbers_file_name + $is_executable_file + $is_archive_file + $invalid_cert
    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e
}

  meta:
    rule_name = "AWS GuardDuty: DefenseEvasion:Kubernetes/TorIPCaller"
    description = "An API commonly used to evade defensive measures was invoked from a Tor exit node IP address."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    reference = "https://docs.aws.amazon.com/guardduty/latest/ug/guardduty_finding-types-active.html"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "AWS GuardDuty"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "DefenseEvasion:Kubernetes/TorIPCaller"
    $e.security_result.about.labels["Sample"] != "true"
    $product_event_type = $e.metadata.product_event_type

  match:
    $product_event_type over 1h

  outcome:
    $vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $product_name = "AWS GuardDuty"
    $risk_score = max(0 +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "CRITICAL", 95, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "HIGH", 85, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "MEDIUM", 65, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "LOW", 35, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "INFORMATIONAL", 10, 0)
    )
    $cloud_regions = array_distinct($e.target.location.name)
    $target_resource_names = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)
    $security_result_summary = array_distinct($e.security_result.summary)
    $security_result_description = array_distinct($e.security_result.description)
    $security_result_severity = array_distinct($e.security_result.severity)
    $security_result_severity_details = array_distinct($e.security_result.severity_details)
    $url_back_to_product = array_distinct($e.security_result.url_back_to_product)

rules.display_name: First Time Interactive Service Account Login by Principal User ID and Target Service Account
rules.text:
rule ueba_first_time_interactive_service_account_login_by_user_id {
  meta:
    rule_name = "First Time Interactive Service Account Login by Principal User ID and Target Service Account"
    description = "Detects the first time a user has a successful interactive service account login, tracked by principal user ID and target service account in the last 30 days. This may be indicative of behavior related to entry vectors."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0001"
    technique = "T1113"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    ($e.security_result.action = "ALLOW" or $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW_WITH_MODIFICATION")
    $service_account = $e.target.user.userid
    $service_account != ""
    $user_id = $e.principal.user.userid
    $user_id != ""

    $e.target.user.attribute.labels.value = /OU=Service Accounts/ nocase
    $e.extensions.auth.auth_details = /Logon Type (2|10)/ nocase

    $principal_ns = $e.principal.namespace
    $target_ns = $e.target.namespace

  match:
    $user_id, $service_account, $target_ns, $principal_ns over 48h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

    $historical_threshold = max(metrics.auth_attempts_success(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:first_seen, agg:min,
        principal.user.userid:$user_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns,
        target.user.userid:$service_account,
        target.namespace:$target_ns))

    $principal_user_id = array_distinct($user_id)
    $target_service_account = array_distinct($service_account)

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e and ($historical_threshold = 0)

  options:
    allow_zero_values = true
}

rule ttp_chrome_extension_sideloaded {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Chrome Extension Installed from External Source"
    description = "This rule monitors the activity of Chrome extensions installed from external sources outside of the Chrome Webstore (CWS). This is a common tactic used by malicious extension to bypass the security review process of the CWS."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1176"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Google"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "Chrome Management"
    $e.extracted.fields["extension_source"] = "EXTERNAL"
    $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["extension_action"]!= "UNINSTALL"
    $hostname = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $ext_id = strings.coalesce($e.target.resource_ancestors.product_object_id, $e.extracted.fields["extension_id"])
    $ext_name = strings.coalesce($e.target.resource_ancestors.name, $e.extracted.fields["extension_name"])

    (
      $ext_id != "nkeimhogjdpnpccoofpliimaahmaaome" and
      $ext_id != "ahfgeienlihckogmohjhadlkjgocpleb" and
      $ext_id != "mhjfbmdgcfjbbpaeojofohoefgiehjai" and
      $ext_id != "neajdppkdcdipfabeoofebfddakdcjhd" and
      $ext_id != "obojlibenopmhabbffmmcimgihgecokj"
    )

  match:
    $ext_id over 1h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.email_addresses)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($ext_id)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($ext_name)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $product_event_types = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_event_type)
    $ext_count = count($ext_id)

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)

  condition:
    $e and $ext_count < 3
}

rules.text:
rule ttp_chrome_extension_contacts_remote_host_with_safebrowsing_classification {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Extension Contacts or Redirects to Remote Host with SafeBrowsing Classification"
    description = "Detects Chrome extensions communicating, redirecting to, or starting a chain of browser traversal events to URLs that have been flagged with a risk level by Google Safe Browsing. This rule correlates extension telemetry signals with URL filtering events within a 30-minute window to detect activity such as potential c2 traffic, phishing, or malicious redirections initiated by browser add-ons."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1102"

  events:
    $e1.metadata.log_type = "CHROME_MANAGEMENT"
    (
      $e1.metadata.product_event_type = "urlFilteringInterstitialEvent" or
      $e1.metadata.product_event_type = "badNavigationEvent" or
      $e1.metadata.product_event_type = "urlNavigationEvent" or
      $e1.metadata.product_event_type = "suspiciousUrlEvent" or
      $e1.metadata.product_event_type = "SafeBrowsingInterstitialEvent"
    )
    $hostname = $e1.principal.hostname
    $e1.extracted.fields["url_info.risk_level"] = /MEDIUM|HIGH/
    $browser_full_url = strings.coalesce($e1.extracted.fields["url_info.url"], $e1.about.url, $e1.target.resource.name ,$e1.target.url)
    $remote_domain = strings.extract_hostname(strings.coalesce($e1.about.url, $e1.target.resource.name ,$e1.target.url))

    $hostname = $e2.principal.hostname
    $e2.metadata.log_type = "CHROME_MANAGEMENT"
    $e2.metadata.product_event_type = "extensionTelemetryEvent"
    $e2.target.resource.attribute.labels["contacted_by"] = "EXTENSION"
    ($e2.target.resource.name = "REMOTE_HOST_CONTACTED_INFO" or $e2.extracted.fields["telemetry_event_signals.signal_name"] = "REMOTE_HOST_CONTACTED_INFO")

    $remote_domain = strings.extract_hostname(strings.coalesce($e2.extracted.fields["telemetry_event_signals.url"], $e2.extracted.fields["telemetry_event_signals.domain"], $e2.extracted.fields["telemetry_event_signals.destination"]))
    $ext_id = strings.coalesce($e2.target.resource_ancestors.product_object_id, $e2.extracted.fields["extension_id"])
    $ext_name = strings.coalesce($e2.target.resource_ancestors.name, $e2.extracted.fields["extension_name"])
    $extension_version = strings.coalesce($e2.target.resource_ancestors.attribute.labels["extension_version"], $e2.extracted.fields["extension_version"])

  match:
    $hostname, $remote_domain over 30m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $result = array_distinct($e2.security_result.action)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.product_name)
    $browser_event_type = array_distinct($e1.metadata.product_event_type)
    $extension_event_type = array_distinct($e2.metadata.product_event_type)
    $browser_event_count = count_distinct($e1.metadata.id)
    $extension_event_count = count_distinct($e2.metadata.id)
    $total_event_count = $browser_event_count + $extension_event_count
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e1.target.resource.name)
    $hostnames = array_distinct($hostname)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e1.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $result_time = min($e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $is_admin_user = array_distinct($e1.principal.user.attribute.labels["is_admin"])

    $ext_names = array_distinct($ext_name)
    $ext_ids = array_distinct($ext_id)
    $extension_versions = array_distinct($extension_version)
    $extension_contacts_domain = array_distinct($remote_domain)

    $suspicious_safebrowsing_url = array_distinct($browser_full_url)
    $safebrowing_severity = array_distinct($e1.extracted.fields["url_info.risk_level"])

  condition:
    $e1 and $e2
}

rules.text:
rule ttp_chrome_extension_contacts_newly_observed_domain_in_environment {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Chrome Extension Contacting Newly Observed Domain In Environment"
    description = "Detects Chrome extensions that are contacting remote hosts that have only been seen in the environment for the first time less than 12 hours ago. This behavior could indicate that malicious code may have been recently added or dormant and recently activated. Verify if the extension has previously contacted this domain or if this is legitimate extension functionality and assess the domain for validity."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1102"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Google"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "Chrome Management"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "extensionTelemetryEvent"
    $e.target.resource.name = "REMOTE_HOST_CONTACTED_INFO" or $e.extracted.fields["telemetry_event_signals.signal_name"] = "REMOTE_HOST_CONTACTED_INFO"
    $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["contacted_by"] = "EXTENSION"
    $remote_domain = $e.extracted.fields["telemetry_event_signals.url"]
    $e.extracted.fields["extension_id"] != "efaidnbmnnnibpcajpcglclefindmkaj"
    (
      $remote_domain != "accounts.google.com" and
      $remote_domain != "play.google.com" and
      $remote_domain != /.*\.googleusercontent\.com/ nocase
    )
    $remote_domain = $first_seen_domain.graph.entity.domain.name
    $first_seen_domain.graph.metadata.entity_type = "DOMAIN_NAME"
    $first_seen_domain.graph.metadata.source_type = "DERIVED_CONTEXT"
    $first_seen_domain.graph.entity.domain.first_seen_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 12)

    $hostname = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $ext_id = strings.coalesce($e.target.resource_ancestors.product_object_id, $e.extracted.fields["extension_id"])
    $ext_name = strings.coalesce($e.target.resource_ancestors.name, $e.extracted.fields["extension_name"])

  match:
    $remote_domain over 1h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(35)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.email_addresses)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($ext_id)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($ext_name)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $domain = array_distinct($remote_domain)
    $extension_source = array_distinct(strings.coalesce($e.target.resource_ancestors.attribute.labels["extension_source"], $e.extracted.fields["extension_source"]))
    $extension_version = array_distinct(strings.coalesce($e.target.resource_ancestors.attribute.labels["extension_version"], $e.extracted.fields["extension_version"]))
    $hostnames = array_distinct($hostname)

  condition:
    $e and $first_seen_domain
}

rule ttp_chrome_extension_sensitive_data_transfer {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Sensitive Data Transferred by a Chrome Extension"
    description = "This rule detects the transfer of sensitive data to a Chrome extension. This behavior could indicate an attempt to exfiltrate data or misuse sensitive information by the extension."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0010"
    technique = "T1567"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Google"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "Chrome Management"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "sensitiveDataEvent"
    $e.target.url = /chrome-extension:\/\//
    $ext_id = re.capture($e.target.url, `chrome-extension:\/\/([^\/]+)`)
    $trigger_types = strings.coalesce($e.extracted.fields["trigger_type"],
      $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["trigger_type"])
    $method = $e.extracted.fields["transfer_method"]
    $e.security_result.action_details = "EVENT_RESULT_ALLOWED"
    $trigger_types != "FILE_DOWNLOAD"
    $method != "DRAG_AND_DROP"
    (
      $ext_id != "lpcaedmchfhocbbapmcbpinfpgnhiddi" and // Google Keep
      $ext_id != "gmbmikajjgmnabiglmofipeabaddhgne" and // Google Drive
      $ext_id != "aapbdbdomjkkjkaonfhkkikfgjllcleb" and // Google Translate
      $ext_id != "gbkeegbaiigmenfmjfclcdgdpimamgkj" and // Google Office Editor
      $ext_id != "mclkkofklkfljcocdinagocijmpgbhab" // Google Input Tools
    )

  match:
    $ext_id over 24h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.hostname)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.email_addresses)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($ext_id)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = array_distinct($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $security_result_rule_name = array_distinct($e.security_result.rule_name)
    $security_result_category = array_distinct($e.security_result.category)

    $url = array_distinct($e.target.url)
    $transfer_method = array_distinct($method)
    $hostname = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.hostname)
    $is_admin_user = array_distinct($e.principal.user.attribute.labels["is_admin"])
    $trigger_type = array_distinct($trigger_types)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_vendor_sentinelone_alerts_severity_low {
  meta:
    rule_name = "SentinelOne Alerts: Low"
    description = "Surfacing Low severity Alerts from SentinelOne"
    severity = "Low"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "SentinelOne"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "Alerts"
    $e.security_result.severity = "LOW"
    $asset_id = strings.ltrim(
      $e.principal.asset_id,
      re.capture($e.principal.asset_id, ".*:")
    )
    $threat_name = $e.security_result.rule_name

  match:
    $asset_id, $threat_name by 1d

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $threats = array_distinct($threat_name)
    $entities = array_distinct($asset_id)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $mitre_tactic = array_distinct($e.security_result.attack_details.tactics.id)
    $mitre_technique = array_distinct($e.security_result.attack_details.techniques.id)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $signature_name = array_distinct($threat_name)
    $log_source = array_distinct($e.metadata.log_type)
    $parser_type = array_distinct($e.metadata.parser_version)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $rule_category = "vendor"
    $update_detection = true
    $update_managed_defense_aggregations = true
    $event_min_timestamp = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_max_timestamp = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $name_override = strings.concat("SentinelOne Alerts: Low - ", arrays.join_string($threats, ","))
    $description_override = strings.concat("Surfacing Low severity Alerts from SentinelOne - ", arrays.join_string($threats, ","))

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_gcp_gke_sus_revshell_args {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Kubernetes Pod Creation with Potential Reverse Shell Arguments"
    description = "Detects when suspicious arguments are passed during the creation of a Pod or DameonSet that could potentially indicate a reverse shell attempt"
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059"
    reference = "https://github.com/BishopFox/badPods/blob/main/manifests/everything-allowed/pod/everything-allowed-revshell-pod.yaml, https://kubehound.io/reference/attacks/POD_CREATE/, https://hub.armosec.io/docs/configuration_parameter_listofdangerousartifcats"

  events:
    $e.security_result.detection_fields["mute"] != "MUTED"
    $e.metadata.event_type = "RESOURCE_CREATION"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "Google Kubernetes Engine"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "io.k8s.core.v1.pods.create"
    (
      $e.target.process.command_line = /(s{0,3}bin|usr\/bin)\/(sh|csh|ksh|tcsh|zsh|scsh)$/ OR
      $e.target.process.command_line = /bin\/busybox/ OR
      $e.target.process.command_line = /usr\/bin\/busybox/
    )
    (
      $e.about.file.capabilities_tags = /bash -i >& \/dev\/tcp\/.*\/[0-9]* 0>&1/ or
      $e.about.file.capabilities_tags = /ncat --ssl .* [0-9]* -e \/bin\/bash;/ or
      $e.target.resource_ancestors.attribute.labels["req_spec_containers_0_args_0"] = /bash -i >& \/dev\/tcp\/.*\/[0-9]* 0>&1/ or
      $e.target.resource_ancestors.attribute.labels["req_spec_containers_0_args_0"] = /ncat --ssl .* [0-9]* -e \/bin\/bash;/
    )
    $e.security_result.action != "BLOCK"

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(45
      + if($e.principal.user.userid = "system:serviceaccount:kube-system:daemon-set-controller", 20))
    $vendor_name = array($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count($e.metadata.id)

    $victim_name = array($e.target.resource.name)
    $adversary_uid = array($e.principal.user.product_object_id)
    $adversary_name = array($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.email_addresses)

    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $arguments = array_distinct($e.about.file.capabilities_tags)
    $command_line_executable = array($e.target.process.command_line)
    $namespace = array($e.target.resource.attribute.labels["res_metadata_namespace"])
    $ip = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $pod_name = array($e.target.resource.attribute.labels["name"])
    $cluster = array($e.target.resource.name)

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: Detects when suspicious arguments are passed during the creation of a Pod or DameonSet that could potentially indicate a reverse shell attempt

    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0010"
    technique = "T1537"
    reference = "https://docs.cloud.google.com/bigquery/docs/omni-aws-export-results-to-s3"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "GCP_CLOUDAUDIT"

      (
        $e.metadata.product_event_type = "google.cloud.bigquery.v2.JobService.InsertJob" and
        $e.target.resource_ancestors.attribute.labels["jobinsertion_jobconfig_extractconfig_destinationuris"] = /^(s3|azure)/ nocase and
        $e.target.resource_ancestors.attribute.labels["jobinsertion_jobconfig_type"] = "EXPORT"

        $e.target.process.command_line = /EXPORT DATA WITH CONNECTION.*uri\s?=\s*['"]?(s3|azure):\/\// nocase or

rule ttp_gcp_sa_self_sakeycreation {
  meta:
    rule_name = "GCP Service Account Self Key Creation"
    description = "Detects a Service Account creating a key for itself. This may indicate an adversary attempting to persist access to a compromised Service Account. If a Service Account key is deleted, active service account tokens may still be valid. These tokens can then be used to recreate the Service Account key for persistent access."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1098.001"

  events:
    $e.security_result.detection_fields["mute"] != "MUTED"
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_RESOURCE_CREATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_CHANGE_PASSWORD"
    )
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "google.iam.admin.v1.CreateServiceAccountKey"
    $e.principal.user.attribute.permissions.name = "iam.serviceAccountKeys.create"
    $e.target.resource.resource_type = "SERVICE_ACCOUNT"
    $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    $e.principal.user.userid = $e.target.resource.name

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $event_count = 1
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $victim_uid = $e.target.resource.name
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_gcp_firewall_delete {

    description = "Detects mass deletion of firewall rules by non-service accounts."
    severity = "Info"
    tactic = "TA0040"
    technique = "T1489"

rule ttp_gcp_deletedsakeyinuse {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Deleted In-Use Service Account Key"
    description = "A Service Account key was deleted, but there are still active authenticated sessions conducting behavior due to cached credentials. This could imply that an unintended user is using the Service Account key."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1078.004"
    false_positives = "A user could have deleted a Service Account key, unaware that it is in legitimate use."

  events:
    $e1.metadata.event_type = "USER_RESOURCE_DELETION"
    $e1.principal.user.attribute.permissions.name = "iam.serviceAccountKeys.delete"
    $e1.target.user.email_addresses = $service_account_email
    strings.coalesce($e1.target.cloud.project.name, $e1.target.resource_ancestors.product_object_id) = $project_name
    $e1.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    $e1.security_result.detection_fields.key = "key_id"
    re.capture($e1.security_result.detection_fields.value, `[a-z0-9]{10,}`) = $key_id
    ($e2.metadata.event_type = "RESOURCE_DELETION" or
      $e2.metadata.event_type = "RESOURCE_CREATION" or
      $e2.metadata.event_type = "USER_RESOURCE_CREATION" or
      $e2.metadata.event_type = "USER_RESOURCE_DELETION") and
    $e2.principal.user.attribute.permissions.name != "iam.serviceAccountKeys.delete"
    $e2.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    $e2.principal.user.email_addresses = $service_account_email
    strings.coalesce($e2.target.cloud.project.name, $e2.target.resource_ancestors.product_object_id) = $project_name
    $e2.security_result.detection_fields.key = "key_id"
    re.capture($e2.security_result.detection_fields.value, `[a-z0-9]{10,}`) = $key_id
    $e1.principal.ip != $e2.principal.ip

  match:
    $service_account_email, $key_id over 15m after $e1

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.product_name)

    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e1.target.resource.product_object_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e1.target.resource.name)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e1.target.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e1.principal.user.product_object_id)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e1.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e1.principal.user.email_addresses)

    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $e1_email_address = array_distinct($e1.principal.user.email_addresses)
    $e2_email_address = array_distinct($e2.principal.user.email_addresses)
    $e1_resource_name = array_distinct($e1.target.resource.name)
    $e2_resource_name = array_distinct($e2.target.resource.name)
    $e1_ip = array_distinct($e1.principal.ip)
    $e2_ip = array_distinct($e2.principal.ip)

  condition:
    #e1 = 1 and $e2
}
rules.description: A Service Account key was deleted, but there are still active authenticated sessions conducting behavior due to cached credentials. This could imply that an unintended user is using the Service Account key.

rules.text:
rule ttp_gcp_migautoscalingincrease {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Managed Instance Group Autoscaling Increased to Maximum"
    description = "Managed Instance groups can be abused for Cryptomining activities, as they allow for the creation of many replicated Compute Engine Instances. This alert identifies suspicious autoscaling behavior in Managed Instance Groups."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0040"
    technique = "T1496"
    false_positives = "This sudden increase in scalability is very rare, though there could be a specific business need."

  events:
    $e1.metadata.event_type = "RESOURCE_WRITTEN"
    $e1.principal.user.email_addresses = $principal
    ($e1.metadata.product_event_type = /compute.regionInstanceGroupManagers.patch/ or
      $e1.metadata.product_event_type = /compute.instanceGroupManagers.patch/)
    $e1.principal.user.attribute.permissions.name = "compute.instances.setMetadata"
    $e1.target.resource.attribute.labels["managed_instances_result"] = "PAGINATED"
    $e1.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    $mig = re.capture($e1.target.resource.name, `\/([A-Za-z0-9-]+)$`)
    strings.coalesce($e1.target.cloud.project.name, $e1.target.resource_ancestors.product_object_id) = $mig_project
    $e2.metadata.event_type = "RESOURCE_WRITTEN"
    $e2.principal.user.email_addresses = $principal
    $e2.principal.user.attribute.permissions.name = "compute.autoscalers.update"
    $e2.metadata.product_event_type = /autoscalers.update|autoscalers.patch/ nocase
    $e2.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    $mig = re.capture($e2.target.resource.name, `\/([A-Za-z0-9-]+)$`)
    strings.coalesce($e2.target.cloud.project.name, $e2.target.resource_ancestors.product_object_id) = $mig_project

  match:
    $mig, $mig_project, $principal over 2m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(35)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.product_name)

    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e1.target.resource.product_object_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e1.target.resource.name)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e1.target.ip)

rules.text:
rule ttp_gcp_sakeyusagegeolocation {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Service Account Key Usage from Various Geolocations"
    description = "A single Service Account Key has been used to carry out actions from various geolocations, in a short period of time. This could imply that the Service Account private key has been leaked."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0006"
    technique = "T1552.004"
    false_positives = "Internet Service Providers, VPNs or Proxy services may funnel traffic through gateways in remote locations."

  events:
    $e.security_result.detection_fields["mute"] != "MUTED"
    $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region != ""
    $geo_location = $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region
    strings.coalesce($e.target.cloud.project.name, $e.target.resource_ancestors.product_object_id) = $project_name
    $project_name != ""
    $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    $e.security_result.detection_fields["key_id"] != ""
    re.capture($e.security_result.detection_fields["key_id"], `[a-z0-9]{10,}`) != ""
    $key_id = re.capture($e.security_result.detection_fields["key_id"], `[a-z0-9]{10,}`)
    $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.organization_name != "google" nocase
    $e.metadata.product_name != "Google Cloud Storage"
    $e.metadata.product_name != "BigQuery"

  match:
    $key_id, $project_name over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(35)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.target.resource.product_object_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.target.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.product_object_id)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.email_addresses)

    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $email_address = array_distinct($e.principal.user.email_addresses)
    $resource_name = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)
    $locations = array_distinct($geo_location)
    $num_locations = count_distinct($geo_location)
    $ip = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)

  condition:
    $e and $num_locations > 3
}

rules.display_name: Unauthorized API Call from Service Account
rules.text:
rule ttp_gcp_saunauthorizedapicall {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Unauthorized API Call from Service Account"
    description = "A service account from an outside project made an unauthorized API call. This behavior could indicate that an unauthorized user is attempting to gain information on resources, enable or disable services, or perform other unauthorized actions."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0007"
    technique = "T1580"

  events:
    $e.security_result.detection_fields["mute"] != "MUTED"
    $e.principal.user.email_addresses = /iam.gserviceaccount.com$/
    $e.target.application = /\.googleapis\.com$/
    ($e.target.cloud.project.name != re.capture($e.principal.user.email_addresses, `\@(.*)\.iam\.gserviceaccount\.com$`) or
      $e.target.resource_ancestors.product_object_id != re.capture($e.principal.user.email_addresses, `\@(.*)\.iam\.gserviceaccount\.com$`))
    $e.security_result.detection_fields["status_code"] = "7"
    any $e.security_result.detection_fields.key = "key_id"
    $user_id = re.capture($e.principal.user.userid, `^([^@]+)`)
    $e.security_result.category_details != /cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Fpolicy$/ nocase
    $e.target.application != /(pubsub|logging|monitoring).googleapis.com/ nocase
    all $e.principal.user.email_addresses != /(aqua|crowdstrike|falcon|nessus|orca|prisma|qualys|scan|splunk|tenable|wiz)/ nocase

  match:
    $user_id over 10m

  outcome:
    $count_services_targeted = count_distinct($e.target.application)
    $unique_services_targeted = array_distinct($e.target.application)

    $risk_score = 35
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.target.resource.product_object_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.target.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.product_object_id)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.email_addresses)

    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $email_address = array_distinct($e.principal.user.email_addresses)
    $resource_name = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)
    $ip = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)

  condition:
    $e and $event_count > 3 and $event_count < 50 and
    $count_services_targeted >= 2
}

rule i_vendor_trellix_hx_shard_0 {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Trellix HX Alerts (Shard 0)"
    description = "Trellix HX Alerts (Shard 0)"
    severity = "Info"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "TRELLIX_HX_ALERTS"
    $hash = hash.fingerprint2011(strings.concat($e.principal.asset_id, strings.coalesce($e.security_result[0].rule_name, $e.security_result[0].threat_name), $e.metadata.product_event_type))
    $hash % cast.as_uint(10) = 0

    $asset_id = $e.principal.asset_id
    $threat_name = strings.coalesce($e.security_result[0].summary, $e.security_result[0].threat_name)
    $rule_name = strings.coalesce($e.security_result[0].rule_name, $e.security_result[0].threat_name)
    $event_type = $e.metadata.product_event_type
    $indicator_or_product_url = strings.coalesce($e.security_result.rule_labels["Indicator URL"], $e.metadata.url_back_to_product)
    $ruleset_category = strings.coalesce($e.security_result[0].ruleset_category_display_name, $e.security_result[0].category_details)

  match:
    $asset_id, $rule_name, $event_type by 1d

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = "Trellix"
    $mitre_tactic = array_distinct($e.security_result.attack_details.tactics.id)
    $mitre_technique = array_distinct($e.security_result.attack_details.techniques.id)
    $product_name = "HX"
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $rule_category = "vendor"
    $update_detection = true
    $update_managed_defense_aggregations = true
    $event_min_timestamp = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_max_timestamp = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $signature_name = array_distinct($rule_name)
    $signature_source = "hx"
    $signature_source_uri = array_distinct($indicator_or_product_url)

    $hx_ruleset_category = array_distinct(strings.to_lower($ruleset_category))

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_o365_successful_mfa_fatigue_attack {
  meta:
    rule_name = "O365 MFA Fatigue Attack"
    description = "This detects on multiple failed Office 365 login events where MFA approval was denied or timed out followed by a successful login from an IP address that has not been seen with this account in the last 30 days, which may indicate a potentially successful multi-factor authentication (MFA) fatigue attack."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0006"
    technique = "T1621"

  events:
    $e1.metadata.log_type = "OFFICE_365"
    $e1.metadata.product_event_type = "UserLoginFailed"
    $e1.additional.fields["error_number"] = "500121"

    $e2.metadata.log_type = /OFFICE_365/
    $e2.metadata.product_event_type = "UserLoggedIn"

    $target_userid = $e1.target.user.userid
    $target_userid = $e2.target.user.userid
    $principal_ip = $e1.principal.ip
    $principal_ip = $e2.principal.ip
    $e2.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds > $e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

  match:
    $target_userid over 2m

  outcome:
    $vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    $product_name = "Office 365"
    $risk_score = 35
    $result = "succeeded"
    $mfa_denied_count = count_distinct($e1.metadata.id)
    $login_success_count = count_distinct($e2.metadata.id)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e2.principal.resource.product_object_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($target_userid)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e2.principal.ip)
    $result_time = array_distinct($e2.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $days_success = max(metrics.auth_attempts_success(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum,
        agg:num_metric_periods,
        target.user.userid:$target_userid,
        principal.asset.hostname:$principal_ip))

  condition:
    $e1 and $e2 and $mfa_denied_count >= 20 and $days_success <= 1
}

rule ueba_excessive_logins_failed_by_user_email_address {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Excessive Failed Logins by User Email Address and Target Application"
    description = "Detects excessive (10x the historical maximum value, if the entity has a coefficient of variation < 0.1 and was observed for at least 9 of the last 30 days) auth attempts failed by user email address. This may be indicative of behavior related to password guessing."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0006"
    technique = "T1110.001"

    $target_application = $e.target.application
    $target_application != ""

    $target_ns = $e.target.namespace

  match:
    $user_email_addresses, $target_application, $target_ns over 24h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $num_times_max = max(10)

    $historical_avg = max(metrics.auth_attempts_fail(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:avg,
        target.user.email_addresses:$user_email_addresses, target.application:$target_application,
        target.namespace:$target_ns))

    $historical_max = max(metrics.auth_attempts_fail(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:max,
        target.user.email_addresses:$user_email_addresses, target.application:$target_application,
        target.namespace:$target_ns))

    $historical_observations = max(metrics.auth_attempts_fail(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:num_metric_periods,
        target.user.email_addresses:$user_email_addresses, target.application:$target_application,
        target.namespace:$target_ns))

    $historical_coefficient_of_variation = max(
      metrics.auth_attempts_fail(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:stddev,
        target.user.email_addresses:$user_email_addresses, target.application:$target_application,
        target.namespace:$target_ns) /
      metrics.auth_attempts_fail(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:avg,
        target.user.email_addresses:$user_email_addresses, target.application:$target_application,
        target.namespace:$target_ns))
    $observation_threshold = max(9)

    $coefficient_of_variation_threshold = max(0.1)

    $historical_threshold = max(10 * metrics.auth_attempts_fail(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:max,
        target.user.email_addresses:$user_email_addresses, target.application:$target_application,
        target.namespace:$target_ns))

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)

    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e and ($event_count > $historical_threshold) and ($historical_coefficient_of_variation < $coefficient_of_variation_threshold) and ($historical_observations >= $observation_threshold)

  options:
    allow_zero_values = true
}

rule ttp_macos_suspicious_hdiutil_shell_mount_tmp {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Suspicious Hdiutil Mount to Tmp via Shell"
    description = "Detects the use of 'hdiutil' spawned from a shell (sh, bash, zsh, dash) to silently mount disk images into a '/tmp/' directory using flags such as '-nobrowse', '-noverify', and '-noautoopen' which bypass trust validation and user notifications."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1564.001"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"
    ) and
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /\b(sh|bash|zsh|dash)$/ nocase and
    $e.target.process.file.full_path = /\bhdiutil$/ nocase and
    $e.target.process.command_line = /\battach\b/ nocase and
    $e.target.process.command_line = /-nobrowse\b/ nocase and
    $e.target.process.command_line = /-noverify\b/ nocase and
    $e.target.process.command_line = /-noautoopen\b/ nocase and
    $e.target.process.command_line = /-mountpoint\s+\/tmp\/[^\/]+(\s|$)/ nocase and
    not $e.target.process.command_line = /-mountpoint\s+\/tmp\/[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}/ nocase and
    not $e.principal.process.command_line = /(\/Library\/Application Support\/JAMF\/|\.claude\/shell-snapshots\/snapshot)/ nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1

    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e
}

  meta:

    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1105"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"
    )
    $e.target.process.file.full_path = /(^|\/)curl$/ nocase

    $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /(^|\/)(bash|sh|zsh|dash|osascript)$/ nocase
    (

      $e1.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"

    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname

    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e1.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)

    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = array($e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e1.metadata.id)
    $principal_hostname = array_distinct($hostname)
    $principalIp = array_distinct($e1.principal.ip)
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $asset_is_server = max(if($e1.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0))

    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $product_event_type = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_event_type)
    $principal_process_command_line = array_distinct($e.principal.process.command_line)
    $principal_process_file_full_path = array_distinct($e.principal.process.file.full_path)
    $target_process_command_line = array_distinct($e.target.process.command_line)
    $target_process_file_full_path = array_distinct($e.target.process.file.full_path)
    $xattr_principal_process_command_line = array_distinct($e1.principal.process.command_line)
    $xattr_principal_process_file_full_path = array_distinct($e1.principal.process.file.full_path)

  condition:
    $e and $e1

rules.text:
rule ueba_anomalous_total_bytes_by_device_hostname {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Anomalous Network Bytes Total By Hostname"
    description = "Detects anomalous (2 standard deviations away from the historical average, if the entity has a coefficient of variation < 0.1 and was observed for at least 9 of the last 30 days) network bytes total (inbound + outbound bytes) by device hostname. This may be indicative of potential Exfiltration behavior."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0010"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
    $e.network.received_bytes > 0
    $e.network.sent_bytes > 0
    $hostname = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $hostname != ""
    optimization.sample_rate($e.metadata.id, 1, 10)

    $principal_ns = $e.principal.namespace

  match:
    $hostname, $principal_ns over 24h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $usage_past_24h = sum(10.0 * $e.network.sent_bytes + 10.0 * $e.network.received_bytes)
    $num_stddevs_away = max(2)

    $historical_stddev = max(metrics.network_bytes_total(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:stddev,
        principal.asset.hostname:$hostname,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))

    $historical_avg = max(metrics.network_bytes_total(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:avg,
        principal.asset.hostname:$hostname,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))

    $historical_max = max(metrics.network_bytes_total(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:max,
        principal.asset.hostname:$hostname,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))

    $historical_observations = max(metrics.network_bytes_total(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:num_metric_periods,
        principal.asset.hostname:$hostname,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))

    $historical_coefficient_of_variation = max(
      metrics.network_bytes_total(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:stddev,
        principal.asset.hostname:$hostname,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns) /
      metrics.network_bytes_total(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:avg,
        principal.asset.hostname:$hostname,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))
    $observation_threshold = max(9)

    $coefficient_of_variation_threshold = max(1/10)

    $historical_threshold = max(
      metrics.network_bytes_total(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:avg,
        principal.asset.hostname:$hostname,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns)+ 2 * metrics.network_bytes_total(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:stddev,
        principal.asset.hostname:$hostname,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e and ($usage_past_24h > $historical_threshold) and ($historical_coefficient_of_variation < $coefficient_of_variation_threshold) and ($historical_observations >= $observation_threshold) and $event_count >= 100

  options:
    allow_zero_values = true
}

rules.text:
rule ueba_aws_excessive_reads_in_secretsmanager {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Excessive Reads in AWS SecretsManager by User ID"
    description = "Detects excessive (10x the historical maximum value, if the entity has a coefficient of variation < 0.1 and was observed for at least 9 of the last 30 days) SecretsManager reads succeeded by user id. This may be indicative of enumeration related to password theft."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0006"
    technique = "T1555.006"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "RESOURCE_READ"
    $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"

    $account_id = $e.additional.fields["recipientAccountId"]
    $user_id = $e.principal.user.userid
    $target_application = $e.target.application

    $e.target.application = "secretsmanager.amazonaws.com"

  match:
    $user_id over 24h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result = array_distinct(if(any $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW", "succeeded", "failed"))
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $target_applications = array_distinct($e.target.application)

    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.target.resource.product_object_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.product_object_id)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)

    $num_times_max = max(10)

    $historical_avg = max(metrics.resource_read_success(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:avg,
        principal.user.userid:$user_id,
        metadata.vendor_name:"AMAZON",
        metadata.product_name:"AWS CloudTrail"
    ))

    $historical_max = max(metrics.resource_read_success(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:max,
        principal.user.userid:$user_id,
        metadata.vendor_name:"AMAZON",
        metadata.product_name:"AWS CloudTrail"
    ))

    $historical_observations = max(metrics.resource_read_success(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:num_metric_periods,
        principal.user.userid:$user_id,
        metadata.vendor_name:"AMAZON",
        metadata.product_name:"AWS CloudTrail"
    ))

    $historical_coefficient_of_variation = max(
      metrics.resource_read_success(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:stddev,
        principal.user.userid:$user_id,
        metadata.vendor_name:"AMAZON",
        metadata.product_name:"AWS CloudTrail") /
      metrics.resource_read_success(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:avg,
        principal.user.userid:$user_id,
        metadata.vendor_name:"AMAZON",
        metadata.product_name:"AWS CloudTrail"))
    $observation_threshold = max(9)

    $coefficient_of_variation_threshold = max(1/10)

    $historical_threshold = max(10 * metrics.resource_read_success(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:max,
        principal.user.userid:$user_id,
        metadata.vendor_name:"AMAZON",
        metadata.product_name:"AWS CloudTrail"))

    $vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"

  condition:
    $e and ($event_count > $historical_threshold) and ($historical_coefficient_of_variation < $coefficient_of_variation_threshold) and ($historical_observations >= $observation_threshold)
}
rules.description: Detects excessive (10x the historical maximum value, if the entity has a coefficient of variation < 0.1 and was observed for at least 9 of the last 30 days) SecretsManager reads succeeded by user id. This may be indicative of enumeration related to password theft.

rule ttp_gcp_base64_encoded_cloudsql {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Base64 Encoded Cloud SQL Command"
    description = "Identifies attempts to run Cloud SQL commands that contain base64 encoded text. This behavior may be indicative of malicious SQL commands or attempts to execute malware on a database's host machine."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0001"
    technique = "T1190"

  events:
    $e1.security_result.detection_fields["mute"] != "MUTED"
    $e1.metadata.product_name = "Google Cloud Platform"
    $e1.target.resource.resource_type = "DATABASE"
    $e1.target.resource.resource_subtype != "bigquery"
    $e1.metadata.log_type = "GCP_CLOUDSQL"
    $e1.target.cloud.project.name = $project_name
    $e1.principal.process.command_line = /-[Ee][Cc]?[Hh]?[Oo]?\s*['\"]?[A-Za-z0-9+\/]{16,}/

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(
      if($e1.principal.user.userid = "root", 25) +
      if($e1.security_result.action = "ALLOW", 25) +
      25
    )
    $vendor_name = array($e1.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array($e1.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = 1

    $victim_name = array($e1.target.resource.name)
    $adversary_name = array($e1.principal.user.userid)

    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $database_name = $e1.target.resource.attribute.labels["database_id"]
    $principal_ip = array_distinct($e1.principal.ip)
    $principal_userid = $e1.principal.user.userid

  condition:
    $e1
}

rule ueba_excessive_network_http_for_new_user_id {
  meta:

    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0001"
    technique = "T1078"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_HTTP"
    $e.security_result.action = "BLOCK"
    $network_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

    $user_id = $e.principal.user.userid
    $user_id != ""
    $network_target =  $e.target.hostname
    $network_target != ""
    $ip = $e.principal.ip
    $user_context.graph.entity.user.userid = $user_id
    $user_context.graph.metadata.vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    ($user_context.graph.metadata.product_name = "Azure Active Directory" or
      $user_context.graph.metadata.product_name = "Windows Active Directory")

    $user_context.graph.metadata.entity_type = "USER"

    $user_creation_time != 0

    $target_ns = $e.target.namespace

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $principal_ip = array_distinct($ip)
    $network_http_target = array_distinct($network_target)
    $user_creation_time_seconds = array_distinct($user_creation_time)

rules.display_name: O365 Sharepoint Bulk File Access or Download via PowerShell
rules.text:
rule ttp_o365_sharepoint_bulk_download_via_powershell {
  meta:
    rule_name = "O365 Sharepoint Bulk File Access or Download via PowerShell"
    description = "Detects programmatic file access or downloads from SharePoint where the User-Agent identifies as PowerShell. Threat actors may use PowerShell to automate the download of data from SharePoint."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0009"
    technique = "T1213.002"
    false_positives = "Legitimate backup tasks using PowerShell scripts to automate the download or transfer files from Sharepoint may trigger this detection."
    reference = "https://www.varonis.com/blog/sidestepping-detection-while-exfiltrating-sharepoint-data"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "OFFICE_365"
    ($e.metadata.product_event_type = "FileDownloaded" or $e.metadata.product_event_type = "FileAccessed")
    ($e.target.application = "SharePoint" or $e.principal.application = "SharePoint")
    $e.network.http.user_agent = /PowerShell/ nocase
    $session_id = $e.network.session_id

  match:
    $session_id over 5m

  outcome:
    $vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    $product_name = "Office 365"
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $risk_score = 65
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $target_url_count = count_distinct(strings.coalesce($e.src.url, $e.target.file.full_path))
    $target_urls = array_distinct(strings.coalesce($e.src.url, $e.target.file.full_path))
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $e and $target_url_count >= 5
}
rules.description: Detects programmatic file access or downloads from SharePoint where the User-Agent identifies as PowerShell. Threat actors may use PowerShell to automate the download of data from SharePoint.

rules.text:
rule ttp_o365_sharepoint_bulk_download_via_file_download {
  meta:
    rule_name = "O365 Sharepoint High Volume File Download Events"
    description = "Detects a high volume of document file download events in SharePoint by a single user within a short period of time."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0009"
    technique = "T1213.002"
    false_positives = "Legitimate backup tasks using PowerShell scripts to automate the download or transfer files from Sharepoint may trigger this detection."
    reference = "https://www.varonis.com/blog/sidestepping-detection-while-exfiltrating-sharepoint-data"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "OFFICE_365"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "FileDownloaded"
    ($e.target.application = "SharePoint" or $e.principal.application = "SharePoint")
    ($e.src.url = /\.(doc[mx]?|xls[bmx]?|ppt[amx]?|pdf)$/ nocase or $e.target.file.full_path = /\.(doc[mx]?|xls[bmx]?|ppt[amx]?|pdf)$/ nocase)
    $url_extension_extract = re.capture($e.src.url, `\.([^\.]+)$`)
    $file_extension_extract = re.capture($e.target.file.full_path, `\.([^\.]+)$`)
    $session_id = $e.network.session_id

  match:
    $session_id over 5m

  outcome:
    $vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    $product_name = "Office 365"
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $risk_score = 35
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $target_url_count = count_distinct(strings.coalesce($e.src.url, $e.target.file.full_path))
    $target_urls = array_distinct(strings.coalesce($e.src.url, $e.target.file.full_path))
    $extension_count = count_distinct(strings.coalesce($url_extension_extract, $file_extension_extract))
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $e and $target_url_count >= 50 and $extension_count >= 3
}
