rule ttp_azure_defender_for_cloud_microburst_exploitation_toolkit_used_to_enumerate_resources_in_your_subscriptions {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Azure Defender for Cloud: MicroBurst exploitation toolkit used to enumerate resources in your subscriptions"
    description = "A PowerShell script was run in your subscription and performed suspicious pattern of executing an information gathering operations to discover resources, permissions, and network structures. Threat actors use automated scripts, like MicroBurst, to gather information for malicious activities. This was detected by analyzing Azure Resource Manager operations in your subscription. This operation might indicate that an identity in your organization was breached, and that the threat actor is trying to compromise your environment for malicious intentions."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0009"
    reference = "https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/alerts-reference"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    (
      $e.metadata.log_type = "MICROSOFT_GRAPH_ALERT" or
      $e.metadata.log_type = "MICROSOFT_DEFENDER_CLOUD_ALERTS"
    )
    $e.security_result.rule_name = "MicroBurst exploitation toolkit used to enumerate resources in your subscriptions"

    $product_event_type = $e.security_result.rule_name

  outcome:
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $risk_score = max(0 +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "HIGH", 85, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "MEDIUM", 65, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "LOW", 35, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "INFORMATIONAL", 10, 0)
    )
    $event_count = 1
    $product_urls = array_distinct($e.security_result.url_back_to_product)
    $security_result_summary = array_distinct($e.security_result.summary)
    $security_result_description = array_distinct($e.security_result.description)
    $security_result_severity = array_distinct($e.security_result.severity)
    $security_remediation_details = array_distinct($e.security_result.action_details)
    $security_result_threat_name = array_distinct($e.security_result.threat_name)
    $adversary_names = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.userid, $e.principal.hostname, $e.principal.resource.name))
    $adversary_uid = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.product_object_id, $e.principal.asset_id, $e.principal.resource.product_object_id))
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $victim_names = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.target.user.userid, $e.target.hostname, $e.target.resource.name))
    $victim_uid = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.target.user.product_object_id, $e.target.asset_id, $e.target.resource.product_object_id))
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.target.ip)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: A PowerShell script was run in your subscription and performed suspicious pattern of executing an information gathering operations to discover resources, permissions, and network structures. Threat actors use automated scripts, like MicroBurst, to gather information for malicious activities. This was detected by analyzing Azure Resource Manager operations in your subscription. rule ttp_vendor_sophos_edr_severity_critical {
  meta:
    rule_name = "SOPHOS_EDR: CRITICAL Detection"
    description = "Surfaces a CRITICAL SOPHOS_EDR alert"
    severity = "Critical"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "SOPHOS_EDR"
    $e.security_result.severity = "CRITICAL"
    $target_hostname = $e.target.hostname
    $threat_name = strings.coalesce($e.security_result.threat_name, $e.security_result.summary, $e.metadata.description, $e.metadata.product_event_type)

  match:
    $target_hostname, $threat_name over 24h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 95
    $rule_category = "vendor"
    $threats = array_distinct($threat_name)
    $entity = array_distinct($target_hostname)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $product_event_type = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_event_type)
    $metadata_description = array_distinct($e.metadata.description)
    $principal_ip = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $principal_user_userid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $target_process_pid = array_distinct($e.target.process.pid)
    $security_result_action = array_distinct($e.security_result.action)
    $security_result_severity = array_distinct($e.security_result.severity)
    $principal_process_file_sha256 = array_distinct($e.principal.process.file.sha256)
    $target_file_full_path = array_distinct($e.target.file.full_path)

    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $e
}

rules.author: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence

rules.display_name: Azure Defender for Cloud: Manipulation of host firewall detected
rules.text:
rule ttp_azure_defender_for_cloud_manipulation_of_host_firewall_detected {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Azure Defender for Cloud: Manipulation of host firewall detected"
    description = "Analysis of processes running within a container or directly on a Kubernetes node, has detected a possible manipulation of the on-host firewall. Attackers will often disable this to exfiltrate data."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    reference = "https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/alerts-reference"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    (
      $e.metadata.log_type = "MICROSOFT_GRAPH_ALERT" or
      $e.metadata.log_type = "MICROSOFT_DEFENDER_CLOUD_ALERTS"
    )
    $e.security_result.rule_name = "Manipulation of host firewall detected"

    $product_event_type = $e.security_result.rule_name

  outcome:
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $risk_score = max(0 +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "HIGH", 85, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "MEDIUM", 65, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "LOW", 35, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "INFORMATIONAL", 10, 0)
    )
    $event_count = 1
    $product_urls = array_distinct($e.security_result.url_back_to_product)
    $security_result_summary = array_distinct($e.security_result.summary)
    $security_result_description = array_distinct($e.security_result.description)
    $security_result_severity = array_distinct($e.security_result.severity)
    $security_remediation_details = array_distinct($e.security_result.action_details)
    $security_result_threat_name = array_distinct($e.security_result.threat_name)
    $adversary_names = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.userid, $e.principal.hostname, $e.principal.resource.name))
    $adversary_uid = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.product_object_id, $e.principal.asset_id, $e.principal.resource.product_object_id))
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $victim_names = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.target.user.userid, $e.target.hostname, $e.target.resource.name))
    $victim_uid = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.target.user.product_object_id, $e.target.asset_id, $e.target.resource.product_object_id))
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.target.ip)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

  events:
    $e.security_result.detection_fields["mute"] != "MUTED"

    any $e.principal.user.email_addresses = /.*-compute@developer\.gserviceaccount\.com/

    $resource_name = $e.target.resource.name
    $ip = $e.principal.ip

  match:

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(35)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.email_addresses)

rules.text:
rule ueba_excessive_logins_total_by_new_user_id {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Excessive Total Logins to Application by Newly Created User ID"
    description = "Detects excessive (> 15) authentication attempts (successful and failed) where the user ID was created within 24h of the authentication events. This may indicate abuse or control of newly created accounts."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0001"
    technique = "T1078"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"

    $user_id = $e.target.user.userid
    $user_id != ""

    $app = $e.target.application
    $app != ""

    $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds != 0
    $user_login_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $user_context.graph.metadata.vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    ($user_context.graph.metadata.product_name = "Azure Active Directory" or
      $user_context.graph.metadata.product_name = "Windows Active Directory")
    $user_context.graph.metadata.source_type = "ENTITY_CONTEXT"
    $user_context.graph.metadata.entity_type = "USER"
    $user_context.graph.entity.user.userid = $user_id
    $user_context.graph.entity.user.attribute.creation_time.seconds != 0
    $user_creation_time = $user_context.graph.entity.user.attribute.creation_time.seconds

    $target_ns = $e.target.namespace

  match:
    $user_id, $target_ns, $app over 24h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $target_application = array_distinct($app)
    $target_user_id = array_distinct($user_id)
    $user_creation_time_seconds = array_distinct($user_creation_time)
    $user_login_time_seconds = array_distinct($user_login_time)
    $created_same_day = max(if($user_login_time - $user_creation_time < 86400, 1, 0))
    $event_threshold = 15

  condition:
    $e and $user_context and ($created_same_day = 1) and ($event_count > $event_threshold)

  options:
    allow_zero_values = true
}
rules.description: Detects excessive (> 15) authentication attempts (successful and failed) where the user ID was created within 24h of the authentication events. This may indicate abuse or control of newly created accounts.

rule ttp_vendor_deep_instinct_edr_severity_informational {
  meta:
    rule_name = "DEEP_INSTINCT_EDR: INFORMATIONAL Detection"
    description = "Surfaces a INFORMATIONAL DEEP_INSTINCT_EDR alert"
    severity = "Info"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "DEEP_INSTINCT_EDR"
    $e.security_result.severity = "INFORMATIONAL"
    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $threat_name = strings.coalesce($e.security_result.threat_name, $e.security_result.summary, $e.metadata.description, $e.metadata.product_event_type)

  match:
    $hostname, $threat_name over 24h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 10
    $rule_category = "vendor"
    $threats = array_distinct($threat_name)
    $entities = array_distinct($hostname)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $product_event_type = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_event_type)
    $principal_user_userid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $principal_process_file_full_path = array_distinct($e.principal.process.file.full_path)
    $target_hostname = array_distinct($e.target.hostname)
    $target_ip = array_distinct($e.target.ip)
    $security_result_action_details = array_distinct($e.security_result.action_details)
    $security_result_severity_details = array_distinct($e.security_result.severity_details)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $event_min_timestamp = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_max_timestamp = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: Surfaces a INFORMATIONAL DEEP_INSTINCT_EDR alert
rules.author: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence

rule m_hunting_aws_create_case_non_console_1 {
  meta:
    rule_name = "CreateCase Events from Non-Console"
    description = "This rule detects CreateCase events that did not originate from the AWS console. CreateCase is used to open a case in the Support Center, and is an uncommon behavior which was observed in use by attackers in an attempt to raise the limit for sending phishing emails."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0004"
    technique = "T1098"
    false_positives = "This rule can generate false positives if the CreateCase API was not invoked through the console for legitimate reasons."
    reference = "https://www.wiz.io/blog/wiz-discovers-cloud-email-abuse-campaign"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "AWS_CLOUDTRAIL"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "CreateCase"
    $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["sessionCredentialFromConsole"] = "false"

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $event_count = 1

    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.ip[0]
    $security_result = array_distinct($e.security_result.action[0])

    $result = "attempted"
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: This rule detects CreateCase events that did not originate from the AWS console. CreateCase is used to open a case in the Support Center, and is an uncommon behavior which was observed in use by attackers in an attempt to raise the limit for sending phishing emails.

rule ttp_aws_s3_made_public_by_acl {
  meta:
    rule_name = "AWS S3 Bucket Made Public by ACL"
    description = "Detect when an AWS S3 bucket is made public using an Access ControL List (ACL)."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1686.001"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "PutBucketAcl"
    (
      $e.target.user_management_chain.group_identifiers = "http://acs.amazonaws.com/groups/global/AuthenticatedUsers" or
      $e.target.user_management_chain.group_identifiers = "http://acs.amazonaws.com/groups/global/AllUsers"
    )
    any $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    all $e.security_result.action != "BLOCK"
    $user_id = $e.principal.user.userid

  match:
    $user_id over 1h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $user_agents = array_distinct($e.network.http.user_agent)
    $network_org_names = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.organization_name)
    $principal_ips = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $recipient_account_ids = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["recipientAccountId"])
    $principal_users = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $cloud_regions = array_distinct($e.target.location.name)
    $target_resource_names = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: Detect when an AWS S3 bucket is made public using an Access ControL List (ACL).

rule ttp_aws_ses_service_modification {
  meta:
    rule_name = "SES Service Modified for Phishing Campaign"
    description = "Detects when the Amazon Simple Email Service (SES) has been modified in a manner that enables attackers to propagate email phishing campaigns."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0040"
    technique = "T1496"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"
    (
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "CreateEmailIdentity" or
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "DeleteEmailIdentity" or
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "VerifyEmailIdentity" or
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "VerifyDomainIdentity" or
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "VerifyDomainDkim"
    )
    or
    (
      (
        $e.metadata.product_event_type = "UpdateAccountSendingEnabled" or
        $e.metadata.product_event_type = "UpdateConfigurationSetSendingEnabled"
      )
      and $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["enabled"] = "true"
    )
    or
    (

rules.text:
rule ueba_aws_excessive_s3_creations {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Excessive Number of S3 Resources Created"
    description = "Detects excessive (10x the historical maximum value, if the entity has a coefficient of variation < 0.1 and was observed for at least 9 of the last 30 days) resource creations by user id."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0040"
    technique = "T1496"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "RESOURCE_CREATION"
    $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"

    $account_id = $e.additional.fields["recipientAccountId"]
    $user_id = $e.principal.user.userid
    $target_application = $e.target.application

    $e.target.application = "s3.amazonaws.com"

  match:
    $user_id over 24h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $num_times_max = max(10)

    $historical_avg = max(metrics.resource_creation_success(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:avg,
        principal.user.userid:$user_id,
        metadata.vendor_name:"AMAZON",
        metadata.product_name:"AWS CloudTrail"
    ))

    $historical_max = max(metrics.resource_creation_success(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:max,
        principal.user.userid:$user_id,
        metadata.vendor_name:"AMAZON",
        metadata.product_name:"AWS CloudTrail"
    ))

    $historical_observations = max(metrics.resource_creation_success(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:num_metric_periods,
        principal.user.userid:$user_id,
        metadata.vendor_name:"AMAZON",
        metadata.product_name:"AWS CloudTrail"
    ))

    $historical_coefficient_of_variation = max(
      metrics.resource_creation_success(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:stddev,
        principal.user.userid:$user_id,
        metadata.vendor_name:"AMAZON",
        metadata.product_name:"AWS CloudTrail") /
      metrics.resource_creation_success(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:avg,
        principal.user.userid:$user_id,
        metadata.vendor_name:"AMAZON",
        metadata.product_name:"AWS CloudTrail"))
    $observation_threshold = max(9)

    $coefficient_of_variation_threshold = max(1/10)

    $historical_threshold = max(10 * metrics.resource_creation_success(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:max,
        principal.user.userid:$user_id,
        metadata.vendor_name:"AMAZON",
        metadata.product_name:"AWS CloudTrail"))

    $vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"

  condition:
    $e and ($event_count > $historical_threshold) and ($historical_coefficient_of_variation < $coefficient_of_variation_threshold) and ($historical_observations >= $observation_threshold)
}
rules.description: Detects excessive (10x the historical maximum value, if the entity has a coefficient of variation < 0.1 and was observed for at least 9 of the last 30 days) resource creations by user id.

rule ttp_aws_s3_public_access_block_removed {
  meta:
    rule_name = "S3 Bucket Public Access Block Removed"
    description = "Detects when an AWS S3 Public Access Block configuration is removed from a bucket or an account."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1686.001"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"
    (
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "DeleteAccountPublicAccessBlock" or
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "DeleteBucketPublicAccessBlock" or

      /* If neither of the above events happened, look instead for a Put...
      * event, which indicates that a public access block was modified.
      */
      (
        (
          $e.metadata.product_event_type = "PutBucketPublicAccessBlock" or
          $e.metadata.product_event_type = "PutAccountPublicAccessBlock"
        )
        and
        (
          /* If a Put... event was found, also verify that at least one of the
          * following four lables is being set to 'False', which is
          * indicative of a public access block removal.
          */
          $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["req_restrict_public_buckets"] = "false" or
          $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["req_block_public_policy"] = "false" or
          $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["req_block_public_acls"] = "false" or
          $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["req_ignore_public_acls"] = "false"
        )
      )
    )
    $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    $user_id = $e.principal.user.userid

  match:
    $user_id over 1h

  outcome:

    $vendor_name = "AMAZON"

rule ttp_gcp_gke_kubesystem_pod_creation {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Suspicious Pod Creation in kube-system Namespace"
    description = "Detects when a suspicious Pod is created in the kube-system namespace. The kube-system namespace is usually reserved for objects created by the Kubernetes system, and unexpected pod creation should be reviewed."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1610"
    false_positives = "The install of tools/plug-ins (such as kubectl node-shell) may trigger alerts if the install process involves Pod creation in the kube-system namespace."
    reference = "https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/, https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/"

  events:
    $e.security_result.detection_fields["mute"] != "MUTED"
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Cloud Platform"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "Google Kubernetes Engine"
    $e.metadata.log_type = "GCP_CLOUDAUDIT"
    $e.metadata.event_type = "RESOURCE_CREATION"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = /io\.k8s\.core\.v\d+\.pods\.create/
    ($e.principal.namespace = "kube-system" or any $e.security_result.about.namespace = "kube-system")
    any $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    all $e.security_result.action != "BLOCK"
    $cluster = $e.target.resource.name
    $e.principal.user.userid != /^system:node:.+/
    $e.principal.user.userid != "system:cluster-autoscaler"
    $e.principal.user.userid != /^system:serviceaccount:kube-system:.+/
    $e.security_result.description != /RBAC: allowed by ClusterRoleBinding \'system:controller:.+of ClusterRole \'system:controller:.+\' to ServiceAccount \'.+\/kube-system/

  match:
    $cluster over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.product_object_id)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.email_addresses)

    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $target_pod = array_distinct($e.target.resource.attribute.labels["request.metadata.name"])
    $target_project = array_distinct($e.target.cloud.project.name)
    $principal_user_id = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $target_pod_image = array_distinct($e.target.file.full_path)

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: Detects when a suspicious Pod is created in the kube-system namespace. The kube-system namespace is usually reserved for objects created by the Kubernetes system, and unexpected pod creation should be reviewed.

rules.display_name: Suspicious Pod Creation With Attempts to List Secrets
rules.text:
rule ttp_gcp_gke_pod_creation_automounted_serviceaccount {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Suspicious Pod Creation With Attempts to List Secrets"
    description = "Detects when a Pod is created with specs that resemble attempts to use a service account's token to list secrets. Unintentional listing of secrets may lead to privilege escalation, and unexpected pod creation should be reviewed."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0006"
    technique = "T1552.007"
    reference = "https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/overview/working-with-objects/namespaces/, https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/, https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-service-account"

  events:
    $e.security_result.detection_fields["mute"] != "MUTED"
    $e.metadata.event_type = "RESOURCE_CREATION"
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Cloud Platform"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "Google Kubernetes Engine"
    $e.metadata.log_type = "GCP_CLOUDAUDIT"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = /io\.k8s\.core\.v\d+\.pods\.create/
    $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    $cluster = $e.target.resource.name
    $namespace = $e.principal.namespace
    $e.principal.user.userid != /^system:node:/
    $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["req_spec_host_network"] = "true"
    $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["req_spec_automount_service_account_token"] = "true"
    $service_account = strings.coalesce($e.target.resource.attribute.labels["req_spec_service_account_name"], $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["req_spec_serivce_account_name"])
    $service_account != ""
    (
      $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["req_spec_container_0_command_0"] != "" or
      $e.target.resource_ancestors.attribute.labels["req_spec_containers_0_command_0"] != ""
    )
    (
      any $e.target.resource.attribute.labels.value = "/bin/sh" nocase or
      any $e.target.resource_ancestors.attribute.labels.value = "/bin/sh" nocase
    )
    any $e.target.resource_ancestors.attribute.labels.value = /\/secrets\/kubernetes\.io\/serviceaccount\/token/ nocase
    any $e.target.resource_ancestors.attribute.labels.value = /\/api\/v\d+\/namespaces\/.+\/secrets/ nocase

  match:
    $cluster over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(50 +
      if($namespace = "kube-system", 29, 0))
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.product_object_id)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.email_addresses)

    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $cloud_projects = array_distinct($e.target.cloud.project.name)
    $target_pods = array_distinct($e.target.application)
    $principal_user_ids = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $target_pod_images = array_distinct($e.target.file.full_path)
    $mounted_service_accounts = array_distinct($service_account)

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: Detects when a Pod is created with specs that resemble attempts to use a service account's token to list secrets. Unintentional listing of secrets may lead to privilege escalation, and unexpected pod creation should be reviewed.

Certain default RBAC ClusterRoles have associated verbs (bind, escalate, impersonate) which may be abused for privilege escalation. Unexpected ClusterRoleBinding actions should be reviewed."

    technique = "T1548"

    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Cloud Platform"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "Google Kubernetes Engine"

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)

    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

rules.text:
rule ttp_gcp_gke_clusterrole_creation_suspicious_verbs {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Suspicious ClusterRole Creation Attempt with Impersonate, Escalate, or Bind Verb"
    description = "Detects when a suspicious role-based access control (RBAC) ClusterRole creation has been attempted with a verb (bind, escalate, impersonate) that may be abused for privilege escalation. Unexpected ClusterRole creations should be reviewed."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0004"
    technique = "T1548"
    reference = "https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/access-authn-authz/rbac/#privilege-escalation-prevention-and-bootstrapping, https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/security/rbac-good-practices/#privilege-escalation-risks"

  events:
    $e.security_result.detection_fields["mute"] != "MUTED"
    $e.metadata.log_type = "GCP_CLOUDAUDIT"
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Cloud Platform"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "Google Kubernetes Engine"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = /io\.k8s\.authorization\.rbac\.v\d+\.clusterroles\.create/

    $e.principal.user.userid != "system:apiserver"
    $e.principal.user.userid != /^system:serviceaccount:cattle-system:.*/
    $e.principal.user.email_addresses != /^service-\d+@gcp-sa-gkehub\.iam\.gserviceaccount\.com/
    $e.principal.user.email_addresses != /^service-\d+@gcp-sa-autopush-gkehub\.iam\.gserviceaccount\.com/
    $e.principal.user.email_addresses != /^service-\d+@gcp-sa-staging-gkehub\.iam\.gserviceaccount\.com/
    strings.coalesce($e.target.resource.attribute.labels["request_metadata_name"], $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["request.metadata.name"]) != /^gke-connect-impersonation-.*/
    strings.coalesce($e.target.resource.attribute.labels["request_metadata_name"], $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["request.metadata.name"]) != "configconnector-operator-manager-role"
    strings.coalesce($e.target.resource.attribute.labels["request_metadata_name"], $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["request.metadata.name"]) != "crossplane-rbac-manager"
    strings.coalesce($e.target.resource.attribute.labels["request_metadata_name"], $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["request.metadata.name"]) != "teleport-agent"
    strings.coalesce($e.target.resource.attribute.labels["request_metadata_name"], $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["request.metadata.name"]) != "kubeflow-kubernetes-edit"
    strings.coalesce($e.target.resource.attribute.labels["request_metadata_name"], $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["request.metadata.name"]) != "concierge-impersonation-proxy"
    strings.coalesce($e.target.resource.attribute.labels["request_metadata_name"], $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["request.metadata.name"]) != /^open-cluster-management:klusterlet.*/

    (
      any $e.security_result.rule_labels.value = "bind" or
      any $e.security_result.rule_labels.value = "escalate" or
      any $e.security_result.rule_labels.value = "impersonate" or
      any $e.target.resource.attribute.labels.value = "bind" or
      any $e.target.resource.attribute.labels.value = "escalate" or
      any $e.target.resource.attribute.labels.value = "impersonate"
    )
    $cluster = $e.target.resource.name

  match:
    $cluster over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(35 +
      if(
        (any $e.security_result.rule_labels.value = "admin" or any $e.security_result.rule_labels.value = "cluster-admin" or any $e.target.resource.attribute.labels.value = "admin" or any $e.target.resource.attribute.labels.value = "cluster-admin") and
        (any $e.security_result.rule_labels.value = "bind" or any $e.target.resource.attribute.labels.value = "bind") and
        (any $e.security_result.rule_labels.value = "clusterroles" or any $e.target.resource.attribute.labels.value = "clusterroles"),
        14, 0))
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.product_object_id)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.email_addresses)

    $result = "attempted"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $cloud_project = array_distinct($e.target.cloud.project.name)
    $principal_users = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $target_clusterrole = array_distinct($e.target.application)
    $target_clusterrole_rule_labels = array_distinct($e.security_result.rule_labels.value)
    $target_cluster_role_names = array_distinct($e.target.resource.attribute.labels["request.metadata.name"])

  condition:
    $e
}

      $e.security_result.action_details = "SOCIAL_ENGINEERING"
    )
    (
      $e.target.url = /[\/=]((%[0-9A-F]{2}|[^<>'" %])+)+(%40|@)\w/ or
      $e.target.url = /[\/=][a-zA-Z0-9_.\+\-]+@\w/ nocase
    )
    $url_category = strings.coalesce($e.security_result.category_details, $e.extracted.fields["url_category"])
    $url_visited = strings.coalesce($e.target.resource.name ,$e.target.url)
    $user_email = strings.coalesce($e.extracted.fields["profile_user"], $e.principal.user.email_addresses)

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $event_count = 1
    $adversary_name = $e.target.resource.name
    $victim_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $victim_netid = $user_email
    $victim_uid = strings.coalesce($e.principal.asset.asset_id, $e.principal.asset_id, $e.principal.resource.id)
    $hostname = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $is_admin_user = $e.principal.user.attribute.labels["is_admin"]

    $result = array_distinct(if($e.security_result.action_details = "EVENT_RESULT_BYPASSED" or

    $url_visited_category = $url_category
    $url = $url_visited
    $action_details = array_distinct($e.security_result.action_details)

    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

  condition:
    $e
}

    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0010"
    technique = "T1567.002"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Google"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "Chrome Management"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "sensitiveDataEvent"
    $trigger_type = $e.security_result.about.labels["trigger_type"]
    $url_category = $e.target.labels["url_category"]

    $profile_user_domain = re.capture($e.extracted.fields["profile_user"] , `@[a-zA-Z0-9\.]*`)
    $e.extracted.fields["web_app_signed_in_account"] != ""

    $e.target.file.full_path != "Text data" AND
    $webapp_user_domain != $profile_user_domain
    (
      $e.security_result.action_details = "EVENT_RESULT_BYPASSED" or
      $e.security_result.action_details = "EVENT_RESULT_ALLOWED"
    )

  match:
    $webapp_user over 10m

    $risk_score = 35
    $event_count = count($e.metadata.id)

    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.email_addresses)
    $result = array_distinct($e.security_result.action_details)
    $result_time = array_distinct($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $hostname = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.hostname)

    $profile_user = array_distinct($e.extracted.fields["profile_user"])
    $url = array_distinct($e.target.url)
    $url_visited_category = array_distinct($url_category)
    $tab_url = array_distinct($e.extracted.fields["tab_url"])
    $trigger = array_distinct($trigger_type)
    $transfer_method = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["transfer_method"])
    $filename = array_distinct($e.target.file.full_path)
    $sha256_hash = array_distinct($e.target.file.sha256)
    $is_admin_user = array_distinct($e.principal.user.attribute.labels["is_admin"])

  condition:
    $e
}

rules.text:
rule ttp_chrome_gti_high_severity_filedownload_event {
  meta:
    rule_name = "GTI High Severity File Download Event in Chrome Management"
    description = "Detects suspicious or malicious file download events from the Chrome browser with a High severity threat verdict utilizing GTI enrichment. This could indicate that users are downloading malware or other harmful files that bypassed initial security scans."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1204.002"

  events:
    $e.metadata.product_name = "Chrome Management"
    (
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "unscannedFileEvent" or
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "contentTransferEvent" or
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "dangerousDownloadEvent"
    )
    $trigger_type = $e.extracted.fields["trigger_type"]
    $trigger_type = "FILE_DOWNLOAD"
    $e.target.file.security_result.severity = "HIGH"
    $download_url = $e.target.url
    $download_domain = re.capture($e.target.url, `(?:https?:\/\/)(?:www\.)?([-a-zA-Z0-9@:%._\+~#=]{2,256}\.[a-z]{2,6}\b)*(?:\/[\/\d\w\.-]*)*`)
    $url_category = strings.coalesce($e.extracted.fields["url_category"],$e.security_result.category_details)
    $reason = strings.coalesce($e.extracted.fields["reason"], $e.security_result.summary, "")

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 85
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $event_type = $e.metadata.product_event_type
    $event_count = $e.metadata.id
    $adversary_name = $e.target.resource.name
    $victim_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $victim_uid = strings.coalesce($e.principal.asset.asset_id, $e.principal.asset_id, $e.principal.resource.id)
    $result = array_distinct($e.security_result.action_details)
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $hostname = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $is_admin_user = $e.principal.user.attribute.labels["is_admin"]
    $url_visited_category = $url_category
    $file_path = $e.target.file.full_path
    $file_type = $e.target.file.file_type
    $sha256file_hash = $e.target.file.sha256
    $file_size_bytes = $e.target.file.size
    $url = $download_url
    $threat_verdict = $e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict
    $gti_file_severity = $e.target.file.security_result.severity

  condition:
    $e
}

rules.text:
rule high_ioc_eg_target_ip {
  meta:
    rule_name = "ATI High Priority Rule Match for Ip Address IoCs (target.ip)"
    description = "This rule matches indicators of compromise from Google Applied Threat Intelligence."
    severity = "High"
    feed = "gti"

  events:
    $gti.graph.metadata.product_name = "GTI_IOC"
    $gti.graph.metadata.vendor_name = "GTI_IOC"
    $gti.graph.metadata.entity_type = "IP_ADDRESS"
    $gti.graph.metadata.source_type = "GLOBAL_CONTEXT"
    $gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.gti_verdict = 16
    $ioc = $gti.graph.entity.ip
    $ioc = $e.target.ip

    $gti.graph.entity.ip != ""
    $e.target.ip != ""
    $e.metadata.product_name != /RECORDED_FUTURE_IOC/ nocase
    $e.metadata.product_name != /stix/ nocase
    $e.metadata.event_type != "ENTITY_RISK_CHANGE"
    (
      $gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.gti_update_time.seconds <=
      (timestamp.current_seconds() - (7 * 24 * 60 * 60)) OR
      $gti.graph.metadata.collected_timestamp.seconds <=
      (timestamp.current_seconds() - (7 * 24 * 60 * 60)) OR
      $gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.reviewed = true
    )

  match:
    $ioc by 1h

  outcome:
    $active_ir_pwn = max(if($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.active_ir = true, 1, 0))
    $active_ir_confidence_score = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.mandiant_analyst_confidence)
    $global_customer_count = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.global_customer_count)
    $global_hits_count = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.global_hit_count)
    $attributed_malware = max(if(any $gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.attributed_malware.name != "", 1, 0))
    $attributed_actor = max(if(any $gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.attributed_threat_actors.name != "", 1, 0))

rules.display_name: ATI High Priority Rule Match for Ip Address IoCs (target.asset.ip)
rules.text:
rule high_ioc_eg_target_asset_ip {
  meta:
    rule_name = "ATI High Priority Rule Match for Ip Address IoCs (target.asset.ip)"
    description = "This rule matches indicators of compromise from Google Applied Threat Intelligence."
    severity = "High"
    feed = "gti"

  events:
    $gti.graph.metadata.product_name = "GTI_IOC"
    $gti.graph.metadata.vendor_name = "GTI_IOC"
    $gti.graph.metadata.entity_type = "IP_ADDRESS"
    $gti.graph.metadata.source_type = "GLOBAL_CONTEXT"
    $gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.gti_verdict = 16
    $ioc = $gti.graph.entity.ip
    $ioc = $e.target.asset.ip

    $gti.graph.entity.ip != ""
    $e.target.asset.ip != ""
    $e.metadata.product_name != /RECORDED_FUTURE_IOC/ nocase
    $e.metadata.product_name != /stix/ nocase
    $e.metadata.event_type != "ENTITY_RISK_CHANGE"
    (
      $gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.gti_update_time.seconds <=
      (timestamp.current_seconds() - (7 * 24 * 60 * 60)) OR
      $gti.graph.metadata.collected_timestamp.seconds <=
      (timestamp.current_seconds() - (7 * 24 * 60 * 60)) OR
      $gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.reviewed = true
    )
    not ($e.target.ip = $ioc)

  match:
    $ioc by 1h

  outcome:
    $active_ir_pwn = max(if($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.active_ir = true, 1, 0))
    $active_ir_confidence_score = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.mandiant_analyst_confidence)
    $global_customer_count = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.global_customer_count)
    $global_hits_count = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.global_hit_count)
    $attributed_malware = max(if(any $gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.attributed_malware.name != "", 1, 0))
    $attributed_actor = max(if(any $gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.attributed_threat_actors.name != "", 1, 0))
    $pwn_event_time = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $pwn_added_time = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.active_ir_first_tagged_time.seconds)
    $pwn_time_diff = $pwn_event_time - $pwn_added_time
    $exclusive_label = max(if($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.exclusive = true, 1, 0))
    $exclusive_actor = $exclusive_label + $attributed_actor
    $gti_verdict = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.gti_verdict)
    $gti_severity = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.gti_severity)
    $gti_threat_score = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.gti_threat_score)
    $commodity = max(if($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.osint = true, 1, 0))
    $scanner = max(if($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.scanner = true, 1, 0))
    $active_ir = if($active_ir_pwn = 1, 1, 0)
    $high_prevalence = if($global_customer_count >= 3, 1, 0)
    +
    if($global_hits_count > 50000, 1, 0)
    $attributed = if($attributed_malware = 1, 1, 0)
    +
    if($attributed_actor = 1, 1, 0)
    $pwn_old = if($pwn_event_time - $pwn_added_time > 7689600,1,0)
    $exclusive = if($exclusive_actor = 2, 1, 0)
    +
    if($attributed_malware = 1, 1, 0)
    $blocked = max(0 +
      if(any $e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.action = "QUARANTINE", 1, 0)
    )
    $entity_type = array_distinct($gti.graph.metadata.entity_type)
    $event_time = array_distinct($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $log_source = array_distinct($e.metadata.log_type)
    $asset_hostname = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)
    $user_id = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $ioc_value =  array_distinct($ioc)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $risk_score = max(85)
    $priority = if(
      $gti_verdict = 16 AND
      $gti_severity = 16 AND
      $high_prevalence != 2 AND
      (
        $active_ir != 1 OR
        (
          $active_ir = 1 AND
          $pwn_old = 1
        )
      ) AND
      $event_count > 2 AND
      $blocked = 0 AND
      $exclusive >= 1,
      3,
      0
    )

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if(any $e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and any $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if(any $e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e AND $gti AND $priority = 3
}

rule ttp_gcp_ws_suslogin_labelaction {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Removal of Sensitive Google Drive Labels Observed after a Successful Suspicious Login"
    description = "Detects when sensitive label removals happen after a user's login was detected as suspicious."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0040"
    technique = "T1565"

  events:
    $login_event.about.labels["is_suspicious"] = "true"
    $login_event.metadata.product_name = "login"
    $login_event.metadata.product_event_type = "login_success"
    $login_event.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Workspace"

    $ip = $login_event.principal.ip
    $user = $login_event.target.user.userid
    $ip_country = $login_event.principal.location.country_or_region

    $suspicious_event.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Workspace"
    (
      $suspicious_event.metadata.product_name = "drive" and
      $suspicious_event.metadata.product_event_type = "label_removed" and
      (
        $suspicious_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["label_title"] = "Confidential" or
        $suspicious_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["label_title"] = "Restricted" or
        $suspicious_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["label_title"] = "Sensitive" or
        $suspicious_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["label_title"] = "Secret"
      )
    )

    $login_event.target.user.userid = $suspicious_event.principal.user.userid

    $target_resource = $suspicious_event.target.resource.name

  match:
    $user, $ip over 1h after $login_event

  outcome:
    $target_resources = array_distinct($target_resource)
    $doc_types = array_distinct($suspicious_event.src.resource.attribute.labels["doc_type"])
    $ips = array_distinct($ip)
    $ip_countries = array_distinct($ip_country)
    $risk_score = max( 45
      + if($suspicious_event.principal.user.attribute.roles.type = "ADMINISTRATOR",10)
      - if(($suspicious_event.principal.user.attribute.labels["isDelegatedAdmin"] = "true"),2)
    )
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($login_event.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($login_event.metadata.product_name)
    $result = array_distinct(if($login_event.security_result.action="ALLOW", "succeeded", "failed"))
    $result_time = min($login_event.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $login_event and $suspicious_event
}

rule ttp_gcp_customsakey_defaultsa {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Uploaded Custom SA key abuse"
    description = "Detects potential privilege escalation and lateral movement when a user managed key is uploaded to a default service account and misused to manipulate resources."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0004"
    technique = "T1078.004"

  events:
    $uploadedServiceAccountKey = re.capture($e1.target.resource.attribute.labels["res_name"],`keys/([a-f0-9]{40})`)
    (
      $e1.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Cloud Platform" and
      $e1.metadata.product_event_type = "google.iam.admin.v1.UploadServiceAccountKey" and
      (
        $e1.target.resource.name = /[0-9]*-compute@developer\.gserviceaccount\.com/ or
        $e1.target.resource.name = /^[a-z][-a-z0-9]{4,28}[a-z0-9]{1}@appspot\.gserviceaccount\.com/
      )
    )
    $e1.security_result.action = "ALLOW"

    (
      $e2.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Cloud Platform" and
      (
        $e2.metadata.event_type = "RESOURCE_CREATION" or
        $e2.metadata.event_type = "RESOURCE_DELETION" or
        $e2.metadata.event_type = "RESOURCE_PERMISSIONS_CHANGE" or
        $e2.metadata.event_type = "RESOURCE_WRITTEN" or
        $e2.metadata.event_type = "USER_RESOURCE_ACCESS" or
        $e2.metadata.event_type = "USER_RESOURCE_CREATION" or
        $e2.metadata.event_type = "USER_RESOURCE_UPDATE_CONTENT" or
        $e2.metadata.event_type = "USER_RESOURCE_UPDATE_PERMISSIONS"
      ) and

      $e2.security_result.action = "ALLOW" and
      $uploadedServiceAccountKey = $e2.security_result.detection_fields["key_id"]
    )

  match:
    $uploadedServiceAccountKey over 20m //all Post-priv-esc actions that take place over 20 mins using the uploaded SA key

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(35)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.product_name)

    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e1.target.resource.product_object_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e1.target.resource.name)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e1.principal.user.product_object_id)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e1.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e1.principal.user.email_addresses)

    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $e1_email_address = array_distinct($e1.principal.user.email_addresses)
    $e2_email_address = array_distinct($e2.principal.user.email_addresses)
    $e1_resource_name = array_distinct($e1.target.resource.name)
    $e2_resource_name = array_distinct($e2.target.resource.name)
    $e1_ip = array_distinct($e2.principal.ip)
    $e2_ip = array_distinct($e2.principal.ip)

  condition:
    $e1 and $e2
}

rule ttp_gcp_signjwt_abuse {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Access Token Generation with signJWT"
    description = "Detects access token generation by abusing the signJwt permission specifically when used across two different service accounts."
    severity = "Info"
    tactic = "TA0006"
    technique = "T1528"
    false_positives = "Some Okta integrations with GCP may use this feature."

  events:
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "SignJwt"
    $e.principal.user.userid != /workloadIdentityPools/ nocase
    $compromised_sa = $e.principal.user.userid
    $e.target.resource.name = $targeted_sa
    (
      $compromised_sa != /admin@my-demo-project/ and
      $targeted_sa != /prod-service-account@my-demo-project/
    )
    $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    $e.target.resource.name != /secrets-accessor/
    $e.target.resource.name != /comms-operator/
    $e.target.resource.name != $compromised_sa
  outcome:
    $risk_score = 10
    $vendor_name = array($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = 1

    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.product_object_id)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.email_addresses)

    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

    $different_account = max(if(($compromised_sa = $targeted_sa),0,1)) //targeting a second account and not signing JWT from the same account
    $email_address = array_distinct($e.principal.user.email_addresses)
    $resource_name = $e.target.resource.name
    $ip = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)

  condition:
    $e and $different_account=1
}

rule ioc_cryptomining_domain_communication {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Cryptomining Domain Communication"
    description = "Detects network communication to known Cryptomining domains."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0040"
    technique = "T1496"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_DNS"
    $e.network.dns.questions.name = /^([a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*\.)+[a-z]{2,}$/
    $e.network.dns.questions.name != ""

    $suspected_domain = $e.network.dns.questions.name

    $gcti.graph.metadata.entity_type = "DOMAIN_NAME"
    $gcti.graph.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Cloud Threat Intelligence"
    $gcti.graph.metadata.product_name = "GCTI Feed"
    $gcti.graph.metadata.threat.threat_feed_name = "CryptominingDomains"
    $gcti.graph.entity.domain.name = $suspected_domain

  match:
    $suspected_domain by 1h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(85)
    $severity = "High"
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $target_hostname = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)
    $target_ip = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $user = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($suspected_domain)
    $matched_ioc = array_distinct($suspected_domain)
    $ioc_type = "Cryptomining Domain"
    $ioc_source = "GCTI Feed"
    $mitre_attack_tactic = "Impact"
    $mitre_attack_tactic_id = "TA0040"
    $mitre_attack_technique_id = "T1496" // Resource Hijacking

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if(any $e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and any $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if(any $e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e and $gcti and $result != "failed"
}

rule ttp_vendor_wiz_severity_critical {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Wiz: Critical Severity Alert"
    description = "Surfacing Critical severity vendor alerts from Wiz"
    severity = "Critical"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "WIZ_IO"
    $e.security_result.severity = "CRITICAL"
    ($e.metadata.product_event_type = "DETECTIONS" or $e.additional.fields["trigger_source"] = "DETECTIONS")
    $entity_name = strings.coalesce(
      $e.principal.hostname,
      $e.principal.asset.hostname,
      re.capture($e.principal.asset_id, ":(.*)"),
      re.capture($e.principal.asset.asset_id, ":(.*)"),
      $e.principal.ip,
      $e.principal.asset.ip,
      $e.principal.user.user_display_name,
      $e.principal.user.userid,
      $e.principal.user.email_addresses,
      $e.target.hostname,
      $e.target.asset.hostname,
      re.capture($e.target.asset_id, ":(.*)"),
      re.capture($e.target.asset.asset_id, ":(.*)"),
      $e.target.ip,
      $e.target.asset.ip,
      $e.target.user.user_display_name,
      $e.target.user.userid,
      $e.target.user.email_addresses
    )

    $entity_name != ""

    $threat_name = strings.coalesce(
      $e.security_result.threat_name,
      $e.security_result.rule_name,
      $e.security_result.summary,
      $e.security_result.category_details,
      $e.metadata.description,
      $e.metadata.product_event_type
    )

    $threat_name != ""

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 95
    $vendor_name = "Wiz"
    $product_name = ""
    $log_source = array_distinct($e.metadata.log_type)
    $parser_type = array_distinct($e.metadata.parser_version)

rule ttp_aws_cognito_enumeration {
  meta:
    rule_name = "AWS Cognito Enumeration"
    description = "Observed 7 or more distinct events associated with enumeration of AWS cognito across 5 or more regions in a 1 hour period."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0007"
    technique = "T1580"
    false_positives = "Security tools and infrastructure management tools that enumerate environments may trigger false positives."

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"
    (
      $e.target.application = "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com" or
      $e.target.application = "cognito-idp.amazonaws.com"
    )
    $principal_user = $e.principal.user.userid
    (
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = /^List(IdentityPools|UserPools|ResourceServers|UserPoolClients)$/ or
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = /^Describe(UserPool|UserPoolClient)$/ or
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = /^Get(PrincipalTagAttributeMap|IdentityPoolRoles)$/
    )

  match:
    $principal_user over 1h

  outcome:
    $region_count = count_distinct($e.target.location.name)
    $product_event_type_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.product_event_type)
    $risk_score = 35
    $vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"
    $network_asns = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.asn)
    $network_domains = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.dns_domain)
    $network_carriers = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.carrier_name)
    $product_event_types = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_event_type)
    $user_agents = array_distinct($e.network.http.user_agent)
    $principal_users = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $recipient_account_ids = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["recipientAccountId"])
    $cloud_regions = array_distinct($e.target.location.name)
    $network_org_names = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.organization_name)
    $target_resource_names = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)
    $access_key_id = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["accessKeyId"])

  condition:
    $e and $product_event_type_count >= 7 and $region_count >= 5
}

rules.text:
rule ttp_aws_auth_successful_login_after_multiple_failed_attempts {
  meta:
    rule_name = "AWS Successful Login After Multiple Failed Attempts"
    description = "This rule detects a successful login after more than 10 failed console login attempts from a single IP address within an hour. This could indicate a successful brute force attack."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0006"
    technique = "T1110.004"

  events:
    $fail.metadata.vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $fail.metadata.product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"
    $fail.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $fail.metadata.product_event_type = "ConsoleLogin"
    $fail.security_result.action = "BLOCK"

    $success.metadata.vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $success.metadata.product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"
    $success.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $success.metadata.product_event_type = "ConsoleLogin"
    $success.security_result.action = "ALLOW"

    $success_ip = $success.principal.ip
    $fail_ip = $fail.principal.ip
    $success_ip = $fail_ip

  match:
    $success_ip over 1h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(
      65+
      if($success.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region = "Cuba", 20) +
      if($success.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region = "Iran", 20) +
      if($success.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region = "North Korea" , 20) +
      if($success.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region = "Russia", 20) +
      if($success.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region = "Syria", 20)
    )
    $event_count = count_distinct($fail.metadata.id)
    $user_agents = array_distinct($fail.network.http.user_agent)
    $recipient_account_ids = array_distinct($success.additional.fields["recipientAccountId"])
    $network_org_names = array_distinct($fail.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.organization_name)
    $vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"
    $principal_ips = array_distinct($fail.principal.ip)
    $principal_users = array_distinct($success.principal.user.attribute.labels["session_issuer_user_name"])
    $cloud_regions = array_distinct($fail.target.location.name)
    $target_resource_names = array_distinct($fail.principal.resource.name)

    $result_time = min($success.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $result = "succeeded"

  condition:
    #fail > 10 and $success
}
rules.description: This rule detects a successful login after more than 10 failed console login attempts from a single IP address within an hour. This could indicate a successful brute force attack.

rules.text:
rule ttp_aws_service_quota_discovery_longterm_access_key {
  meta:
    rule_name = "AWS Service Quota Discovery by Long-term Access Key"
    description = "Detects an EC2 service quota discovery command by a long-term AWS access key (i.e., AKIA****). Access keys beginning with AKIA are long-term credentials for IAM users that do not have a set lifespan, which makes them valuable targets for credential access. Threat actors collect information on EC2 service quota as a precursor to running compute instances for cryptocurrency mining."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0007"
    technique = "T1580"
    reference = "https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/javaghost-cloud-phishing/"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "AWS_CLOUDTRAIL" nocase and
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = /(GetServiceQuotas|GetSendQuota|^GetAccount$)/ nocase and
    $e.target.application = /(servicequotas|^ses.)/ nocase
    $e.additional.fields["accessKeyId"] = /^AKIA/
    $principal_userid  = $e.principal.user.userid

  match:
    $principal_userid over 15m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.windows_sid)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

    $base_risk_score = .40 * 100
    $user_agent_risk_score = max(
      if( //Increase risk score if user agent is associated with an automated routine such as scripting language client
        $e.network.http.user_agent = /(python|curl|go-|wget|selenium|aiohttp|Headless)/ nocase,
        .25,
        0
      ) +
      if( //Increase risk score if user agent is associated with an offensive security tool like Kali
        $e.network.http.user_agent = /(kali|scoutsuite|trufflehog|autodiscoverclient|microburst|AADinternals|Stormspotter|ROADtools|Steam-pipe|Monkey365|GraphRunner|SkyArk|Cloudsploit|MFASweep|CloudBrute|CloudEnum|gstrike|gcp_scanner|PurplePanda|Gcphound|Forsetisecurity|gcp_enum|BucketLoot|Trivy|Pacu|awspx|Slyther|Invictus-|Cloudfox|Prowler)/ nocase,
        .50,
        0
      ) +
      if( //Increase risk score if user agent is associated with a command line tool
        $e.network.http.user_agent = /(aws-cli)/ nocase,
        .25,
        0
      )
    ) * 100
    $action_allowed_risk_score = max(
      if( //Increase risk score if the action was performed successfully
        $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW",
        .10,
        0
      )
    ) * 100
    $longterm_credential_risk_score = max(
      if( //Increase risk score //depot/google3/googlex/security/uppercase/analysis/pipeline/lint_exceptions.textprotoif the action was performed by a long term access key
        $e.additional.fields["accessKeyId"] = /^AKIA/,
        .10,
        0
      )
    ) * 100
    $mfa_authenticated_risk_score = max(
      if( //Increase risk score if the action was performed while the user was not authenticated via MFA
        $e.principal.user.attribute.labels["mfaAuthenticated"] = "false",
        .10,
        0
      )
    ) * 100
    $mitre_technique = "T1087.004"
    $mitre_tactic = "Discovery"
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $temp_risk_score = $action_allowed_risk_score + $user_agent_risk_score + $longterm_credential_risk_score + $mfa_authenticated_risk_score + $base_risk_score
    $producer_risk_score = if(
      $temp_risk_score > 100,
      100,
      $temp_risk_score
    )
  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: Detects an EC2 service quota discovery command by a long-term AWS access key (i.e., AKIA****). Access keys beginning with AKIA are long-term credentials for IAM users that do not have a set lifespan, which makes them valuable targets for credential access. Threat actors collect information on EC2 service quota as a precursor to running compute instances for cryptocurrency mining.

rules.text:
rule ttp_aws_iam_access_key_created_for_root_or_other_user {
  meta:
    rule_name = "AWS Access Key Created for Root or Other User"
    description = "This rule detects when an AWS user creates access keys for another user or the root user. "
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1078.004"
    false_positives = "A System administrator may create access keys for another user for maintanance, troubleshooting, or deployment."

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "CreateAccessKey"
    $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    $actor = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $target = $e.target.user.user_display_name
    $principal_type = $e.principal.user.attribute.roles.name
    (
      (
        $principal_type = "IAMUser" and
        $actor != $target
      ) or
      (
        $principal_type = "Root" and
        $actor = $target
      )
    )

  match:
    $actor, $target over 1h

  outcome:
    $risk_score =  max(
      35+
      if((
          $principal_type = "Root" and
          $actor = $target ), 50)
    )
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $user_agents = array_distinct($e.network.http.user_agent)
    $principal_ips = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $network_org_names = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.organization_name)
    $recipient_account_ids = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["recipientAccountId"])
    $cloud_regions = array_distinct($e.target.location.name)
    $target_name = array_distinct($e.target.user.user_display_name)
    $vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"
    $principal_users = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $principal_resource_names = array_distinct($e.principal.resource.name)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_aws_iam_privilege_escalation_using_iam_login_profile {
  meta:
    rule_name = "User has modified or created a profile and then logged in from same IP."
    description = "This security alert triggers when an AWS user modifies or creates a profile and subsequently logs in from the same IP address. The alert is designed to flag potentially suspicious activity related to user profiles within the AWS environment."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0004"
    technique = "T1098.001"

  events:
    $profile.metadata.vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $profile.metadata.product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"
    $profile.metadata.product_event_type = "CreateLoginProfile" or $profile.metadata.product_event_type = "UpdateLoginProfile"
    $profile.security_result.action= "ALLOW"
    $profile.principal.user.userid = $p_userid
    $profile.target.user.userid = $t_userid

    $login.metadata.vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $login.metadata.product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"
    $login.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $login.metadata.product_event_type = "ConsoleLogin"
    $login.security_result.action= "ALLOW"
    $login.principal.ip = $profile.principal.ip
    $profile.principal.user.user_display_name != $profile.target.user.user_display_name
    $login.principal.user.attribute.labels["session_issuer_user_name"] = $profile.target.user.userid

    $profile.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds < $login.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

  match:
    $p_userid over 1h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(35)
    $event_count = count_distinct($login.metadata.id)
    $network_http_user_agent = array_distinct($login.network.http.user_agent)
    $principal_ip = array_distinct($login.principal.ip)
    $principal_ip_country = array_distinct($login.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region)
    $principal_ip_state = array_distinct($login.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.state)
    $principal_user_display_name = array_distinct($login.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $dc_principal_user_display_name = count_distinct($login.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $is_mfa_used = array_distinct($login.principal.user.attribute.labels["mfaAuthenticated"])
    $target_resource_name = array_distinct($login.target.resource.name)
    $target_resource_product_object_id = array_distinct($login.target.resource.product_object_id)

    $vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"
    $result_time = min($login.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(if($login.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $login.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2))
    $tmp2 = max(if($login.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $profile and $login
}

    description = "This rule detects if there are more than 10 failed console login attempts from a single IP address within an hour. This could be a sign of brute force attacks, where attackers are trying to guess user passwords."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0006"
    technique = "T1110.004"

    $e.metadata.product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"

    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "ConsoleLogin"
    $e.security_result.action = "BLOCK"
    $ip = $e.principal.ip

  match:
    $ip over 1h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(
      35+
      if($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region = "Cuba", 40) +
      if($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region = "Iran", 40) +
      if($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region = "North Korea" , 40) +
      if($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region = "Russia", 40) +
      if($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region = "Syria", 40)
    )
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $user_agents = array_distinct($e.network.http.user_agent)
    $recipient_account_ids = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["recipientAccountId"])
    $security_result_descriptions = array_distinct($e.security_result.description)

    $cloud_regions = array_distinct($e.target.location.name)
    $target_resource_names = array_distinct($e.principal.resource.name)

  condition:
    #e > 10
}

rule ttp_aws_iam_username_suspicious {
  meta:
    rule_name = "AWS IAM Suspicious Username"
    description = "Detects console logins from an IAM username matching patterns (/^aws_dev[0-9]+/ OR /^aws-cli[A-ZA-z]+/) that have been seen in recent AWS compromises."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0042"
    technique = "T1585"
    false_positives = "User intentionally set username."
    reference = "https://securitylabs.datadoghq.com/articles/tales-from-the-cloud-trenches-ecs-crypto-mining/#first-observed-attacker-activity-data-exfiltration-from-s3-and-attempted-lateral-movement-through-ec2-instance-connect"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "ConsoleLogin"
    $e.target.application = "signin.amazonaws.com"
    $e.principal.resource.type = "IAMUser"
    re.regex($e.principal.resource.name, /^aws_dev[0-9]+/) or re.regex($e.principal.resource.name, /^aws-cli[A-ZA-z]+/)
    $eventType = $e.metadata.product_event_type
    $resource = $e.principal.resource.name

  match:
    $resource over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"
    $users = array_distinct($resource)
    $useragents = array_distinct($e.network.http.user_agent)
    $ips = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_aws_iam_access_key_multiple_asn {
  meta:
    rule_name = "AWS Access Key Used by Multiple ASNs"
    description = "The userIdentity.accessKeyId identifies the key used by a request. Seeing a key used in multiple ASNs may indicate that a session token was compromised and used in another location."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0006"
    technique = "T1552"
    false_positives = "Legitimate users that access multiple networks such as home and office using the same access key."

    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"
    $event_name = $e.metadata.product_event_type
    $event_name != /ConsoleLogin|GetSigninToken|AdminInitiateAuth|GetConnection|StartSession|AssumeRole/ // Seems to be common FP
    $e.target.application != /s3.amazonaws.com|iot.amazonaws.com/ // Some weird S3 usage allowing get/puts from everywhere. IoT also
    $access_key = $e.additional.fields["accessKeyId"]
    $access_key != ""
    $network_dns_domain = $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.dns_domain
    $network_dns_domain != ""
    $network_asn = $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.asn
    $network_asn != ""
    $e.network.http.user_agent != /amazon-ssm-agent|HashiCorp/

  match:
    $access_key over 24h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"
    $network_asns = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.asn)
    $network_domains = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.dns_domain)

    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

rule ttp_gcp_dnstun_cname {
  meta:
    rule_name = "DNS Tunneling Using CNAME"
    description = "Detects DNS tunneling using CNAME DNS queries."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1071.004"
    false_positives = "CNAME is a common query type, but it is unusual to see CNAME queries in large quantities."
    reference = "https://unit42.paloaltonetworks.com/dns-tunneling-how-dns-can-be-abused-by-malicious-actors/"

  events:
    $e.security_result.detection_fields["mute"] != "MUTED"
    $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_DNS"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "Google Cloud DNS"  // restrict rule to GCP DNS
    $e.network.application_protocol = "DNS"
    $e.network.dns.questions.type = 5  // CNAME==5
    $resource = $e.principal.resource.name
    $questions = $e.network.dns.questions.name
    $e.network.dns.questions.name != /\.internal\.?$/
    $e.network.dns.answers.name != strings.concat($e.network.dns.questions.name, ".")

  match:
    $resource over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.resource.id)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.resource.name)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)

    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $email_address = array_distinct($e.principal.user.email_addresses)
    $ip = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)

  condition:
    #e >= 50 and #questions >= 50
}

rule ttp_cloud_node_access_removal {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Cloud Node Access Removal or Logout"
    description = "Detects the removal, deletion, or logout of a cloud node or host session, which may indicate an adversary removing access to evade detection."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1531"

  events:
    (
      (
        $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN" and
        $e.security_result.action_details = "LOGOUT"
      ) or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_DELETION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "RESOURCE_DELETION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_UNCATEGORIZED"
    ) and

    (
      re.regex($e.principal.hostname, `.*-Host.*`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.hostname, `.*\.ts\.net.*`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.resource.type, `.*node.*`) nocase
    )

    $risk_score = 35
    $victim_uids = array_distinct($e.target.resource.product_object_id)
    $victim_names = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)
    $adversary_netids = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $target_applications = array_distinct($e.target.application)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name

    $security_result_action_details = array_distinct($e.security_result.action_details)
    $target_resource_type = if($e.target.resource.type != "", $e.target.resource.type, "")
    $target_user_userid = if($e.target.user.userid != "", $e.target.user.userid, "")
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result_time = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2, 0))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1, 0))

  condition:
    $e
}
