rules.text:
rule ttp_gcp_workspace_mfa_spam_followed_by_device_or_passkey_enrollment {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Google Workspace Device or Passkey Enrollment Following MFA Fatigue"
    description = "Detects when a new passkey, 2-Step Verification factor, or device is registered in Google Workspace shortly after repeated MFA challenges or login failures for the same user, indicating post-compromise persistence."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1098.005"

  events:
    $e1.metadata.log_type = "WORKSPACE_ACTIVITY"
    $e1.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Workspace"
    $e1.metadata.product_name = "login"
    $e1.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $e1.security_result.detection_fields["login_type"] = "reauth"
    $e1.security_result.detection_fields["login_challenge_method"] = /passkey/ nocase
    (
      (
        $e1.metadata.product_event_type = "login_challenge" and
        $e1.additional.fields["login_challenge_status"] = "error"
      ) or
      $e1.metadata.product_event_type = "login_failure" or
      $e1.metadata.product_event_type = "risky_sensitive_action_blocked"
    )
    $e2.metadata.log_type = "WORKSPACE_ACTIVITY"
    $e2.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Workspace"
    $e2.security_result.action != "BLOCK"
    $e2.security_result.action != "FAIL"
    (
      $e2.metadata.product_event_type = "passkey_enrolled" or
      (
        $e2.metadata.product_event_type = "DEVICE_REGISTER_UNREGISTER_EVENT" and
        $e2.target.resource.attribute.labels["account_state"] = "REGISTERED"
      ) or
      $e2.metadata.product_event_type = "2sv_enroll" or
      $e2.metadata.product_event_type = "titanium_enroll" or
      $e2.metadata.product_event_type = "SECURITY_KEY_REGISTERED_FOR_USER"
    )
    $user = strings.coalesce($e1.target.user.userid, $e1.target.user.product_object_id)
    $user = strings.coalesce($e2.principal.user.userid, $e2.principal.user.product_object_id)
    $user != ""
    $e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds <= $e2.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

  match:
    $user over 30m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e2.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e2.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct(strings.coalesce($e2.principal.user.product_object_id, $e1.target.user.product_object_id))
    $victim_name = array_distinct($user)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e2.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct(strings.coalesce($e2.principal.user.userid, $e1.target.user.userid))
    $adversary_name = array_distinct(strings.coalesce($e2.principal.user.user_display_name, $e1.target.user.user_display_name))
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e2.principal.ip)
    $mfa_challenge_count = count_distinct($e1.metadata.id)
    $mfa_challenge_types = array_distinct($e1.metadata.product_event_type)
    $mfa_challenge_methods = array_distinct($e1.security_result.detection_fields["login_challenge_method"])
    $enrollment_event_types = array_distinct($e2.metadata.product_event_type)
    $enrollment_ips = array_distinct($e2.principal.ip)
    $enrollment_countries = array_distinct($e2.principal.location.country_or_region)
    $enrollment_asns = array_distinct($e2.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.asn)
    $enrollment_orgs = array_distinct($e2.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.organization_name)
    $tmp1 = max(if($e2.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e2.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e2.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $result_time = min($e2.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e2.metadata.id)
    $principal_hostname = array_distinct($e2.principal.hostname)
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $asset_is_server = max(if($e2.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0))

  condition:
    $e1 and $e2 and $mfa_challenge_count >= 5
}

rule ttp_gcp_google_workspace_external_drive_share {

    tactic = "TA0010"
    technique = "T1567.002"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "WORKSPACE_ACTIVITY"
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Workspace"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "drive"
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_RESOURCE_UPDATE_PERMISSIONS" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_CHANGE_PERMISSIONS"
    )
    (
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "change_document_visibility" or
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "change_document_access_scope"
    )
    $e.security_result.action != "BLOCK"
    $e.security_result.action != "FAIL"
    $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["new_value"] != "none"

      $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["visibility"] = "people_with_link" or

    (
      $e.target.user.email_addresses = /@(?:gmail|yahoo|ymail|hotmail|outlook|live|msn|aol|icloud|me|protonmail|proton|zoho|gmx|mail)\.com$|@proton\.me$/ nocase or
      $e.network.email.to = /@(?:gmail|yahoo|ymail|hotmail|outlook|live|msn|aol|icloud|me|protonmail|proton|zoho|gmx|mail)\.com$|@proton\.me$/ nocase
    )

    $user = $e.principal.user.userid
    $doc_id = strings.coalesce($e.target.resource.product_object_id, $e.target.resource.name)

  match:
    $user over 15m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)

    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.product_object_id)

    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)

    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $dc_shared_files = count_distinct($doc_id)
    $shared_file_names = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)
    $shared_doc_ids = array_distinct($e.target.resource.product_object_id)
    $target_user_email_addresses = array_distinct(strings.coalesce($e.target.user.email_addresses, $e.network.email.to))
    $target_domains = array_distinct($e.target.domain.name)
    $visibilities = array_distinct($e.target.resource.attribute.labels["visibility"])
    $visibility_changes = array_distinct($e.target.resource.attribute.labels["visibility_change"])
    $new_permission_values = array_distinct($e.target.resource.attribute.labels["new_value"])
    $metadata_product_event_types = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_event_type)
    $tmp1 = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2, 0))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1, 0))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $principal_hostname = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $asset_is_server = max(if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0))

  condition:
    $e and $dc_shared_files >= 1
}

rule ttp_gcp_workspace_successful_mfa_fatigue_attack {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Google Workspace Successful MFA Fatigue Attack"
    description = "Detects multiple failed passkey reauthentication attempts or passkey challenge errors (login_challenge, login_failure, or risky_sensitive_action_blocked) for a single user within a short timeframe, followed closely by a successful authentication from the same IP address. This indicates a potential MFA fatigue attack."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0006"
    technique = "T1621"

  events:
    $e1.metadata.log_type = "WORKSPACE_ACTIVITY"
    $e1.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Workspace"
    $e1.metadata.product_name = "login"
    $e1.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $e1.security_result.detection_fields["login_type"] = "reauth"
    $e1.security_result.detection_fields["login_challenge_method"] = /passkey/ nocase
    (
      (
        $e1.metadata.product_event_type = "login_challenge" and
        $e1.additional.fields["login_challenge_status"] = "error"
      ) or
      $e1.metadata.product_event_type = "login_failure" or
      $e1.metadata.product_event_type = "risky_sensitive_action_blocked"
    )
    $e2.metadata.log_type = "WORKSPACE_ACTIVITY"
    $e2.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Workspace"
    $e2.metadata.product_name = "login"
    $e2.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    (
      $e2.metadata.product_event_type = "login_success" or
      $e2.metadata.product_event_type = "risky_sensitive_action_allowed"
    )
    $e2.security_result.action = "ALLOW"

    $targetUserProductObjectId = $e1.target.user.product_object_id
    $targetUserProductObjectId = $e2.target.user.product_object_id
    $principal_ip = $e1.principal.ip
    $principal_ip = $e2.principal.ip
    $e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds <= $e2.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

  match:
    $targetUserProductObjectId, $principal_ip over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e2.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e2.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e2.target.user.product_object_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct(strings.coalesce($e2.target.user.userid, $e1.target.user.email_addresses, $e1.target.user.product_object_id))
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e2.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e1.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e1.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e1.principal.ip)
    $tmp1 = max(if($e2.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e2.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e1.security_result.action = "BLOCK" or $e1.security_result.action = "FAIL", 1))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $result_time = min($e2.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e1.metadata.id)
    $principal_hostname = array_distinct($e1.principal.hostname)
    $rule_category = "methodology"

    $failed_or_challenge_count = count_distinct($e1.metadata.id)
    $failed_or_challenge_threshold = 5
    $challenge_methods = array_distinct($e1.security_result.detection_fields["login_challenge_method"])
    $challenge_statuses = array_distinct($e1.additional.fields["login_challenge_status"])
    $sensitive_actions = array_distinct($e1.security_result.action_details)

    $asset_is_server = max(if($e1.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0))

  condition:
    $e1 and $e2 and $failed_or_challenge_count >= 5
}
rules.description: Detects multiple failed passkey reauthentication attempts or passkey challenge errors (login_challenge, login_failure, or risky_sensitive_action_blocked) for a single user within a short timeframe, followed closely by a successful authentication from the same IP address. This indicates a potential MFA fatigue attack.

rule tst_linux_failed_su_login {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Linux Failed su/sudo Auth Attempt Test"
    description = "Detects a su or sudo authentication failure attempt to verify logging is properly functioning."
    severity = "Info"

  events:
    ($e.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN" or $e.metadata.event_type = "STATUS_UPDATE")

rule ttp_gcp_scc_cloud_armor_increasing_deny_ratio_critical {
  meta:
    rule_name = "SCC: Cloud Armor: Critical - Increasing Deny Ratio"
    description = "Detects an increase in the ratio of traffic that Google Cloud Armor blocks because of a user-configured rule in a security policy. Although the denial is expected and does not affect the backend service, this finding helps alert you to increases in unwanted and potentially malicious traffic targeting your applications."
    severity = "Critical"
    tactic = "TA0040"
    reference = "https://cloud.google.com/security-command-center/docs/how-to-investigate-threats, https://cloud.google.com/armor/docs/cscc-findings"

  events:
    $e.security_result.detection_fields["mute"] != "MUTED"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "Security Command Center"
    $e.metadata.description = "Cloud Armor"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "Increasing Deny Ratio"
    any $e.security_result.severity = "CRITICAL"

    $resource_name = $e.target.resource.name
    $rule_name = $e.metadata.product_event_type

  match:
    $rule_name over 1h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 95
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

    $severity = array_distinct($e.security_result.severity)
    $scc_product = array_distinct($e.metadata.description)
    $threat_category = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_event_type)
    $resource_names = array_distinct($resource_name)
    $cloud_projects = array_distinct(if($e.target.resource_ancestors.resource_type = "CLOUD_PROJECT",$e.target.resource_ancestors.name, ""))
    $url_back_to_product = array_distinct($e.security_result.url_back_to_product)
    $next_steps = array_distinct($e.security_result.outcomes["nextSteps"])
    $result = array_distinct(if($e.security_result.action="ALLOW", "succeeded", "failed"))
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_gcp_firewall_highpriorityblock {
  meta:
    rule_name = "VPC Firewall High Priority Block"
    description = "Alerts when a VPC firewall rule is added at priority 0 (the highest) which blocks all traffic on all ports and protocols, ingress or egress."
    severity = "Info"
    tactic = "TA0040"
    technique = "T1489"
    false_positives = "Denying all traffic via firewall rules is not necessarily malicious, but could be used to disrupt operations."

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "RESOURCE_CREATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "RESOURCE_WRITTEN"
    )
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = /compute\.firewalls\.(insert|patch)/
    $e.target.application = "compute.googleapis.com"

    (
      (
        $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["destination_ranges"] = /^(0\.0\.0\.0|::)\/0$/ or
        $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["source_ranges"]      = /^(0\.0\.0\.0|::)\/0$/
      ) or
      (
        $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["req_destination_ranges"] = /^(0\.0\.0\.0|::)\/0$/ or
        $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["req_source_ranges"]      = /^(0\.0\.0\.0|::)\/0$/
      )
    )
    $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["Denied_Protocol"] = "all"
    $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["response_operation_type"] = /patch|insert/
    $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["Request_Priority"] = "0"
    $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW"

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 10
    $vendor_name = array($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = 1

    $victim_name = array($e.target.resource.name)
    $adversary_uid = array($e.principal.user.product_object_id)
    $adversary_name = array($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.email_addresses)

    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $email_address = array_distinct($e.principal.user.email_addresses)
    $resource_name = $e.target.resource.name
    $ip = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule c_cloud_cloud_accounts_and_t1651 {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Cloud Account Compromise and Cloud Administration Command Execution"
    description = "Detects suspicious Cloud Account activity (T1078.004) combined with Cloud Administration Command execution (T1651) by the same identity within 2 hours across cloud environments."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1651"

  events:
    $c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"] = /T1078\.004|T1651/

    $c1.detection.detection.rule_name = /./
    $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.userid != ""

    $producer_severity = $c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["severity"]
    $rule_category = $c1.detection.detection.outcomes["rule_category"]
    $event_type = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.event_type
    $principal_users_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.userid
    $target_actors_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.userid
    $principal_ip_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.ip
    $target_resource_name_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.resource.name

    $user_match = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.userid

  match:
    $user_match over 2h

  outcome:
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.product_name)
    $rule_names = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_name)
    $rule_name_count = count_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_name)
    $rule_set_category_names = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name)
    $rule_set_display_names = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_set_display_name)

    $principal_users = array_distinct($principal_users_src)
    $target_actors = array_distinct($target_actors_src)
    $principal_ips = array_distinct($principal_ip_src)
    $target_resources = array_distinct($target_resource_name_src)
    $principal_hostnames = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.hostname)

    $unique_mitre_technique_count = count_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"])
    $unique_mitre_tactic_count = count_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"])
    $mitre_tactics = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"])
    $mitre_techniques = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"])

    $unique_event_types = array_distinct($event_type)
    $unique_event_type_count = arrays.size($unique_event_types)
    $result_time = min($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.id)

    $detection_rule_ids = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_id)
    $detection_contains_ati = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Applied Threat Intelligence - Curated Prioritization/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_ueba = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Risk Analytics for UEBA/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_3p = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_names, "|"), /(Entra ID Protection|Defender for Cloud|SCC:|AWS GuardDuty)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_customer_live_rule = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($detection_rule_ids, "|"), /ru_/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_hunting_rule_pack = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Mandiant Hunting Rules/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_methodology_curated_detection = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Cloud Threats/) nocase, 1, 0)

    $detection_contains_privileged_account = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string(arrays.concat($principal_users, $target_actors), "|"), /\b(admin|root|owner|superadmin|serviceaccount)\b/) nocase, 1, 0)

    $risk_score_calculated = 25 +
    ($detection_contains_privileged_account * 40) +
    (count_distinct($target_resource_name_src) * 5)

    $risk_score = if($risk_score_calculated > 100, 100, $risk_score_calculated)
    $result = "succeeded"

    $victim_uid = $principal_users
    $victim_name = $principal_users
    $upstream_detection_ids = array_distinct($c1.detection.id)

  condition:
    $c1 and $unique_mitre_technique_count >= 2 and arrays.contains($mitre_techniques, "T1078.004") and arrays.contains($mitre_techniques, "T1651")
}

      not $c.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.userid = /\/vega-vdev-nodegroup-role\/|\/AWSReservedSSO_AI_Hub_|\/build360-prod-FargateTaskExecutionRole\/|\/ecsTaskExecutionRole\/|\/crypto-lambda-role-skmu3at9|\/secrets-store-csi-driver-provider-aws|-ecs-task-app-role\/|-rfq-alerts-importer-|lambda-role-ingest-mandiant-asm\/ingest-mandiant-asm|\/secrets-store-csi-driver-provider-aws|assumed\-role\/POC\-SFTP\-LambdaExecutionRole\-|assumed\-role\/sftp\-lambda\-execution\-role\-testing|sftp\-lambda\-execution\-role\-password\-auth\-prod\/get\-user\-config\-password\-auth\-prod/ nocase
    )

    $victim_product_object_id = $c.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.product_object_id
    $victim_userid = strings.to_lower($c.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.userid)
    $victim_email = strings.to_lower($c.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.email_addresses)
    $victim_ip = strings.to_lower($c.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.ip)

  match:

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $result_time = array_distinct($c.detection.detection.outcomes["result_time"])
    $rule_set_category_names = array_distinct($c.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($c.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($c.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.product_name)

    $adversary_uids = array_distinct($adversary_product_object_id)
    $adversary_names = array_distinct($adversary_userid)
    $adversary_netids = array_distinct($adversary_email)
    $adversary_ips = array_distinct($adversary_ip)

    $victim_uids = array_distinct($victim_product_object_id)
    $victim_names = array_distinct($victim_userid)
    $victim_netids = array_distinct($victim_email)
    $victim_ips = array_distinct($victim_ip)

    $result = array_distinct($c.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.action)
    $target_resource_count = count_distinct($c.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.resource.name)
    $detection_rule_ids = array_distinct($c.detection.detection.rule_id)
    $unique_event_types = array_distinct($c.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.event_type)
    $rule_names = array_distinct($c.detection.detection.rule_name)
    $mitre_tactics = array_distinct($c.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"])
    $mitre_techniques = array_distinct($c.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"])
    $rule_set_display_names = array_distinct($c.detection.detection.rule_set_display_name)
    $detection_contains_ati = if(arrays.join_string($rule_names, ",") = /ATI/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_3p = if(arrays.join_string($rule_names, ",") = /Entra ID Protection|Defender for Cloud|SCC:|AWS GuardDuty/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_hunting_rule_pack = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Mandiant Hunting Rules/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_customer_live_rule = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($detection_rule_ids, "|"), /ru_/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_methodology_curated_detection = if(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ",") = /Cloud Threats/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $principal_ips = array_distinct($c.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.ip)
    $principal_users = array_distinct($c.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.userid)
    $principal_resource_names = array_distinct($c.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.resource.name)
  condition:
    $c and $target_resource_count >= 3

  options:
    allow_zero_values = true
}

Threat actors may collect information on service accounts in a cloud account as a precursor to follow-on targeting. This activity may be automated using a cloud exploitation tool, such as ScoutSuite. See: https://github.com/nccgroup/ScoutSuite/wiki"
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0007"

    $adversary_ips = array_distinct($adversary_ip)
    $victim_uids = array_distinct($victim_product_object_id)
    $victim_names = array_distinct($victim_userid)
    $victim_netids = array_distinct($victim_email)
    $victim_ips = array_distinct($victim_ip)
    $result = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.action)
    $rule_set_category_names = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.product_name)
    $result_time = min($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $detection_rule_ids = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_id)
    $unique_event_types = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.event_type)
    $rule_names = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_name)
    $mitre_tactics = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"])
    $mitre_techniques = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"])
    $rule_set_display_names = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_set_display_name)
    $detection_contains_ati = if(arrays.join_string($rule_names, ",") = /ATI/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_3p = if(arrays.join_string($rule_names, ",") = /Entra ID Protection|Defender for Cloud|SCC:|AWS GuardDuty/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_hunting_rule_pack = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Mandiant Hunting Rules/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_customer_live_rule = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($detection_rule_ids, "|"), /ru_/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_methodology_curated_detection = if(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ",") = /Cloud Threats/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $principal_ips = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.ip)
    $principal_users = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.userid)
    $principal_resource_names = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.resource.name)
  condition:
    $c1 and $c2 and $c3 and $service_account_count >= 3

  options:
    allow_zero_values = true
}

rule c_cloud_unordered_wildcard_cluster_on_entity_medium {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Medium Severity Cloud Detection Cluster on Entity"
    description = "Detects cloud entities exhibiting multiple distinct detection rules and event types over a 10 minute period. Confidence and risk levels are determined by specific characteristics of those detections."
    severity = "Medium"

  events:
    $wildcard.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name = /Cloud Threats|Third Party Vendor Alerts|Third Party Alerts|Wiz/ nocase or
    (
      $wildcard.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name != /Mandiant Hunt/ nocase and
      $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_name = /./ and
      (
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.log_type = /azure|aws|gcp|wiz|google_cloud/ nocase or
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.product_name = /azure|aws|gcp|google(\s+|_)?cloud|wiz|cloud|entra|defender|guardduty|scc/ nocase or
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.vendor_name = /google|amazon|aws|microsoft|azure|wiz/ nocase or
        $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_name = /google|office\s*365|_o365_|_gw_|okta|duo|wiz|aws|gcp|azure|entra|guardduty|defender/ nocase or
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.cloud.project.name != ""
      )
    )
    $severity = $wildcard.detection.detection.severity
    $customer_severity = $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["severity"]
    $mitre_tactic = $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"]
    $mitre_technique = $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"]
    $entity_id = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce(
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.asset.asset_id,
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.hostname,
        re.capture($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.userid, `^([^@]+)`),
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.product_object_id,
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.asset.asset_id,
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.hostname,
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.user_display_name,
        re.capture($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.userid, `^([^@]+)`),
        re.capture($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.email_addresses, `^([^@]+)`),
        re.capture($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.email_addresses, `^([^@]+)`)
    ))
    $principal_ip = strings.coalesce(
      $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.ip,
      $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.asset.ip,
      $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.observer.ip
    )
    $entity_id != ""
    $event_type = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.event_type
    $principal_country = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region
    $producer_severity = $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["severity"] // Using rule_labels for severity

  match:
    $entity_id over 10m

  outcome:
    $entities = array_distinct($entity_id)
    $principal_users = array_distinct(strings.coalesce($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.userid, $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.email_addresses, $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.user_display_name))
    $target_users = array_distinct(strings.coalesce($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.userid, $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.email_addresses, $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.user_display_name))
    $rule_set_category_names = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name)
    $rule_set_display_names = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_set_display_name)
    $rule_names = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_name)
    $rule_name_count = count_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_name)
    $unique_event_types = array_distinct($event_type)
    $unique_event_type_count = count_distinct($event_type)
    $principal_ips = array_distinct($principal_ip)
    $principal_countries = array_distinct($principal_country)
    $count_principal_country = count_distinct($principal_country) - max(if($principal_country = "", 1)) //principal_country may be null in events, therefore subtract 1 (if null instance exists) from count to get accurate distinct country count.
    $mitre_tactics = array_distinct($mitre_tactic)
    $mitre_techniques = array_distinct($mitre_technique)
    $detection_rule_ids = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_id)
    $principal_network_organization = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.organization_name)
    $principal_network_carrier_name = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.carrier_name)
    $principal_network_dns_domain = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.dns_domain)
    $log_replay_source = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.ingestion_labels["replayedFrom"])
    $aws_mfa_authentication = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.attribute.labels["mfaAuthenticated"])
    $azure_risk_level = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.additional.fields["riskLevelAggregated"])
    $azure_risk_state = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.additional.fields["riskState"])
    $azure_signin_risk = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.additional.fields["riskLevelDuringSignIn"])
    $user_agents = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.network.http.user_agent)
    $suspicious_principal_hosting_organization_name = if(
      arrays.join_string($principal_network_organization, ",") = /(responsible organization|232web internet services|quintex|emerald onion|linode|vultr|digital ocean|digitalocean|ovh|contabo|gmbh|cloudflare|namecheap|flokinet|whg hosting|alibaba|online sas|liquid web|yigit|host department|empasoft)/ nocase, 1, 0
    )

    $suspicious_principal_hosting_carrier_name = if(
      arrays.join_string($principal_network_carrier_name, ",") = /(M247|LLC Internet Tehnologii|llc baxet|mt6 llc|black mesa|global connectivity solutions llp|Constant Company|Namecheap|DigitalOcean|simoresta uab|tangram canada|cyber data llc|stark industries solutions|Ikoula Net SAS|ReliableSite|ASERGO|uk-2|UK2.NET|Psychz|server|dedicated|hosting|Almouroltec|Binary Racks|Amanah Tech|Gigabit Hosting|xTom|Peg Tech|Multacom Corporation|Scaleway|Scalaxy|US Dedicated|Serverfield|Serverstadium|ServerMania|Informacines sistemos ir technologijos|Magna Capax|Chunghwa|Netminders|KIRINO|tier\.net|Seflow|virtual systems|v-sys|ServeTheWorld|nexeon technologies|WholeSale Internet|active-servers|Host Europe|AltusHost|latitude|IPXO|Madgenius|ColoCrossing|Secured Servers|Performive|Pacswitch|WhiteLabel|Perfect International|SoftLayer|Owl Limited|interbs|B2 Net|Global Internet Solutions|EGIHosting|Choopa|ENDOFFICE|Charles River Operation|ENAHOST|globaltelehost|gthost|^Path Network|Sternforth|hosting services|hetzner|webworld|tempest|hostkey|belcloud|melbikomas|clouvider|leaseweb|milkywan|code200|hostroyale|web2objects|BaCloud|IP Connect|hivelocity|terratransit ag|Akamai Connected Cloud|KeFF Networks Ltd|Foundation for Applied Privacy|hostpapa|TerraHost|Private Layer|Calyx|1984 ehf|FlokiNET|AEZA INTERNATIONAL|liteserver|OVH SAS|netcup|SURF B\.V\.|Stiftung Erneuerbare Freiheit|pfcloud ug|unmanaged ltd|3xk tech gmbh|Proxy|Nubes|Wimax|Limestone Networks|Perfect International|Starlink|Fdcservers|Hurricane Electric|Peg Tech|24 Shells|GorillaServers|ReliableSite.Net|Eonix|QuadraNet|Cybernet|Sharktech|Majestic Hosting|quintex|dedicated server provider|universal layer llc|frantech|1337 services|hostinger|hostwinds)/ nocase, 1, 0
    )

    $suspicious_principal_hosting_dns_domain = if(
      arrays.join_string($principal_network_dns_domain, ",") = /(for-privacy.net|bullethost|proxy|nothingtohide|artikel10)/ nocase, 1, 0
    )
    $user_agent_confidence = if(
      arrays.join_string($user_agents, ",") = /(pentoo|scout-suite|\bkali|scoutsuite|trufflehog|autodiscoverclient|microburst|AADinternals|Stormspotter|ROADtools|Steam-pipe|Monkey365|GraphRunner|SkyArk|Cloudsploit|MFASweep|CloudBrute|CloudEnum|gstrike|gcp_scanner|PurplePanda|Gcphound|Forsetisecurity|gcp_enum|BucketLoot|Trivy|\bPacu|awspx|Slyther|Invictus-|Cloudfox|Prowler)/ nocase, 1, 0
    )
    $high_risk_account = if(
      arrays.join_string($principal_users, ",") = /gserviceaccount|service account|\badmin\b|administrator|root|\bsvc / nocase or
      arrays.join_string($target_users, ",") = /gserviceaccount|service account|\badmin\b|administrator|root|\bsvc / nocase or
      arrays.join_string($entities, ",") = /gserviceaccount|service account|\badmin\b|administrator|root|\bsvc / nocase, 1, 0
    )
    $detection_contains_threat_emulation_software = if(
      arrays.join_string($log_replay_source, ",") = /demoverse/ nocase, 1, 0
    )
    $detection_contains_cspm_platform = if(
      arrays.join_string($principal_users, ",") = /orca-security|orca security|crowdstrikecspmreader|qualyscspm|paloalto-prisma|prisma cloud|prisma-cloud|laceworkcwssarole|datadogintegrationrole|datadogawsintegration|wiz-access-role|aqua-cspm/ nocase or
      arrays.join_string($target_users, ",") = /orca-security|orca security|crowdstrikecspmreader|qualyscspm|paloalto-prisma|prisma cloud|prisma-cloud|laceworkcwssarole|datadogintegrationrole|datadogawsintegration|wiz-access-role|aqua-cspm/ nocase or
      arrays.join_string($entities, ",") = /orca-security|orca security|crowdstrikecspmreader|qualyscspm|paloalto-prisma|prisma cloud|prisma-cloud|laceworkcwssarole|datadogintegrationrole|datadogawsintegration|wiz-access-role|aqua-cspm/ nocase, 1, 0
    )
    $detection_contains_3p = if(arrays.join_string($rule_names, ",") = /Entra ID Protection|Defender for Cloud|SCC:|AWS GuardDuty|Wiz|wiz_io/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_ati = if(arrays.join_string($rule_names, ",") = / ATI / nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_customer_live_rule = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($detection_rule_ids, "|"), /ru_/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $azure_elevated_risk_level = if(
      arrays.join_string($azure_risk_level, ",") = /high/ nocase, 1, 0
    )

    $azure_elevated_risk_level_during_signin = if(
      arrays.join_string($azure_signin_risk, ",") = /high/ nocase, 1, 0
    )

    $azure_elevated_risk_state = if(
      arrays.join_string($azure_risk_state, ",") = /atrisk|confirmedcompromised/ nocase, 1, 0
    )
    $detection_contains_methodology_curated_detection = if(
      arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ",") = /Cloud Threats/ nocase, 1, 0
    )
    $detection_contains_hunting_rule_pack = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Mandiant Hunting Rules/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $confidence_score_calculated = 0 +
    (if(arrays.join_string($rule_set_display_names, ",") = /Hacktools/ nocase, 1, 0) * 10) + // Small increase if hacktools used
    ($detection_contains_ati * 20) + // Moderate increase if ati cloud intel used
    ($detection_contains_customer_live_rule * 10) + // Small increase if customer rule name
    ($detection_contains_hunting_rule_pack * 20) + // Moderate increase if hunting rule pack used
    ($detection_contains_3p * 20) + // Moderate increase if 3rd party cloud detections
    ($user_agent_confidence * 30) + // Large increase if offensive security user agent used
    ($suspicious_principal_hosting_organization_name * 15) + // Small increase if suspicious principal hosting organization name
    ($suspicious_principal_hosting_carrier_name * 15) + // Small increase if suspicious principal hosting carrier name
    ($suspicious_principal_hosting_dns_domain * 15) + // Small increase if suspicious principal hosting dns domain
    (if($unique_event_type_count >= 2, 1, 0) * 10) + // Small increase if multiple event types
    (if($count_principal_country >= 2, 1, 0) * 20)  // Moderate increase if multiple source countries
    $confidence = if($confidence_score_calculated > 100, 100, $confidence_score_calculated)
    $risk_score_calculated = 10 +
    ($high_risk_account * 20) + // Small increase if high risk account
    ($azure_elevated_risk_level * 20) + // Small increase if azure elevated risk level
    ($azure_elevated_risk_level_during_signin * 20) + // Small increase if azure elevated risk level during signin
    ($azure_elevated_risk_state * 20) + // Small increase if azure elevated risk state
    (if(arrays.join_string($aws_mfa_authentication, ",") = "false" nocase, 1, 0) * 20) // Small increase if aws not mfa authenticated
    $risk_score_temp = if($detection_contains_threat_emulation_software > 0, 0, $risk_score_calculated)
    $risk_score = if($risk_score_temp > 100, 100, $risk_score_temp)
    $max_producer_severity = max(
      if(strings.to_lower($producer_severity) = "critical", 6, 0) +
      if(strings.to_lower($producer_severity) = "high", 5, 0) +
      if(strings.to_lower($producer_severity) = "medium", 4, 0) +
      if(strings.to_lower($producer_severity) = "low", 3, 0) +
      if(strings.to_lower($producer_severity) = /info/, 2, 0) +
      if(strings.to_lower($producer_severity) = "none", 1, 0)
    )
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.vendor_name)

rule c_cloud_unordered_wildcard_cluster_on_entity_high {
  meta:
    rule_name = "High Severity Cloud Detection Cluster on Entity"
    description = "Detects cloud entities exhibiting multiple distinct detection rules and event types over a 10 minute period. Confidence and risk levels are determined by specific characteristics of those detections."
    severity = "High"

  events:
    $wildcard.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name = /Cloud Threats|Third Party Vendor Alerts|Third Party Alerts|Wiz/ nocase or
    (
      $wildcard.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name != /Mandiant Hunt/ nocase and
      $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_name = /./ and
      (
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.log_type = /azure|aws|gcp|wiz|google_cloud/ nocase or
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.product_name = /azure|aws|gcp|google(\s+|_)?cloud|wiz|cloud|entra|defender|guardduty|scc/ nocase or
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.vendor_name = /google|amazon|aws|microsoft|azure|wiz/ nocase or
        $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_name = /google|office\s*365|_o365_|_gw_|okta|duo|wiz|aws|gcp|azure|entra|guardduty|defender/ nocase or
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.cloud.project.name != ""
      )
    )
    $severity = $wildcard.detection.detection.severity
    $customer_severity = $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["severity"]
    $mitre_tactic = $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"]
    $mitre_technique = $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"]
    $entity_id = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce(
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.asset.asset_id,
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.hostname,
        re.capture($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.userid, `^([^@]+)`),
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.product_object_id,
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.asset.asset_id,
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.hostname,
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.user_display_name,
        re.capture($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.userid, `^([^@]+)`),
        re.capture($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.email_addresses, `^([^@]+)`),
        re.capture($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.email_addresses, `^([^@]+)`)
    ))
    $principal_ip = strings.coalesce(
      $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.ip,
      $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.asset.ip,
      $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.observer.ip

    $event_type = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.event_type
    $principal_country =  $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region
    $producer_severity = $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["severity"] // Using rule_labels for severity

  match:
    $entity_id over 10m

  outcome:
    $entities = array_distinct($entity_id)
    $principal_users = array_distinct(strings.coalesce($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.userid, $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.email_addresses, $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.user_display_name))
    $target_users = array_distinct(strings.coalesce($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.userid, $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.email_addresses, $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.user_display_name))
    $rule_set_category_names = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name)
    $rule_set_display_names = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_set_display_name)
    $rule_names = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_name)
    $rule_name_count = count_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_name)
    $unique_event_types = array_distinct($event_type)
    $unique_event_type_count = count_distinct($event_type)
    $principal_ips = array_distinct($principal_ip)
    $principal_countries = array_distinct($principal_country)
    $count_principal_country = count_distinct($principal_country) - max(if($principal_country = "", 1)) //principal_country may be null in events, therefore subtract 1 (if null instance exists) from count to get accurate distinct country count.
    $mitre_tactics = array_distinct($mitre_tactic)
    $mitre_techniques = array_distinct($mitre_technique)
    $detection_rule_ids = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_id)
    $principal_network_organization = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.organization_name)
    $principal_network_carrier_name = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.carrier_name)

    $user_agents = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.network.http.user_agent)
    $suspicious_principal_hosting_organization_name = if(
      arrays.join_string($principal_network_organization, ",") = /(responsible organization|232web internet services|quintex|emerald onion|linode|vultr|digital ocean|digitalocean|ovh|contabo|gmbh|cloudflare|namecheap|flokinet|whg hosting|alibaba|online sas|liquid web|yigit|host department|empasoft)/ nocase, 1, 0

      arrays.join_string($target_users, ",") = /orca-security|orca security|crowdstrikecspmreader|qualyscspm|paloalto-prisma|prisma cloud|prisma-cloud|laceworkcwssarole|datadogintegrationrole|datadogawsintegration|wiz-access-role|aqua-cspm/ nocase or
      arrays.join_string($entities, ",") = /orca-security|orca security|crowdstrikecspmreader|qualyscspm|paloalto-prisma|prisma cloud|prisma-cloud|laceworkcwssarole|datadogintegrationrole|datadogawsintegration|wiz-access-role|aqua-cspm/ nocase, 1, 0
    )
    $detection_contains_3p = if(arrays.join_string($rule_names, ",") = /Entra ID Protection|Defender for Cloud|SCC:|AWS GuardDuty|Wiz|wiz_io/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_ati = if(arrays.join_string($rule_names, ",") = / ATI / nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_customer_live_rule = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($detection_rule_ids, "|"), /ru_/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $azure_elevated_risk_level = if(
      arrays.join_string($azure_risk_level, ",") = /high/ nocase, 1, 0
    )

    $azure_elevated_risk_level_during_signin = if(
      arrays.join_string($azure_signin_risk, ",") = /high/ nocase, 1, 0
    )

    $azure_elevated_risk_state = if(
      arrays.join_string($azure_risk_state, ",") = /atrisk|confirmedcompromised/ nocase, 1, 0
    )
    $detection_contains_methodology_curated_detection = if(
      arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ",") = /Cloud Threats/ nocase, 1, 0
    )
    $detection_contains_hunting_rule_pack = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Mandiant Hunting Rules/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $confidence_score_calculated = 0 +
    (if(arrays.join_string($rule_set_display_names, ",") = /Hacktools/ nocase, 1, 0) * 10) + // Small increase if hacktools used
    ($detection_contains_ati * 20) + // Moderate increase if ati cloud intel used
    ($detection_contains_customer_live_rule * 10) + // Small increase if customer rule name
    ($detection_contains_hunting_rule_pack * 20) + // Moderate increase if hunting rule pack used
    ($detection_contains_3p * 20) + // Moderate increase if 3rd party cloud detections
    ($user_agent_confidence * 30) + // Large increase if offensive security user agent used
    ($suspicious_principal_hosting_organization_name * 15) + // Small increase if suspicious principal hosting organization name
    ($suspicious_principal_hosting_carrier_name * 15) + // Small increase if suspicious principal hosting carrier name
    ($suspicious_principal_hosting_dns_domain * 15) + // Small increase if suspicious principal hosting dns domain
    (if($unique_event_type_count >= 2, 1, 0) * 10) + // Small increase if multiple event types
    (if($count_principal_country >= 2, 1, 0) * 20)  // Moderate increase if multiple source countries
    $confidence = if($confidence_score_calculated > 100, 100, $confidence_score_calculated)
    $risk_score_calculated = 10 +
    ($high_risk_account * 20) + // Small increase if high risk account
    ($azure_elevated_risk_level * 20) + // Small increase if azure elevated risk level
    ($azure_elevated_risk_level_during_signin * 20) + // Small increase if azure elevated risk level during signin
    ($azure_elevated_risk_state * 20) + // Small increase if azure elevated risk state
    (if(arrays.join_string($aws_mfa_authentication, ",") = "false" nocase, 1, 0) * 20) // Small increase if aws not mfa authenticated
    $risk_score_temp = if($detection_contains_threat_emulation_software > 0, 0, $risk_score_calculated)
    $risk_score = if($risk_score_temp > 100, 100, $risk_score_temp)
    $max_producer_severity = max(
      if(strings.to_lower($producer_severity) = "critical", 6, 0) +
      if(strings.to_lower($producer_severity) = "high", 5, 0) +
      if(strings.to_lower($producer_severity) = "medium", 4, 0) +
      if(strings.to_lower($producer_severity) = "low", 3, 0) +
      if(strings.to_lower($producer_severity) = /info/, 2, 0) +
      if(strings.to_lower($producer_severity) = "none", 1, 0)
    )
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.vendor_name)
    $result = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.action)
    $product_name = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.product_name)
    $result_time = min($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
  condition:
    $wildcard and $rule_name_count >= 2 and $confidence >= 67 and $confidence <= 80
}

rule c_hunting_classification_aws_securitygroup_creation_with_suspicious_egress_rule {
  meta:
    rule_name = "AWS Security Group Creation with Suspicious Egress Rule"
    description = "Detects the creation of an AWS Security Group followed by the creation of a risky egress firewall rule for the security group, such as permitting all traffic to any external IP address. Threat actors may create new AWS security groups and apply permissive policies to bypass restrictions that would otherwise impede their objectives."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1686.001"

  events:
    $c1.detection.detection.rule_name = /AWS Security Group Created/ nocase
    $c2.detection.detection.rule_name = /AWS Security Group Egress Rule Authorized/ nocase
    (
      strings.concat($c2.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.port, $c2.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.port) = /3389|22/ or
      $c2.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.resource.attribute.labels["requestParameters.cidrIp"] = "0.0.0.0/0" or
      $c2.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.resource.attribute.labels["requestParameters.cidrIp"] = "::/0" or
      $c2.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.resource.attribute.labels["requestParameters.fromPort"] = "-1" or
      $c2.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.resource.attribute.labels["requestParameters.toPort"] = "-1" or
      (
        $c2.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.resource.attribute.labels["requestParameters.fromPort"] = "1" and
        $c2.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.resource.attribute.labels["requestParameters.toPort"] = "65535"
      )
    )
    $target_group_id = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.resource.product_object_id

    $victim_ip = strings.to_lower($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.ip)

  match:
    $target_group_id over 10m

  outcome:
    $base_risk_score = 65
    $risk_score = $base_risk_score
    $adversary_uids = array_distinct($adversary_product_object_id)
    $adversary_names = array_distinct($adversary_userid)
    $adversary_netids = array_distinct($adversary_email)
    $adversary_ips = array_distinct($adversary_ip)
    $victim_uids = array_distinct($victim_product_object_id)
    $victim_names = array_distinct($victim_userid)
    $victim_netids = array_distinct($victim_email)
    $victim_ips = array_distinct($victim_ip)
    $result = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.action)
    $rule_set_category_names = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.product_name)
    $result_time = min($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $detection_rule_ids = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_id)
    $unique_event_types = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.event_type)
    $rule_names = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_name)
    $mitre_tactics = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"])
    $mitre_techniques = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"])
    $rule_set_display_names = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_set_display_name)
    $detection_contains_ati = if(arrays.join_string($rule_names, ",") = /ATI/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_3p = if(arrays.join_string($rule_names, ",") = /Entra ID Protection|Defender for Cloud|SCC:|AWS GuardDuty/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_hunting_rule_pack = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Mandiant Hunting Rules/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_customer_live_rule = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($detection_rule_ids, "|"), /ru_/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_methodology_curated_detection = if(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ",") = /Cloud Threats/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $principal_ips = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.ip)
    $principal_users = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.userid)
    $principal_resource_names = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.resource.name)
  condition:
    $c1 and $c2

  options:
    allow_zero_values = true
}

rules.text:
rule c_cloud_unordered_wildcard_cluster_on_entity_low {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Low Severity Cloud Detection Cluster on Entity"
    description = "Detects cloud entities exhibiting multiple distinct detection rules and event types over a 10 minute period. Confidence and risk levels are determined by specific characteristics of those detections."
    severity = "Low"

  events:
    $wildcard.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name = /Cloud Threats|Third Party Vendor Alerts|Third Party Alerts|Wiz/ nocase or
    (
      $wildcard.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name != /Mandiant Hunt/ nocase and
      $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_name = /./ and
      (
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.log_type = /azure|aws|gcp|wiz|google_cloud/ nocase or
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.product_name = /azure|aws|gcp|google(\s+|_)?cloud|wiz|cloud|entra|defender|guardduty|scc/ nocase or
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.vendor_name = /google|amazon|aws|microsoft|azure|wiz/ nocase or
        $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_name = /google|office\s*365|_o365_|_gw_|okta|duo|wiz|aws|gcp|azure|entra|guardduty|defender/ nocase or
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.cloud.project.name != ""
      )
    )
    $severity = $wildcard.detection.detection.severity
    $customer_severity = $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["severity"]
    $mitre_tactic = $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"]
    $mitre_technique = $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"]
    $entity_id = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce(
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.asset.asset_id,
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.hostname,
        re.capture($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.userid, `^([^@]+)`),
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.product_object_id,
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.asset.asset_id,
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.hostname,
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.user_display_name,
        re.capture($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.userid, `^([^@]+)`),
        re.capture($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.email_addresses, `^([^@]+)`),
        re.capture($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.email_addresses, `^([^@]+)`)
    ))
    $principal_ip = strings.coalesce(
      $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.ip,
      $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.asset.ip,
      $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.observer.ip
    )
    $entity_id != ""
    $event_type = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.event_type
    $principal_country = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region
    $producer_severity = $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["severity"] // Using rule_labels for severity

  match:
    $entity_id over 10m

  outcome:
    $entities = array_distinct($entity_id)
    $principal_users = array_distinct(strings.coalesce($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.userid, $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.email_addresses, $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.user_display_name))
    $target_users = array_distinct(strings.coalesce($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.userid, $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.email_addresses, $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.user_display_name))
    $rule_set_category_names = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name)
    $rule_set_display_names = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_set_display_name)
    $rule_names = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_name)
    $rule_name_count = count_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_name)
    $unique_event_types = array_distinct($event_type)
    $unique_event_type_count = count_distinct($event_type)
    $principal_ips = array_distinct($principal_ip)
    $principal_countries = array_distinct($principal_country)
    $count_principal_country = count_distinct($principal_country) - max(if($principal_country = "", 1)) //principal_country may be null in events, therefore subtract 1 (if null instance exists) from count to get accurate distinct country count.
    $mitre_tactics = array_distinct($mitre_tactic)
    $mitre_techniques = array_distinct($mitre_technique)
    $detection_rule_ids = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_id)
    $principal_network_organization = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.organization_name)
    $principal_network_carrier_name = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.carrier_name)
    $principal_network_dns_domain = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.dns_domain)
    $log_replay_source = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.ingestion_labels["replayedFrom"])
    $aws_mfa_authentication = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.attribute.labels["mfaAuthenticated"])
    $azure_risk_level = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.additional.fields["riskLevelAggregated"])
    $azure_risk_state = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.additional.fields["riskState"])
    $azure_signin_risk = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.additional.fields["riskLevelDuringSignIn"])
    $user_agents = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.network.http.user_agent)
    $suspicious_principal_hosting_organization_name = if(
      arrays.join_string($principal_network_organization, ",") = /(responsible organization|232web internet services|quintex|emerald onion|linode|vultr|digital ocean|digitalocean|ovh|contabo|gmbh|cloudflare|namecheap|flokinet|whg hosting|alibaba|online sas|liquid web|yigit|host department|empasoft)/ nocase, 1, 0
    )

    $suspicious_principal_hosting_carrier_name = if(
      arrays.join_string($principal_network_carrier_name, ",") = /(M247|LLC Internet Tehnologii|llc baxet|mt6 llc|black mesa|global connectivity solutions llp|Constant Company|Namecheap|DigitalOcean|simoresta uab|tangram canada|cyber data llc|stark industries solutions|Ikoula Net SAS|ReliableSite|ASERGO|uk-2|UK2.NET|Psychz|server|dedicated|hosting|Almouroltec|Binary Racks|Amanah Tech|Gigabit Hosting|xTom|Peg Tech|Multacom Corporation|Scaleway|Scalaxy|US Dedicated|Serverfield|Serverstadium|ServerMania|Informacines sistemos ir technologijos|Magna Capax|Chunghwa|Netminders|KIRINO|tier\.net|Seflow|virtual systems|v-sys|ServeTheWorld|nexeon technologies|WholeSale Internet|active-servers|Host Europe|AltusHost|latitude|IPXO|Madgenius|ColoCrossing|Secured Servers|Performive|Pacswitch|WhiteLabel|Perfect International|SoftLayer|Owl Limited|interbs|B2 Net|Global Internet Solutions|EGIHosting|Choopa|ENDOFFICE|Charles River Operation|ENAHOST|globaltelehost|gthost|^Path Network|Sternforth|hosting services|hetzner|webworld|tempest|hostkey|belcloud|melbikomas|clouvider|leaseweb|milkywan|code200|hostroyale|web2objects|BaCloud|IP Connect|hivelocity|terratransit ag|Akamai Connected Cloud|KeFF Networks Ltd|Foundation for Applied Privacy|hostpapa|TerraHost|Private Layer|Calyx|1984 ehf|FlokiNET|AEZA INTERNATIONAL|liteserver|OVH SAS|netcup|SURF B\.V\.|Stiftung Erneuerbare Freiheit|pfcloud ug|unmanaged ltd|3xk tech gmbh|Proxy|Nubes|Wimax|Limestone Networks|Perfect International|Starlink|Fdcservers|Hurricane Electric|Peg Tech|24 Shells|GorillaServers|ReliableSite.Net|Eonix|QuadraNet|Cybernet|Sharktech|Majestic Hosting|quintex|dedicated server provider|universal layer llc|frantech|1337 services|hostinger|hostwinds)/ nocase, 1, 0
    )

    $suspicious_principal_hosting_dns_domain = if(
      arrays.join_string($principal_network_dns_domain, ",") = /(for-privacy.net|bullethost|proxy|nothingtohide|artikel10)/ nocase, 1, 0
    )
    $user_agent_confidence = if(
      arrays.join_string($user_agents, ",") = /(pentoo|scout-suite|\bkali|scoutsuite|trufflehog|autodiscoverclient|microburst|AADinternals|Stormspotter|ROADtools|Steam-pipe|Monkey365|GraphRunner|SkyArk|Cloudsploit|MFASweep|CloudBrute|CloudEnum|gstrike|gcp_scanner|PurplePanda|Gcphound|Forsetisecurity|gcp_enum|BucketLoot|Trivy|\bPacu|awspx|Slyther|Invictus-|Cloudfox|Prowler)/ nocase, 1, 0
    )
    $high_risk_account = if(
      arrays.join_string($principal_users, ",") = /gserviceaccount|service account|\badmin\b|administrator|root|\bsvc / nocase or
      arrays.join_string($target_users, ",") = /gserviceaccount|service account|\badmin\b|administrator|root|\bsvc / nocase or
      arrays.join_string($entities, ",") = /gserviceaccount|service account|\badmin\b|administrator|root|\bsvc / nocase, 1, 0
    )
    $detection_contains_threat_emulation_software = if(
      arrays.join_string($log_replay_source, ",") = /demoverse/ nocase, 1, 0
    )
    $detection_contains_cspm_platform = if(
      arrays.join_string($principal_users, ",") = /orca-security|orca security|crowdstrikecspmreader|qualyscspm|paloalto-prisma|prisma cloud|prisma-cloud|laceworkcwssarole|datadogintegrationrole|datadogawsintegration|wiz-access-role|aqua-cspm/ nocase or
      arrays.join_string($target_users, ",") = /orca-security|orca security|crowdstrikecspmreader|qualyscspm|paloalto-prisma|prisma cloud|prisma-cloud|laceworkcwssarole|datadogintegrationrole|datadogawsintegration|wiz-access-role|aqua-cspm/ nocase or
      arrays.join_string($entities, ",") = /orca-security|orca security|crowdstrikecspmreader|qualyscspm|paloalto-prisma|prisma cloud|prisma-cloud|laceworkcwssarole|datadogintegrationrole|datadogawsintegration|wiz-access-role|aqua-cspm/ nocase, 1, 0
    )
    $detection_contains_3p = if(arrays.join_string($rule_names, ",") = /Entra ID Protection|Defender for Cloud|SCC:|AWS GuardDuty|Wiz|wiz_io/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_ati = if(arrays.join_string($rule_names, ",") = / ATI / nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_customer_live_rule = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($detection_rule_ids, "|"), /ru_/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_methodology_curated_detection = if(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ",") = /Cloud Threats/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_hunting_rule_pack = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Mandiant Hunting Rules/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $azure_elevated_risk_level = if(
      arrays.join_string($azure_risk_level, ",") = /high/ nocase, 1, 0
    )

    $azure_elevated_risk_level_during_signin = if(
      arrays.join_string($azure_signin_risk, ",") = /high/ nocase, 1, 0
    )

    $azure_elevated_risk_state = if(
      arrays.join_string($azure_risk_state, ",") = /atrisk|confirmedcompromised/ nocase, 1, 0
    )
    $confidence_score_calculated = 0 +
    (if(arrays.join_string($rule_set_display_names, ",") = /Hacktools/ nocase, 1, 0) * 10) + // Small increase if hacktools used
    ($detection_contains_ati * 20) + // Moderate increase if ati cloud intel used
    ($detection_contains_customer_live_rule * 10) + // Small increase if customer rule name
    ($detection_contains_hunting_rule_pack * 20) + // Moderate increase if hunting rule pack used
    ($detection_contains_3p * 20) + // Moderate increase if 3rd party cloud detections
    ($user_agent_confidence * 30) + // Large increase if offensive security user agent used
    ($suspicious_principal_hosting_organization_name * 15) + // Small increase if suspicious principal hosting organization name
    ($suspicious_principal_hosting_carrier_name * 15) + // Small increase if suspicious principal hosting carrier name
    ($suspicious_principal_hosting_dns_domain * 15) + // Small increase if suspicious principal hosting dns domain
    (if($unique_event_type_count >= 2, 1, 0) * 10) + // Small increase if multiple event types
    (if($count_principal_country >= 2, 1, 0) * 20)  // Moderate increase if multiple source countries
    $confidence = if($confidence_score_calculated > 100, 100, $confidence_score_calculated)
    $risk_score_calculated = 10 +
    ($high_risk_account * 20) + // Small increase if high risk account
    ($azure_elevated_risk_level * 20) + // Small increase if azure elevated risk level
    ($azure_elevated_risk_level_during_signin * 20) + // Small increase if azure elevated risk level during signin
    ($azure_elevated_risk_state * 20) + // Small increase if azure elevated risk state
    (if(arrays.join_string($aws_mfa_authentication, ",") = "false" nocase, 1, 0) * 20) // Small increase if aws not mfa authenticated
    $risk_score_temp = if($detection_contains_threat_emulation_software > 0, 0, $risk_score_calculated)
    $risk_score = if($risk_score_temp > 100, 100, $risk_score_temp)
    $max_producer_severity = max(
      if(strings.to_lower($producer_severity) = "critical", 6, 0) +
      if(strings.to_lower($producer_severity) = "high", 5, 0) +
      if(strings.to_lower($producer_severity) = "medium", 4, 0) +
      if(strings.to_lower($producer_severity) = "low", 3, 0) +
      if(strings.to_lower($producer_severity) = /info/, 2, 0) +
      if(strings.to_lower($producer_severity) = "none", 1, 0)
    )
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.vendor_name)
    $result = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.action)
    $result_time = min($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $product_name = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.product_name)
  condition:
    $wildcard and $rule_name_count >= 3 and $confidence >= 31 and $confidence <= 50
}

rule c_hunting_classification_aws_ec2_snapshot_exfiltration_attempt {
  meta:
    rule_name = "AWS EC2 Snapshot Exfiltration Attempt"
    description = "Detects on the modification of permissions for an AWS EC2 Amazon Machine Images (AMI) snapshot, which can allow for the snapshot to be shared publicly. Threat actors may modify the permissions of an AMI snapshot as a precursor to exfiltration. When the launch permissions for the group value are set to all, that means the RDS snapshot is made public. When the launch permissions for the userID value are set to *, that means the RDS snapshot was shared with a new or unknown AWS account. For more information, please see: https://docs.datadoghq.com/security/default_rules/cloudtrail-aws-ec2-ami-exfil/"
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0010"
    technique = "T1537"

  events:
    $c.detection.detection.rule_name = /AWS ModifyImageAttribute/ nocase and
    (
      $c.detection.collection_elements.references.event.additional.fields["Add Items UserId"] = /\*/ or
      $c.detection.collection_elements.references.event.additional.fields["Add Items UserId"] = "all" or
      $c.detection.collection_elements.references.event.additional.fields["Add Items Group"] = /\*/ or
      $c.detection.collection_elements.references.event.additional.fields["Add Items Group"] = "all" or
      $c.detection.collection_elements.references.event.additional.fields["requestParameters.launchPermission.add.items[0].group"] = "all" or
      $c.detection.collection_elements.references.event.additional.fields["requestParameters.launchPermission.add.items[0].group"] = /\*/ or
      $c.detection.collection_elements.references.event.additional.fields["requestParameters.launchPermission.add.items[0].userId"] = "all" or
      $c.detection.collection_elements.references.event.additional.fields["requestParameters.launchPermission.add.items[0].userId"] = /\*/ or
      $c.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.resource.attribute.roles.name = "all" or
      $c.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.resource.attribute.roles.name = /\*/
    )
    $principal_userid = $c.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.userid
    (//tuning
      not $c.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.userid = /\/usydbackuprole\/AWSBackup-usydbackuprole/

rules.text:
rule c_cloud_unordered_wildcard_cluster_on_entity_critical {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Critical Severity Cloud Detection Cluster on Entity"
    description = "Detects cloud entities exhibiting multiple distinct detection rules and event types over a 10 minute period. Confidence and risk levels are determined by specific characteristics of those detections."
    severity = "Critical"

  events:
    $wildcard.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name = /Cloud Threats|Third Party Vendor Alerts|Third Party Alerts|Wiz/ nocase or
    (
      $wildcard.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name != /Mandiant Hunt/ nocase and
      $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_name = /./ and
      (
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.log_type = /azure|aws|gcp|wiz|google_cloud/ nocase or
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.product_name = /azure|aws|gcp|google(\s+|_)?cloud|wiz|cloud|entra|defender|guardduty|scc/ nocase or
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.vendor_name = /google|amazon|aws|microsoft|azure|wiz/ nocase or
        $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_name = /google|office\s*365|_o365_|_gw_|okta|duo|wiz|aws|gcp|azure|entra|guardduty|defender/ nocase or
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.cloud.project.name != ""
      )
    )
    $severity = $wildcard.detection.detection.severity
    $customer_severity = $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["severity"]
    $mitre_tactic = $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"]
    $mitre_technique = $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"]
    $entity_id = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce(
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.asset.asset_id,
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.hostname,
        re.capture($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.userid, `^([^@]+)`),
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.product_object_id,
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.asset.asset_id,
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.hostname,
        $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.user_display_name,
        re.capture($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.userid, `^([^@]+)`),
        re.capture($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.email_addresses, `^([^@]+)`),
        re.capture($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.email_addresses, `^([^@]+)`)
    ))
    $principal_ip = strings.coalesce(
      $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.ip,
      $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.asset.ip,
      $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.observer.ip
    )
    $entity_id != ""
    $event_type = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.event_type
    $principal_country = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region
    $producer_severity = $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["severity"] // Using rule_labels for severity

  match:
    $entity_id over 10m

  outcome:
    $entities = array_distinct($entity_id)
    $principal_users = array_distinct(strings.coalesce($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.userid, $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.email_addresses, $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.user_display_name))
    $target_users = array_distinct(strings.coalesce($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.userid, $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.email_addresses, $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.user_display_name))
    $rule_set_category_names = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name)
    $rule_set_display_names = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_set_display_name)
    $rule_names = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_name)
    $rule_name_count = count_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_name)
    $unique_event_types = array_distinct($event_type)
    $unique_event_type_count = count_distinct($event_type)
    $principal_ips = array_distinct($principal_ip)
    $principal_countries = array_distinct($principal_country)
    $count_principal_country = count_distinct($principal_country) - max(if($principal_country = "", 1)) //principal_country may be null in events, therefore subtract 1 (if null instance exists) from count to get accurate distinct country count.
    $mitre_tactics = array_distinct($mitre_tactic)
    $mitre_techniques = array_distinct($mitre_technique)
    $detection_rule_ids = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_id)
    $principal_network_organization = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.organization_name)
    $principal_network_carrier_name = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.carrier_name)
    $principal_network_dns_domain = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.dns_domain)
