    $aws_mfa_authentication = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.attribute.labels["mfaAuthenticated"])
    $azure_risk_level = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.additional.fields["riskLevelAggregated"])
    $azure_risk_state = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.additional.fields["riskState"])
    $azure_signin_risk = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.additional.fields["riskLevelDuringSignIn"])
    $user_agents = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.network.http.user_agent)
    $suspicious_principal_hosting_organization_name = if(
      arrays.join_string($principal_network_organization, ",") = /(responsible organization|232web internet services|quintex|emerald onion|linode|vultr|digital ocean|digitalocean|ovh|contabo|gmbh|cloudflare|namecheap|flokinet|whg hosting|alibaba|online sas|liquid web|yigit|host department|empasoft)/ nocase, 1, 0
    )

    $suspicious_principal_hosting_carrier_name = if(
      arrays.join_string($principal_network_carrier_name, ",") = /(M247|LLC Internet Tehnologii|llc baxet|mt6 llc|black mesa|global connectivity solutions llp|Constant Company|Namecheap|DigitalOcean|simoresta uab|tangram canada|cyber data llc|stark industries solutions|Ikoula Net SAS|ReliableSite|ASERGO|uk-2|UK2.NET|Psychz|server|dedicated|hosting|Almouroltec|Binary Racks|Amanah Tech|Gigabit Hosting|xTom|Peg Tech|Multacom Corporation|Scaleway|Scalaxy|US Dedicated|Serverfield|Serverstadium|ServerMania|Informacines sistemos ir technologijos|Magna Capax|Chunghwa|Netminders|KIRINO|tier\.net|Seflow|virtual systems|v-sys|ServeTheWorld|nexeon technologies|WholeSale Internet|active-servers|Host Europe|AltusHost|latitude|IPXO|Madgenius|ColoCrossing|Secured Servers|Performive|Pacswitch|WhiteLabel|Perfect International|SoftLayer|Owl Limited|interbs|B2 Net|Global Internet Solutions|EGIHosting|Choopa|ENDOFFICE|Charles River Operation|ENAHOST|globaltelehost|gthost|^Path Network|Sternforth|hosting services|hetzner|webworld|tempest|hostkey|belcloud|melbikomas|clouvider|leaseweb|milkywan|code200|hostroyale|web2objects|BaCloud|IP Connect|hivelocity|terratransit ag|Akamai Connected Cloud|KeFF Networks Ltd|Foundation for Applied Privacy|hostpapa|TerraHost|Private Layer|Calyx|1984 ehf|FlokiNET|AEZA INTERNATIONAL|liteserver|OVH SAS|netcup|SURF B\.V\.|Stiftung Erneuerbare Freiheit|pfcloud ug|unmanaged ltd|3xk tech gmbh|Proxy|Nubes|Wimax|Limestone Networks|Perfect International|Starlink|Fdcservers|Hurricane Electric|Peg Tech|24 Shells|GorillaServers|ReliableSite.Net|Eonix|QuadraNet|Cybernet|Sharktech|Majestic Hosting|quintex|dedicated server provider|universal layer llc|frantech|1337 services|hostinger|hostwinds)/ nocase, 1, 0
    )

    $suspicious_principal_hosting_dns_domain = if(
      arrays.join_string($principal_network_dns_domain, ",") = /(for-privacy.net|bullethost|proxy|nothingtohide|artikel10)/ nocase, 1, 0
    )
    $user_agent_confidence = if(
      arrays.join_string($user_agents, ",") = /(pentoo|scout-suite|\bkali|scoutsuite|trufflehog|autodiscoverclient|microburst|AADinternals|Stormspotter|ROADtools|Steam-pipe|Monkey365|GraphRunner|SkyArk|Cloudsploit|MFASweep|CloudBrute|CloudEnum|gstrike|gcp_scanner|PurplePanda|Gcphound|Forsetisecurity|gcp_enum|BucketLoot|Trivy|\bPacu|awspx|Slyther|Invictus-|Cloudfox|Prowler)/ nocase, 1, 0
    )
    $high_risk_account = if(
      arrays.join_string($principal_users, ",") = /gserviceaccount|service account|\badmin\b|administrator|root|\bsvc / nocase or
      arrays.join_string($target_users, ",") = /gserviceaccount|service account|\badmin\b|administrator|root|\bsvc / nocase or
      arrays.join_string($entities, ",") = /gserviceaccount|service account|\badmin\b|administrator|root|\bsvc / nocase, 1, 0
    )
    $detection_contains_threat_emulation_software = if(
      arrays.join_string($log_replay_source, ",") = /demoverse/ nocase, 1, 0
    )
    $detection_contains_cspm_platform = if(
      arrays.join_string($principal_users, ",") = /orca-security|orca security|crowdstrikecspmreader|qualyscspm|paloalto-prisma|prisma cloud|prisma-cloud|laceworkcwssarole|datadogintegrationrole|datadogawsintegration|wiz-access-role|aqua-cspm/ nocase or
      arrays.join_string($target_users, ",") = /orca-security|orca security|crowdstrikecspmreader|qualyscspm|paloalto-prisma|prisma cloud|prisma-cloud|laceworkcwssarole|datadogintegrationrole|datadogawsintegration|wiz-access-role|aqua-cspm/ nocase or
      arrays.join_string($entities, ",") = /orca-security|orca security|crowdstrikecspmreader|qualyscspm|paloalto-prisma|prisma cloud|prisma-cloud|laceworkcwssarole|datadogintegrationrole|datadogawsintegration|wiz-access-role|aqua-cspm/ nocase, 1, 0
    )
    $detection_contains_3p = if(arrays.join_string($rule_names, ",") = /Entra ID Protection|Defender for Cloud|SCC:|AWS GuardDuty|Wiz|wiz_io/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_ati = if(arrays.join_string($rule_names, ",") = / ATI / nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_customer_live_rule = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($detection_rule_ids, "|"), /ru_/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $azure_elevated_risk_level = if(
      arrays.join_string($azure_risk_level, ",") = /high/ nocase, 1, 0
    )

    $azure_elevated_risk_level_during_signin = if(
      arrays.join_string($azure_signin_risk, ",") = /high/ nocase, 1, 0
    )

    $azure_elevated_risk_state = if(
      arrays.join_string($azure_risk_state, ",") = /atrisk|confirmedcompromised/ nocase, 1, 0
    )
    $detection_contains_methodology_curated_detection = if(
      arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ",") = /Cloud Threats/ nocase, 1, 0
    )
    $detection_contains_hunting_rule_pack = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Mandiant Hunting Rules/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $confidence_score_calculated = 0 +
    (if(arrays.join_string($rule_set_display_names, ",") = /Hacktools/ nocase, 1, 0) * 10) + // Small increase if hacktools used
    ($detection_contains_ati * 20) + // Moderate increase if ati cloud intel used
    ($detection_contains_customer_live_rule * 10) + // Small increase if customer rule name
    ($detection_contains_hunting_rule_pack * 20) + // Moderate increase if hunting rule pack used
    ($detection_contains_3p * 20) + // Moderate increase if 3rd party cloud detections
    ($user_agent_confidence * 30) + // Large increase if offensive security user agent used
    ($suspicious_principal_hosting_organization_name * 15) + // Small increase if suspicious principal hosting organization name
    ($suspicious_principal_hosting_carrier_name * 15) + // Small increase if suspicious principal hosting carrier name
    ($suspicious_principal_hosting_dns_domain * 15) + // Small increase if suspicious principal hosting dns domain
    (if($unique_event_type_count >= 2, 1, 0) * 10) + // Small increase if multiple event types
    (if($count_principal_country >= 2, 1, 0) * 20)  // Moderate increase if multiple source countries
    $confidence = if($confidence_score_calculated > 100, 100, $confidence_score_calculated)
    $risk_score_calculated = 10 +
    ($high_risk_account * 20) + // Small increase if high risk account
    ($azure_elevated_risk_level * 20) + // Small increase if azure elevated risk level
    ($azure_elevated_risk_level_during_signin * 20) + // Small increase if azure elevated risk level during signin
    ($azure_elevated_risk_state * 20) + // Small increase if azure elevated risk state
    (if(arrays.join_string($aws_mfa_authentication, ",") = "false" nocase, 1, 0) * 20) // Small increase if aws not mfa authenticated
    $risk_score_temp = if($detection_contains_threat_emulation_software > 0, 0, $risk_score_calculated)
    $risk_score = if($risk_score_temp > 100, 100, $risk_score_temp)
    $max_producer_severity = max(
      if(strings.to_lower($producer_severity) = "critical", 6, 0) +
      if(strings.to_lower($producer_severity) = "high", 5, 0) +
      if(strings.to_lower($producer_severity) = "medium", 4, 0) +
      if(strings.to_lower($producer_severity) = "low", 3, 0) +
      if(strings.to_lower($producer_severity) = /info/, 2, 0) +
      if(strings.to_lower($producer_severity) = "none", 1, 0)
    )
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.vendor_name)
    $result = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.action)
    $product_name = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.product_name)
    $result_time = min($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
  condition:
    $wildcard and $rule_name_count >= 2 and $confidence >= 81
}

    $detection_contains_hunting_rule_pack = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Mandiant Hunting Rules/) nocase, 1, 0)

rule c_hunting_classification_aws_secrets_enumeration_by_long_term_access_key {

    description = "Detects on commands to enumerate credentials from the AWS Secrets Manager service by a long-lived AWS access key (i.e., AKIA*). Threat actors may list all the secrets for an account stored in the Secrets Manager prior to attempting to obtain the secrets values, such as a password or an API key. Once collected, the secrets values can be used by threat actors for follow-on activities, including privilege escalation and lateral movement."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0006"
    technique = "T1555.006"
    reference = "https://github.com/RhinoSecurityLabs/pacu/blob/7ff8ba93186f68d40d350b2e250c65b7b93b349b/pacu/modules/enum__secrets/main.py"

    $principal_userid = $c.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.userid

    $adversary_names = array_distinct($adversary_userid)
    $adversary_netids = array_distinct($adversary_email)
    $adversary_ips = array_distinct($adversary_ip)

    $victim_ips = array_distinct($victim_ip)
    $region_count = count_distinct($c.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.location.name)

    $result = array_distinct($c.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.action)
    $detection_rule_ids = array_distinct($c.detection.detection.rule_id)
    $unique_event_types = array_distinct($c.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.event_type)
    $rule_names = array_distinct($c.detection.detection.rule_name)
    $mitre_tactics = array_distinct($c.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"])

    $rule_set_display_names = array_distinct($c.detection.detection.rule_set_display_name)
    $detection_contains_ati = if(arrays.join_string($rule_names, ",") = /ATI/ nocase, 1, 0)

rule c_hunting_activity_cluster_from_account {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Hunting Activity Cluster From Account"
    description = "Detects a high severity cluster of Mandiant Hunt rules triggered from a single account."
    severity = "High"

  events:
    $wildcard.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name = /Mandiant Hunt/ nocase
    $severity = $wildcard.detection.detection.severity
    $customer_severity = $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["severity"]
    $mitre_tactics_match = $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"]
    $mitre_techniques_match = $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"]
    $account_id = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce(re.capture($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.userid, `^([^@]+)`), re.capture($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.userid, `^([^@]+)`)))
    $principal_ip = strings.coalesce(
      $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.ip,
      $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.asset.ip,
      $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.observer.ip
    )
    $account_id != ""
    $event_type = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.event_type
    $principal_country = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region
    $producer_severity = $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["severity"] // Using rule_labels for severity
    $third_party_threat_names = strings.coalesce($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.threat_name, $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.rule_name)

  match:
    $account_id over 1h

  outcome:
    $principal_users = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.userid)
    $rule_set_category_names = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name)
    $rule_set_display_names = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_set_display_name)
    $rule_names = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_name)
    $rule_name_count = count_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_name)
    $mitre_tactics = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"])
    $mitre_techniques = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"])
    $unique_event_types = array_distinct($event_type)
    $unique_event_type_count = count_distinct($event_type)
    $principal_ips = array_distinct($principal_ip)
    $principal_countries = array_distinct($principal_country)
    $count_principal_country = count_distinct($principal_country) - max(if($principal_country = "", 1)) //principal_country may be null in events, therefore subtract 1 (if null instance exists) from count to get accurate distinct country count.
    $unique_third_party_names = array_distinct($third_party_threat_names)
    $principal_network_organization = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.organization_name)
    $principal_network_carrier_name = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.carrier_name)
    $principal_network_dns_domain = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.dns_domain)
    $log_replay_source = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.ingestion_labels["replayedFrom"])
    $aws_mfa_authentication = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.attribute.labels["mfaAuthenticated"])
    $azure_risk_level = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.additional.fields["riskLevelAggregated"])
    $azure_risk_state = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.additional.fields["riskState"])
    $azure_signin_risk = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.additional.fields["riskLevelDuringSignIn"])
    $user_agents = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.network.http.user_agent)
    $suspicious_principal_hosting_organization_name = if(
      arrays.join_string($principal_network_organization, ",'") = /(responsible organization|232web internet services|quintex|emerald onion|linode|vultr|digital ocean|digitalocean|ovh|contabo|gmbh|cloudflare|namecheap|flokinet|whg hosting|alibaba|online sas|liquid web|yigit|host department|empasoft)/ nocase, 1, 0
    )

    $suspicious_principal_hosting_carrier_name = if(
      arrays.join_string($principal_network_carrier_name, ",'") = /(M247|LLC Internet Tehnologii|llc baxet|mt6 llc|black mesa|global connectivity solutions llp|Constant Company|Namecheap|DigitalOcean|simoresta uab|tangram canada|cyber data llc|stark industries solutions|Ikoula Net SAS|ReliableSite|ASERGO|uk-2|UK2.NET|Psychz|server|dedicated|hosting|Almouroltec|Binary Racks|Amanah Tech|Gigabit Hosting|xTom|Peg Tech|Multacom Corporation|Scaleway|Scalaxy|US Dedicated|Serverfield|Serverstadium|ServerMania|Informacines sistemos ir technologijos|Magna Capax|Chunghwa|Netminders|KIRINO|tier\.net|Seflow|virtual systems|v-sys|ServeTheWorld|nexeon technologies|WholeSale Internet|active-servers|Host Europe|AltusHost|latitude|IPXO|Madgenius|ColoCrossing|Secured Servers|Performive|Pacswitch|WhiteLabel|Perfect International|SoftLayer|Owl Limited|interbs|B2 Net|Global Internet Solutions|EGIHosting|Choopa|ENDOFFICE|Charles River Operation|ENAHOST|globaltelehost|gthost|^Path Network|Sternforth|hosting services|hetzner|webworld|tempest|hostkey|belcloud|melbikomas|clouvider|leaseweb|milkywan|code200|hostroyale|web2objects|BaCloud|IP Connect|hivelocity|terratransit ag|Akamai Connected Cloud|KeFF Networks Ltd|Foundation for Applied Privacy|hostpapa|TerraHost|Private Layer|Calyx|1984 ehf|FlokiNET|AEZA INTERNATIONAL|liteserver|OVH SAS|netcup|SURF B\.V\.|Stiftung Erneuerbare Freiheit|pfcloud ug|unmanaged ltd|3xk tech gmbh|Proxy|Nubes|Wimax|Limestone Networks|Perfect International|Starlink|Fdcservers|Hurricane Electric|Peg Tech|24 Shells|GorillaServers|ReliableSite.Net|Eonix|QuadraNet|Cybernet|Sharktech|Majestic Hosting|quintex|dedicated server provider|universal layer llc|frantech|1337 services|hostinger|hostwinds)/ nocase, 1, 0
    )

    $suspicious_principal_hosting_dns_domain = if(
      arrays.join_string($principal_network_dns_domain, ",'") = /(for-privacy.net|bullethost|proxy|nothingtohide|artikel10)/ nocase, 1, 0
    )
    $user_agent_confidence = if(
      arrays.join_string($user_agents, ",'") = /(pentoo|scout-suite|\bkali|scoutsuite|trufflehog|autodiscoverclient|microburst|AADinternals|Stormspotter|ROADtools|Steam-pipe|Monkey365|GraphRunner|SkyArk|Cloudsploit|MFASweep|CloudBrute|CloudEnum|gstrike|gcp_scanner|PurplePanda|Gcphound|Forsetisecurity|gcp_enum|BucketLoot|Trivy|\bPacu|awspx|Slyther|Invictus-|Cloudfox|Prowler)/ nocase, 1, 0
    )
    $high_risk_account = if(
      arrays.join_string($principal_users, ",'") = /gserviceaccount|service account|\badmin\b|administrator|root|\bsvc / nocase, 1, 0
    )
    $detection_contains_threat_emulation_software = if(
      arrays.join_string($log_replay_source, ",'") = /demoverse/ nocase, 1, 0

      arrays.join_string($principal_users, ",'") = /orca-security|orca security|crowdstrikecspmreader|qualyscspm|paloalto-prisma|prisma cloud|prisma-cloud|laceworkcwssarole|datadogintegrationrole|datadogawsintegration|wiz-access-role|aqua-cspm/ nocase, 1, 0
    )
    $detection_contains_3p = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_names, "|"), /(mdatp |CrowdStrike EDR|Sentinelone Threats| - CoreLight|forescout|AWS GuardDuty:|Azure Defender for Cloud:|SCC: |MDE Graph)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_ati = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Applied Threat Intelligence - Curated Prioritization/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_rule_ids = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_id)
    $detection_contains_customer_live_rule = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($detection_rule_ids, "|"), /ru_/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $azure_elevated_risk_level = if(
      arrays.join_string($azure_risk_level, ",'") = /high/ nocase, 1, 0
    )

    $azure_elevated_risk_level_during_signin = if(
      arrays.join_string($azure_signin_risk, ",'") = /high/ nocase, 1, 0
    )

    $azure_elevated_risk_state = if(
      arrays.join_string($azure_risk_state, ",'") = /atrisk|confirmedcompromised/ nocase, 1, 0
    )
    $detection_contains_methodology_curated_detection = if(
      arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ",'") = /Cloud Threats/ nocase, 1, 0
    )

    $detection_contains_hunting_rule_pack = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Mandiant Hunting Rules/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $confidence_score_calculated = 0 +
    (if(arrays.join_string($rule_set_display_names, ",") = /Hacktools/ nocase, 1, 0) * 10) + // Small increase if hacktools used
    ($detection_contains_ati * 20) + // Moderate increase if ati cloud intel used
    ($detection_contains_customer_live_rule * 10) + // Small increase if customer rule name
    ($detection_contains_3p * 20) + // Moderate increase if 3rd party cloud detections
    ($user_agent_confidence * 30) + // Large increase if offensive security user agent used
    ($suspicious_principal_hosting_organization_name * 15) + // Small increase if suspicious principal hosting organization name
    ($suspicious_principal_hosting_carrier_name * 15) + // Small increase if suspicious principal hosting carrier name
    ($suspicious_principal_hosting_dns_domain * 15) + // Small increase if suspicious principal hosting dns domain
    (if($unique_event_type_count >= 2, 1, 0) * 10) + // Small increase if multiple event types
    (if($count_principal_country >= 2, 1, 0) * 20)  // Moderate increase if multiple event types
    $confidence = if($confidence_score_calculated > 100, 100, $confidence_score_calculated)
    $risk_score_calculated = 10 +
    ($high_risk_account * 20) + // Small increase if azure elevated risk level
    ($azure_elevated_risk_level * 20) + // Small increase if azure elevated risk level
    ($azure_elevated_risk_level_during_signin * 20) + // Small increase if azure elevated risk level during signin
    ($azure_elevated_risk_state * 20) + // Small increase if azure elevated risk state
    (if(arrays.join_string($aws_mfa_authentication, ",") = "false" nocase, 1, 0) * 20) // Small increase if aws not mfa authenticated
    $risk_score_temp = if($detection_contains_threat_emulation_software > 0, 0, $risk_score_calculated)
    $risk_score = if($risk_score_temp > 100, 100, $risk_score_temp)
    $max_producer_severity = max(
      if(strings.to_lower($producer_severity) = "critical", 6, 0) +
      if(strings.to_lower($producer_severity) = "high", 5, 0) +
      if(strings.to_lower($producer_severity) = "medium", 4, 0) +
      if(strings.to_lower($producer_severity) = "low", 3, 0) +
      if(strings.to_lower($producer_severity) = /info/, 2, 0) +
      if(strings.to_lower($producer_severity) = "none", 1, 0)
    )
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.vendor_name)
    $result = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.action)
    $product_name = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.product_name)
    $result_time = min($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $principal_resource_names = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.resource.name)
  condition:
    $wildcard and $rule_name_count >= 3 and $confidence >= 52
}

rule c_visual_basic_and_deobfuscatedecode_files_or_information {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Visual Basic and Deobfuscate/Decode Files or Information"
    description = "Detects Visual Basic and Deobfuscate/Decode Files or Information events occurring in close proximity."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059.005"

  events:
    $c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"] = /T1059\.005|T1140/
    $c1.detection.detection.rule_name = /./ nocase
    $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.asset_id != ""
    $producer_severity = $c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["severity"] // Using rule_labels for severity
    $rule_category = $c1.detection.detection.outcomes["rule_category"]
    $asset_type = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.asset.type
    $event_type = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.event_type
    $threat_verdict = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict
    $cert_status = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status
    $target_file_path = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.full_path // For file checks
    $principal_users_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.userid
    $target_actors_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.userid
    $principal_processes_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_processes_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.process.file.full_path
    $principal_files_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.file.full_path
    $target_files_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.full_path
    $principal_command_lines_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.process.command_line
    $target_command_lines_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.process.command_line
    $hostname_match = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.hostname
    $third_party_threat_names = strings.coalesce($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.threat_name, $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.rule_name)

  match:
    $hostname_match over 3h

  outcome:
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.product_name)
    $platform = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.platform)
    $unique_third_party_names = array_distinct($third_party_threat_names)

    $rule_names = arrays.concat(array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_name), array_distinct($third_party_threat_names))
    $rule_name_count = count_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_name)
    $rule_set_category_names = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name)
    $rule_set_display_names = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_set_display_name)

    $principal_users = array_distinct($principal_users_src)
    $target_actors = array_distinct($target_actors_src)
    $principal_processes = array_distinct($principal_processes_src)
    $target_processes = array_distinct($target_processes_src)
    $principal_files = array_distinct($principal_files_src)
    $target_files = array_distinct($target_files_src)
    $principal_command_lines = array_distinct($principal_command_lines_src)
    $target_command_lines = array_distinct($target_command_lines_src)

    $unique_mitre_technique_count = count_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"])
    $unique_mitre_tactic_count = count_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"])
    $mitre_tactics = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"])
    $mitre_techniques = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"])

    $unique_event_types = array_distinct($event_type)
    $unique_event_type_count = arrays.size($unique_event_types)
    $result_time = min($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.id)
    $detection_contains_vt_malicious = max(if($threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0))
    $detection_contains_server = max(if($asset_type = "SERVER", 1, 0))
    $detection_contains_network_connection = max(if($event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION", 1, 0))
    $detection_contains_privileged_account = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string(arrays.concat($principal_users,$target_actors), "|"), /(SYSTEM|Admin|root|S-1-5-18)/ ) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_threat_emulation_software = if(
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($principal_processes, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($target_processes, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($principal_files, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($target_files, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($principal_command_lines, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($target_command_lines, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($principal_users, "|"), /(picusendpoint)/) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string(array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.ingestion_labels["replayedFrom"])), /demoverse/) nocase),
      1, 0) // Returns 1 if any check is true, 0 otherwise
    $risk_score_calculated = 10 +
    ($detection_contains_server * 30) + // Substantial increase if server
    ($detection_contains_privileged_account * 20) + // Major increase if privileged account
    ($detection_contains_network_connection * 40) // Moderate increase if network connection
    $risk_score_temp = if($detection_contains_threat_emulation_software > 0, 0, $risk_score_calculated)
    $risk_score = if($risk_score_temp > 100, 100, $risk_score_temp)
    $result = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.action)
    $detection_rule_ids = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_id)
    $detection_contains_ati = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Applied Threat Intelligence - Curated Prioritization/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_ueba = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Risk Analytics for UEBA/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_3p = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_names, "|"), /(mdatp |CrowdStrike EDR|Sentinelone Threats| - CoreLight|forescout|AWS GuardDuty:|Azure Defender for Cloud:|SCC: |MDE Graph)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_customer_live_rule = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($detection_rule_ids, "|"), /ru_/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_hunting_rule_pack = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Mandiant Hunting Rules/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_methodology_curated_detection = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /(Windows|Linux|MacOS) Threats/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_vt_suspicious = max(if($threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0))
    $target_files_sha256 = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.sha256)
    $target_processes_sha256 = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.process.file.sha256)
    $principal_processes_sha256 = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.process.file.sha256)

    $principal_hostnames = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.hostname)
    $asset_id = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.asset_id)

  condition:
    $c1 and $unique_mitre_technique_count >= 2 and arrays.contains($mitre_techniques, "T1059.005")
}

    $detection_contains_server = max(if($asset_type = "SERVER", 1, 0))

      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($target_processes, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or

      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($principal_command_lines, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($target_command_lines, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string(array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.ingestion_labels["replayedFrom"])), /demoverse/) nocase),
      1, 0) // Returns 1 if any check is true, 0 otherwise

    $detection_contains_vt_suspicious = max(if($threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0))
    $detection_contains_invalid_cert = max(if(re.regex($cert_status, /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ ), 1, 0)) // max(boolean) pattern
    $confidence_calc = 10 +
    ($sum_of_detection_methodologies * 5) +  // Max ~30 points
    ($rule_name_count * 4) +    // Moderate increase for rules beyond minimum count (Max depends on rule count)
    ($detection_contains_vt_malicious * 30) // Large increase for VT Malicious

    ($detection_contains_server * 30) + // Large increase if server
    ($detection_contains_privileged_account * 20) + // Large increase if privileged account

  condition:
    $wildcard and $rule_name_count > 2 and $confidence < 50 and $sum_of_detection_methodologies > 1

    $hostname_match = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.hostname

  match:
    $hostname_match over 3h

    $target_files_sha256 = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.sha256)
    $target_processes_sha256 = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.process.file.sha256)

  condition:
    $c1 and $unique_mitre_technique_count >= 3 and $unique_mitre_tactic_count >= 2 and $discovery_rule_count >= 2

rule c_chrome_multiple_suspicious_downloads_on_same_host {

    $hostname = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.hostname
    $is_admin_user = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.attribute.labels["is_admin"]

    $product_name = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.product_name)

    $detection_contains_ati = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($c1.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name, ""), /ATI.*/), 1, 0))
    $detection_contains_3p = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($c1.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name, ""), /Third Party.*/), 1, 0))
    $detection_contains_methodology_curated_detection = max(if($c1.detection.detection.rule_set_display_name = "Methodology Curated Detections", 1, 0))
    $detection_contains_hunting_rule_pack = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($c1.detection.detection.rule_set_display_name, ""), /Hunting Rulepack.*/), 1, 0))
    $detection_contains_customer_live_rule = max(if($rule_type = "CUSTOMER_LIVE_RULE", 1, 0))

    $unique_event_types = array_distinct($event_type)
    $unique_event_type_count = arrays.size($unique_event_types)
    $result = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.action_details)
    $result_time = min($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_counts = count_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.id)

    $event_urls = array_distinct($event_url)
    $url_categories = array_distinct($url_category)

    $file_paths = array_distinct($file_path)
    $file_types = array_distinct($file_type)
    $sha256file_hashes = array_distinct($sha256file_hash)
    $unique_hash_count = count_distinct($sha256file_hash) - max(if($sha256file_hash = "", 1))
    $threat_verdicts = array_distinct($threat_verdict)
    $gti_file_severities = array_distinct($gti_file_severity)
    $safebrowsing_file_severities = array_distinct($safebrowsing_file_severity)

  condition:
    $c1 and $unique_hash_count > 1
}

rule c_mitre_ttps_persistence_multi_discovery {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Persistence + Multiple Discovery Tactics"
    description = "Detects one Persistence rule detection and multiple Discovery rule detections occurring in close proximity."
    severity = "High"

  events:
    $c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"] = /TA0003|TA0007/
    $c1.detection.detection.rule_name = /./ nocase
    $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.asset_id != ""
    $c1.detection.detection.rule_name != / Spawning / nocase
    $discovery_rule = re.capture($c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"], `TA0007`)
    $producer_severity = $c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["severity"] // Using rule_labels for severity
    $rule_category = $c1.detection.detection.outcomes["rule_category"]
    $asset_type = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.asset.type
    $event_type = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.event_type
    $threat_verdict = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict
    $cert_status = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status
    $target_file_path = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.full_path // For file checks
    $principal_users_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.userid
    $target_actors_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.userid
    $principal_processes_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_processes_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.process.file.full_path
    $principal_files_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.file.full_path
    $target_files_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.full_path
    $principal_command_lines_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.process.command_line
    $target_command_lines_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.process.command_line
    $hostname_match = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.hostname
    $third_party_threat_names = strings.coalesce($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.threat_name, $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.rule_name)

  match:
    $hostname_match over 3h

  outcome:
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.product_name)
    $platform = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.platform)
    $unique_third_party_names = array_distinct($third_party_threat_names)

    $rule_names = arrays.concat(array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_name), array_distinct($third_party_threat_names))
    $rule_name_count = count_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_name)
    $result = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.action)
    $rule_set_category_names = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name)
    $rule_set_display_names = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_set_display_name)

    $principal_users = array_distinct($principal_users_src)
    $target_actors = array_distinct($target_actors_src)
    $principal_processes = array_distinct($principal_processes_src)
    $target_processes = array_distinct($target_processes_src)
    $principal_files = array_distinct($principal_files_src)
    $target_files = array_distinct($target_files_src)
    $principal_command_lines = array_distinct($principal_command_lines_src)
    $target_command_lines = array_distinct($target_command_lines_src)

    $unique_mitre_technique_count = count_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"])
    $unique_mitre_tactic_count = count_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"])
    $mitre_tactics = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"])
    $mitre_techniques = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"])
    $discovery_rule_count = count($discovery_rule)

    $unique_event_types = array_distinct($event_type)
    $unique_event_type_count = arrays.size($unique_event_types)
    $result_time = min($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.id)
    $detection_contains_vt_malicious = max(if($threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0))
    $detection_contains_server = max(if($asset_type = "SERVER", 1, 0))
    $detection_contains_network_connection = max(if($event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION", 1, 0))
    $detection_contains_privileged_account = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string(arrays.concat($principal_users,$target_actors), "|"), /(SYSTEM|Admin|root|S-1-5-18)/ ) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_threat_emulation_software = if(
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($principal_processes, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($target_processes, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($principal_files, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($target_files, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($principal_command_lines, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($target_command_lines, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($principal_users, "|"), /(picusendpoint)/) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string(array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.ingestion_labels["replayedFrom"])), /demoverse/) nocase),
      1, 0) // Returns 1 if any check is true, 0 otherwise
    $soc_confidence_modifier = 65 // Major increase if MD SOC confidence is High
    $risk_score_calculated = 10 +
    $soc_confidence_modifier +
    ($detection_contains_server * 30) + // Substantial increase if server
    ($detection_contains_privileged_account * 20) + // Moderate increase if privileged account
    ($detection_contains_network_connection * 40) // Major increase if network connection
    $risk_score_temp = if($detection_contains_threat_emulation_software > 0, 0, $risk_score_calculated)
    $risk_score = if($risk_score_temp > 100, 100, $risk_score_temp)
    $detection_rule_ids = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_id)
    $detection_contains_ati = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Applied Threat Intelligence - Curated Prioritization/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_ueba = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Risk Analytics for UEBA/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_3p = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_names, "|"), /(mdatp |CrowdStrike EDR|Sentinelone Threats| - CoreLight|forescout|AWS GuardDuty:|Azure Defender for Cloud:|SCC: |MDE Graph)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_customer_live_rule = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($detection_rule_ids, "|"), /ru_/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_hunting_rule_pack = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Mandiant Hunting Rules/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_methodology_curated_detection = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /(Windows|Linux|MacOS) Threats/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_vt_suspicious = max(if($threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0))
    $target_files_sha256 = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.sha256)
    $target_processes_sha256 = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.process.file.sha256)
    $principal_processes_sha256 = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.process.file.sha256)

    $principal_hostnames = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.hostname)
    $asset_id = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.asset_id)

  condition:
    $c1 and $unique_mitre_technique_count >= 3 and $unique_mitre_tactic_count >= 2 and $discovery_rule_count >= 2
}

rules.display_name: High Severity Chrome Detection Cluster by Account and Extension
rules.text:
rule c_chrome_unordered_wildcard_cluster_by_account_and_extension_high {
  meta:
    rule_name = "High Severity Chrome Detection Cluster by Account and Extension"
    description = "Detects chrome extensions exhibiting multiple distinct detection rules and event types over a 30 minute period. Confidence and risk levels are determined by specific characteristics of those detections. Organizations may need to consider exceptions on internal extensions."
    severity = "High"

  events:
    $wildcard.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name = /Chrome Enterprise Premium Threats/ nocase
    $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_name = /Extension/ nocase
    $severity = $wildcard.detection.detection.severity
    $customer_severity = $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["severity"]
    $mitre_tactic = $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"]
    $mitre_technique = $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"]
    $account_id = strings.to_lower($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $event_type = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.event_type
    $ext_id = strings.coalesce($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.resource_ancestors.product_object_id, $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.extracted.fields["extension_id"])
    $trigger_type = strings.coalesce($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.extracted.fields["trigger_type"], $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.resource.attribute.labels["trigger_type"])

  match:
    $account_id, $ext_id over 30m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 85
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.product_name)
    $platform = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.platform)
    $result_time = min($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $result = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.action)

    $rule_names = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_name)
    $rule_name_count = count_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_name)
    $detection_rule_ids = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_id)
    $rule_set_category_names = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name)
    $rule_set_display_names = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_set_display_name)
    $detection_contains_ati = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Applied Threat Intelligence - Curated Prioritization/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_ueba = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Risk Analytics for UEBA/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_3p = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_names, "|"), /(mdatp |CrowdStrike EDR|Sentinelone Threats| - CoreLight|forescout|AWS GuardDuty:|Azure Defender for Cloud:|SCC: |MDE Graph)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_customer_live_rule = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_names, "|"), /_/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_hunting_rule_pack = if(arrays.join_string($rule_names, ",") = /hunting activity cluster/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_methodology_curated_detection = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /(Windows|Linux|MacOS) Threats/) nocase, 1, 0)

    $principal_users = array_distinct($account_id)
    $unique_event_types = array_distinct($event_type)
    $unique_event_type_count = count_distinct($event_type)
    $extension_name = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.resource_ancestors.name)
    $extension_id = array_distinct($ext_id)
    $ext_version = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.resource_ancestors.attribute.labels["extension_version"])
    $ext_source = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.resource_ancestors.attribute.labels["extension_source"])
    $target_action = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.resource.name)
    $target_methods = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.resource.attribute.labels["tabs_api_method"])
    $target_source = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.resource.attribute.labels["source"])
    $target_url = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.url)
    $target_hostname = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.hostname)

    $security_result_rule_name = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.rule_name)
    $security_result_category = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.category)
    $transfer_method = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.extracted.fields["transfer_method"])
    $trigger_types = array_distinct($trigger_type)
    $target_full_paths = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.full_path)
    $target_file_sizes = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.size)
    $target_mime_types = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.mime_type)

    $unique_mitre_technique_count = count_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"])
    $unique_mitre_tactic_count = count_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"])
    $mitre_tactics = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"])
    $mitre_techniques = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"])

    $detection_contains_stolen_cookies = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_names, ","), /Chrome Extension Accessing Session Cookies/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_tab_capture = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_names, ","), /Capturing Visible Tab/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_sensitive_data_transfer = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_names, ","), /Sensitive Data Transferred/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_sideloaded_extension = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_names, ","), /Extension Installed from External Source/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $confidence_calc = 10 +
    ($rule_name_count * 10) +
    ($detection_contains_sideloaded_extension * 10) +
    ($detection_contains_tab_capture * 10) +
    ($detection_contains_stolen_cookies * 25) +
    ($detection_contains_sensitive_data_transfer * 25)
    $confidence = if($confidence_calc > 100, 100, $confidence_calc)

  condition:
    $wildcard and $rule_name_count > 1 and $confidence >= 80
}

rules.text:
rule c_endpoint_unordered_wildcard_on_rulename_grouped_by_principal_hostname_critical {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Critical Severity Endpoint Detection Cluster on Host"
    description = "Detects endpoints exhibiting multiple distinct detection rules over an 15 minute period. Confidence and risk levels are determined by specific characteristics of those detections."
    severity = "Critical"
    tags = "google.mandiant.recommended"

  events:
    (
      $wildcard.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name != /cloud threats/ nocase and
      $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_set_display_name != /extensions threats/ nocase and
      $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_name != /hunting_endpoint|md_alerts|azure|aws|google|office 365|_o365_|_gw_|okta|duo/ nocase and
      $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.log_type != /azure/ nocase and
      $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.vendor_name != /amazon|google\s/ nocase and
      $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.product_name != /azure|aws/ nocase
    )
    $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_name = /./ nocase
    $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.hostname != ""
    $producer_severity = $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["severity"] // Using rule_labels for severity
    $rule_category = $wildcard.detection.detection.outcomes["rule_category"]
    $asset_type = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.asset.type
    $event_type = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.event_type
    $threat_verdict = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict
    $cert_status = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status
    $target_file_path = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.full_path // For file checks
    $principal_users_src = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.userid
    $target_actors_src = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.userid
    $principal_processes_src = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.process.file.full_path
    $principal_processes_sha256hash = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.process.file.sha256
    $target_processes_src = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.process.file.full_path
    $target_processes_sha256hash = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.process.file.sha256
    $principal_files_src = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.file.full_path
    $target_files_src = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.full_path
    $target_files_sha256hash = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.sha256
    $principal_command_lines_src = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.process.command_line
    $target_command_lines_src = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.process.command_line
    $hostname = strings.to_lower(re.capture($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.hostname, "^[^.]+"))
    $third_party_threat_names = strings.coalesce($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.threat_name, $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.rule_name)

  match:
    $hostname over 15m

  outcome:
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.product_name)
    $platform = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.platform)
    $result_time = min($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $result = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.action)
    $unique_third_party_names = array_distinct($third_party_threat_names)

    $rule_names = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_name)
    $rule_name_count = count_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_name)
    $detection_rule_ids = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_id)
    $rule_set_category_names = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name)
    $rule_set_display_names = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_set_display_name)

    $asset_id = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.asset_id)
    $principal_users = array_distinct($principal_users_src)
    $target_actors = array_distinct($target_actors_src)
    $principal_processes = array_distinct($principal_processes_src)
    $principal_processes_sha256 = array_distinct($principal_processes_sha256hash)
    $target_processes = array_distinct($target_processes_src)
    $target_processes_sha256 = array_distinct($target_processes_sha256hash)
    $principal_files = array_distinct($principal_files_src)
    $target_files = array_distinct($target_files_src)
    $target_files_sha256 = array_distinct($target_files_sha256hash)
    $principal_command_lines = array_distinct($principal_command_lines_src)
    $target_command_lines = array_distinct($target_command_lines_src)

    $victim_uid = array_distinct($hostname)
    $unique_mitre_technique_count = count_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"])
    $unique_mitre_tactic_count = count_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"])
    $mitre_tactics = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"])
    $mitre_techniques = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"])

    $event_count = count_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.id)
    $unique_event_types = array_distinct($event_type)
    $unique_event_type_count = arrays.size($unique_event_types)
    $detection_contains_ati = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Applied Threat Intelligence - Curated Prioritization/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_ueba = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Risk Analytics for UEBA/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_3p = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, "|"), /(Vendor Alerts|Third Party Vendor Passthrough Rules)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_customer_live_rule = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($detection_rule_ids, "|"), /ru_/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_hunting_rule_pack = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Mandiant Hunting Rules/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_methodology_curated_detection = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /(Windows|Linux|MacOS) Threats/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $sum_of_detection_methodologies = $detection_contains_ati + $detection_contains_ueba + $detection_contains_3p + $detection_contains_customer_live_rule + $detection_contains_hunting_rule_pack + $detection_contains_methodology_curated_detection
    $detection_contains_vt_malicious = max(if($threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0))
    $detection_contains_server = max(if($asset_type = "SERVER", 1, 0))
    $detection_contains_network_connection = max(if($event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION", 1, 0))
    $detection_contains_privileged_account = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string(arrays.concat($principal_users,$target_actors), "|"), /(SYSTEM|Admin|root|S-1-5-18)/ ) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_threat_emulation_software = if(
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($principal_processes, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($target_processes, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($target_files, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($principal_command_lines, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($target_command_lines, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string(array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.ingestion_labels["replayedFrom"])), /demoverse/) nocase),
      1, 0) // Returns 1 if any check is true, 0 otherwise

    $detection_contains_vt_suspicious = max(if($threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0))
    $detection_contains_invalid_cert = max(if(re.regex($cert_status, /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ ), 1, 0)) // max(boolean) pattern
    $confidence_calc = 10 +
    ($sum_of_detection_methodologies * 5) +  // Max ~30 points
    ($rule_name_count * 4) +    // Moderate increase for rules beyond minimum count (Max depends on rule count)
    ($detection_contains_vt_malicious * 30) // Large increase for VT Malicious
    $confidence = if($confidence_calc > 100, 100, $confidence_calc)

    $risk_score_calculated = 10 +
    ($detection_contains_server * 30) + // Large increase if server
    ($detection_contains_privileged_account * 20) + // Major increase if privileged account
    ($detection_contains_network_connection * 40) // Moderate increase if network connection

    $risk_score_temp = if($detection_contains_threat_emulation_software > 0, 0, $risk_score_calculated)
    $risk_score = if($risk_score_temp > 100, 100, $risk_score_temp)

  condition:
    $wildcard and $rule_name_count > 2 and $confidence >= 90
}

    severity = "Medium"

  events:
    (
      $wildcard.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name != /cloud threats/ nocase and

    $principal_processes_sha256hash = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.process.file.sha256
    $target_processes_src = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.process.file.full_path
    $target_processes_sha256hash = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.process.file.sha256
    $principal_files_src = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.file.full_path

    $mitre_techniques = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"])

    $detection_contains_ati = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Applied Threat Intelligence - Curated Prioritization/) nocase, 1, 0)

    $sum_of_detection_methodologies = $detection_contains_ati + $detection_contains_ueba + $detection_contains_3p + $detection_contains_customer_live_rule + $detection_contains_hunting_rule_pack + $detection_contains_methodology_curated_detection
    $detection_contains_vt_malicious = max(if($threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0))

    $detection_contains_network_connection = max(if($event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION", 1, 0))

      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($principal_processes, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($target_processes, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($target_files, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($principal_command_lines, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($target_command_lines, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string(array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.ingestion_labels["replayedFrom"])), /demoverse/) nocase),

    $detection_contains_vt_suspicious = max(if($threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0))
    $detection_contains_invalid_cert = max(if(re.regex($cert_status, /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ ), 1, 0)) // max(boolean) pattern
    $confidence_calc = 10 +
    ($sum_of_detection_methodologies * 5) +  // Max ~30 points
    ($rule_name_count * 4) +    // Moderate increase for rules beyond minimum count (Max depends on rule count)
    ($detection_contains_vt_malicious * 30) // Large increase for VT Malicious
    $confidence = if($confidence_calc > 100, 100, $confidence_calc)

    $risk_score_calculated = 10 +
    ($detection_contains_server * 30) + // Large increase if server
    ($detection_contains_privileged_account * 20) + // Large increase if privileged account
    ($detection_contains_network_connection * 40) // Moderate increase if network connection

    $risk_score_temp = if($detection_contains_threat_emulation_software > 0, 0, $risk_score_calculated)
    $risk_score = if($risk_score_temp > 100, 100, $risk_score_temp)

  condition:
    $wildcard and $rule_name_count > 2 and $confidence >= 50 and $confidence < 80 and $sum_of_detection_methodologies > 1
}

    $principal_users_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.userid
    $target_actors_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.userid
    $principal_processes_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_processes_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.process.file.full_path
    $principal_files_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.file.full_path
    $target_files_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.full_path
    $principal_command_lines_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.process.command_line
    $target_command_lines_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.process.command_line
    $hostname_match = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.hostname
    $third_party_threat_names = strings.coalesce($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.threat_name, $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.rule_name)

  match:
    $hostname_match over 30m

  outcome:
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.product_name)
    $platform = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.platform)
    $unique_third_party_names = array_distinct($third_party_threat_names)

    $rule_names = arrays.concat(array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_name), array_distinct($third_party_threat_names))
    $rule_name_count = count_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_name)
    $rule_set_category_names = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name)
    $rule_set_display_names = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_set_display_name)

    $principal_users = array_distinct($principal_users_src)
    $target_actors = array_distinct($target_actors_src)
    $principal_processes = array_distinct($principal_processes_src)
    $target_processes = array_distinct($target_processes_src)
    $principal_files = array_distinct($principal_files_src)
    $target_files = array_distinct($target_files_src)
    $principal_command_lines = array_distinct($principal_command_lines_src)
    $target_command_lines = array_distinct($target_command_lines_src)

    $unique_mitre_technique_count = count_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"])
    $unique_mitre_tactic_count = count_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"])
    $mitre_tactics = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"])
    $mitre_techniques = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"])

    $unique_event_types = array_distinct($event_type)
    $unique_event_type_count = arrays.size($unique_event_types)
    $result_time = min($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.id)
    $detection_contains_vt_malicious = max(if($threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0))
    $detection_contains_server = max(if($asset_type = "SERVER", 1, 0))
    $detection_contains_network_connection = max(if($event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION", 1, 0))
    $detection_contains_privileged_account = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string(arrays.concat($principal_users,$target_actors), "|"), /(SYSTEM|Admin|root|S-1-5-18)/ ) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_threat_emulation_software = if(
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($principal_processes, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($target_processes, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($principal_files, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($target_files, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($principal_command_lines, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($target_command_lines, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($principal_users, "|"), /(picusendpoint)/) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string(array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.ingestion_labels["replayedFrom"])), /demoverse/) nocase),
      1, 0) // Returns 1 if any check is true, 0 otherwise
    $risk_score_calculated = 10 +
    ($detection_contains_server * 30) + // Substantial increase if server
    ($detection_contains_privileged_account * 20) + // Major increase if privileged account
    ($detection_contains_network_connection * 40) // Moderate increase if network connection
    $risk_score_temp = if($detection_contains_threat_emulation_software > 0, 0, $risk_score_calculated)
    $risk_score = if($risk_score_temp > 100, 100, $risk_score_temp)
    $result = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.action)
    $detection_rule_ids = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_id)
    $detection_contains_ati = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Applied Threat Intelligence - Curated Prioritization/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_ueba = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Risk Analytics for UEBA/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_3p = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_names, "|"), /(mdatp |CrowdStrike EDR|Sentinelone Threats| - CoreLight|forescout|AWS GuardDuty:|Azure Defender for Cloud:|SCC: |MDE Graph)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_customer_live_rule = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($detection_rule_ids, "|"), /ru_/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_hunting_rule_pack = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Mandiant Hunting Rules/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_methodology_curated_detection = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /(Windows|Linux|MacOS) Threats/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_vt_suspicious = max(if($threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0))
    $target_files_sha256 = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.sha256)
    $target_processes_sha256 = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.process.file.sha256)
    $principal_processes_sha256 = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.process.file.sha256)

    $principal_hostnames = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.hostname)
    $asset_id = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.asset_id)

  condition:
    $c1 and $unique_mitre_tactic_count >= 2 and $detection_contains_server = 1
}

rule c_chrome_suspicious_downloads_with_matching_hashes_on_multiple_hosts {

    description = "Composite Alert which detects download events such as dangerous downloads or files found suspicious by Google Threat Intelligence by multiple hosts with the same hash in Chrome Management over an hour time period. This may be an early indicator of lateral movement attempts, phishing campaigns or other means for initial access or post exploitation."
    severity = "Medium"

    $hostname = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.hostname

  match:
    $sha256file_hash over 1h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.product_name)
    $platform = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.platform)
    $hostnames = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.hostname)
    $host_count = count_distinct($hostname)
    $principal_users = array_distinct($victim_name)
    $victim_names = array_distinct($victim_name)
    $victim_assets = array_distinct($victim_asset)
    $detection_id_count = count_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_id)

    $unique_rule_categories = count_distinct($rule_category)
    $rule_set_category_names = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name)
    $rule_set_display_names = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_set_display_name)
    $rule_names = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_name)
    $detection_rule_ids = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_id)
    $rule_name_count = count_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_name)

    $mitre_tactics = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"])
    $mitre_techniques = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"])

    $detection_contains_ati = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($c1.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name, ""), /ATI.*/), 1, 0))
    $detection_contains_3p = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($c1.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name, ""), /Third Party.*/), 1, 0))
    $detection_contains_methodology_curated_detection = max(if($c1.detection.detection.rule_set_display_name = "Methodology Curated Detections", 1, 0))
    $detection_contains_hunting_rule_pack = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($c1.detection.detection.rule_set_display_name, ""), /Hunting Rulepack.*/), 1, 0))
    $detection_contains_customer_live_rule = max(if($rule_type = "CUSTOMER_LIVE_RULE", 1, 0))

    $unique_event_types = array_distinct($event_type)
    $unique_event_type_count = arrays.size($unique_event_types)
    $result = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.action_details)

  condition:

rule c_chrome_unordered_wildcard_cluster_by_account_and_extension_medium {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Medium Severity Chrome Detection Cluster by Account and Extension"
    description = "Detects chrome extensions exhibiting multiple distinct detection rules and event types over a 30 minute period. Confidence and risk levels are determined by specific characteristics of those detections."
    severity = "Medium"

  events:
    $wildcard.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name = /Chrome Enterprise Premium Threats/ nocase
    $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_name = /Extension/ nocase
    $severity = $wildcard.detection.detection.severity
    $customer_severity = $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["severity"]
    $mitre_tactic = $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"]
