    $ext_id = strings.coalesce($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.resource_ancestors.product_object_id, $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.extracted.fields["extension_id"])
    $trigger_type = strings.coalesce($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.extracted.fields["trigger_type"], $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.resource.attribute.labels["trigger_type"])

  match:
    $account_id, $ext_id over 30m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.product_name)
    $platform = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.platform)
    $result_time = min($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $result = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.action)

    $rule_names = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_name)
    $rule_name_count = count_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_name)
    $detection_rule_ids = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_id)
    $rule_set_category_names = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name)
    $rule_set_display_names = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_set_display_name)
    $detection_contains_ati = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Applied Threat Intelligence - Curated Prioritization/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_ueba = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Risk Analytics for UEBA/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_3p = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_names, "|"), /(mdatp |CrowdStrike EDR|Sentinelone Threats| - CoreLight|forescout|AWS GuardDuty:|Azure Defender for Cloud:|SCC: |MDE Graph)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_customer_live_rule = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_names, "|"), /_/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_hunting_rule_pack = if(arrays.join_string($rule_names, ",") = /hunting activity cluster/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_methodology_curated_detection = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /(Windows|Linux|MacOS) Threats/) nocase, 1, 0)

    $principal_users = array_distinct($account_id)
    $unique_event_types = array_distinct($event_type)
    $unique_event_type_count = count_distinct($event_type)
    $extension_name = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.resource_ancestors.name)
    $extension_id = array_distinct($ext_id)
    $ext_version = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.resource_ancestors.attribute.labels["extension_version"])
    $ext_source = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.resource_ancestors.attribute.labels["extension_source"])
    $target_action = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.resource.name)
    $target_methods = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.resource.attribute.labels["tabs_api_method"])
    $target_source = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.resource.attribute.labels["source"])
    $target_url = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.url)
    $target_hostname = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.hostname)

    $security_result_rule_name = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.rule_name)
    $security_result_category = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.category)
    $transfer_method = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.extracted.fields["transfer_method"])
    $trigger_types = array_distinct($trigger_type)
    $target_full_paths = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.full_path)
    $target_file_sizes = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.size)
    $target_mime_types = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.mime_type)

    $unique_mitre_technique_count = count_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"])
    $unique_mitre_tactic_count = count_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"])
    $mitre_tactics = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"])
    $mitre_techniques = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"])

    $detection_contains_stolen_cookies = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_names, ","), /Chrome Extension Accessing Session Cookies/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_tab_capture = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_names, ","), /Capturing Visible Tab/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_sensitive_data_transfer = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_names, ","), /Sensitive Data Transferred/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_sideloaded_extension = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_names, ","), /Extension Installed from External Source/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $confidence_calc = 10 +
    ($rule_name_count * 10) +
    ($detection_contains_sideloaded_extension * 10) +
    ($detection_contains_tab_capture * 10) +
    ($detection_contains_stolen_cookies * 25) +
    ($detection_contains_sensitive_data_transfer * 25)
    $confidence = if($confidence_calc > 100, 100, $confidence_calc)

  condition:
    $wildcard and $rule_name_count > 1 and $confidence >= 50 and $confidence < 80
}

rule c_endpoint_unordered_wildcard_on_rulename_grouped_by_principal_hostname_high {

    description = "Detects endpoints exhibiting multiple distinct detection rules over a 15 minute period. Confidence and risk levels are determined by specific characteristics of those detections."
    severity = "High"
    tags = "google.mandiant.recommended"

  events:
    (
      $wildcard.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name != /cloud threats/ nocase and
      $wildcard.detection.detection.rule_set_display_name != /extensions threats/ nocase and

    $target_actors_src = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.userid
    $principal_processes_src = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.process.file.full_path
    $principal_processes_sha256hash = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.process.file.sha256
    $target_processes_src = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.process.file.full_path
    $target_processes_sha256hash = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.process.file.sha256
    $principal_files_src = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.file.full_path
    $target_files_src = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.full_path
    $target_files_sha256hash = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.sha256
    $principal_command_lines_src = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.process.command_line
    $target_command_lines_src = $wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.process.command_line

    $hostname over 15m

  outcome:

    $product_name = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.product_name)

    $unique_mitre_tactic_count = count_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"])
    $mitre_tactics = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"])
    $mitre_techniques = array_distinct($wildcard.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"])

    $event_count = count_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.id)
    $unique_event_types = array_distinct($event_type)
    $unique_event_type_count = arrays.size($unique_event_types)
    $detection_contains_ati = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Applied Threat Intelligence - Curated Prioritization/) nocase, 1, 0)

    $detection_contains_hunting_rule_pack = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Mandiant Hunting Rules/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_methodology_curated_detection = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /(Windows|Linux|MacOS) Threats/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $sum_of_detection_methodologies = $detection_contains_ati + $detection_contains_ueba + $detection_contains_3p + $detection_contains_customer_live_rule + $detection_contains_hunting_rule_pack + $detection_contains_methodology_curated_detection
    $detection_contains_vt_malicious = max(if($threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0))
    $detection_contains_server = max(if($asset_type = "SERVER", 1, 0))
    $detection_contains_network_connection = max(if($event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION", 1, 0))
    $detection_contains_privileged_account = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string(arrays.concat($principal_users,$target_actors), "|"), /(SYSTEM|Admin|root|S-1-5-18)/ ) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_threat_emulation_software = if(
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($principal_processes, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($target_processes, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($target_files, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($principal_command_lines, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($target_command_lines, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string(array_distinct($wildcard.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.ingestion_labels["replayedFrom"])), /demoverse/) nocase),
      1, 0) // Returns 1 if any check is true, 0 otherwise

    $detection_contains_vt_suspicious = max(if($threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0))
    $detection_contains_invalid_cert = max(if(re.regex($cert_status, /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ ), 1, 0)) // max(boolean) pattern
    $confidence_calc = 10 +
    ($sum_of_detection_methodologies * 5) +  // Max ~30 points
    ($rule_name_count * 4) +    // Moderate increase for rules beyond minimum count (Max depends on rule count)
    ($detection_contains_vt_malicious * 30) // Large increase for VT Malicious
    $confidence = if($confidence_calc > 100, 100, $confidence_calc)

    $risk_score_calculated = 10 +
    ($detection_contains_server * 30) + // Large increase if server
    ($detection_contains_privileged_account * 20) + // Large increase if privileged account
    ($detection_contains_network_connection * 40) // Moderate increase if network connection

    $risk_score_temp = if($detection_contains_threat_emulation_software > 0, 0, $risk_score_calculated)
    $risk_score = if($risk_score_temp > 100, 100, $risk_score_temp)

  condition:
    $wildcard and $rule_name_count > 2 and $confidence >= 80 and $confidence < 90
}

rule c_external_proxy_and_registry_modification {
  meta:

    technique = "T1090.002"

  events:
    $c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"] = /T1090\.002|T1112/
    $c1.detection.detection.rule_name = /./ nocase
    $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.asset_id != ""
    $producer_severity = $c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["severity"] // Using rule_labels for severity
    $rule_category = $c1.detection.detection.outcomes["rule_category"]

    $event_type = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.event_type
    $threat_verdict = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict
    $cert_status = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status
    $target_file_path = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.full_path // For file checks
    $principal_users_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.user.userid
    $target_actors_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.user.userid
    $principal_processes_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_processes_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.process.file.full_path
    $principal_files_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.file.full_path
    $target_files_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.full_path
    $principal_command_lines_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.process.command_line
    $target_command_lines_src = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.process.command_line
    $hostname_match = $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.hostname
    $third_party_threat_names = strings.coalesce($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.threat_name, $c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.rule_name)

  match:
    $hostname_match over 10m

  outcome:
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.product_name)
    $platform = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.platform)
    $unique_third_party_names = array_distinct($third_party_threat_names)

    $rule_names = arrays.concat(array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_name), array_distinct($third_party_threat_names))
    $rule_name_count = count_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_name)
    $rule_set_category_names = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.ruleset_category_display_name)
    $rule_set_display_names = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_set_display_name)

    $target_actors = array_distinct($target_actors_src)
    $principal_processes = array_distinct($principal_processes_src)
    $target_processes = array_distinct($target_processes_src)
    $principal_files = array_distinct($principal_files_src)
    $target_files = array_distinct($target_files_src)
    $principal_command_lines = array_distinct($principal_command_lines_src)
    $target_command_lines = array_distinct($target_command_lines_src)

    $unique_mitre_technique_count = count_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"])
    $unique_mitre_tactic_count = count_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"])
    $mitre_tactics = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["tactic"])
    $mitre_techniques = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_labels["technique"])

    $unique_event_types = array_distinct($event_type)
    $unique_event_type_count = arrays.size($unique_event_types)
    $result_time = min($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.id)
    $detection_contains_vt_malicious = max(if($threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0))
    $detection_contains_server = max(if($asset_type = "SERVER", 1, 0))
    $detection_contains_network_connection = max(if($event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION", 1, 0))
    $detection_contains_privileged_account = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string(arrays.concat($principal_users,$target_actors), "|"), /(SYSTEM|Admin|root|S-1-5-18)/ ) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_threat_emulation_software = if(
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($principal_processes, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($target_processes, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($principal_files, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($target_files, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($principal_command_lines, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($target_command_lines, "|"), /(verodin_backend\.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq|picus simulation|cymulate)/ ) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string($principal_users, "|"), /(picusendpoint)/) nocase ) or
      ( re.regex(arrays.join_string(array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.metadata.ingestion_labels["replayedFrom"])), /demoverse/) nocase),
      1, 0) // Returns 1 if any check is true, 0 otherwise
    $risk_score_calculated = 10 +
    ($detection_contains_server * 30) + // Substantial increase if server
    ($detection_contains_privileged_account * 20) + // Major increase if privileged account
    ($detection_contains_network_connection * 40) // Moderate increase if network connection
    $risk_score_temp = if($detection_contains_threat_emulation_software > 0, 0, $risk_score_calculated)
    $risk_score = if($risk_score_temp > 100, 100, $risk_score_temp)
    $result = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.security_result.action)
    $detection_rule_ids = array_distinct($c1.detection.detection.rule_id)
    $detection_contains_ati = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Applied Threat Intelligence - Curated Prioritization/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_ueba = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Risk Analytics for UEBA/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_3p = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_names, "|"), /(mdatp |CrowdStrike EDR|Sentinelone Threats| - CoreLight|forescout|AWS GuardDuty:|Azure Defender for Cloud:|SCC: |MDE Graph)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_customer_live_rule = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($detection_rule_ids, "|"), /ru_/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_hunting_rule_pack = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /Mandiant Hunting Rules/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_methodology_curated_detection = if(re.regex(arrays.join_string($rule_set_category_names, ","), /(Windows|Linux|MacOS) Threats/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $detection_contains_vt_suspicious = max(if($threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0))
    $target_files_sha256 = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.file.sha256)
    $target_processes_sha256 = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.target.process.file.sha256)
    $principal_processes_sha256 = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.process.file.sha256)

    $principal_hostnames = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.hostname)
    $asset_id = array_distinct($c1.detection.collection_elements.references.event.principal.asset_id)

  condition:
    $c1 and $unique_mitre_technique_count >= 2 and arrays.contains($mitre_techniques, "T1090.002")
}

rule mal_win_powershell_execution_from_lnk {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Suspicious .LNK File Execution with Powershell Dropping .Bat and .PDF Files"
    description = "APT37 has leveraged shell link binary format files (.LNK) to execute Powershell that drop .PDF and .Bat files to stage and execute DOGCALL malware."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1204.002"
    reference = "https://research.checkpoint.com/2023/chain-reaction-rokrats-missing-link/"

  events:
    $e1.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $e1.principal.process.file.full_path = /explorer/ nocase
    $e1.target.process.file.full_path = /powershell/ nocase
    $e1.target.process.command_line = /\.bat/ nocase

    $bat_file_name = re.capture($e1.target.process.command_line, `(?i)[\\\s]+([^\\]+)\.bat`)
    re.capture($e1.target.process.command_line, `(?i)[\\\s]+([^\\]+)\.bat`) != ""

    $e2.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION"
    $e2.principal.process.command_line = /\.bat/ nocase
    $e2.target.file.full_path = /\.bat/
    $bat_file_name = re.capture($e2.target.file.full_path, `(?i)[\\\s]+([^\\]+)\.bat`)
    re.capture($e2.target.file.full_path, `(?i)[\\\s]+([^\\]+)\.bat`) != ""

    $hostname = $e1.principal.hostname
    $hostname = $e2.principal.hostname

  match:
    $hostname, $bat_file_name over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.product_name)

    $result_time = min($e2.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(if($e2.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e2.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e2.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
  condition:
    $e1 and $e2
}
rules.description: APT37 has leveraged shell link binary format files (.LNK) to execute Powershell that drop .PDF and .Bat files to stage and execute DOGCALL malware.
rules.author: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence

rule ttp_rundll32_openurl {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Rundll32 OpenURL"
    description = "Identifies abuse of rundll32 url.dll for downloading files."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1218.011"

  events:
    (
      $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /rundll32\.exe$/ nocase and
      $e.principal.process.command_line = /url\.dll/ nocase and
      $e.principal.process.command_line = /OpenURL/ nocase and
      $e.principal.process.command_line != /OpenURL\s+https:\/\/support\.lenovo\.com\/docs\// nocase and
      $e.principal.process.command_line != /https:\/\/(store\.steampowered|steamcommunity)\.com/ nocase
    ) or
    (
      $e.target.process.file.full_path = /rundll32\.exe$/ nocase and
      $e.target.process.command_line = /url\.dll/ nocase and
      $e.target.process.command_line = /OpenURL/ nocase and
      $e.target.process.command_line != /OpenURL\s+https:\/\/support\.lenovo\.com\/docs/ nocase and
      $e.target.process.command_line != /https:\/\/(store\.steampowered|steamcommunity)\.com/ nocase
    )

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1

    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $threat_verdict_malicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))
    $recent_compile_time = if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)
    $invalid_cert = if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $system_user_file_write = if($e.principal.user.userid = "system", 1, 0)
    $sus_file_name_architecture = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\[^\/]+(32|64).[^\/.]+$/), 1, 0)
    $single_double_char_filename = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*([^\/]{1,2}.[^\/.]+)$/), 1, 0)
    $double_extensions = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+.[a-zA-Z]{3}.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_file_name = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\d+.[a-zA-Z]{3}$/), 1, 0)
    $common_malicious_file_names = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup\.exe|update\.js|lsass\.dmp|1\.txt|ntds\.dit|logs\.dat|sqlite3\.dll|pass_1234|system\.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $is_archive_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0)
    $is_executable_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0)
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)
    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $recent_compile_time + $system_user_file_write + $sus_file_name_architecture + $common_malicious_file_names + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_filename + $double_extensions + $sus_vt_tags + $all_numbers_file_name + $is_executable_file + $is_archive_file + $invalid_cert
    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e
}

rules.author: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence

rule ttp_okta_offsec_user_agent_activity {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Okta Offsec User Agent Activity"
    description = "Detects unblocked user agent activity from offensive security tools and is a strong indicator of attempted malicious activity."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0042"
    technique = "T1650"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = /okta/ nocase
    $e.security_result.action != "BLOCK"
    $e.network.http.user_agent = /(pentoo|scout-suite|\bkali|scoutsuite|trufflehog|autodiscoverclient|microburst|AADinternals|Stormspotter|ROADtools|Steam-pipe|Monkey365|GraphRunner|SkyArk|Cloudsploit|MFASweep|CloudBrute|CloudEnum|gstrike|gcp_scanner|PurplePanda|Gcphound|Forsetisecurity|gcp_enum|BucketLoot|Trivy|\bPacu|awspx|Slyther|Invictus-|Cloudfox|Prowler)/ nocase
    $e.network.http.user_agent != /fhir-sync-agent/ nocase
    $e.network.http.user_agent != /(\$\{(.+?):-([^}]+)\})/ nocase
    $principal_ip = $e.principal.ip

  match:
    $principal_ip over 4h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 20
    $vendor_name = "Okta"
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.target.user.userid)
    $event_type = array_distinct($e.metadata.event_type)
    $product_event_type = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_event_type)
    $user_agents = array_distinct($e.network.http.user_agent)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.target.ip)
    $result = "success"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)

  condition:
    $e
}

rules.text:
rule ttp_okta_mismatch_between_source_and_response_for_verify_push_request {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Okta Mismatch Between Source And Response For Verify Push Request"
    description = "Detects Okta MFA push authentication anomalies by flagging instances where the device initiating the push request significantly differs from the device used for approval, indicating potential account compromise."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0006"
    technique = "T1621"
    reference = "https://help.okta.com/en-us/content/topics/security/behavior-detection/type-behavior-detection.htm"

  events:
    $e1.metadata.product_name = "Okta"
    $e1.metadata.vendor_name = "Okta"
    $e1.metadata.event_type = "USER_UNCATEGORIZED"
    $e1.metadata.product_event_type = "system.push.send_factor_verify_push"
    $e1.security_result.detection_fields["New Device"] = "POSITIVE"
    $e1.security_result.detection_fields["New IP"] = "POSITIVE"
    $e1.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    $e1.network.parent_session_id = $parent_session_id

    $e2.metadata.product_name = "Okta"
    $e2.metadata.vendor_name = "Okta"
    $e2.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $e2.metadata.product_event_type = "user.authentication.auth_via_mfa"
    $e2.security_result.detection_fields["factor"] = "OKTA_VERIFY_PUSH"
    $e2.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    $e2.network.parent_session_id = $parent_session_id

    $e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds <= $e2.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

  match:
    $parent_session_id over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $vendor_name = "Okta"
    $product_name = "Okta"
    $result = "succeeded"
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e2.target.user.product_object_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e2.target.user.userid)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e2.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e1.target.user.product_object_id)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e1.target.user.userid)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e1.principal.ip)
    $result_time = min($e2.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $e1 and $e2
}

rule ttp_okta_mfa_fatigue_attack {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Okta MFA Fatigue Attack"
    description = "Detects three or more failed Okta multi-factor authentication (MFA) push events from a new IP address followed by a push approval, which may indicate a successful MFA fatigue attack."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0006"
    technique = "T1621"
    reference = "https://help.okta.com/en-us/content/topics/security/behavior-detection/type-behavior-detection.htm"

  events:
    $e1.metadata.product_name = "Okta"
    $e1.metadata.vendor_name = "Okta"
    $e1.metadata.event_type = "USER_UNCATEGORIZED"
    $e1.metadata.product_event_type = "system.push.send_factor_verify_push"
    $e1.network.parent_session_id = $parent_session_id
    $e1.security_result.detection_fields["New IP"] = "POSITIVE"

    $e2.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $e2.metadata.product_event_type = "user.authentication.auth_via_mfa"
    $e2.metadata.product_name = "Okta"
    $e2.metadata.vendor_name = "Okta"
    $e2.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    $e2.security_result.detection_fields["factor"] = "OKTA_VERIFY_PUSH"
    $e2.network.parent_session_id = $parent_session_id

    $e2.principal.ip != $e1.principal.ip
    $e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds <= $e2.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    (
      not $e2.network.http.user_agent = /^PAN GlobalProtect\/|^Windows-AzureAD-Authentication-Provider\/1.0$/ nocase and
      not $e1.network.http.user_agent = /^PAN GlobalProtect\// nocase
    )

  match:
    $parent_session_id over 10m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $push_count = count_distinct($e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $vendor_name = "Okta"
    $product_name = "Okta"
    $result = "succeeded"
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e2.target.user.product_object_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e2.target.user.userid)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e2.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e1.target.user.product_object_id)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e1.target.user.userid)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e1.principal.ip)
    $result_time = min($e2.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $e2 and $e1 and $push_count >= 3
}
rules.description: Detects three or more failed Okta multi-factor authentication (MFA) push events from a new IP address followed by a push approval, which may indicate a successful MFA fatigue attack.

      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "user.session.start" or
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "user.authentication.auth_via_mfa" or
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "user.authentication.sso"
    )
    (
      $e.security_result.outcomes["New_Device"] = "POSITIVE" or

    $security_summary = array_distinct($e.security_result.summary)

rule ttp_okta_credential_modifications_from_anomalous_ip {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Okta Credential Modifications from Anomalous IP"
    description = "Detects when an Okta user makes modifications to their credentials or MFA factors while logged in from an anomalous IP."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1556.006"

  events:
    $e.metadata.product_name = "Okta"
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Okta"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = /^user\.mfa\.factor\.activate|^user\.mfa\.factor\.deactivate|^user\.account\.reset_password|^user\.session\.start$|^device\.user\.add$/
    $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    not re.regex(any $e.principal.user.email_addresses, re.capture($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.dns_domain, /^.(.*$)/))
    $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.organization_name = /./
    $ip_network_name = $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.organization_name
    $e.principal.ip = $principal_ip
    $e.principal.user.userid = $userid

  match:
    $principal_ip,$userid over 2h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $vendor_name = "Okta"
    $product_name = "Okta"
    $days_success = max(metrics.auth_attempts_success(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:first_seen,
        agg:min,
        target.user.userid:$userid,
        principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.organization_name:$ip_network_name))
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.product_object_id)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $dc_event_types = count_distinct($e.metadata.product_event_type)

  condition:
    $e and $dc_event_types >= 3 and $days_success = 0
}

rule ttp_okta_infeasible_travel_between_logins {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Okta Infeasible Travel Between Logins"
    description = "Detects a successful Okta login where the Velocity behavior type condition is met involving a new device and a new country or state, indicating the geographic distance and time elapsed between two successive sign-ins was determined to be infeasible."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0001"
    technique = "T1078.004"
    reference = "https://help.okta.com/en-us/content/topics/security/behavior-detection/type-behavior-detection.htm"

  events:
    $e.metadata.product_name = "Okta"
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Okta"
    $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "user.authentication.auth_via_mfa"
    $e.security_result.detection_fields["Velocity"] = "POSITIVE"
    $e.security_result.detection_fields["New Device"] = "POSITIVE"
    $e.security_result.detection_fields["New Country"] = "POSITIVE"
    $e.principal.user.userid != "portal.monitor"
    $e.network.http.user_agent != "libwww-perl/6.53"
    $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region != $e.principal.user.personal_address.country_or_region
    $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region != $e.principal.user.office_address.country_or_region
    (
      $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region != "United States" or
      (
        $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region = "United States" and
        $e.principal.user.personal_address.country_or_region != "US" and
        $e.principal.user.office_address.country_or_region != "US"
      )
    )
    (
      $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region != "United Kingdom" or
      (
        $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region = "United Kingdom" and
        $e.principal.user.personal_address.country_or_region != "GB" and
        $e.principal.user.office_address.country_or_region != "GB"
      )
    )
    (
      $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region != "South Korea" or
      (
        $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region = "South Korea" and
        $e.principal.user.personal_address.country_or_region != "KR" and
        $e.principal.user.office_address.country_or_region != "KR"
      )
    )
    (
      $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region != "Bulgaria" or
      (
        $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region = "Bulgaria" and
        $e.principal.user.personal_address.country_or_region != "BG" and
        $e.principal.user.office_address.country_or_region != "BG"
      )
    )
    (
      $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region != "Taiwan" or
      (
        $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region = "Taiwan" and
        $e.principal.user.personal_address.country_or_region != "TW" and
        $e.principal.user.office_address.country_or_region != "TW"
      )
    )
    $country_code = strings.to_upper(re.capture($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region, `^(..)`))
    $e.principal.user.office_address.country_or_region != $country_code
    $e.principal.user.personal_address.country_or_region != $country_code
    $e.principal.ip = $principal_ip
    $e.principal.user.userid = $principal_userid

  match:
    $principal_userid over 12h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $vendor_name = "Okta"
    $product_name = "Okta"
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $unique_asns = count_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.asn)
    $unique_browsers = count_distinct($e.network.http.parsed_user_agent.browser)
    $unique_states = count_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.state)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.target.user.product_object_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.target.user.userid)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $e
}

rules.text:
rule ttp_okta_user_rejected_multiple_push_notifications {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Okta User Rejected Multiple Push Notifications"
    description = "Detects when an Okta user rejects two or more Push notifications in a 10 minute window, which may indicate compromised Okta credentials and an attempted MFA fatigue attack."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0006"
    technique = "T1621"

  events:
    $e.metadata.product_name = "Okta"
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Okta"
    (
      (
        $e.metadata.product_event_type = "user.mfa.okta_verify.deny_push" and
        $e.security_result.summary = "User rejected Okta push verify"
      )
      or
      (
        $e.metadata.product_event_type = "user.authentication.auth_via_mfa" and
        $e.security_result.detection_fields["factor"] = "OKTA_VERIFY_PUSH"
      )
    )
    $e.security_result.action = "BLOCK"
    $e.principal.user.userid = $userid

  match:
    $userid over 10m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $push_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $vendor_name = "Okta"
    $product_name = "Okta"
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $unique_asns = count_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.asn)
    $unique_browsers = count_distinct($e.network.http.parsed_user_agent.browser)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.product_object_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $e and $push_count >= 2
}
rules.description: Detects when an Okta user rejects two or more Push notifications in a 10 minute window, which may indicate compromised Okta credentials and an attempted MFA fatigue attack.

rules.text:
rule ttp_gcp_scc_exfil_with_related_occurrence {
  meta:
    rule_name = "SCC: Exfiltration with Context on Related Occurrences"
    description = "SCC Exfiltration alerts enriched with context on Related Occurences of other alerts and API actions"
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0010"
    technique = "T1537"
    reference = "https://cloud.google.com/security-command-center/docs/how-to-investigate-threats"

  events:
    $alert.metadata.event_type = "USER_RESOURCE_ACCESS"
    $alert.metadata.product_name = "Security Command Center"
    $alert.metadata.description = "Event Threat Detection"
    $alert.metadata.product_event_type = /^Exfiltration:/
    $alert.security_result.detection_fields["sourceProperties_detectionCategory_subRuleName"] != "vpc_perimeter_violation"
    $alert.principal.user.email_addresses = $compromised_account
    $alert.security_result.detection_fields["mute"] != "MUTED"
    $related_scc.metadata.product_name = "Security Command Center"
    $related_scc.metadata.description = "Event Threat Detection"
    $related_scc.metadata.product_event_type != /^Exfiltration:/
    $related_scc.principal.user.email_addresses = $compromised_account
    $context_apis.principal.user.email_addresses = $compromised_account
    $context_apis.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Cloud Platform"

  match:
    $compromised_account over 1h

  outcome:
    $gcti_alert_names = array_distinct($alert.metadata.product_event_type)
    $related_alert_names = array_distinct($related_scc.metadata.product_event_type)
    $surrounding_api_calls = array_distinct($context_apis.metadata.product_event_type)
    $affected_instance = array_distinct($alert.src.resource.name)
    $suspicious_ip = array_distinct($alert.principal.ip)
    $gcti_storage_failed = array_distinct(
      if(
        ($context_apis.metadata.product_event_type = /cloudsql/ nocase or
          $context_apis.metadata.product_event_type = /bigquery/ nocase or
          $context_apis.metadata.product_event_type = /storage/ nocase) and
        $context_apis.security_result.action = "BLOCK" , "FAILED_ATTEMPT(S)_TO_ACCESS_OTHER_STORAGE_RESOURCES"
      )
    )
    $gcti_compute_failed = array_distinct(
      if(
        ($context_apis.metadata.product_event_type = /compute/ nocase or
          $context_apis.metadata.product_event_type = /k8s/ nocase) and
        $context_apis.security_result.action = "BLOCK" , "FAILED_ATTEMPT(S)_TO_ACCESS_OTHER_COMPUTE_RESOURCES"
      )
    )
    $gcti_iam_failed = array_distinct(
      if(
        ($context_apis.metadata.product_event_type = /accesscontextmanager/ nocase or
          $context_apis.metadata.product_event_type = /iam/ nocase) and
        $context_apis.security_result.action = "BLOCK" , "FAILED_ATTEMPT(S)_TO_ACCESS_OTHER_IAM_RESOURCES"
      )
    )
    $gcti_select_all_records = array_distinct(if((( $alert.src.resource.attribute.labels.key = "exfiltration_sources_components" and $alert.src.resource.attribute.labels.value = /(\W|^)select.*\W\*/ nocase ) or ($alert.target.process.command_line = /(\W|^)select.*\W\*/ nocase)),"ATTEMPT_TO_SELECT_ALL_RECORDS_FROM_TABLE"))
    $gcti_drop_all_records = array_distinct(if(((( $alert.src.resource.attribute.labels.key = "exfiltration_sources_components" and $alert.src.resource.attribute.labels.value = /(\W|^)drop .* table\W/ nocase )) or ($alert.target.process.command_line = /(\W|^)drop .* table\W/ nocase)),"ATTEMPT_TO_DROP_ALL_RECORDS_FROM_TABLE"))

    $risk_score = max(if($context_apis.metadata.product_event_type = /cloudsql/ nocase or $context_apis.metadata.product_event_type = /bigquery/ nocase or $context_apis.metadata.product_event_type = /storage/ nocase , 18 )
      +if( $context_apis.metadata.product_event_type = /compute/ nocase or $context_apis.metadata.product_event_type = /k8s/ nocase , 9 )
      +if( $context_apis.metadata.product_event_type = /accesscontextmanager/ nocase or $context_apis.metadata.product_event_type = /iam/ nocase or $context_apis.metadata.product_event_type = /identity/ , 11)
      +if( $context_apis.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 5)

      +if( $related_scc.metadata.product_event_type = /Defense Evasion/,16)
      +if( $related_scc.metadata.product_event_type = /Credential Access/,14)
      +if( $related_scc.metadata.product_event_type = /Persistence/,12)
      +if( $related_scc.metadata.product_event_type = /Malware/,11)
      +if( $related_scc.metadata.product_event_type = /Brute Force/,10)
      +if( $related_scc.metadata.product_event_type = /Active Scan/,4)

      +if( ($alert.src.resource.attribute.labels.key = "exfiltration_sources_components" and $alert.src.resource.attribute.labels.value = /(\W|^)select.*\W\*/ nocase )
        or ($alert.target.process.command_line = /(\W|^)select.*\W\*/ nocase),9)

      +if( ($alert.src.resource.attribute.labels.key = "exfiltration_sources_components" and $alert.src.resource.attribute.labels.value = /(\W|^)drop .* table\W/ nocase )
        or ($alert.target.process.command_line = /(\W|^)drop .* table\W/ nocase),8)
      +if(( $alert.target.resource.attribute.labels.key = "sourceProperties_properties_exportToGcs_exportScope" and $alert.target.resource.attribute.labels.value = "WHOLE_INSTANCE"), 12)
    )

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($alert.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($alert.metadata.product_name)

    $result_time = min($alert.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(if($alert.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $alert.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2))
    $tmp2 = max(if($alert.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $alert and $context_apis and $related_scc and $risk_score >0 //Will alert only when there is atleast one "other" SCC alert
}
rules.description: SCC Exfiltration alerts enriched with context on Related Occurences of other alerts and API actions

    $affected_instance = array_distinct($alert.src.resource.name)
    $suspicious_ip = array_distinct($alert.principal.ip)

    $risk_score = max(if(( $related_sha.metadata.product_event_type = "SQL_PUBLIC_IP") or ($related_sha.metadata.product_event_type = "PUBLIC_SQL_INSTANCE"),45)
      +if( $related_sha.metadata.product_event_type = "SSL_NOT_ENFORCED", 15)
      +if(( $related_sha.metadata.product_event_type = "SQL_SKIP_SHOW_DATABASE_DISABLED") or ($related_sha.metadata.product_event_type = "SQL_LOCAL_INFILE"), 10)

      +if(( $alert.src.resource.attribute.labels.key = "exfiltration_sources_components" and $alert.src.resource.attribute.labels.value = /(\W|^)select.*\W\*/ nocase ),9)
      +if(( $alert.src.resource.attribute.labels.key = "exfiltration_sources_components" and $alert.src.resource.attribute.labels.value = /(\W|^)drop .* table\W/ nocase ),7)
      +if(( $alert.target.resource.attribute.labels.key = "sourceProperties_properties_exportToGcs_exportScope" and $alert.target.resource.attribute.labels.value = "WHOLE_INSTANCE"), 19)
    )

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($alert.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($alert.metadata.product_name)

    $result_time = min($alert.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $tmp1 = max(if($alert.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $alert.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2))

    $tmp2 = max(if($alert.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1))

    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $alert and $related_sha

rules.text:
rule ttp_gcp_scc_exfiltration_launch_remote_file_copy_tools_in_container {
  meta:
    rule_name = "SCC: Exfiltration: Launch Remote File Copy Tools in Container"
    description = "Detects the execution of remote file copy tools within a container, which may indicate potential data exfiltration, lateral movement, or the deployment of malicious payloads. The detector triggers alerts to prevent unauthorized data transfers, network compromise, or the introduction of malware, as such activity is often linked to security breaches and system infiltration."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0010"
    technique = "T1020"
    reference = "https://cloud.google.com/security-command-center/docs/how-to-investigate-threats"

  events:
    $e1.metadata.product_name = "Security Command Center"
    $e1.metadata.product_event_type = "Exfiltration: Launch Remote File Copy Tools in Container"
    $e1.security_result.detection_fields["mute"] != "MUTED"
    $resource_name = $e1.target.resource.name
    $rule_name = $e1.metadata.product_event_type

  match:
    $rule_name over 1h

  outcome:
    $resource_names = array_distinct($resource_name)
    $cloud_projects = array_distinct(if($e1.target.resource_ancestors.resource_type = "CLOUD_PROJECT",$e1.target.resource_ancestors.name, ""))
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.product_name)
    $risk_score = max(0 +
      if(any $e1.security_result.severity = "CRITICAL", 95, 0) +
      if(any $e1.security_result.severity = "HIGH", 85, 0) +
      if(any $e1.security_result.severity = "MEDIUM", 65, 0) +
      if(any $e1.security_result.severity = "LOW", 35, 0) +
      if(any $e1.security_result.severity = "INFORMATIONAL", 10, 0)
    )

    reference = "https://cloud.google.com/security-command-center/docs/how-to-investigate-threats"

  events:
    $alert.metadata.product_name = "Security Command Center"
    $alert.metadata.product_event_type = "Exfiltration: BigQuery Data to Google Drive"
    $alert.principal.user.email_addresses = $compromised_account
    $table_exfiled_timestamp = $alert.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $alert.security_result.detection_fields["mute"] != "MUTED"
    $context_dlp.graph.metadata.product_name = "GCP DLP CONTEXT"
    $context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.resource_subtype = "BigQuery Table"
    $context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.name = $alert.src.resource_ancestors.name
    $table_creation_timestamp = $context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.attribute.creation_time.seconds

  match:
    $compromised_account over 1m

  outcome:
    $dlp_risk=array_distinct($context_dlp.graph.metadata.description)
    $attacker_controlled_drive = array_distinct(if($alert.target.resource.attribute.labels.key= "sourceProperties_properties_extractionAttempt_destinations_originalUri",$alert.target.resource.attribute.labels.value,""))
    $affected_bq_table = array_distinct($alert.src.resource_ancestors.name)
    $table_age_in_seconds = max($table_exfiled_timestamp - $table_creation_timestamp)
    $gcti_cloud_credential_loss = array_distinct(if(
        (
          $context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.attribute.labels["Other InfoType"]     = "GCP_CREDENTIALS" or
          $context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.attribute.labels["Predicted InfoType"] = "GCP_CREDENTIALS" or

          $context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.attribute.labels["Other InfoType"]     = "KEY_MATERIAL" or
          $context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.attribute.labels["Predicted InfoType"] = "KEY_MATERIAL" or

          $context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.attribute.labels["Other InfoType"]     = "AWS_CREDENTIALS" or
          $context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.attribute.labels["Predicted InfoType"] = "AWS_CREDENTIALS" or

          $context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.attribute.labels["Other InfoType"]     = "JSON_WEB_TOKEN" or
          $context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.attribute.labels["Predicted InfoType"] = "JSON_WEB_TOKEN" or

          $context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.attribute.labels["Other InfoType"]     = "AZURE_AUTH_TOKEN" or
          $context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.attribute.labels["Predicted InfoType"] = "AZURE_AUTH_TOKEN" or

          $context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.attribute.labels["Other InfoType"]     = "GCP_API_KEY" or
          $context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.attribute.labels["Predicted InfoType"] = "GCP_API_KEY" or

          $context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.attribute.labels["Other InfoType"]     = "GOOGLE_OAUTH_TOKEN" or
          $context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.attribute.labels["Predicted InfoType"] = "GOOGLE_OAUTH_TOKEN" or

          $context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.attribute.labels["Other InfoType"]     = "WEAK_PASSWORD_HASH" or
          $context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.attribute.labels["Predicted InfoType"] = "WEAK_PASSWORD_HASH" or

          $context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.attribute.labels["Other InfoType"]     = "ENCRYPTION_KEY" or
          $context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.attribute.labels["Predicted InfoType"] = "ENCRYPTION_KEY"
        ), "CLOUD_CREDENTIALS_POTENTIALLY_COMPROMISED", "N/A"
      )
    )
    $gcti_low_confidence_infotypes = array_distinct(if($context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.attribute.labels.key = "Other InfoType", $context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.attribute.labels.value, ""))
    $gcti_high_confidence_infotypes = array_distinct(if($context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.attribute.labels.key = "Predicted InfoType", $context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.attribute.labels.value, ""))

    $cloud_dlp_infotype_alert = max( if(
        ($context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.attribute.labels.key = "Other InfoType" and $context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.attribute.labels.value != "") or
        ($context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.attribute.labels.key = "Predicted InfoType" and $context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.attribute.labels.value != ""),1))

    $risk_score = max(
      if( $context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.attribute.labels["Sensitivity Score"] = "SENSITIVITY_LOW"      , 40 ) +
      if( $context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.attribute.labels["Sensitivity Score"] = "SENSITIVITY_MODERATE" , 60 ) +
      if( $context_dlp.graph.entity.resource.attribute.labels["Sensitivity Score"] = "SENSITIVITY_HIGH"     , 80 )
    )

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($alert.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($alert.metadata.product_name)

    $result_time = min($alert.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($alert.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $alert.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($alert.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $alert and $context_dlp and $cloud_dlp_infotype_alert > 0 and $risk_score > 0
}

rule ttp_gcp_gkeanoncallnoncreate {
  meta:
    rule_name = "GKE Anonymous Data Access Event from the Internet"

    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0001"
    technique = "T1190"
    false_positives = "Organizations may use public IP space for 'internal' addresses."
    reference = "https://cloud.google.com/kubernetes-engine/docs/how-to/authorized-networks, https://cloud.google.com/kubernetes-engine/docs/best-practices/rbac#default-roles-groups, https://raesene.github.io/blog/2023/03/18/lets-talk-about-anonymous-access-to-Kubernetes/"

  events:
    $e.security_result.detection_fields["mute"] != "MUTED"
    $e.metadata.log_type = "GCP_CLOUDAUDIT"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "Google Kubernetes Engine"
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Cloud Platform"

    $e.target.resource.resource_type = "CLUSTER"

    (
      $e.principal.user.userid = "system:anonymous" OR
      $e.target.user.userid = "system:anonymous" OR
      $e.security_result.action_details = /RBAC: allowed by .+to Group ("|')system:(un)?authenticated("|')/ OR
      $e.security_result.description = /RBAC: allowed by .+to Group ("|')system:(un)?authenticated("|')/
    )
    $e.principal.user.email_addresses != /@container-engine-robot\.iam\.gserviceaccount\.com$/
    $e.security_result.action_details != /RBAC: allowed by ClusterRoleBinding .+ of ClusterRole ("|')system:(discovery|basic-user|public-info-viewer)("|')/
    $e.security_result.description != /RBAC: allowed by ClusterRoleBinding .+ of ClusterRole ("|')system:(discovery|basic-user|public-info-viewer)("|')/

    (
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = /io\.k8s\.(?:post|put|patch|delete)/ OR
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = /io\.k8s\..+(?:create|apply|update|patch|delete)/
    )
    $e.metadata.event_type != "RESOURCE_CREATION"
    any $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    $e.security_result.detection_fields["resource_name"] != "readyz" // These paths are expected.
    $e.security_result.detection_fields["resource_name"] != "livez"
    $e.security_result.detection_fields["resource_name"] != "version"

    $originating_ip = $e.principal.ip

      net.ip_in_range_cidr($originating_ip, "192.168.0.0/16") OR
      net.ip_in_range_cidr($originating_ip, "100.64.0.0/10") OR
      net.ip_in_range_cidr($originating_ip, "192.0.0.0/24") OR
      net.ip_in_range_cidr($originating_ip, "192.0.2.0/24") OR
      net.ip_in_range_cidr($originating_ip, "198.51.100.0/24") OR
      net.ip_in_range_cidr($originating_ip, "203.0.113.0/24") OR
      net.ip_in_range_cidr($originating_ip, "192.88.99.0/24") OR
      net.ip_in_range_cidr($originating_ip, "198.18.0.0/15") OR
      net.ip_in_range_cidr($originating_ip, "240.0.0.0/4")
    )

  match:
    $originating_ip over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.product_object_id)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.email_addresses)

    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $distinct_originating_ips = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $num_distinct_originating_ips = count_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $num_originating_ips = count($e.principal.ip)
    $event_types = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_event_type)
    $target_users = array_distinct($e.target.user.userid)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_linux_echo_cron {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Echo to Cron from Behavioral Signals"
    description = "Detects specific examples of echoing data into a cron system, observed from behaviors of Linux malware detected in real-world environments."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1053.003"

  events:
    $e1.principal.platform = "LINUX"
    (
      $e1.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
      $e1.metadata.product_event_type = "PROCTITLE" or
      $e1.metadata.product_event_type = "EXECVE"

      strings.concat(
        $e1.principal.process.command_line,
        $e1.target.process.command_line,

        $e1.target.process.file.full_path
      )

    re.regex($cmd_lines, `/bin/sh\s+\-c\s+echo\s+'?\*\s+\*\s+\*\s+\*\s+\*\s+/.+cron`)

  match:
    $cmd_lines over 1h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 20

    $principal_process_command_lines = array_distinct($e1.principal.process.command_line)
    $target_process_command_lines = array_distinct($e1.target.process.command_line)
    $principal_process_file_full_paths = array_distinct($e1.principal.process.file.full_path)
    $target_process_file_full_paths = array_distinct($e1.target.process.file.full_path)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.product_name)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

}

rule ttp_linux_cron_persistence {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Cron Job Persistence Techniques"
    description = "Detects cron executions that reach out externally or that match patterns seen being used by malicious actors. Cron jobs can be used to schedule commands that maintain persistent access to a system."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1053"

  events:

    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"

    (
      (
        (
          $e.principal.process.command_line = /cron\s.*(wget|curl|\.png|\.jpe?g)/ nocase and
          $e.principal.process.command_line != /micron/ nocase
        ) OR
        (
          $e.target.process.command_line = /cron\s.*(wget|curl|\.png|\.jpe?g)/ nocase and
          $e.target.process.command_line != /micron/ nocase
        )
      ) or

      (
        $e.target.application=/cron/ nocase AND
        $e.target.process.command_line = /wget|curl/ nocase
      )
    )

    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $e.principal.process.command_line != /dpkg/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line != /dpkg/ nocase
    $e.principal.process.command_line != /apt-get/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line != /apt-get/ nocase

    $e.target.process.command_line != /systemstats\.sh/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line != /changing\sownership\sof/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line != /xsltproc \/opt\/tomcat\/prtg\/tomcat.xsl/ nocase
    $e.target.process.file.full_path != /\/bin\/grep/ nocase
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path != /\/bin\/grep/ nocase
    $e.target.process.file.full_path != /\/bin\/ls/ nocase
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path != /\/bin\/ls/ nocase
    $e.target.process.file.full_path != /\/bin\/rm/ nocase
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path != /\/bin\/rm/ nocase
    $e.target.file.full_path != /\/bin\/grep/ nocase
    $e.principal.file.full_path != /\/bin\/grep/ nocase
    $e.target.file.full_path != /\/bin\/ls/ nocase
    $e.principal.file.full_path != /\/bin\/ls/ nocase
    $e.target.file.full_path != /\/bin\/rm/ nocase
    $e.principal.file.full_path != /\/bin\/rm/ nocase

  match:
    $hostname over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($hostname)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $e
}

    rule_name = "SCC: Reverse Shell"
    description = "The detector looks for stdin bound to a remote socket."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059"
    reference = "https://cloud.google.com/security-command-center/docs/how-to-investigate-threats"

  events:
    $e1.metadata.product_name = "Security Command Center"
    $e1.metadata.product_event_type = "Reverse Shell"
    $e1.security_result.detection_fields["mute"] != "MUTED"
    $resource_name = $e1.target.resource.name
    $rule_name = $e1.metadata.product_event_type

  match:
    $rule_name over 1h

  outcome:
    $resource_names = array_distinct($resource_name)
    $cloud_projects = array_distinct(if($e1.target.resource_ancestors.resource_type = "CLOUD_PROJECT",$e1.target.resource_ancestors.name, ""))
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.product_name)
    $risk_score = max(0 +
      if(any $e1.security_result.severity = "CRITICAL", 95, 0) +
      if(any $e1.security_result.severity = "HIGH", 85, 0) +
      if(any $e1.security_result.severity = "MEDIUM", 65, 0) +
      if(any $e1.security_result.severity = "LOW", 35, 0) +
      if(any $e1.security_result.severity = "INFORMATIONAL", 10, 0)
    )
    $threat_category = array_distinct($e1.metadata.product_event_type)
    $scc_product = array_distinct($e1.metadata.description)
    $severity = array_distinct($e1.security_result.severity)
    $url_back_to_product = array_distinct($e1.security_result.url_back_to_product)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e1.metadata.id)

    $result_time = min($e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e1.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e1.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e1.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e1
}

rule ttp_linux_curl_for_drupal {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Suspicious Curl for Drupal Exploits"
    description = "Detects specific usage of the curl command downloading drupal related exploits. This rule was generated from observed behaviors of Linux malware detected in real-world environments."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1105"

  events:
    $e1.principal.platform = "LINUX"
    (
      $e1.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
      $e1.metadata.product_event_type = "PROCTITLE" or
      $e1.metadata.product_event_type = "EXECVE"
    )
    $cmd_lines = strings.to_lower(
      strings.concat(
        $e1.principal.process.command_line,
        $e1.target.process.command_line,
        $e1.principal.process.file.full_path,
        $e1.target.process.file.full_path
      )
    )
    re.regex($cmd_lines, `sh\s+-c`)
    re.regex($cmd_lines, `wget\s+https?://((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)/drupal`)
    re.regex($cmd_lines, `-o-\s+\|sh;curl\s+http://((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9][0-9]?)/drupal`)

  match:
    $cmd_lines over 1h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(20)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e1.metadata.id)
    $principal_process_command_lines = array_distinct($e1.principal.process.command_line)
    $target_process_command_lines = array_distinct($e1.target.process.command_line)
    $principal_process_file_full_paths = array_distinct($e1.principal.process.file.full_path)
    $target_process_file_full_paths = array_distinct($e1.target.process.file.full_path)
    $vendor_names = array_distinct($e1.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_names = array_distinct($e1.metadata.product_name)
    $hostnames = array_distinct($e1.principal.hostname)
    $result = array_distinct(if($e1.security_result.action = "ALLOW","succeeded","failed"))
    $result_time = min($e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $vendor_name = array($e1.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array($e1.metadata.product_name)

  condition:
    $e1
}

rules.text:
rule ttp_azure_defender_for_cloud_log_on_from_an_unusual_location {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Azure Defender for Cloud: Log on from an unusual location"
    description = "Someone logged on to your resource from an unusual Azure Data Center."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0043"
    reference = "https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/alerts-reference"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    (
      $e.metadata.log_type = "MICROSOFT_GRAPH_ALERT" or
      $e.metadata.log_type = "MICROSOFT_DEFENDER_CLOUD_ALERTS"
    )
    $e.security_result.rule_name = "Log on from an unusual location"

    $product_event_type = $e.security_result.rule_name

  outcome:
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $risk_score = max(0 +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "HIGH", 85, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "MEDIUM", 65, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "LOW", 35, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "INFORMATIONAL", 10, 0)
    )
    $event_count = 1
    $product_urls = array_distinct($e.security_result.url_back_to_product)
    $security_result_summary = array_distinct($e.security_result.summary)
    $security_result_description = array_distinct($e.security_result.description)
    $security_result_severity = array_distinct($e.security_result.severity)
    $security_remediation_details = array_distinct($e.security_result.action_details)
    $security_result_threat_name = array_distinct($e.security_result.threat_name)
    $adversary_names = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.userid, $e.principal.hostname, $e.principal.resource.name))
    $adversary_uid = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.product_object_id, $e.principal.asset_id, $e.principal.resource.product_object_id))
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $victim_names = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.target.user.userid, $e.target.hostname, $e.target.resource.name))
    $victim_uid = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.target.user.product_object_id, $e.target.asset_id, $e.target.resource.product_object_id))
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.target.ip)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

  condition:
    $e
}

rules.display_name: Azure Defender for Cloud: Potential SQL injection
rules.text:
rule ttp_azure_defender_for_cloud_potential_sql_injection {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Azure Defender for Cloud: Potential SQL injection"
    description = "An active exploit has occurred against an identified application vulnerable to SQL injection. This means an attacker is trying to inject malicious SQL statements by using the vulnerable application code or stored procedures."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0043"
    reference = "https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/alerts-reference"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    (
      $e.metadata.log_type = "MICROSOFT_GRAPH_ALERT" or
      $e.metadata.log_type = "MICROSOFT_DEFENDER_CLOUD_ALERTS"
    )
    $e.security_result.rule_name = "Potential SQL injection"

    $product_event_type = $e.security_result.rule_name

  outcome:
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $risk_score = max(0 +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "HIGH", 85, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "MEDIUM", 65, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "LOW", 35, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "INFORMATIONAL", 10, 0)
    )
    $event_count = 1
    $product_urls = array_distinct($e.security_result.url_back_to_product)
    $security_result_summary = array_distinct($e.security_result.summary)
    $security_result_description = array_distinct($e.security_result.description)
    $security_result_severity = array_distinct($e.security_result.severity)
    $security_remediation_details = array_distinct($e.security_result.action_details)
    $security_result_threat_name = array_distinct($e.security_result.threat_name)
    $adversary_names = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.userid, $e.principal.hostname, $e.principal.resource.name))
    $adversary_uid = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.product_object_id, $e.principal.asset_id, $e.principal.resource.product_object_id))
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $victim_names = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.target.user.userid, $e.target.hostname, $e.target.resource.name))
    $victim_uid = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.target.user.product_object_id, $e.target.asset_id, $e.target.resource.product_object_id))
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.target.ip)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

  condition:
    $e
}

rules.display_name: Execution of Known RMM Tool - First Seen by User
rules.text:
rule ioc_execution_of_known_rmm_tool_first_seen_user {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Execution of Known RMM Tool - First Seen by User"
    description = "Detects execution of known Remote Monitoring and Management (RMM) tool binaries for the first time by a user in the last 30 days."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1204"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $event_type = $e.metadata.event_type
    $e.principal.process.file.sha256 != ""
    $rmm_hash = $e.principal.process.file.sha256
    $user_id_val = $e.principal.user.userid
    $gcti.graph.metadata.entity_type = "FILE"
    $gcti.graph.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Cloud Threat Intelligence"
    $gcti.graph.metadata.product_name = "GCTI Feed"
    $gcti.graph.metadata.threat.threat_feed_name = "Remote Access Tools"
    $gcti.graph.entity.file.sha256 = $rmm_hash

  match:
    $user_id_val by 1h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(35)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $entity_type = array_distinct($gcti.graph.metadata.entity_type)
    $event_time = array_distinct($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $log_source = array_distinct($e.metadata.log_type)
    $asset_hostname = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)

    $user_id = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $matched_ioc = array_distinct($gcti.graph.entity.file.sha256)
    $ioc_type = "RMM Tool Hash"
    $ioc_source = "GCTI Feed"
    $target_hostname = array_distinct($e.target.hostname)
    $target_ip = array_distinct($e.target.ip)

    $target_process_name = array_distinct($e.target.process.file.full_path)
    $command_line = array_distinct($e.target.process.command_line)
    $parent_process = array_distinct($e.principal.process.file.full_path)
    $principal_hostname = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)
    $mitre_attack_tactic = "Execution"
    $mitre_attack_tactic_id = "TA0002"
    $mitre_attack_technique_id = "T1204" // User Execution
    $historical_threshold = max(metrics.file_executions_total(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:first_seen, agg:min,
        metadata.event_type:$event_type, principal.user.userid:$user_id_val, principal.process.file.sha256:$rmm_hash))

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if(any $e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and any $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if(any $e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e and $gcti and $historical_threshold = 0 and $result != "failed"
}

rules.text:
rule ioc_malicious_linux_binary_execution {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Malicious Linux Binary Execution"
    description = "Detects execution of known malicious Linux binaries."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1204"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $malicious_sha256 = $e.target.process.file.sha256
    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname

    $gcti.graph.metadata.entity_type = "FILE"
    $gcti.graph.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Cloud Threat Intelligence"
    $gcti.graph.metadata.product_name = "GCTI Feed"
    $gcti.graph.metadata.threat.threat_feed_name = "Bad Linux Binary"
    $gcti.graph.entity.file.sha256 = $malicious_sha256

  match:
    $hostname by 15m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(90)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $entity_type = array_distinct($gcti.graph.metadata.entity_type)
    $event_time = array_distinct($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $log_source = array_distinct($e.metadata.log_type)
    $asset_hostname = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)

    $user_id = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $matched_ioc = array_distinct($gcti.graph.entity.file.sha256)
    $ioc_type = "Bad Linux Binary"
    $ioc_source = "GCTI Feed"
    $target_hostname = array_distinct($e.target.hostname)
    $target_ip = array_distinct($e.target.ip)

    $target_process_name = array_distinct($e.target.process.file.full_path)
    $command_line = array_distinct($e.target.process.command_line)
    $parent_process = array_distinct($e.principal.process.file.full_path)
    $principal_hostname = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)
    $mitre_attack_tactic = "Execution"
    $mitre_attack_tactic_id = "TA0002"
    $mitre_attack_technique_id = "T1204" // User Execution

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if(any $e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and any $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if(any $e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e and $gcti and $result != "failed"
}
rules.description: Detects execution of known malicious Linux binaries.
rules.author: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence
