rules.display_name: Recurring Unique Malware On Same Host
rules.text:
rule ata_recurring_unique_malware_same_host{
  meta:
    rule_name = "Recurring Unique Malware On Same Host"
    description = "Escalate instances of multiple different remediated malware on same host within 24 hours."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1543"

  events:
    (
      (
        $e.metadata.log_type = "SENTINELONE_ALERT" and
        $e.metadata.product_event_type = "Threats" and
        $e.metadata.event_type != "GENERIC_EVENT" and
        $e.target.file.full_path != "" and
        (
          $e.security_result.category_details = "Backdoor" or
          $e.security_result.category_details = "Downloader" or
          $e.security_result.category_details = "Hacktool" or
          $e.security_result.category_details = "Malware" or
          $e.security_result.category_details = "Miner" or
          $e.security_result.category_details = "Ransomware" or
          $e.security_result.category_details = "Toolbar" or
          $e.security_result.category_details = "Trojan" or
          $e.security_result.category_details = "Virus" or
          $e.security_result.category_details = "Worm"
        )
      ) or
      (
        $e.metadata.log_type = "MICROSOFT_GRAPH_ALERT" and
        $e.metadata.product_name = "Microsoft Defender for Endpoint" nocase and
        $e.metadata.product_event_type = "Malware"
      ) or
      (
        $e.metadata.log_type = "CS_EDR" and
        (
          $e.security_result.detection_fields["ExternalApiType"] = "external_api_type" OR
          $e.security_result.detection_fields["ExternalApiType"] = "Event_DetectionSummaryEvent"
        ) and
        (
          $e.security_result.threat_name = "NGAV" OR
          $e.security_result.threat_name = "Known Malware" OR
          $e.security_result.threat_name = "Machine Learning" OR
          $e.security_result.threat_name = "Intel Detection"
        )
      )
    ) and
    (
      $e.security_result.action_details = "mitigated" or
      $e.security_result.action = "QUARANTINE" or
      $e.security_result.action = "BLOCK"
    )
    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $md5 = $e.target.file.md5
    $sha1 = $e.target.file.sha1
    $sha256 = $e.target.file.sha256
    $malwareName = $e.security_result.threat_name
    $timestamp = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

  match:
    $hostname over 24h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $window = max($timestamp) - min($timestamp) //https://b.corp.google.com/issues/287633154 link to similar issue
    $target_files = array_distinct($e.target.file.full_path)
    $actions = array_distinct($e.security_result.action)
    $hash_md5_count = count_distinct($md5)
    $hash_md5 = array_distinct($md5)
    $hash_sha1_count = count_distinct($sha1)
    $hash_sha1 = array_distinct($sha1)
    $hash_sha256_count = count_distinct($sha256)
    $hash_sha256 = array_distinct($sha256)
    $malware_names_count = count_distinct($malwareName)
    $malware_names = array_distinct($malwareName)

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    ((#md5 >= 4 or #sha1 >=4 or #sha256 >= 4) or #malwareName >= 4) and $window >= 600
}

rules.display_name: Unusual Process Activity with Execution Tactic.
rules.text:
rule ata_unusual_process_activity_execution {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Unusual Process Activity with Execution Tactic."
    description = "Escalate evidence, from EDR alerts, of unusual process activity sourcing from a system management utility tagged with the execution tactic."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1203"

  events:
    ( $e.metadata.log_type = "CS_EDR" and
      ( $e.security_result.detection_fields["ExternalApiType"] = "Event_DetectionSummaryEvent" or
        $e.security_result.detection_fields["external_api_type"] = "Event_DetectionSummaryEvent"
      ) and
      ( $e.security_result.threat_name = "Intel Detection" or
        $e.security_result.threat_name = "Known Malware" or
        $e.security_result.threat_name = "Machine Learning" or
        $e.security_result.threat_name = "NGAV")
    ) or
    ( $e.metadata.log_type = "MICROSOFT_GRAPH_ALERT"  and
      $e.metadata.product_name = "Microsoft Defender for Endpoint" nocase
    ) or
    (
      $e.metadata.log_type = "SENTINELONE_ALERT" and
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "Threats" and
      $e.metadata.event_type != "GENERIC_EVENT" and
      (
        $e.target.file.full_path = "" or
        $e.security_result.category_details = "Backdoor" or
        $e.security_result.category_details = "Downloader" or
        $e.security_result.category_details = "Hacktool" or
        $e.security_result.category_details = "Malware" or
        $e.security_result.category_details = "miner" or
        $e.security_result.category_details = "Ransomware" or
        $e.security_result.category_details = "toolbar" or
        $e.security_result.category_details = "Trojan" or
        $e.security_result.category_details = "Virus" or
        $e.security_result.category_details = "Worm"
      )
    )
    $e.security_result.attack_details.tactics.name = "Execution" nocase and
    $e.principal.process.command_line != "" and
    $e.principal.process.command_line=/(AccessChk|AccessEnum|AdExplorer|AdRestore)(64)?\.exe|(at|certutil|csvde|dcdiag)\.exe|(Desktops|dsquery|EFSDump|Handle|ListDLLs)(64)?\.exe|(ipconfig|ldifde|netstat|nltest|ntdsutil|ping)\.exe|(PortMon|ProcDump|psexec|PsInfo|PsKill|PsList|PsLoggedOn|PsLogList|PsPasswd|PsPing|PsService|PsSuspend)(64)?\.exe|(qprocess|query\.exe|reg)\.exe|RegHide(64)?\.exe|sc\.exe|sdelete(64)?\.exe|ShareEnum(64)?\.exe|ShellRunas(64)?\.exe|shred(\.exe)?|Sigcheck(64)?\.exe|Strings(64)?\.exe|systeminfo\.exe|tasklist\.exe|timestomp|ver\.exe|vssadmin\.exe|wevtutil\.exe|whoami\.exe|wmic\.exe|wusa\.exe|msbuild\.exe/ nocase
    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $event_name = $e.security_result.rule_name
    $file_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path

  match:
    $hostname over 1h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 85
    $principal_process_paths = array_distinct($file_path)
    $principal_process_command_line = array_distinct($e.principal.process.command_line)
    $impacted_hosts = array_distinct($hostname)
    $impacted_host_count = count_distinct($hostname)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

    $days_seen_same_system_path_signature = max(
      metrics.alert_event_name_count(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum,
        agg:num_metric_periods,
        principal.asset.hostname:$hostname,
        principal.process.file.full_path:$file_path,
        security_result.rule_name:$event_name))

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e and (($days_seen_same_system_path_signature >= 0) and ($days_seen_same_system_path_signature < 3))
}

rules.display_name: Initial Compromise with Staged Malware for Windows
rules.text:
rule ata_initial_compromise_with_staged_malware_windows {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Initial Compromise with Staged Malware for Windows"
    description = "Analyze the target file path of EDR alerts for abnormalities. Additionally, evaluate if the MITRE tactic suggests Initial Compromise activity."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0001"
    technique = "T1189"

  events:
    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $filePath = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $signatureName = $e.security_result.rule_name
    (
      (
        $e.metadata.log_type = "CS_EDR" and
        (
          $e.security_result.detection_fields["ExternalApiType"] = "Event_DetectionSummaryEvent" or
          $e.security_result.detection_fields["external_api_type"] = "Event_DetectionSummaryEvent"
        ) and
        (
          $e.security_result.threat_name != "NGAV" or
          $e.security_result.threat_name != "Known Malware" or
          $e.security_result.threat_name != "Machine Learning" or
          $e.security_result.threat_name != "Intel Detection"
        )
      ) or
      (
        $e.metadata.log_type = "MICROSOFT_GRAPH_ALERT"  and
        $e.metadata.product_name = "Microsoft Defender for Endpoint" nocase and
        $e.metadata.product_event_type != "Malware"
      ) or
      (
        $e.metadata.log_type = "SENTINELONE_ALERT" and
        $e.metadata.product_event_type = "Threats" and
        $e.metadata.event_type != "GENERIC_EVENT" and
        (
          $e.target.file.full_path = "" or
          $e.security_result.category_details = "Adware" or
          $e.security_result.category_details = "Exploits" or
          $e.security_result.category_details = "generic.heuristic" or

          $e.security_result.category_details = "Packed" or

          $e.security_result.category_details = "Spyware"

    $targetFilePath = re.capture($e.principal.process.command_line, /(?:\w+|(?:\w"?)) \"?((?:[a-zA-Z]\:|\\\\[\w\.]+\\[\w.$]+)\\(?:[\w\s().$~-]+\\)*\w(?:[\w.-])+\\*)/)

    "" != re.capture($e.principal.process.command_line, /(?:\w+|(?:\w"?)) \"?(?:[a-zA-Z]\:|\\\\[\w\.]+\\[\w.$]+)\\(?:[\w\s().$~-]+\\)*(?:(?:[\w.-])+(\.\w+))?\\*/)

    (
      $targetFileName = /^[^\\]{1,1}\.(?:\w|\d)+$|^[^\\]{15,}\.(?:\w|\d)+$|[^\\]+\.[^\\]+\.[^\\]+/ or

rules.description: Analyze the target file path of EDR alerts for abnormalities. Additionally, evaluate if the MITRE tactic suggests Initial Compromise activity.
rules.author: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence

rules.display_name: A malware alert followed by an EDR alert with a post compromise MITRE tactic.
rules.text:
rule ata_attack_progression_epp_initial_post_compromise {
  meta:
    rule_name = "A malware alert followed by an EDR alert with a post compromise MITRE tactic."
    description = "Escalate series of progressive attack events: malware detected follwed by a post-compromise event within 24 hours."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0002"

  events:
    (
      (
        $e.metadata.log_type = "CS_EDR" and
        ( $e.security_result.detection_fields["ExternalApiType"] = "Event_DetectionSummaryEvent" or
          $e.security_result.detection_fields["external_api_type"] = "Event_DetectionSummaryEvent"
        ) and
        (//EPP
          $e.security_result.threat_name = "NGAV" or
          $e.security_result.threat_name = "Known Malware" or
          $e.security_result.threat_name = "Machine Learning" or
          $e.security_result.threat_name = "Intel Detection"
        )
      ) or
      (
        $e.metadata.log_type = "SENTINELONE_ALERT" and
        $e.metadata.product_event_type = "Threats" and
        $e.metadata.event_type != "GENERIC_EVENT" and
        (//EPP
          $e.target.file.full_path != "" and
          (
            $e.security_result.category_details = "Backdoor" or
            $e.security_result.category_details = "Downloader" or
            $e.security_result.category_details = "Hacktool" or
            $e.security_result.category_details = "Malware" or
            $e.security_result.category_details = "Miner" or
            $e.security_result.category_details = "Ransomware" or
            $e.security_result.category_details = "Toolbar" or
            $e.security_result.category_details = "Trojan" or
            $e.security_result.category_details = "Virus" or
            $e.security_result.category_details = "Worm"
          )
        )
      ) or
      (
        $e.metadata.log_type = "MICROSOFT_GRAPH_ALERT" and
        $e.metadata.product_name = "Microsoft Defender for Endpoint" nocase and
        $e.metadata.product_event_type = "Malware"
      )
    ) and
    (
      (
        $e1.metadata.log_type = "CS_EDR" and
        ( $e1.security_result.detection_fields["ExternalApiType"] = "Event_DetectionSummaryEvent" or
          $e1.security_result.detection_fields["external_api_type"] = "Event_DetectionSummaryEvent"
        ) and
        (
          (
            $e1.security_result.threat_name != "NGAV" or
            $e1.security_result.threat_name != "Known Malware" or
            $e1.security_result.threat_name != "Machine Learning" or
            $e1.security_result.threat_name != "Intel Detection"
          ) and
          $e1.security_result.attack_details.tactics.name = /(Discovery|Privilege|Collection|Lateral|Impact|Command|Credential)/ nocase
        )
      ) or
      (
        $e1.metadata.log_type = "MICROSOFT_GRAPH_ALERT"  and
        $e1.metadata.product_name = "Microsoft Defender for Endpoint" nocase and
        $e1.metadata.product_event_type != "Malware" and
        $e1.security_result.attack_details.tactics.name = /(Discovery|Privilege|Collection|Lateral|Impact|Command|Credential)/ nocase
      ) or
      (
        $e1.metadata.log_type = "SENTINELONE_ALERT" and
        $e1.metadata.product_event_type = "Threats" and
        $e1.metadata.event_type != "GENERIC_EVENT" and
        (
          (
            $e1.target.file.full_path = "" or
            $e1.security_result.category_details = "generic.heuristic" or
            $e1.security_result.category_details = "Spyware" or
            $e1.security_result.category_details = "PUA" or
            $e1.security_result.category_details = "Adware" or
            $e1.security_result.category_details = "Exploits" or
            $e1.security_result.category_details = "Packed" or
            $e1.security_result.category_details = "Infostealer" or
            $e1.security_result.category_details = "Linux.Malware" or
            $e1.security_result.category_details = "OSX.Malware"
          ) and
          $e1.security_result.attack_details.tactics.name = /(Discovery|Privilege|Collection|Lateral|Impact|Command|Credential)/ nocase
        )
      )
    )
    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $hostname = $e1.principal.hostname
    $event_name = $e1.security_result.rule_name
    $e_file_path = $e.target.file.full_path
    $file_path = $e1.target.file.full_path

  match:
    $hostname, $event_name over 24h before $e1

  outcome:

    $risk_score = 65
    $malware_file_paths = array_distinct($e_file_path)
    $post_compromise_event_file_paths = array_distinct($file_path)
    $impacted_hosts = array_distinct($hostname)
    $impacted_host_count = count_distinct($hostname)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

    $days_seen_same_system_path_signature = max(
      metrics.alert_event_name_count(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum,
        agg:num_metric_periods,
        principal.asset.hostname:$hostname,
        principal.process.file.full_path:$file_path,
        security_result.rule_name:$event_name))

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $result = "succeeded"

  condition:
    $e and $e1 and (($days_seen_same_system_path_signature >= 0) and ($days_seen_same_system_path_signature < 3))
}
rules.description: Escalate series of progressive attack events: malware detected follwed by a post-compromise event within 24 hours.
rules.author: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence

rules.text:
rule ata_recurring_malware_same_host_and_hash{
  meta:
    rule_name = "Recurring Malware on Same Host"
    description = "Escalate instances of same malware repeatedly quarantined on same host within 24 hours with the events being at least 10 minutes between the first occurence and most recent occurence this tracks based on hostname and unique md5, sha1 and sha256 hashes."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1543"

  events:
    (
      (
        $e.metadata.log_type = "CS_EDR" and
        (
          $e.security_result.detection_fields["ExternalApiType"] = "Event_DetectionSummaryEvent" or
          $e.security_result.detection_fields["external_api_type"] = "Event_DetectionSummaryEvent"
        ) and
        (
          $e.security_result.threat_name = "NGAV" or
          $e.security_result.threat_name = "Known Malware" or
          $e.security_result.threat_name = "Machine Learning" or
          $e.security_result.threat_name = "Intel Detection"
        )
      ) or
      (
        $e.metadata.log_type = "MICROSOFT_GRAPH_ALERT"  and
        $e.metadata.product_name = "Microsoft Defender for Endpoint" nocase and
        $e.metadata.product_event_type = "Malware"
      ) or
      (
        $e.metadata.log_type = "SENTINELONE_ALERT" and
        $e.metadata.product_event_type = "Threats" and
        $e.metadata.event_type != "GENERIC_EVENT" and
        $e.target.file.full_path != "" and
        (
          $e.security_result.category_details = "Backdoor" or
          $e.security_result.category_details = "Downloader" or
          $e.security_result.category_details = "Hacktool" or
          $e.security_result.category_details = "Malware" or
          $e.security_result.category_details = "Miner" or
          $e.security_result.category_details = "Ransomware" or
          $e.security_result.category_details = "Toolbar" or
          $e.security_result.category_details = "Trojan" or
          $e.security_result.category_details = "Virus" or
          $e.security_result.category_details = "Worm"
        )
      )
    ) and
    (
      $e.security_result.action_details = "mitigated" or
      $e.security_result.action = "QUARANTINE" or
      $e.security_result.action = "BLOCK"
    )

    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    (
      "" != $e.target.file.md5 or
      "" != $e.target.file.sha1 or
      "" != $e.target.file.sha256
    )
    $md5 = $e.target.file.md5
    $sha1 = $e.target.file.sha1
    $sha256 = $e.target.file.sha256
    $timestamp = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

  match:
    $hostname, $md5, $sha1, $sha256 over 24h

  outcome:
    $min_window = min($timestamp)
    $max_window = max($timestamp)
    $window = $max_window - $min_window
    $md5_distinct = count_distinct($md5)
    $sha1_distinct = count_distinct($sha1)
    $sha256_distinct = count_distinct($sha256)
    $risk_score = 85
    $threat_names = array_distinct($e.security_result.threat_name)
    $files = array_distinct($e.target.file.full_path)
    $impacted_hosts = array_distinct($hostname)
    $impacted_host_count = count_distinct($hostname)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $actions = array_distinct($e.security_result.action)

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    #e >= 8 and $window >= 600
}

      (
        $e.metadata.log_type = "CS_EDR" and

          $e.security_result.detection_fields["external_api_type"] = "Event_DetectionSummaryEvent"
        ) and

      (
        $e.metadata.log_type = "SENTINELONE_ALERT" and
        $e.metadata.product_event_type = "Threats" and
        $e.metadata.event_type != "GENERIC_EVENT" and
        $e.security_result.attack_details.tactics.name = /(Initial|Execution|Persistence)/ nocase
      ) or
      (
        $e.metadata.log_type = "MICROSOFT_GRAPH_ALERT" and
        $e.metadata.product_name = "Microsoft Defender for Endpoint" nocase and
        $e.security_result.attack_details.tactics.name = /(Initial|Execution|Persistence)/ nocase
      )
    ) and
    (
      (
        $e1.metadata.log_type = "CS_EDR" and
        ( $e1.security_result.detection_fields["ExternalApiType"] = "Event_DetectionSummaryEvent" or
          $e1.security_result.detection_fields["external_api_type"] = "Event_DetectionSummaryEvent"
        ) and

          $e1.security_result.threat_name = "Intel Detection"
        )
      ) or
      (
        $e1.metadata.log_type = "MICROSOFT_GRAPH_ALERT"  and
        $e1.metadata.product_name = "Microsoft Defender for Endpoint" nocase and
        $e1.metadata.product_event_type = "Malware"
      ) or
      (
        (
          $e1.metadata.log_type = "SENTINELONE_ALERT" and
          $e1.metadata.product_event_type = "Threats" and
          $e1.metadata.event_type != "GENERIC_EVENT"
        ) and
        (
          $e1.security_result.category_details = "Downloader" or
          $e1.security_result.category_details = "Hacktool" or
          $e1.security_result.category_details = "Malware" or
          $e1.security_result.category_details = "Miner" or
          $e1.security_result.category_details = "Ransomware" or
          $e1.security_result.category_details = "Toolbar" or
          $e1.security_result.category_details = "Trojan" or
          $e1.security_result.category_details = "Virus" or
          $e1.security_result.category_details = "Worm"
        )
      )
    )
    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $tactic = $e.security_result.attack_details.tactics.name
    $hostname = $e1.principal.hostname
    $event_name = $e1.security_result.rule_name
    $file_path = $e.target.file.full_path
    $file_path = $e1.target.file.full_path
    $e.metadata.product_log_id != $e1.metadata.product_log_id

  match:
    $hostname, $tactic, $event_name over 24h before $e1

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 85
    $tactics = array_distinct($tactic)
    $event_names = array_distinct($event_name)
    $file_paths = array_distinct($file_path)
    $impacted_hosts = array_distinct($hostname)
    $impacted_host_count = count_distinct($hostname)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

    $days_seen_same_system_path_signature = max(
      metrics.alert_event_name_count(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum,
        agg:num_metric_periods,
        principal.asset.hostname:$hostname,
        principal.process.file.full_path:$file_path,
        security_result.rule_name:$event_name))

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $result = "succeeded"

  condition:
    $e and $e1 and ($event_count >= 2) and ($days_seen_same_system_path_signature >= 0) and ($days_seen_same_system_path_signature < 3)

rule ttp_linux_sudo_privilege_escalation_via_sed_sudoers_modification {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Sudo Privilege Escalation via Sed Sudoers Modification"
    description = "Detects the use of the sed stream editor to modify the /etc/sudoers configuration file to grant passwordless sudo privileges. Adversaries modify sudoers configurations to bypass authentication requirements and maintain persistent root-level access on compromised Linux systems."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0004"
    technique = "T1548.003"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"
    )
    $e.target.process.command_line = /sh\s+-c\s+"?sed\s+.*-i\b/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line = /\bALL=\(ALL\)/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line = /\bNOPASSWD:ALL/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line = /\/etc\/sudoers/ nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1
    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line

    $e
}

rule ttp_linux_sap_icman_shell_execution {
  meta:
    rule_name = "SAP ICM Spawning Command Shell"
    description = "Detects SAP Internet Communication Manager (icman) spawning interactive command shells or interpreters such as sh, bash, cmd.exe, or PowerShell. While not inherently malicious, this behavior could potentially indicate pre-authentication remote code execution."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"
    )
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /(?:^|[\\\/])icman(?:\.exe)?$/ nocase
    $e.target.process.file.full_path = /(?:^|[\\\/])((ba|da|z)?sh|(cmd|powershell|pwsh)\.exe)$/ nocase
    not $e.target.process.command_line = /sh\s-c.*"?\/usr\/sap\/[^\\\/]+\/[^\\\/]+\/exe\/sapmscsa\s+pf=\/usr\/sap\/[^\\\/]+\/[^\\\/]+\/profile\/[^\\\/]+\s*"?$/ nocase
    not $e.target.process.command_line = /(sh -c "?\/usr\/sap.*\/exe\/uc\/linuxx86_64\/icmbnd -v"?$|sh -c \/usr\/sap\/[^\\\/]+\/[^\\\/]+\/exe\/run\/icmbnd -v$)/

  meta:

    description = "Detects network activity (HTTP, DNS, or raw network connections) originating from a curl process with a POST request flag that was spawned by a Python parent process. Adversaries often abuse Python to silently proxy commands and execute curl to exfiltrate data or communicate with C2 servers."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1071"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_HTTP" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_DNS" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
    )
    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    (
      $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /\bcurl(?:\.exe)?$/ nocase or
      $e.principal.process.command_line = /(?:^|\s)curl\b/ nocase
    )
    $e.principal.process.command_line = /-X\s*POST\b/ nocase
    $e.principal.process.command_line = /--data-binary/ nocase
    (
      $e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path = /\bpython(?:3)?(?:\.exe)?$/ nocase or
      $e.principal.process.parent_process.file.names = /\bpython(?:3)?(?:\.exe)?$/ nocase

This behavior has been previously associated with Supply Chain Compromise."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059.006"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or

    )

    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1105"

      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or

rule ttp_linux_archive_exfiltration_via_curl_wget {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Linux Archive Exfiltration via Curl or Wget"
    description = "Detects the use of curl or wget to exfiltrate compressed archive files from temporary directories such as /tmp/ or /dev/shm/. This behavior is often associated with data collection and exfiltration by adversaries."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0009"
    technique = "T1560.001"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"
    )

    (
      any $e.target.process.file.names = /^(curl|wget)$/ nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `/(curl|wget)$`) nocase or
      any $e.principal.process.file.names = /^(curl|wget)$/ nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `/(curl|wget)$`) nocase
    )

    (
      (
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `(--data-binary|--data|-d|-F|--form|-T|--upload-file|--post-file)(\s+|=)[^/]*(/tmp/|/var/tmp/|/dev/shm/).*\.(tar\.gz|tgz|zip|gz|tar|rar|7z)`) nocase
      ) or
      (
        re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, `(--data-binary|--data|-d|-F|--form|-T|--upload-file|--post-file)(\s+|=)[^/]*(/tmp/|/var/tmp/|/dev/shm/).*\.(tar\.gz|tgz|zip|gz|tar|rar|7z)`) nocase
      )
    )
    not (
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `169\.254\.169\.254`) or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, `169\.254\.169\.254`)
    )

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.hostname
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = ""

    $principal_process_command_line = strings.coalesce($e.principal.process.command_line, "")
    $principal_process_file_full_path = strings.coalesce($e.principal.process.file.full_path, "")
    $principal_process_file_names = array_distinct($e.principal.process.file.names)
    $target_process_command_line = strings.coalesce($e.target.process.command_line, "")
    $target_process_file_full_path = strings.coalesce($e.target.process.file.full_path, "")
    $target_process_file_names = array_distinct($e.target.process.file.names)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result_time = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2, 0))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1, 0))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: Detects the use of curl or wget to exfiltrate compressed archive files from temporary directories such as /tmp/ or /dev/shm/. This behavior is often associated with data collection and exfiltration by adversaries.

rule ttp_linux_perl_spawning_shell_download_chmod_exec {
  meta:

    description = "Detects a Perl process spawning a command shell that downloads a remote file using curl or wget, modifies its permissions via chmod, and executes it. This pattern is commonly observed during exploitation of command injection vulnerabilities in Perl-based services (such as Zimbra Collaboration Suite or CGI scripts) to deploy post-exploitation payloads."

      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or

    $e.target.process.file.full_path = /(?:^|[\\\/])(ba|da|z)?sh$/ nocase and
    $e.target.process.command_line = /\b(curl|wget)\b/ nocase and
    $e.target.process.command_line = /\bchmod\s+([0-7]{3,4}|\+x)\b/ nocase and
    $e.target.process.command_line = /(?:^|[\\\/])tmp\b|\.[\\\/]/ nocase

  outcome:

    $tmp1 = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1
    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname

rule ttp_aws_ssm_command_execution {
  meta:
    rule_name = "AWS Systems Manager Command Execution"
    description = "AWS SSM enables you to run commands across an entire fleet of EC2 instances with SendCommand. Malicious actors may abuse this feature to perform actions, such as installing software or running scripts from the web, on fleet instances."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059.009"
    false_positives = "Known usage of this feature from administrators, approved software, or management services should be tuned out."

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"
    $e.target.application = "ssm.amazonaws.com"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "SendCommand"
    $command_document_name = $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["requestParameters.documentName"]

    (
      $command_document_name = /Run.*Script/ or //RunShellScript, RunPowershellScript, RunRemoteScript -> command execution
      $command_document_name = "AWS-InstallApplication" or //Installs a .msi file from local path OR url
      $command_document_name = "AWS-InstallPowerShellModule" or //Can install powershell module from url AND run powershell commands
      $command_document_name = "AWS-RunDocument" or // Runs document from github, s3, or ssm
      $command_document_name = "AWS-RunDockerAction" or // Run docker commands on instances
      $command_document_name = "AWSFleetManager-CreateWindowsRegistryKey" or //Create windows registry keys
      $command_document_name = "AWSFleetManager-TerminateProcess" or // terminate processes potentially security tools
      $command_document_name = "AWSSSO-CreateSSOUser" // Creates RDP user
    )
    $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW"

    $e.principal.user.userid != /AWSServiceRoleForImageBuilder|AWSServiceRoleForAmazonSSM/
    $actor = $e.principal.user.userid
    $actor != /PurpleboxRole\/PurpleBox/

  match:
    $actor over 24h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $user_agents = array_distinct($e.network.http.user_agent)
    $network_org_names = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.organization_name)
    $principal_ips = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $recipient_account_ids = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["recipientAccountId"])
    $cloud_regions = array_distinct($e.target.location.name)
    $target_resource_names = array_distinct($e.principal.resource.name)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ueba_aws_excessive_ec2_creations {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Excessive Number of EC2 Resources Created"
    description = "Detects excessive (10x the historical maximum value, if the entity has a coefficient of variation < 0.1 and was observed for at least 9 of the last 30 days) resource creations by user id."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0040"
    technique = "T1496"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "RESOURCE_CREATION"
    $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"

    $account_id = $e.additional.fields["recipientAccountId"]
    $user_id = $e.principal.user.userid
    $target_application = $e.target.application

    $e.target.application = "ec2.amazonaws.com"

  match:
    $user_id over 24h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $num_times_max = max(10)

    $historical_avg = max(metrics.resource_creation_success(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:avg,
        principal.user.userid:$user_id,
        metadata.vendor_name:"AMAZON",
        metadata.product_name:"AWS CloudTrail"
    ))

    $historical_max = max(metrics.resource_creation_success(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:max,
        principal.user.userid:$user_id,
        metadata.vendor_name:"AMAZON",
        metadata.product_name:"AWS CloudTrail"
    ))

    $historical_observations = max(metrics.resource_creation_success(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:num_metric_periods,
        principal.user.userid:$user_id,
        metadata.vendor_name:"AMAZON",
        metadata.product_name:"AWS CloudTrail"
    ))

    $historical_coefficient_of_variation = max(
      metrics.resource_creation_success(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:stddev,
        principal.user.userid:$user_id,
        metadata.vendor_name:"AMAZON",
        metadata.product_name:"AWS CloudTrail") /
      metrics.resource_creation_success(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:avg,
        principal.user.userid:$user_id,
        metadata.vendor_name:"AMAZON",
        metadata.product_name:"AWS CloudTrail"))
    $observation_threshold = max(9)

    $coefficient_of_variation_threshold = max(1/10)

    $historical_threshold = max(10 * metrics.resource_creation_success(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:max,
        principal.user.userid:$user_id,
        metadata.vendor_name:"AMAZON",
        metadata.product_name:"AWS CloudTrail"))

    $vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"

  condition:
    $e and ($event_count > $historical_threshold) and ($historical_coefficient_of_variation < $coefficient_of_variation_threshold) and ($historical_observations >= $observation_threshold)
}
rules.description: Detects excessive (10x the historical maximum value, if the entity has a coefficient of variation < 0.1 and was observed for at least 9 of the last 30 days) resource creations by user id.
rules.author: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence

rule ttp_aws_lambda_update_function_code {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Lambda Function Code Modified"
    description = "Detects an IAM user attempting to update or modify AWS lambda code."
    severity = "Info"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1648"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = /UpdateFunctionCode/
    $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    $user_id = $e.principal.user.userid
    $user_id != /PurpleboxRole\/PurpleBox/

  match:
    $user_id over 1h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"
    $principal_ips = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $principal_users = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $recipient_account_ids = array_distinct($e.principal.resource.attribute.labels["Recipient Account Id"])
    $cloud_regions = array_distinct($e.target.location.name)

    $user_agents = array_distinct($e.network.http.user_agent)

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)

  condition:

  meta:
    rule_name = "LEMONLIME HTTP POST C2 activity"
    description = "Detects HTTP POST activity to a URI format used in the LEMONLIME downloader code family. LEMONLIME is used to deliver a secondary executable payload. URI parameters containing page1, page2 or page3 are for exfiltrating system information. HTTP POST activity to the URI parameter containing page4 indicates a secondary payload is being downloaded."

    tactic = "TA0043"
    technique = "T1592"

rule ttp_windows_node_script_execution_via_cmd {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Suspicious Node.js Script Execution via CMD"
    description = "Detects the execution of a Node.js script (e.g., setup scripts) launched via the Windows command shell (cmd.exe) using the /c flag, which may indicate automated or malicious script execution."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"

    (
      any $e.target.process.file.names = /.*\bnode\.exe\b.*/ nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `\\node\.exe`) nocase
    )

    (
      any $e.principal.process.file.names = /.*\bcmd\.exe\b.*/ nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `\\cmd\.exe`) nocase or
      any $e.target.process.parent_process.file.names = /.*\bcmd\.exe\b.*/ nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.parent_process.file.full_path, `\\cmd\.exe`) nocase
    )

    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `setup.*\.js`) nocase

    (
      re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, `/c.*node`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.parent_process.command_line, `/c.*node`) nocase
    )

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.hostname
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = ""

    $principal_process_command_line = strings.coalesce($e.principal.process.command_line, "")
    $principal_process_file_full_path = strings.coalesce($e.principal.process.file.full_path, "")
    $principal_process_file_names = array_distinct($e.principal.process.file.names)
    $target_process_command_line = strings.coalesce($e.target.process.command_line, "")
    $target_process_file_full_path = strings.coalesce($e.target.process.file.full_path, "")
    $target_process_file_names = array_distinct($e.target.process.file.names)
    $target_process_parent_process_command_line = strings.coalesce($e.target.process.parent_process.command_line, "")
    $target_process_parent_process_file_full_path = strings.coalesce($e.target.process.parent_process.file.full_path, "")
    $target_process_parent_process_file_names = array_distinct($e.target.process.parent_process.file.names)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result_time = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2, 0))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1, 0))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: Detects the execution of a Node.js script (e.g., setup scripts) launched via the Windows command shell (cmd.exe) using the /c flag, which may indicate automated or malicious script execution.
rules.author: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence

      any $e.principal.process.file.names = /^explorer\.exe$/ nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `(^|\\)explorer\.exe$`) nocase

    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset_id

    $e

rule m_exploit_cve202559287_1 {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Command Prompt Launching From WSUS Process"
    description = "This rule detects the Windows command prompt (cmd.exe) being launched by a Windows Server Update Services (WSUS) process. This activity is unusual and could indicate an attacker is exploiting a vulnerability (such as CVE-2025-59287) to execute arbitrary commands on the server. Legitimate WSUS operations do not typically involve spawning interactive command shells."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059.003"
    false_positives = "Legitimate administrative tasks or other software interacting with WSUS in an unexpected way could cause a false positive, but this is expected to be rare."
    reference = "https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/alerts/2025/10/24/microsoft-releases-out-band-security-update-mitigate-windows-server-update-service-vulnerability-cve"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $e.target.process.file.full_path = /cmd\.exe$/ nocase

    (
      $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /wsusservice\.exe$/ nocase
      or
      (
        $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /w3wp\.exe$/ nocase and
        $e.principal.process.command_line = /wsuspool/ nocase
      )
    )
    $hostname = $e.principal.asset.hostname

  match:
    $hostname over 5m

  outcome:

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($hostname)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct("")
    $adversary_name = array_distinct("")
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct("")

  condition:
    $e
}

rules.text:
rule ttp_windows_360ts_recom_apps_process_spawning {
  meta:
    rule_name = "360 TS Recommended Apps Spawning Suspicious Process"
    description = "Detects process launch events where the parent process executes out of the 360 Total Security (TS) Recommended Apps directory and spawns a command shell, script interpreter, or administrative utility (such as cmd.exe, powershell.exe, wmic.exe, netsh.exe). It also detects processes spawned from this directory with a suspicious command line pattern containing an MD5 hash. This is highly indicative of adware installation hijacking, malware drop/execution, or DLL sideloading abuse. This TTP has been previously associated with SUNBRICKED malware."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1204.002"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"
    ) and
    (
      $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /[\/\\]TS Recommended Apps[\/\\]/ nocase or
      $e.target.process.parent_process.file.full_path = /[\/\\]TS Recommended Apps[\/\\]/ nocase
    ) and
    (
      $e.target.process.file.full_path = /\b(netsh|cmd|wmic|powershell|pwsh|rundll32|regsvr32|mshta|certutil|schtasks|wscript|cscript|sc|bitsadmin)\.exe$/ nocase or
      $e.target.process.command_line = /\b(whoami|tasklist|netsh|cmd|wmic|powershell|pwsh|rundll32|regsvr32|mshta|certutil|schtasks|wscript|cscript|sc|bitsadmin)\b/ nocase or
      $e.target.process.command_line = /\-s\s+.*\-m\s+\b[a-fA-F0-9]{32}\b["]{0,5}\s*$|\bnet(\.exe)?\s+(user|group|localgroup)\b/ nocase
    )
  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1
    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)
    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: Detects process launch events where the parent process executes out of the 360 Total Security (TS) Recommended Apps directory and spawns a command shell, script interpreter, or administrative utility (such as cmd.exe, powershell.exe, wmic.exe, netsh.exe). It also detects processes spawned from this directory with a suspicious command line pattern containing an MD5 hash. This is highly indicative of adware installation hijacking, malware drop/execution, or DLL sideloading abuse. This TTP has been previously associated with SUNBRICKED malware.

rule ttp_explorer_spawning_archiver_chrome_lure {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Explorer Spawning Archiver for Chrome Update Lure"
    description = "Detects Windows Explorer spawning an archive utility (like WinRAR or 7-Zip) to open a potentially malicious ZIP archive masquerading as a Google Chrome update."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1204.002"

  events:
    ($e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH") and
    (
      (
        any $e.principal.process.file.names = /.*explorer\.exe.*/ nocase or
        re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `.*\\explorer\.exe.*`) nocase or
        any $e.target.process.parent_process.file.names = /.*explorer\.exe.*/ nocase or
        re.regex($e.target.process.parent_process.file.full_path, `.*\\explorer\.exe.*`) nocase
      ) and
      (
        any $e.target.process.file.names = /.*(winrar|7zfm|winzip|winzip64)\.exe.*/ nocase or
        re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `.*\\(winrar|7zfm|winzip|winzip64)\.exe.*`) nocase
      ) and
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `.*Chrome.*\.zip.*`) nocase
    )

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.hostname
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name

    $principal_process_file_full_path = if($e.principal.process.file.full_path != "", $e.principal.process.file.full_path, "")
    $principal_process_file_names = array_distinct($e.principal.process.file.names)
    $target_process_command_line = if($e.target.process.command_line != "", $e.target.process.command_line, "")

    $target_process_parent_process_file_names = array_distinct($e.target.process.parent_process.file.names)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result_time = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2, 0))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1, 0))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e

  events:
    $e1.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"

      (
        $e1.target.url = /^http:\/\/[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\/file$/ and
        $e1.target.port = 443
      ) or
      $e1.target.url = "global.db" or

    ($e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED") and

          re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `.*dir\s*=\s*out.*`) nocase and

        any $e.principal.process.file.names = /\bnetsh\.exe\b/ nocase or

    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result_time = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2, 0))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1, 0))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e

rules.text:
rule m_hunting_win_python_programdata_persistence_1 {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Methodology - Python Dropper and Scheduled Task Persistence"
    description = "Detects a malicious Python process dropping an executable into the C:\\ProgramData\\ directory tree, followed by the creation of a scheduled task to execute a binary from that same directory. Threat actors utilize this chain to deploy hidden RATs (like NetSupport) and establish persistence."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1053.005"
    false_positives = "Highly unlikely. While legitimate applications create scheduled tasks pointing to ProgramData, it is extremely rare for a Python interpreter to drop an executable into ProgramData immediately prior to a task creation event."

  events:
    $e1.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION"
    $e1.principal.platform = "WINDOWS"
    $e1.principal.process.file.full_path = /pythonw?\.exe/ nocase
    $e1.target.file.full_path = /(?:^|\\)(?:programdata|windows\\temp|users\\public)\\[^"]+\.exe/ nocase

    $dropped_file = $e1.target.file.full_path
    $hostname = $e1.principal.hostname
    $e2.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $e2.principal.platform = "WINDOWS"

    $cmd_line = $e2.target.process.command_line
    $cmd_line = /schtasks(?:\.exe)?/ nocase
    $cmd_line = /\/create/ nocase
    $cmd_line = /\/tr\s/ nocase
    $cmd_line = /(?:^|\\)(?:programdata|windows\\temp|users\\public)\\[^"]+\.exe/ nocase
    $e2.principal.hostname = $hostname

  match:
    $hostname over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.product_name)
    $result = array_distinct("attempted")
    $result_time = max($e2.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct("")
    $victim_name = array_distinct($hostname)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e1.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct("")
    $adversary_name = array_distinct("")
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct("")
    $dropped_executable = array_distinct($dropped_file)
    $schtasks_cmdline = array_distinct($cmd_line)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e1.metadata.id) + count_distinct($e2.metadata.id)

  condition:
    $e1 and $e2
}
rules.description: Detects a malicious Python process dropping an executable into the C:\ProgramData\ directory tree, followed by the creation of a scheduled task to execute a binary from that same directory. Threat actors utilize this chain to deploy hidden RATs (like NetSupport) and establish persistence.

    description = "SWITCHBLADE is a dropper that drops a next-stage payload onto the disk and adds it to the startup run-registry key to achieve persistence.     tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1547.001"

rule ttp_powershell_file_carving_and_execution {
  meta:
    rule_name = "PowerShell File Carving and Execution"
    description = "This rule detects a PowerShell command used to find a file, carve out a portion of its content, write it to a new file in the temp directory, and then execute it. This technique is used by adversaries to unpack and run payloads from an initial dropper file while hiding the execution window."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059.001"

      re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `powershell(\.exe)?`) nocase or

    )
    and re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\s+(-w|-WindowStyle)\s+1\b`) nocase
    and re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\[System\.IO\.File\]::ReadAllBytes`) nocase
    and re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `WriteAllBytes\(\s*\$Env:temp`) nocase
    and (
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\b(tar|tar\.exe)\s+`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\bStart-Process\s+.*\$Env:temp`) nocase

    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)

    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)

    $adversary_netid = array_distinct(
      if($e.principal.platform = "WINDOWS",
        $e.principal.user.windows_sid,  // Value if TRUE

      )
    )
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_windows_powershell_download_execute_temp {
  meta:
    rule_name = "PowerShell Download and Execute from Temp Directory"
    description = "Detects PowerShell executing a command to download a payload to a temporary directory and immediately execute it, a behavior commonly associated with social engineering and other malware delivery."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059.001"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"
    )

    (
      any $e.target.process.file.names = /\b(powershell|pwsh)\.exe\b/ nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `\b(powershell|pwsh)\.exe\b`) nocase
    )

    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\b(iwr|invoke-webrequest|wget|irm|invoke-restmethod)\s.*-outfile\s.*(\$env:(temp|tmp)|%(temp|tmp)%).*;\s?(iex|invoke-expression|&).*(\$env:(temp|tmp)|%(temp|tmp)%)`) nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.hostname
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = ""

    $target_process_command_line = strings.coalesce($e.target.process.command_line, "")
    $target_process_file_full_path = strings.coalesce($e.target.process.file.full_path, "")
    $target_process_file_names = array_distinct($e.target.process.file.names)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result_time = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2, 0))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1, 0))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e
}

    $tmp1 = max(

    )

    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)
    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0)

        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `set\s+["']?[a-zA-Z0-9_]+["']?\s*=[^&]+&&`) nocase and
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `call\s+echo\s+["']?%[a-zA-Z0-9_]+%["']?`) nocase and

  outcome:

    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset_id

    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name

    $target_process_file_full_path = if($e.target.process.file.full_path != "", $e.target.process.file.full_path, "")
    $target_process_file_md5 = if($e.target.process.file.md5 != "", $e.target.process.file.md5, "")
    $target_process_file_names = array_distinct($e.target.process.file.names)

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)

rule m_hunting_saas_salesforce_systematic_soql_scraping_1 {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Methodology - Systematic Scraping of High-Value Salesforce Objects"
    description = "Detects an entity systematically executing SOQL queries against multiple highly sensitive Salesforce objects (such as Contract, Opportunity, Lead, Contact, Account) in a short timeframe. This behavior is indicative of a threat actor methodically extracting core business data and PII following a compromise."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0009"
    technique = "T1213"
    false_positives = "Legitimate CRM backup solutions, full-org sync integrations, or data warehousing pipelines performing nightly extracts."

  events:
    $e.metadata.product_name = "Salesforce" nocase
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_RESOURCE_ACCESS" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_READ"
    )
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "UniqueQuery" nocase
    (
      $e.target.resource.name = /^(Opportunity|Contract|Account|Contact|Lead|Campaign|Task|Event|Case)$/ nocase or
      $e.target.url = /\b(Opportunity|Contract|Account|Contact|Lead|Campaign|Task|Event|Case)\b/ nocase
    )
    (
      any $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.asn = "43641" or
      any $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.asn = "6698" or
      any $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.asn = "214961"
    )

    $user = $e.principal.user.userid

  match:
    $user over 15m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $result = array_distinct("succeeded")
    $result_time = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $query_threshold = max(10)
    $distinct_objects = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)
    $num_distinct_objects = count_distinct($e.target.resource.name)
    $num_queries = count($e.metadata.id)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct("")
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)

  condition:
    $e and #e > 10 and $num_distinct_objects > 1
}

    $event_count = count_distinct($dns.metadata.id)
    $dns_questions_name = array_distinct($dns.network.dns.questions.name)
    $process_file_full_path = array_distinct($dns.principal.process.file.full_path)

    $result_time = min($dns.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($dns.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $dns.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)

      if($dns.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)

rule m_hunting_tamperengine_disablewindowsdefenderfileandprogramregistry_1 {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Windows Defender Real-time File and Program Monitoring Being Disabled via Registry Key Change"
    description = "Windows Defender contains functionality to disable real-time behaviour detection by adding a registry key named DisableOnAccessProtection to HKLM\\Software\\Policies\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Real-Time Protection, with a DWORD value of 1. Once this key is set, Windows Defender will stop real-time monitoring of behaviour."
    severity = "Low"
    technique = "T1685"
    false_positives = "It is possible that in some environments system administrators may be using scripts or scheduled tasks to disable Windows Defender."

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "REGISTRY_CREATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "REGISTRY_MODIFICATION"
    )
    (
      $e.target.registry.registry_key = "HKLM\\Software\\Policies\\Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Real-Time Protection" nocase and
      $e.target.registry.registry_value_name = "DisableOnAccessProtection" nocase and
      not re.regex($e.target.registry.registry_value_data, `\x00`) and // not 0. Anything more than 0 will likely trigger the change
      $e.target.registry.registry_value_data != "" and
      $e.principal.process.command_line != /-k GPSvcGroup/ nocase and // exclude MS group policy setting the registry key
      $e.principal.process.command_line != /-s gpsvc/ nocase
    )
    $e.principal.hostname = $hostname

  match:
    $hostname over 5m

  outcome:

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $target_registry_registry_keys = array_distinct($e.target.registry.registry_key)
    $target_registry_registry_value_names = array_distinct($e.target.registry.registry_value_name)
    $target_registry_registry_value_data = array_distinct($e.target.registry.registry_value_data)

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

rule ttp_suspicious_service_event_log_clearing_or_smbexec {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Suspicious Service Event Log Clearing or SMBExec Pattern"
    description = "Detects the execution of a batch script via a newly created service (smbexec pattern) or an encoded PowerShell command to clear Windows Event Logs, often indicative of Impacket usage or defense evasion."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1685.005"

  events:
    ($e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED") and
    (
      (
        any $e.principal.process.file.names = /services\.exe/ nocase or
        re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `.*\\services\.exe`) nocase or
        any $e.target.process.parent_process.file.names = /services\.exe/ nocase or
        re.regex($e.target.process.parent_process.file.full_path, `.*\\services\.exe`) nocase
      ) and
      (
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `.*(IABHAGUAdAAtAFcAaQBuAEV2AGUAbgB0AEwAbwBn|AEMAbABlAGEAcgAtAFcAaQBuAEV2AGUAbgB0AEwAbwBn|QwBsAGUAYQByAC0AVwBpAG4ARQB2AGUAbgB0|QwBsAGUAYQByAC0ARQB2AGUAbgB0AEwAbwBn|AEMAbABlAGEAcgAtAEUAdgBlAG4AdABMAG8AZw|wevtutil.*\s+cl|Clear-WinEvent|Clear-EventLog).*`) nocase or
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `.*>\s*.*\.bat\s*&.*\.bat\s*&.*del\s+.*\.bat.*`) nocase
      )
    )

  outcome:
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.windows_sid)
    $risk_score = 0
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.hostname
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name

    $principal_process_file_full_path = if($e.principal.process.file.full_path != "", $e.principal.process.file.full_path, "")
    $principal_process_file_names = array_distinct($e.principal.process.file.names)
    $target_process_command_line = if($e.target.process.command_line != "", $e.target.process.command_line, "")
    $target_process_file_full_path = if($e.target.process.file.full_path != "", $e.target.process.file.full_path, "")
    $target_process_parent_process_file_full_path = if($e.target.process.parent_process.file.full_path != "", $e.target.process.parent_process.file.full_path, "")
    $target_process_parent_process_file_names = array_distinct($e.target.process.parent_process.file.names)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result_time = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2, 0))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1, 0))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_windows_rdp_filewrite_from_phishing {
  meta:

    description = "Detects when an RDP configuration file (.rdp) is created or moved by commonly abused processes such as mail clients, or archive extraction utilities.     technique = "T1566"

    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MODIFICATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_UNCATEGORIZED" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MOVE"
    ) and
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path != "" and
    $e.target.file.full_path = /\.rdp$/ nocase and
    (
      $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /(?:outlook|winrar|7zG|system)\.exe$/ nocase or
      $e.target.file.full_path = /\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\Windows\\INetCache\\Content\.Outlook\\/ nocase

  outcome:

    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1
    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname

    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line

rule m_hunting_saas_salesforce_querymore_abuse_1 {

    description = "Detects repeated calls to the Salesforce REST API 'QueryMore' endpoint originating from a bulletproof hosting ASN. Threat actors use this endpoint to fetch subsequent batches of records when an initial data extraction query exceeds standard API return limits."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0010"
    technique = "T1567"

      any $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.asn = "43641" or
      any $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.asn = "6698" or
      any $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.asn = "214961"

    $user = $e.principal.user.userid

  outcome:

    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.target.resource.name)

    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)

rule ttp_windows_w3wp_lateral_movement_network_connection {
  meta:

    description = "Detects the Internet Information Services (IIS) worker process (w3wp.exe) initiating outbound network connections over ports commonly used for administrative access and lateral movement (SMB port 445, WinRM HTTP port 5985, and WinRM HTTPS port 5986). Legitimate web application behavior rarely involves direct outbound communication using SMB or Windows Remote Management. This activity is highly suspicious and often indicates a compromised web server or web shell being used to propagate laterally within the network."

    tactic = "TA0008"
    technique = "T1021"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"

      $e.target.port = 445 or
      $e.target.port = 5985 or
      $e.target.port = 5986
    )
    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname

  match:
    $hostname over 6h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)

    $tmp1 = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

rules.text:
rule ttp_windows_trojanized_putty_execution {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Trojanized PuTTY Process Injection or Execution"
    description = "Detects the execution of PuTTY.exe from a common user-writable staging directory (such as Downloads or Temp) initiating a cross-process action or launching a child process. This behavior is highly unusual for a legitimate terminal emulator and is indicative of a trojanized PuTTY executable performing process injection or executing a malicious payload."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1055"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"
    )

    (
      any $e.principal.process.file.names = /putty\.exe/ nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `\\putty\.exe`) nocase or
      any $e.target.process.parent_process.file.names = /putty\.exe/ nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.parent_process.file.full_path, `\\putty\.exe`) nocase
    )

    (
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `\\(Downloads|Temp|Tmp|AppData|ProgramData|Public)\\`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.parent_process.file.full_path, `\\(Downloads|Temp|Tmp|AppData|ProgramData|Public)\\`) nocase
    )

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.hostname
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = ""

    $principal_process_file_full_path = strings.coalesce($e.principal.process.file.full_path, "")
    $principal_process_file_names = array_distinct($e.principal.process.file.names)
    $target_process_parent_process_file_full_path = strings.coalesce($e.target.process.parent_process.file.full_path, "")
    $target_process_parent_process_file_names = array_distinct($e.target.process.parent_process.file.names)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result_time = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2, 0))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1, 0))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: Detects the execution of PuTTY.exe from a common user-writable staging directory (such as Downloads or Temp) initiating a cross-process action or launching a child process. This behavior is highly unusual for a legitimate terminal emulator and is indicative of a trojanized PuTTY executable performing process injection or executing a malicious payload.
rules.author: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence

rule ttp_windows_iis_viewstate_exploitation_file_tampering {
  meta:
    rule_name = "IIS ViewState Exploitation Followed by Web Root File Tampering"
    description = "Detects a ViewState verification failure (Event Code 4009) followed within 30 minutes by the IIS worker process (w3wp.exe) writing or modifying .js, .aspx, or .config files in the web root. This suggests an attacker has successfully exploited a deserialization flaw and is establishing persistence or tampering with libraries."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1505.003"

  events:
    (
      $e1.metadata.log_type = "WINEVTLOG" or
      $e1.metadata.log_type = "WINEVTLOG_XML"
    )
    $e1.additional.fields["Message"] = /Event code: 4009\b.*Viewstate verification failed/ nocase
    $e1.principal.hostname = $hostname
    (
      $e2.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION" or
      $e2.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MOVE" or
      $e2.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MODIFICATION" or
      $e2.metadata.event_type = "FILE_UNCATEGORIZED"
    )
    $e2.principal.process.file.full_path = /\bw3wp\.exe$/ nocase
    $e2.target.file.full_path = /(\.js|\.aspx|\.config)$/ nocase
    $e2.target.file.full_path = /\\inetpub\\wwwroot\\/ nocase
    $e2.principal.hostname = $hostname
    $e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds <= $e2.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

  match:
    $hostname over 30m after $e1

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e2.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e2.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e2.principal.asset.asset_id)

rule ttp_anydesk_executable_creation {
  meta:

    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1219"

  events:
    ($e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION" or $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MODIFICATION" or $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MOVE") and
    (
      re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `.*(\\|/)anydesk\.exe$`) nocase
    )
    not re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `.*\\Program Files \(x86\)\\AnyDesk\\anydesk\.exe$`) nocase
    not (
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `.*\\msedge\.exe$`) nocase and
      re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `.*\\Users\\.*\\Downloads\\AnyDesk\.exe$`) nocase
    )
    not (
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `.*\\explorer\.exe$`) nocase and
      re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `.*\\Users\\.*\\Documents\\.*\\anydesk\.exe$`) nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.hostname
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)

    $principal_process_file_full_path = if($e.principal.process.file.full_path != "", $e.principal.process.file.full_path, "")
    $target_file_full_path = if($e.target.file.full_path != "", $e.target.file.full_path, "")
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1, 0))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule m_hunting_discovery_cisco_ssh_telnet_1 {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Cisco Discovery with SSH/Telnet"
    description = "Looks for Cisco ISE and TACACS logs that contain more than 15 consecutive unique command line with a command that is either telnet, ssh, or ssh -l followed by a numeric IP address within 30 minutes. This could indicate attacker discovery of the enviroment."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0007"
    technique = "T1046"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Cisco"
    (
      $e.metadata.log_type = "CISCO_ISE" OR
      $e.metadata.log_type = "CISCO_TACACS"
    )
    $target_ip = $e.target.ip
    $e.target.process.command_line = /^CmdAV=(telnet|ssh|ssh\s+-l)\s+/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line = /[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}/
    $ip_address = re.capture($e.target.process.command_line, /([0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3})/)
    $command_line = $e.target.process.command_line

  match:
    $target_ip over 30m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $cmdline = array_distinct($e.target.process.command_line)
    $unique_count_ip_addresses = count_distinct($ip_address)
    $unique_ip_addresses = array_distinct($ip_address)
    $unique_count_command_lines = count_distinct($command_line)
    $unique_command_lines = array_distinct($command_line)
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    #e >= 14 and $unique_count_command_lines >= 14
}

    $e.target.process.file.full_path = /\b(cmd|powershell|pwsh)(\.exe)?$/ nocase and
    $e.target.process.command_line = /\bcurl(\.exe)?\b/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line = /-X\s+POST\b|https?:\/\// nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line != /\.verizon.com\/|\.ha\.org\.hk\// nocase
