    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid

    $tmp1 = max(

      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )

rule m_hunting_persistence_vgauth_soh_1 {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Use of VGAuthCLI.exe in a non-standard path"
    description = "VMWare Guest Authentication Services (VGAuth) is a legitimate tool part of the VMWare Tool suit. However, threat actors have been noticed bundling original VMWare files along with maliicious DLLs that get loaded by search order hijacking. This rule looks for VGAuthCli.exe along with it's required DLLs within a non-standard path. When this rule alerts, all files (exe + DLLs) within the folder should be inspected for legitimacy."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1574.001"
    false_positives = "False positives may occur if an administrator chooses to manually run these files from a non-standard location."

  events:
    $e1.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION"
    $e1.target.file.full_path = /vgauthcli\.exe$/ nocase and
    $e1.target.file.full_path != /Program Files\\VMware\\VMware Tools\\VMware VGAuth/ nocase and
    $exe_target_file_path = strings.to_lower(re.capture($e1.target.file.full_path, `(?i)(.*)\\vgauthcli\.exe$`))
    $hostname = $e1.principal.hostname

    $e2.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION"
    (
      $e2.target.file.full_path = /libxml.dll$/ nocase or
      $e2.target.file.full_path = /libxml2.dll$/ nocase or
      $e2.target.file.full_path = /VGauth.dll$/ nocase or
      $e2.target.file.full_path = /netmsg.dll$/ nocase or
      $e2.target.file.full_path = /glib-2.0-0.dll$/ nocase
    ) and
    $e2.target.file.full_path != /Program Files\\VMware\\VMware Tools\\VMware VGAuth/ nocase and
    $dll_target_file_path = strings.to_lower(re.capture($e2.target.file.full_path, `(.*)\\.*\.dll$`))
    $hostname = $e2.principal.hostname

    $exe_target_file_path = $dll_target_file_path

  match:
    $hostname over 1h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $event_count = count_distinct($e1.metadata.id)

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.product_name)
    $result_time = min($e2.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(if($e2.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e2.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e2.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e1 and $e2
}

rule ttp_python_impacket_library_modification {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Python Impacket Library Modification"
    description = "Detects the creation or modification of files within the Impacket library directory inside a Python site-packages or dist-packages folder. This may indicate an attacker installing or modifying the Impacket toolset for lateral movement or execution."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0042"
    technique = "T1587.001"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "FILE_MODIFICATION"
    ) and

    (
      re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `.*(site-packages|dist-packages)(\\|/)+impacket.*`) nocase or
      any $e.target.file.names = /.*(site-packages|dist-packages)(\\|\/)+impacket.*/ nocase
    )

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.hostname
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.windows_sid)

    $target_file_full_path = if($e.target.file.full_path != "", $e.target.file.full_path, "")
    $target_file_names = array_distinct($e.target.file.names)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result_time = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2, 0))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1, 0))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: Detects the creation or modification of files within the Impacket library directory inside a Python site-packages or dist-packages folder. This may indicate an attacker installing or modifying the Impacket toolset for lateral movement or execution.
rules.author: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence

  meta:

      $e.target.process.command_line = /sc\screate\s.*\sbinPath=\s*["']?(?:[a-zA-Z]:|\\Device\\HarddiskVolume\d+)\\Users\\Public\\/ nocase
    )

  outcome:

    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $event_count = 1
    $principal_process_command_lines = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $target_process_command_lines = $e.target.process.command_line

    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.userid

    $result = "successful"
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

  condition:
    $e
}

    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1204.002"

    reference = "https://www.virustotal.com/gui/collection/malware--3f56996c-04f9-54e0-baee-9abb0d63a40e"

  events:

    $e1.target.file.full_path = /Database.MDF/ nocase
    $e1.principal.hostname = $hostname

    $e2.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION"
    $e2.target.file.full_path = /curent.txt/ nocase
    $e2.principal.hostname = $hostname

  match:
    $hostname over 5m

  outcome:

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.vendor_name)

    $tmp2 = max(if($e2.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e1 and $e2
}

    severity = "Low"

  events:

      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
      or $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"
      or $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_OPEN"

    (
      $e.target.process.command_line = /maper\.info/ nocase
      or $e.target.process.command_line = /grabify\.link/ nocase
      or $e.target.process.command_line = /iplogger\.ru/ nocase
      or $e.target.process.command_line = /iplogger\.co/ nocase

rule ttp_suspicious_execution_from_temp_random_dir {

      (
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `.*\\Temp\\[a-zA-Z0-9]{5,12}\.[a-zA-Z0-9]{2,4}\\[a-zA-Z0-9]{5,12}\.[a-zA-Z0-9]{2,4}\.exe.*`) nocase or
        re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `.*\\Temp\\[a-zA-Z0-9]{5,12}\.[a-zA-Z0-9]{2,4}\\[a-zA-Z0-9]{5,12}\.[a-zA-Z0-9]{2,4}\.exe.*`) nocase or

        re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `.*\\Temp\\[a-zA-Z0-9]{5,12}\.[a-zA-Z0-9]{2,4}\\[a-zA-Z0-9]{5,12}\.[a-zA-Z0-9]{2,4}\.exe.*`) nocase or
        re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, `.*\\Temp\\[a-zA-Z0-9]{5,12}\.[a-zA-Z0-9]{2,4}\\[a-zA-Z0-9]{5,12}\.[a-zA-Z0-9]{2,4}\.exe.*`) nocase
      )
    )

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.hostname
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name

    $principal_process_command_line = if($e.principal.process.command_line != "", $e.principal.process.command_line, "")
    $principal_process_file_full_path = if($e.principal.process.file.full_path != "", $e.principal.process.file.full_path, "")
    $target_file_full_path = if($e.target.file.full_path != "", $e.target.file.full_path, "")
    $target_process_command_line = if($e.target.process.command_line != "", $e.target.process.command_line, "")
    $target_process_file_full_path = if($e.target.process.file.full_path != "", $e.target.process.file.full_path, "")
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result_time = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2, 0))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1, 0))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e
}

    $file_id_2 = re.capture($e2.target.url, /googleapis\.com\/drive\/v3\/files\/([^\/]+)/)

  condition:

    description = "A registry modification is being used to change the contents of the exclusion list. This list will not be scanned by antivirus. Modification of this list, adding paths to be abused, is a common defensive evasion tactic."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1564"
    false_positives = "Many organizations have valid use-cases to add to the exclusion list."

    )
    $e1.target.registry.registry_key = /Microsoft\\Windows Defender\\Exclusions/ nocase

    $registry_key = array_distinct($e1.target.registry.registry_key)
    $registry_value_name = array_distinct($e1.target.registry.registry_value_name)
    $registry_value_data = array_distinct($e1.target.registry.registry_value_data)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e1.metadata.id)

    $result_time = min($e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e1.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e1.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)

      if($e1.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)

    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

rule ttp_suspicious_service_disabling_via_services_exe {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Suspicious Service Disabling via Services.exe"
    description = "Detects a newly created service or WMI provider executing a command to disable or stop a system service using the sc utility. This behavior is often associated with lateral movement tools creating temporary services to impair defenses or critical infrastructure."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0040"
    technique = "T1489"

  events:
    ($e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH") and
    (
      (
        any $e.principal.process.file.names = /\bservices\.exe\b/ nocase or
        re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `.*\\services\.exe`) nocase or
        any $e.target.process.parent_process.file.names = /\bservices\.exe\b/ nocase or
        re.regex($e.target.process.parent_process.file.full_path, `.*\\services\.exe`) nocase or
        any $e.principal.process.file.names = /\bwmiprvse\.exe\b/ nocase or
        re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `.*\\wmiprvse\.exe`) nocase or
        any $e.target.process.parent_process.file.names = /\bwmiprvse\.exe\b/ nocase or
        re.regex($e.target.process.parent_process.file.full_path, `.*\\wmiprvse\.exe`) nocase
      ) and
      (
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `.*\bsc\s+config\s+.*start=\s*disabled.*`) nocase or
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `.*\bsc\.exe\s+config\s+.*start=\s*disabled.*`) nocase or
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `.*\bsc\s+stop\s+.*`) nocase or
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `.*\bsc\.exe\s+stop\s+.*`) nocase
      )
    )
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `.*\\sc(?:\.exe)?\s+config\s+RemoteRegistry\s+start=\s*disabled.*`) nocase
    not re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `\bsc(\s+|\.exe\s+)stop\s+windows_exporter\b`) nocase

  outcome:
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.windows_sid)
    $risk_score = 0
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.hostname
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name

    $principal_process_file_full_path = if($e.principal.process.file.full_path != "", $e.principal.process.file.full_path, "")
    $principal_process_file_names = array_distinct($e.principal.process.file.names)
    $target_process_command_line = if($e.target.process.command_line != "", $e.target.process.command_line, "")
    $target_process_file_full_path = if($e.target.process.file.full_path != "", $e.target.process.file.full_path, "")
    $target_process_parent_process_file_full_path = if($e.target.process.parent_process.file.full_path != "", $e.target.process.parent_process.file.full_path, "")
    $target_process_parent_process_file_names = array_distinct($e.target.process.parent_process.file.names)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result_time = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2, 0))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1, 0))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e

    $e1.additional.fields["accessKeyId"] = $access_key

    $e2.metadata.vendor_name = "AMAZON"

  outcome:

    $principal_users = array_distinct($e1.principal.user.userid)

    $victim_name = array_distinct($e1.principal.asset.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e1.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e1.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e1.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e1.principal.user.windows_sid)
    $result_time = array_distinct($e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:

rule m_hunting_fortinet_exploitation_1 {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Suspicious FortiManager Inbound and Outbound Connection"
    description = "Detection of connections to the FortiManager port and then following outbound connection to an external IP. This is commonly observed in exploitation attempts."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1071"

  events:
    $e1.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
    $e1.principal.ip != ""
    $e1.target.ip != ""
    $e1.principal.ip != /^(10|127)\.([0-9]{1,3}\.){2}[0-9]{1,3}$/
    not net.ip_in_range_cidr($e1.principal.ip, "172.16.0.0/12")
    not net.ip_in_range_cidr($e1.principal.ip, "192.168.0.0/24")
    $e1.target.ip != /^(10|127)\.([0-9]{1,3}\.){2}[0-9]{1,3}$/
    not net.ip_in_range_cidr($e1.target.ip, "172.16.0.0/12")
    not net.ip_in_range_cidr($e1.target.ip, "192.168.0.0/24")
    $e1.target.ip != "0.0.0.0"
    $e1.principal.ip != "0.0.0.0"
    $e1.target.port = 541
    $e1.principal.port >= 49152
    any $e1.security_result.action != "BLOCK"

    $impacted_nat_ip = $e1.target.ip
    $exploitation_ip = $e1.principal.ip
    $e2.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
    $e2.target.ip != ""
    $e2.principal.ip != ""
    $e2.principal.ip != "0.0.0.0"
    $e2.target.port = 443
    $e2.principal.port >= 49152
    any $e2.security_result.action != "BLOCK"

    $impacted_nat_ip = $e2.principal.nat_ip
    $exploitation_ip = $e2.target.ip

    $impacted_nat_ip != $exploitation_ip
    $e1.target.ip = $e2.principal.nat_ip
    $e1.principal.ip = $e2.target.ip

  match:
    $exploitation_ip, $impacted_nat_ip over 2m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $nat_ip = array_distinct($impacted_nat_ip)
    $exploit_ip = array_distinct($exploitation_ip)
    $num_exploit_ip = count_distinct($exploitation_ip)
    $num_impacted_nat_ip = count_distinct($impacted_nat_ip)
    $num_principal_ip = count_distinct($e1.principal.ip)

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.product_name)
    $result_time = min($e2.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(if($e2.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e2.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e2.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e1 and $e2 and $num_exploit_ip = 1 and $num_impacted_nat_ip = 1 and $num_principal_ip = 1
}
rules.description: Detection of connections to the FortiManager port and then following outbound connection to an external IP. This is commonly observed in exploitation attempts.
rules.author: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence

rule m_hunting_saas_salesforce_bulk_query_1 {

    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0010"
    technique = "T1567"

      $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_RESOURCE_ACCESS" or

      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "UniqueQuery" nocase or
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "ReportExport" nocase
    )
    (
      any $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.asn = "43641" or

rule m_hunting_t1071_001_process_with_pif_extension_network_connections_methodology {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Process With Pif Extension Network Connections"
    description = "Detects when a process with a .PIF (Program Information Files on Microsoft Windows computers) file extension spawns network events. This technique has been previously linked to compromises involving Infostealer malware. Determine the maliciousness of the observed process and network traffic."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1071.001"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_DNS" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_HTTP"
    )
    re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `\.pif$`) nocase
    (
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `\\AppData`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `\\Downloads`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `\\Desktop`) nocase
    )

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1
    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $threat_verdict_malicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))
    $recent_compile_time = if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)
    $invalid_cert = if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $system_user_file_write = if($e.principal.user.userid = "system", 1, 0)
    $sus_file_name_architecture = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\[^\/]+(32|64).[^\/.]+$/), 1, 0)
    $single_double_char_filename = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*([^\/]{1,2}.[^\/.]+)$/), 1, 0)
    $double_extensions = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+.[a-zA-Z]{3}.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_file_name = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\d+.[a-zA-Z]{3}$/), 1, 0)
    $common_malicious_file_names = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup\.exe|update\.js|lsass\.dmp|1\.txt|ntds\.dit|logs\.dat|sqlite3\.dll|pass_1234|system\.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $is_archive_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0)
    $is_executable_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0)
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)
    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $recent_compile_time + $system_user_file_write + $sus_file_name_architecture + $common_malicious_file_names + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_filename + $double_extensions + $sus_vt_tags + $all_numbers_file_name + $is_executable_file + $is_archive_file + $invalid_cert
    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: Detects when a process with a .PIF (Program Information Files on Microsoft Windows computers) file extension spawns network events. This technique has been previously linked to compromises involving Infostealer malware. Determine the maliciousness of the observed process and network traffic.

rule ttp_windows_terminal_in_staging_directory {

    severity = "Medium"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or

      $e.target.process.file.full_path = /\\(ProgramData|Temp|Public)\\.*\bwt\.exe$/ nocase or
      $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /\\(ProgramData|Temp|Public)\\.*\bwt\.exe$/ nocase or
      $e.target.file.full_path = /\\(ProgramData|Temp|Public)\\.*\bwt\.exe$/ nocase
    ) and
    $e.target.file.full_path != /\\TEMP\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\WindowsApps\\Microsoft\.WindowsTerminal_|\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\WindowsApps\\.*\bwt\.exe$/ nocase and
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path != /\\TEMP\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\WindowsApps\\Microsoft\.WindowsTerminal_|\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\WindowsApps\\.*\bwt\.exe$/ nocase and
    $e.target.process.file.full_path != /\\TEMP\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\WindowsApps\\Microsoft\.WindowsTerminal_|\\AppData\\Local\\Microsoft\\WindowsApps\\.*\bwt\.exe$/ nocase

    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)

    $result = arrays.index_to_str(

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = array_distinct($e.principal.process.command_line)

    $target_file_full_path = array_distinct($e.target.file.full_path)

rule m_hunting_execution_win_powershell_drops_nodejs_for_js_1 {
  meta:
    rule_name = "PowerShell Staging Node.js in System32 Subfolder to Execute JavaScript"
    description = "PowerShell was observed writing a Node.js executable (node.exe) to a non-standard subfolder within C:\\Windows\\System32\\, and this Node.js instance was subsequently used to run a JavaScript (.js) file. Attackers may use this method to blend in with system files and execute malicious scripts using a legitimate interpreter."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059.007"
    false_positives = "Extremely unlikely for legitimate software to install Node.js in a dynamically named subfolder of System32."

  events:
    $e1.metadata.event_type = "FILE_CREATION"
    $e1.principal.process.file.full_path = /powershell\.exe$/ nocase
    $e1.target.file.full_path = /^C:\\Windows\\System32\\[^\\]+\\node\.exe$/ nocase
    $node_path = $e1.target.file.full_path
    $hostname = $e1.principal.hostname
    $e2.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $node_path = $e2.principal.process.file.full_path
    $hostname = $e2.principal.hostname
    $e2.target.process.command_line = /script\.js$/ nocase

  match:
    $hostname, $node_path over 3m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.product_name)
    $hostnames = array_distinct($hostname)
    $node_paths = array_distinct($node_path)
    $dropped_node_exe = array_distinct($e1.target.file.full_path)
    $executed_commands = array_distinct($e2.target.process.command_line)
    $principal_users = array_distinct($e1.principal.user.userid)
    $target_users = array_distinct($e2.target.user.userid)
    $result = "succeeded" // Both file creation and process launch are assumed to have succeeded if logged.
    $result_time = min($e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $e1 and $e2
}
rules.description: PowerShell was observed writing a Node.js executable (node.exe) to a non-standard subfolder within C:\Windows\System32\, and this Node.js instance was subsequently used to run a JavaScript (.js) file. Attackers may use this method to blend in with system files and execute malicious scripts using a legitimate interpreter.

rule ttp_windows_iis_viewstate_exploitation_success {
  meta:
    rule_name = "IIS ViewState Exploitation Success"
    description = "Detects a sequence where a ViewState verification failure is recorded in the Event Logs, followed within 30 minutes by the IIS worker process (w3wp.exe) spawning a suspicious shell or reconnaissance process. This combination strongly indicates that an adversary has successfully exploited a deserialization vulnerability to achieve remote code execution on the web server."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0001"
    technique = "T1190"

  events:
    (
      $e1.metadata.log_type = "WINEVTLOG" or
      $e1.metadata.log_type = "WINEVTLOG_XML"
    )
    $e1.additional.fields["Message"] = /Event code: 4009\b.*Viewstate verification failed/ nocase
    $e1.principal.hostname = $hostname
    (
      $e2.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
      $e2.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"
    )
    $e2.principal.process.file.full_path = /\bw3wp\.exe$/ nocase
    (
      $e2.target.process.command_line = /\bcmd(\.exe)?\s+[\/\-][ck]\b/ nocase or
      $e2.target.process.command_line = /\bwhoami\b/ nocase or
      $e2.target.process.command_line = /\bnc\b/ nocase or

      $e2.target.process.command_line = /\b(powershell|pwsh)(\.exe)?\b/ nocase or

    )
    $e2.principal.hostname = $hostname
    $e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds <= $e2.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

  match:

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e2.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e2.metadata.product_name)

    $victim_name = array_distinct($e2.principal.asset.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e2.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e2.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e2.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e2.principal.user.windows_sid)
    $tmp1 = max(if($e2.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e2.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e2.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $result_time = max($e2.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e2.metadata.id)
    $principal_hostname = array_distinct($e2.principal.hostname)
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = array_distinct($e2.principal.process.command_line)
    $principal_process_file_full_path = array_distinct($e2.principal.process.file.full_path)

    $target_process_file_full_path = array_distinct($e2.target.process.file.full_path)
    $asset_is_server = max(if($e2.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0))

  condition:

}

rule m_hunting_execution_python_b64_blockchain_1 {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Python Inline Base64 Execution with Blockchain API Call"
    description = "A Python process was observed executing inline base64-decoded code, in conjunction with network connections to public blockchain API endpoints. This pattern is associated with techniques like EtherHiding, where malware fetches payloads or C2 instructions from the blockchain."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1071.001"
    false_positives = "Rare legitimate uses of Python to interact with blockchain APIs might exist, but the combination with inline base64 execution is suspicious. Analyze the decoded script content."

  events:
    $e1.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $e1.principal.process.file.full_path = /python(w)?([\d\.]+)?(\.exe)?$/ nocase
    (
      $e1.principal.process.command_line = /exec\(\s*base64\.b64decode\(/ or
      $e1.principal.process.command_line = /eval\(\s*base64\.b64decode\(/
    )
    $hostname = $e1.principal.hostname
    $pid = $e1.principal.process.pid
    $e2.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
    $e2.principal.hostname = $hostname
    $e2.principal.process.pid = $pid
    (
      $e2.target.hostname = /api\.trongrid\.io$/ or
      $e2.target.hostname = /fullnode\.mainnet\.aptoslabs\.com$/ or
      $e2.target.hostname = /bsc-dataseed\.binance\.org$/ or
      $e2.target.hostname = /bsc-rpc\.publicnode\.com$/ or
      $e2.target.hostname = /rpc\.ankr\.com$/
    )

  match:
    $hostname, $pid over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e1.metadata.id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($hostname)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e1.principal.ip)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e2.target.ip)
    $target_domains = array_distinct($e2.target.hostname)
    $process_commandline = array_distinct($e1.principal.process.command_line)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $e1 and $e2
}

    description = "This rule detects an MSI installer communicating with a suspicious website to retrieve the password for its embedded payload.     severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1218.007"

    )

    $e.network.http.method = "POST"
    (
      $e.principal.url = /\/licenseUser\.php/ nocase or
      $e.src.url = /\/licenseUser\.php/ nocase or

    )
    $adv_uid = strings.coalesce($e.principal.asset.product_object_id, $e.principal.asset.asset_id)

    $vic_uid = strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.product_object_id, $e.principal.user.employee_id)
    $vic_netid = strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.email_addresses, $e.principal.user.windows_sid)
    $vic_name = strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.userid, $e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $url = strings.coalesce($e.principal.url, $e.src.url, $e.target.url)

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $event_count = 1
    $victim_uid = $vic_uid

    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

rule m_hunting_t1218_bitlockertogo_process_execution {
  meta:
    rule_name = "BitLockerToGo Process Execution"
    description = "Detects the execution of the BitLockerToGo.exe process on the host. While this process can be used for legitimate purposes, malware families like LUMMAC have previously used it as a target for process hollowing.  Determine maliciousness of the parent process and review activity linked to the BitLockerToGo.exe process, such as potential command and control network traffic."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1218"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    (
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `(\\|")BitLockerToGo\.exe`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `BitLockerToGo\.exe`) nocase
    )
    re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, `\\AppData\\Roaming\\`) nocase
    not $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /(^|\\)explorer.exe$/ nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1
    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $threat_verdict_malicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "MALICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $threat_verdict_suspicious = if($e.target.file.security_result.threat_verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", 1, 0)
    $sus_vt_tags = max(if(re.regex(strings.coalesce($e.target.file.tags, "None"), /(cve-|executes-dropped-file|zero-filled|spreader|self-delete|registry|base64-string|exploit|upx|checks-hostname|write-file|contains-embedded-js|sets-process-name|embedded-ole|persistence|revoked-cert|via-tor)/), 1, 0))
    $recent_compile_time = if($e.target.file.pe_file.compilation_time.seconds >= $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds - (60 * 60 * 48), 1, 0)
    $invalid_cert = if(any $e.target.file.signature_info.sigcheck.signers.status = /(revoked|untrusted|distrusted|nottrusted)/ nocase, 1, 0)
    $system_user_file_write = if($e.principal.user.userid = "system", 1, 0)
    $sus_file_name_architecture = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*\[^\/]+(32|64).[^\/.]+$/), 1, 0)
    $single_double_char_filename = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^.*([^\/]{1,2}.[^\/.]+)$/), 1, 0)
    $double_extensions = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /^(?:.*[\/])?([^.\/\]+.[a-zA-Z]{3}.[a-zA-Z]{3})$/), 1, 0)
    $all_numbers_file_name = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /\d+.[a-zA-Z]{3}$/), 1, 0)
    $common_malicious_file_names = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /(setup\.exe|update\.js|lsass\.dmp|1\.txt|ntds\.dit|logs\.dat|sqlite3\.dll|pass_1234|system\.dll|readme|mimi)/) nocase, 1, 0)
    $is_archive_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(zip|rar|7z|tar|gz|bz2|cab|iso)$/), 1, 0)
    $is_executable_file = if(re.regex($e.target.file.full_path, /.(exe|dll|scr|pif|com|cpl|bat|cmd|vbs|js|jse|wsf|wsh|ps1|psm1|msh|msh1|msh2|scf|lnk|inf|reg|hta|gadget)$/), 1, 0)
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)
    $producer_risk_score = $threat_verdict_malicious + $threat_verdict_suspicious + $recent_compile_time + $system_user_file_write + $sus_file_name_architecture + $common_malicious_file_names + $asset_is_server + $single_double_char_filename + $double_extensions + $sus_vt_tags + $all_numbers_file_name + $is_executable_file + $is_archive_file + $invalid_cert
    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend.exe|safebreach|\sb_|attackiq)/) nocase, 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e
}

rules.text:
rule ueba_excessive_logins_failed_by_device_mac {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Excessive Failed Logins By Device MAC Address"
    description = "Detects excessive (10x the historical maximum value, if the entity has a coefficient of variation < 0.1 and was observed for at least 9 of the last 30 days) auth attempts failed by device MAC address. This may be indicative of behavior related to password guessing."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0006"
    technique = "T1110.001"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $e.security_result.action = "BLOCK"
    $device_mac = $e.principal.asset.mac
    $device_mac != ""

    $principal_ns = $e.principal.namespace

  match:
    $device_mac, $principal_ns over 24h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $num_times_max = max(10)

    $historical_stddev = max(metrics.auth_attempts_fail(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:stddev,
        principal.asset.mac:$device_mac,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))

    $historical_avg = max(metrics.auth_attempts_fail(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:avg,
        principal.asset.mac:$device_mac,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))

    $historical_max = max(metrics.auth_attempts_fail(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:max,
        principal.asset.mac:$device_mac,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))

    $historical_observations = max(metrics.auth_attempts_fail(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:num_metric_periods,
        principal.asset.mac:$device_mac,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))

    $historical_coefficient_of_variation = max(
      metrics.auth_attempts_fail(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:stddev,
        principal.asset.mac:$device_mac,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns) /
      metrics.auth_attempts_fail(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:avg,
        principal.asset.mac:$device_mac,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))
    $observation_threshold = max(9)

    $coefficient_of_variation_threshold = max(0.1)

    $historical_threshold = max(10 * metrics.auth_attempts_fail(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:max,
        principal.asset.mac:$device_mac,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))
    $mac_address = array_distinct($device_mac)

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e and ($event_count > $historical_threshold) and ($historical_coefficient_of_variation < $coefficient_of_variation_threshold) and ($historical_observations >= $observation_threshold)

  options:
    allow_zero_values = true
}
rules.description: Detects excessive (10x the historical maximum value, if the entity has a coefficient of variation < 0.1 and was observed for at least 9 of the last 30 days) auth attempts failed by device MAC address. This may be indicative of behavior related to password guessing.

        metric:event_count_sum, agg:stddev,
        principal.asset.hostname:$hostname, principal.namespace:$principal_ns, target.user.userid:$user_id) /
      metrics.auth_attempts_total(

rule ttp_gcp_ws_2fa_enforce_removal {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Two Factor Authentication Enforcement Removal by a Workspace Admin User"
    description = "Detects when 2- Step Verification Enforcement setting is disabled by an admin user at the organization level."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1556.006"

  events:
    $e.security_result.detection_fields["mute"] != "MUTED"
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_RESOURCE_UPDATE_PERMISSIONS" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_RESOURCE_UPDATE_CONTENT"
    )
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "google.admin.AdminService.enforceStrongAuthentication"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "G Suite"
    (
      (
        $e.target.labels.key = "new_value" and
        $e.target.labels.value = "false"
      ) or
      $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["new_value"] = "false" or
      $e.additional.fields["new_value_0_0"] = "false" or

    $ip = $e.principal.ip

  outcome:
    $event_count = 1
    $ips = array_distinct($ip)
    $ip_countries = array_distinct($ip_country)
    $risk_score = max ( 55
      + if(($e.principal.user.attribute.labels.key = "is_admin" and $e.principal.user.attribute.labels.value = "true"),25)
      + if(($e.principal.user.attribute.labels.key = "is_delegated_admin" and $e.principal.user.attribute.labels.value = "true"),5)

rules.text:
rule ueba_ws_anomalous_downloads {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Anomalous Google Workspace Downloads Total by a Privileged User"
    description = "Detects anomalous (6 standard deviations higher than the user's 30 day historical average) Google Workspace downloads total by a privileged user."
    severity = "Low"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Workspace"

    $product_event_type = $e.metadata.product_event_type
    $product_event_type = "download"

    $userid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $user_email = $e.principal.user.email_addresses
    $resource = $e.target.resource.name

    $e.principal.user.attribute.roles.type = "ADMINISTRATOR"

  match:
    $userid over 24h

  outcome:
    $usage_past_24h = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $num_stddevs_away = max(6)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $historical_avg = max(
      metrics.workspace_total_download_actions(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum,agg:avg,
        principal.user.userid:$userid))

    $historical_stddev = max(
      metrics.workspace_total_download_actions(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum,agg:stddev,
        principal.user.userid:$userid))
    $historical_threshold = max(
      6*metrics.workspace_total_download_actions(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:stddev,
        principal.user.userid:$userid)
      + metrics.workspace_total_download_actions(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:avg,
        principal.user.userid:$userid))

    $user_email_addresses = array_distinct($user_email)
    $files = array_distinct($resource)
    $risk_score = 45

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $result = array_distinct(if($e.security_result.action="ALLOW", "succeeded", "failed"))
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $e and ($usage_past_24h > $historical_threshold) and $historical_threshold > 0
}
rules.description: Detects anomalous (6 standard deviations higher than the user's 30 day historical average) Google Workspace downloads total by a privileged user.

rule ttp_aws_pentest_distro {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Offensive Security Distro Activity"
    description = "Identifies successful AWS or GCP resource manipulations from known penetration testing or offensive security distros"
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0042"
    technique = "T1588"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"
    $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW" and
    (
      $e.network.http.user_agent = /.*kali.*/ nocase  or
      $e.network.http.user_agent = /.*parrot.*amd.*/ nocase or
      $e.network.http.user_agent = /.*parrotsec.*/ nocase  or
      $e.network.http.user_agent = /parrot/ nocase
    )
    $e.network.http.user_agent != /Mozilla.*Linux.*Android.*parrot Build.*/ nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $email_address = array($e.principal.user.userid)
    $event_count = 1
    $user_agents = array($e.network.http.user_agent)
    $network_org_names = array($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.organization_name)
    $principal_ips = array($e.principal.ip)
    $recipient_account_ids = array($e.additional.fields["recipientAccountId"])
    $cloud_regions = array($e.target.location.name)
    $target_resource_names = array($e.target.resource.name)
    $vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"
    $principal_users = array($e.principal.user.userid)

    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e
}

    rule_name = "Successful AWS API Call from Tor Exit Node"
    description = "Detects successful API executions from a Tor exit node."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1090.003"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"
    $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    $ip = $e.principal.ip
    $ip = $gcti_feed.graph.entity.artifact.ip
    $gcti_feed.graph.metadata.entity_type = "IP_ADDRESS"
    $gcti_feed.graph.metadata.threat.threat_feed_name = "Tor Exit Nodes"
    $gcti_feed.graph.metadata.product_name = "GCTI Feed"
    $gcti_feed.graph.metadata.source_type = "GLOBAL_CONTEXT"

  match:
    $ip over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 85

    $vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $network_http_user_agent = array_distinct($e.network.http.user_agent)
    $principal_ip = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $principal_ip_country = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region)
    $principal_ip_state = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.state)

  condition:
    $e and $gcti_feed
}
rules.description: Detects successful API executions from a Tor exit node.

rule ttp_aws_obufscated_user_agent_exploit_attempt {
  meta:
    rule_name = "AWS Obfuscated User Agent Exploit Attempt"
    description = "Detects specific obfuscated segments using the ${junk:-char} methodology along with http response codes indicative of potential successful exploitation. This pattern has been observed in attempts to exploit vulnerabilities like Log4Shell (CVE-2021-44228) by obfuscating payloads in User-Agent strings or other logged data."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0001"
    technique = "T1190"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = /aws/ nocase
    $e.security_result.action != "BLOCK"
    $e.network.http.user_agent = /(\$\{(.+?):-([^}]+)\})/ nocase
    (
      $e.network.http.response_code = 500 or
      $e.network.http.response_code = 200 or
      $e.network.http.response_code = 201 or
      $e.network.http.response_code = 204 or
      $e.network.http.response_code = 301
    )
    $principal_ip = $e.principal.ip

  match:
    $principal_ip over 4h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 20
    $vendor_name = "AWS"
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.target.user.userid)
    $event_type = array_distinct($e.metadata.event_type)
    $product_event_type = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_event_type)
    $user_agents = array_distinct($e.network.http.user_agent)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.target.ip)
    $result = "success"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: Detects specific obfuscated segments using the ${junk:-char} methodology along with http response codes indicative of potential successful exploitation. This pattern has been observed in attempts to exploit vulnerabilities like Log4Shell (CVE-2021-44228) by obfuscating payloads in User-Agent strings or other logged data.

rule ttp_aws_access_denied_discovery_events {
  meta:
    rule_name = "AWS AccessDenied Discovery Events"
    description = "This rule detects when a user has a high number of access denied events. This could be a sign of reconnaissance activity, improperly provisioned accounts, or other malicious activity. Access denied events can indicate that a user is trying to access resources that they do not have permission to access. This could be a sign of an attacker trying to probe your system for vulnerabilities or to steal sensitive data."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0007"
    technique = "T1580"
    false_positives = "A legitimate user may be trying to access a resource that they do not have permission to access because of a misconfiguration.\nAutomated tools that scan environments may trigger this detection."

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"
    $e.security_result.summary = "AccessDenied"
    $e.security_result.action = "BLOCK"
    $user_id = $e.principal.user.userid
    $user_agent = $e.network.http.user_agent
    $user_id != /StackSet/ nocase //Tuning: StackSet generates FPs
    $user_id != /AWSServiceRole/ nocase //Tuning: AWS Service Roles generate FPs
    $user_id != /CrowdStrikeCSPMReader/ nocase //Tuning: Common scanner
    $user_id != /Qualys/ nocase //Tuning: Common Scanner
    $user_id != /WizAccess-Role/ nocase //Tuning: Common Scanner
    $user_id != /redlock/ nocase //Tuning: Common Scanner
    $user_id != /orca-security/ nocase //Tuning: Common Scanner
    $user_id != /CloudConformity/ nocase //Tuning: Scanner
    $user_id != /CloudHealth/ nocase //Tuning: Scanner

    $user_agent != "config.amazonaws.com" // config generates fps
    $user_agent != "AWS Internal"

    $target_application = $e.target.application
    $product_event_type = $e.metadata.product_event_type
  match:
    $user_id over 24h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $principal_ips = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $principal_users = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $recipient_account_id = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["recipientAccountId"])
    $cloud_regions = array_distinct($e.target.location.name)
    $target_applications = array_distinct($e.target.application)
    $product_event_types = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_event_type)
    $network_org_names = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.organization_name)
    $vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"
    $target_resource_names = array_distinct($e.principal.resource.name)
    $user_agents = array_distinct($e.network.http.user_agent)

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $result = "failed"

  condition:
    #e > 50 and #target_application > 5 and #product_event_type > 5
}

rule ttp_powershell_decodebase64_ns139797 {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Encoded PowerShell - Internal Signature Match"
    description = "Possible malicious PowerShell command. (ref: 20ca1ae0-a6c7-4ec2-88c1-bef3d0c3ccd8)"
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $e.principal.process.command_line != ""
    $e.principal.process.command_line != /-ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned/
    $e.principal.process.command_line != /ciscowebexstart.exe|^sed |^grep |^(\/bin\/)?(ba)?sh |^bash |^rm .*\//
    $decoded = strings.to_lower(
      strings.base64_decode(
        re.capture(
          $e.principal.process.command_line, "-[Ee][Nn]?[Cc]?[Oo]?[Dd]?[Ee]?[Dd]?[Cc]?[Oo]?[Mm]?[Mm]?[Aa]?[Nn]?[Dd]?[ \t\n\r]*['\"]?([A-Za-z0-9+/]{16,}[=]{0,2})")))
    $decoded != ""
    $e.principal.process.command_line = /[A-Za-z0-9+\/\.]/

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $event_count = max(1)
    $victim_uid = array($e.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array($e.principal.asset.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $adversary_netid = array($e.principal.user.windows_sid)
    $result = array($e.security_result.summary)
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $suspiciousness_score = if(re.regex($decoded, ".i.n.v.o.k.e.-.w.e.b.r.e.q.u.e.s.t."), 113, 0)
    + if(re.regex($decoded, ".d.l.l."), 108, 0)
    + if(re.regex($decoded, ".h.t.t.p.:././."), 99, 0)
    + if(re.regex($decoded, ".p.n.g."), 97, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".p.u.b.l.i.s.h."), 33, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".g.e.t.-.c.o.u.n.t.e.r."), 32, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".c.o.n.v.e.r.t.f.r.o.m.-.s.t.r.i.n.g.d.a.t.a."), 32, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".o.w.n.e.r.s."), 31, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".n.e.w.-.e.v.e.n.t."), 31, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".u.t.f.8.e.n.c.o.d.i.n.g."), 30, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".a.d.d.r.e.s.s."), 29, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".i.m.p.o.r.t.-.m.o.d.u.l.e."), 29, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".h.t.t.p.s.:././."), 28, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".w.r.i.t.e.-.o.u.t.p.u.t."), 28, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".b.a.t."), 28, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".s.e.t.-.l.o.c.a.t.i.o.n."), 27, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".i.d.e.n.t.i.t.y."), 27, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".p.n.g."), 27, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, "\\[0-255\\]\\\\\\.\\[0-255\\]\\\\\\.\\[0-255\\]\\\\\\.\\[0-255\\]"), 27, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".s.c.s.i."), 26, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".s.q.l."), 26, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".o.u.t.-.f.i.l.e."), 26, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".i.n.t.e.g.r.a.t.i.o.n."), 22, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".\\[.c.h.a.r.\\]."), 21, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".s.e.r.v.e.r."), 19, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".a.d.d.-.t.y.p.e."), 18, 0)

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
  condition:
    $e and $suspiciousness_score > 208
}

rule ttp_powershell_github_download_enigma0x3 {

    rule_name = "PowerShell Download from github.com/enigma0x3."
    description = "The GitHub repository enigma0x3 hosts PowerShell security code or tooling."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1105"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
    $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION" or
    $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_HTTP"
    (
      $e.principal.process.command_line = /powershell|pwsh/ nocase or
      $e.principal.process.parent_process.command_line = /powershell|pwsh/ nocase or
      $e.target.process.command_line = /powershell|pwsh/ nocase or
      $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /(?:powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/ nocase or
      $e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path = /(?:powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/ nocase or
      $e.target.process.file.full_path = /(?:powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/ nocase

    (
      re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, `raw.githubusercontent.com/enigma0x3`) nocase
      or

rule ttp_powershell_decodebase64_ns166136 {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Encoded PowerShell - Internal Signature Match"
    description = "Possible malicious PowerShell command. (ref: cf61e2bd-d395-40cb-9176-aeb542efb33a)"
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $e.principal.process.command_line != ""
    $e.principal.process.command_line != /-ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned/
    $e.principal.process.command_line != /ciscowebexstart.exe|^sed |^grep |^(\/bin\/)?(ba)?sh |^bash |^rm .*\//

    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $event_count = max(1)
    $victim_uid = array($e.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array($e.principal.asset.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)

    + if(re.regex($decoded, ".t.e.s.t.-.p.a.t.h."), 41, 0)
    + if(re.regex($decoded, ".h.t.t.p.s.:././."), 32, 0)
    + if(re.regex($decoded, ".t.e.s.t."), 32, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".p.u.b.l.i.s.h."), 33, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".g.e.t.-.c.o.u.n.t.e.r."), 32, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".c.o.n.v.e.r.t.f.r.o.m.-.s.t.r.i.n.g.d.a.t.a."), 32, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".o.w.n.e.r.s."), 31, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".n.e.w.-.e.v.e.n.t."), 31, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".u.t.f.8.e.n.c.o.d.i.n.g."), 30, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".a.d.d.r.e.s.s."), 29, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".i.m.p.o.r.t.-.m.o.d.u.l.e."), 29, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".h.t.t.p.s.:././."), 28, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".w.r.i.t.e.-.o.u.t.p.u.t."), 28, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".b.a.t."), 28, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".p.n.g."), 27, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".s.e.t.-.l.o.c.a.t.i.o.n."), 27, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".i.d.e.n.t.i.t.y."), 27, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, "\\[0-255\\]\\\\\\.\\[0-255\\]\\\\\\.\\[0-255\\]\\\\\\.\\[0-255\\]"), 27, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".s.c.s.i."), 26, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".s.q.l."), 26, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".o.u.t.-.f.i.l.e."), 26, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".i.n.t.e.g.r.a.t.i.o.n."), 22, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".\\[.c.h.a.r.\\]."), 21, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".s.e.r.v.e.r."), 19, 0)
    - if(re.regex($decoded, ".a.d.d.-.t.y.p.e."), 18, 0)

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
  condition:
    $e and $suspiciousness_score > 255
}

rule ttp_o365_ediscovery_search_created_and_removed {
  meta:

    description = "Detects an Office 365 user creating and deleting an Office 365 eDiscovery content search. The Office 365 eDiscovery tool can be used to search for content in Exchange Online mailboxes, Sharepoint, OneDrive, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365 Groups, and Viva Engage Groups. Threat actors can use the eDiscovery tool to identify data of interest, including strategic intelligence and credentials, and can subsequently remove searches to hide evidence of their activity."

    technique = "T1114.002"
    reference = "https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/ediscovery-content-search"

    $principal_userid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $search_id = $e.about.labels["SearchIds"]

  match:

  outcome:
    $vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    $product_name = "Office 365"
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $risk_score = 65

rule ueba_ws_excessive_sensitive_emails {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Excessive Sensitive Emails Sent By User"
    description = "Detects when external emails are determined as sensitive by DLP and when their amount is greater than twice the maximum events observed for that user in the past 30 days."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0010"
    technique = "T1048"

  events:
    $e.security_result.detection_fields["mute"] != "MUTED"
    $e.metadata.event_type = "EMAIL_TRANSACTION"
    $e.metadata.product_name = /gmail/ nocase
    (($e.principal.application = "gmail-ui send" and $e.network.direction = "OUTBOUND") or $e.target.application = "smtp-outbound")
    $sender = $e.network.email.from
    $receiver = strings.coalesce($e.network.smtp.rcpt_to, $e.network.email.to)

    $sender_domain = re.capture($e.network.email.from ,`@[a-zA-Z0-9\.]*`)
    $receiver_domain = strings.coalesce(re.capture($e.network.smtp.rcpt_to, `@[a-zA-Z0-9\.]+`), re.capture($e.network.email.to, `@[a-zA-Z0-9\.]+`))

rule ueba_ws_anomalous_email_as_attach {

    $e.metadata.product_name = "drive"

    $product_event_type = $e.metadata.product_event_type
    $product_event_type = "email_as_attachment"
    $userid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $user_email = $e.principal.user.email_addresses
    $resource = $e.target.resource.name

    $userid over 24h

  outcome:
    $usage_past_24h = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $num_stddevs_away = max(3)
    $historical_max = max(
      metrics.workspace_total_change_actions(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum,agg:max,
        principal.user.userid:$userid,metadata.product_event_type:$product_event_type, metadata.product_name:$event_product))

    $min_ts = min(
      metrics.workspace_total_change_actions(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:first_seen,agg:min,
        principal.user.userid:$userid, metadata.product_event_type:$product_event_type, metadata.product_name:$event_product))
    $max_ts = max(
      metrics.workspace_total_change_actions(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:last_seen,agg:max,
        principal.user.userid:$userid,metadata.product_event_type:$product_event_type, metadata.product_name:$event_product))

    $historical_stddev = max(
      metrics.workspace_total_change_actions(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum,agg:stddev,
        principal.user.userid:$userid, metadata.product_event_type:$product_event_type, metadata.product_name:$event_product))
    $historical_avg = max(
      metrics.workspace_total_change_actions(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum,agg:avg,
        principal.user.userid:$userid, metadata.product_event_type:$product_event_type, metadata.product_name:$event_product))
    $historical_threshold = max(
      3*metrics.workspace_total_change_actions(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:stddev,
        principal.user.userid:$userid, metadata.product_event_type:$product_event_type,metadata.product_name:$event_product)
      + metrics.workspace_total_change_actions(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:avg,
        principal.user.userid:$userid, metadata.product_event_type:$product_event_type, metadata.product_name:$event_product))

    $user_email_addresses = array_distinct($user_email)
    $files = array_distinct($resource)
    $risk_score = 45

    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $result = array_distinct(if($e.security_result.action="ALLOW", "succeeded", "failed"))
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $e and ($usage_past_24h > $historical_threshold) and $historical_threshold > 0
}

    severity = "Low"

  events:
    $e.metadata.product_name = "GMAIL"
    $e.network.sent_bytes != 0
    $e.principal.user.userid != "drive-shares-dm-noreply@google.com"

    all $e.security_result.action != "BLOCK"
    $e.network.direction = "OUTBOUND"

    $userid = $e.principal.user.userid

    $recipient = $e.network.email.to

    $target_domain = re.capture($e.network.email.to , `@[a-zA-Z0-9\.]*`)

    $origin_domain != $target_domain
    ( $target_domain = "@gmail.com" or $target_domain = "@aol.com" or $target_domain = "@ymail.com" or $target_domain = "@hotmail.com" or $target_domain = "@outlook.com" )

  match:
    $userid over 24h

  outcome:
    $outbound_bytes_past_24h = sum($outbound_bytes)
    $num_stddevs_away = max(12)

    $historical_avg = max(
      metrics.workspace_network_bytes_outbound(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum,agg:avg,
        principal.user.userid:$userid))

      metrics.workspace_network_bytes_outbound(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum,agg:stddev,

      12*metrics.workspace_network_bytes_outbound(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum,agg:stddev,
        principal.user.userid:$userid)
      +metrics.workspace_network_bytes_outbound(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum,agg:avg,
        principal.user.userid:$userid))
    $recipients = array_distinct($recipient)

    $risk_score = 45

    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $result = array_distinct(if($e.security_result.action="ALLOW", "succeeded", "failed"))
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $e and ($outbound_bytes_past_24h > $historical_threshold) and $historical_threshold > 0
}

rules.text:
rule ttp_gcp_scc_initial_access_suspicious_login_blocked {
  meta:
    rule_name = "SCC: Initial Access: Suspicious Login Blocked"
    description = "A suspicious login to a user's account was detected and blocked.\nThis finding isn't available for project-level activations."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0001"
    technique = "T1078"
    reference = "https://cloud.google.com/security-command-center/docs/how-to-investigate-threats"

  events:
    $e1.metadata.product_name = "Security Command Center"
    $e1.metadata.product_event_type = "Initial Access: Suspicious Login Blocked"
    $e1.security_result.detection_fields["mute"] != "MUTED"
    $resource_name = $e1.target.resource.name
    $rule_name = $e1.metadata.product_event_type

  match:
    $rule_name over 1h

  outcome:
    $resource_names = array_distinct($resource_name)
    $cloud_projects = array_distinct(if($e1.target.resource_ancestors.resource_type = "CLOUD_PROJECT",$e1.target.resource_ancestors.name, ""))
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.product_name)
    $risk_score = max(0 +
      if(any $e1.security_result.severity = "CRITICAL", 95, 0) +
      if(any $e1.security_result.severity = "HIGH", 85, 0) +
      if(any $e1.security_result.severity = "MEDIUM", 65, 0) +
      if(any $e1.security_result.severity = "LOW", 35, 0) +
      if(any $e1.security_result.severity = "INFORMATIONAL", 10, 0)
    )
    $threat_category = array_distinct($e1.metadata.product_event_type)
    $scc_product = array_distinct($e1.metadata.description)
    $severity = array_distinct($e1.security_result.severity)
    $url_back_to_product = array_distinct($e1.security_result.url_back_to_product)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e1.metadata.id)

    $result_time = min($e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e1.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e1.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e1.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e1
}
rules.description:
A suspicious login to a user's account was detected and blocked.
This finding isn't available for project-level activations.

rule ttp_azure_account_lockout_multiple_geolocations {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Account Lockout From Multiple Geolocations"
    description = "Detects repeated attempts to access a locked out account from 4 or more geo locations or regions within 1 hour."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0006"
    technique = "T1110"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    $e.metadata.log_type = "AZURE_AD"
    $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $e.security_result.action = "BLOCK"
    $e.security_result.rule_id != "50053"
    $e.security_result.detection_fields["errorCode"] != "50053"
    $targetAccountId = strings.coalesce($e.target.user.userid, $e.target.user.email_addresses, $e.target.user.product_object_id)

  match:
    $targetAccountId over 1h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 20
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $victim_name = array_distinct(strings.coalesce($e.target.user.userid, $e.target.user.email_addresses, $e.target.user.product_object_id))
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $result = "failed"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $target_applications = array_distinct($e.target.application)
    $source_lockout_geolocation = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region)
    $source_lockout_geolocation_count = count_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region)
    $source_lockout_geolocation_count_threshold = 4

  condition:
    $e and $source_lockout_geolocation_count >= 4
}

    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "Azure AD"
    (
      $e.additional.fields["riskLevelDuringSignIn"] = "high" or
      $e.additional.fields["riskLevelAggregated"] = "high" or

rule ttp_azure_mfa_registration_from_new_country {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Azure MFA Registration from New Country"
    description = "Detects when the Azure Authenticator MFA Application is registered from a geolocation or region that was not among those seen in successful login activity for the account within the last 6 hours and logins are occuring from 3 or more locations."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0001"
    technique = "T1078"

  events:
    $e1.metadata.log_type = "AZURE_AD_AUDIT"
    $e1.metadata.vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    $e1.metadata.product_name = "Azure AD Directory Audit"
    $e1.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    $e1.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region != ""
    $e1.target.user.product_object_id != ""
    $e1.security_result.description = "User registered Authenticator App with Notification and Code"
    $e2.metadata.log_type = "AZURE_AD"
    $e2.metadata.vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    $e2.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $e2.security_result.summary = "Successful login occurred"
    $e2.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region != ""
    $mfa_registration_geolocation = $e1.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region
    $successful_login_geolocation = $e2.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region
    $targetAccountId = strings.coalesce($e1.target.user.userid, $e1.target.user.email_addresses, $e1.target.user.product_object_id)
    $targetAccountId = strings.coalesce($e2.target.user.userid, $e2.target.user.email_addresses, $e2.target.user.product_object_id)
    $mfa_registration_geolocation != $successful_login_geolocation

  match:
    $targetAccountId, $mfa_registration_geolocation over 24h after $e2

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e1.metadata.id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct(strings.coalesce($e1.target.user.userid, $e1.target.user.email_addresses, $e1.target.user.product_object_id))
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e1.principal.user.userid)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $mfa_registration_event_names = array_distinct($e1.security_result.description )
    $mfa_registration__event_geolocations = array_distinct($e1.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region)
    $successful_login_event_summary= array_distinct($e2.security_result.description)
    $successful_login__event_geolocations = array_distinct($e2.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region)
    $count_login_event_geolocations = count_distinct($e2.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region)
    $count_login_event_geolocations_threshold = 3

  condition:
    $e1 and $e2 and $count_login_event_geolocations >= 3
}

rule ttp_azure_entra_id_mfa_bypass_via_ropc {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Azure Entra ID MFA Bypass via ROPC"
    description = "Detects Azure Entra ID MFA bypass via the Resource Owner Password Credentials (ROPC) grant type by identifying successful legacy authentication to Azure CLI or PowerShell within non-interactive sign-in logs. This technique allows threat actors to leverage compromised credentials to gain unauthorized access while circumventing mandatory Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) requirements."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0001"
    technique = "T1078.004"
    reference = "https://www.wiz.io/blog/recent-oauth-attacks-detection-strategies"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = /AZURE/
    $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    $e.metadata.description = /NonInteractiveUserSignInLogs|^SigninLogs$/ nocase
    $e.principal.application = "Mobile Apps and Desktop clients"
    $e.target.application = /Azure CLI|PowerShell/ nocase
    $e.target.resource.name = /Azure Resource Manager|Azure Active Directory|Microsoft Graph/ nocase
    $e.security_result.detection_fields["authenticationProtocol"] = "ropc"
    $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region != ""
    $e.principal.ip != ""
    $e.target.user.userid != ""
    $e.network.session_id != ""
    $e.network.http.user_agent != ""
    $session_id = $e.network.session_id

  match:
    $session_id over 4h

  outcome:
    $vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    $product_name = "Azure AD"
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $risk_score = 35
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.target.user.userid)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.target.user.userid)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $e
}

rules.text:
rule ttp_azure_entra_id_whfb_reg_after_sus_device_code {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Azure Entra ID Whfb Registration After Suspicious Device Code Event"
    description = "Detects Azure Entra ID persistence by correlating suspicious Device Code Flow authentication with the subsequent registration of Windows Hello for Business credentials, identified by geographic or User-Agent inconsistencies within the session. This behavior signifies a threat actor attempting to secure a permanent, MFA-resistant foothold in the environment by masking their presence as a legitimate biometric enrollment."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1098.001"
    reference = "https://www.wiz.io/blog/recent-oauth-attacks-detection-strategies"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = /AZURE/
    ($e.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN" or $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_UNCATEGORIZED")
    (
      (
        $e.metadata.description = /NonInteractiveUserSignInLogs|^SigninLogs$/ nocase and
        $e.security_result.detection_fields["errorCode"] = /^(0|50199)$/ and
        $e.principal.application = "Mobile Apps and Desktop clients" and
        $e.additional.fields["originalTransferMethod"] = "deviceCodeFlow" and
        $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region != "" and
        $e.principal.ip != "" and
        $e.target.user.userid != "" and
        $e.network.session_id != "" and
        $e.network.http.user_agent != ""
      ) or
      (
        $e.metadata.product_event_type = "Add Windows Hello for Business credential"
      )
    )
    $target_userid = strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.userid, $e.target.user.userid)

  match:
    $target_userid over 24h

  outcome:
    $vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    $product_name = "Azure AD"
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $risk_score = 65
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($target_userid)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($target_userid)
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $unique_ips = count_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $unique_error_code_count = count_distinct($e.security_result.detection_fields["errorCode"])
    $unique_user_agent_count = count_distinct($e.network.http.user_agent)
    $unique_country_count = count_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region)
    $unique_product_event_type_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.product_event_type)
    $unique_product_event_type_list = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_event_type)

  condition:
    $e and $unique_ips > 1 and $unique_error_code_count > 1 and $unique_product_event_type_count > 1 and ($unique_user_agent_count > 1 or $unique_country_count > 1) and arrays.contains($unique_product_event_type_list, "Add Windows Hello for Business credential")
}
rules.description: Detects Azure Entra ID persistence by correlating suspicious Device Code Flow authentication with the subsequent registration of Windows Hello for Business credentials, identified by geographic or User-Agent inconsistencies within the session. This behavior signifies a threat actor attempting to secure a permanent, MFA-resistant foothold in the environment by masking their presence as a legitimate biometric enrollment.
