    $risk_event_type = strings.coalesce($e.security_result.detection_fields["riskEventTypes_v2_0"],$e.security_result.detection_fields["riskEventTypes_0"],$e.additional.fields["riskEventType_v2"],$e.additional.fields["riskEventType"])
    $risk_detail = strings.coalesce($e.security_result.detection_fields["riskDetail"],$e.additional.fields["riskDetail"])
    $source = strings.coalesce($e.security_result.detection_fields["source"],$e.additional.fields["source"])
    $operation_name = strings.coalesce($e.security_result.detection_fields["operationName"],$e.additional.fields["operationName"])
    $action = $e.security_result.action

  outcome:
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)

    $risk_score = max(0 +
      if($risk_level = "high", 85, 0) +
      if($risk_level = "medium", 65, 0) +
      if($risk_level = "low", 35, 0)
    )

    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct(strings.coalesce($e.target.user.userid, $e.target.user.email_addresses, $e.target.user.product_object_id))
    $victim_uid =  array_distinct($e.target.user.product_object_id)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $principal_ip_carrier_name = array_distinct($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.carrier_name)
    $network_user_agents = array_distinct($e.network.http.user_agent)
    $application_name = array_distinct($e.target.application)
    $result = array_distinct(if($action = "BLOCK", "failed", "succeeded"))
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

    $risk_levels = array_distinct($risk_level)
    $risk_states = array_distinct($risk_state)
    $risk_types = array_distinct($risk_type)
    $risk_event_types = array_distinct($risk_event_type)
    $risk_reasons = array_distinct($e.security_result.detection_fields["riskReasons"])
    $risk_details = array_distinct($risk_detail)
    $token_type = array_distinct($e.security_result.detection_fields["tokenIssuerType"])
    $operation_names = array_distinct($operation_name)
    $sources = array_distinct($source)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_azure_entra_id_device_registration_after_ropc {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Azure Entra ID Device Registration After ROPC"
    description = "Detects Azure Entra ID rogue device enrollment by correlating successful legacy ROPC authentication to the Device Registration Service with subsequent device registration events within a 24-hour window. Registering an unauthorized device allows a threat actor to establish long-term persistence and maintain a trusted status, which is frequently used to bypass future MFA prompts and security challenges."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1098.005"
    reference = "https://www.wiz.io/blog/recent-oauth-attacks-detection-strategies"

  events:
    $e1.metadata.log_type = /AZURE/
    $e1.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $e1.metadata.description = /NonInteractiveUserSignInLogs|^SigninLogs$/ nocase
    $e1.security_result.detection_fields["errorCode"] = "0"
    $e1.security_result.detection_fields["authenticationProtocol"] = "ropc"
    $e1.target.resource.attribute.labels["resourceId"] = "d4ebce55-015a-49b5-a083-c84d1797ae8c"
    $e1.target.resource.attribute.labels["App Id"] = "29d9ed98-a469-4536-ade2-f981bc1d605e"

    $e2.metadata.log_type = /AZURE/
    $e2.metadata.event_type = "DEVICE_CONFIG_UPDATE"
    $e2.metadata.product_event_type = "Register device"
    $e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds < $e2.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $target_userid = strings.coalesce($e1.principal.user.userid, $e1.target.user.userid)
    $target_userid = strings.coalesce($e2.principal.user.userid, $e2.target.user.userid)
    $metadata_id = $e1.metadata.id
    $metadata_id = $e2.metadata.id

  match:
    $target_userid over 24h

  outcome:
    $vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    $product_name = "Azure AD"
    $event_count = count_distinct($metadata_id)
    $risk_score = 65
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e1.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e1.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e1.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e1.principal.ip)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($target_userid)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($target_userid)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e1.principal.ip)
    $result_time = min($e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $e1 and $e2
}
rules.description: Detects Azure Entra ID rogue device enrollment by correlating successful legacy ROPC authentication to the Device Registration Service with subsequent device registration events within a 24-hour window. Registering an unauthorized device allows a threat actor to establish long-term persistence and maintain a trusted status, which is frequently used to bypass future MFA prompts and security challenges.
rules.author: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence

rule ttp_azure_entra_id_mfa_fatigue_activity {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Azure Entra ID MFA Fatigue Activity"
    description = "Detects potential successful MFA fatigue attacks by identifying users with multiple failed push notification MFA login attempts within a short period, followed by a successful login in the same session."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0006"
    technique = "T1621"

  events:
    $e1.metadata.vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    $e1.metadata.product_name = "Azure AD"
    $e1.metadata.log_type = "AZURE_AD"
    $e1.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $e1.security_result.action = "BLOCK"
    $e1.security_result.detection_fields["authenticationMethod"] = "Mobile app notification"
    (
      $e1.security_result.description = "Authentication failed during strong authentication request." or
      $e1.additional.fields["failureReason"] = "Authentication failed during strong authentication request."
    )

    $e2.metadata.vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    $e2.metadata.product_name = "Azure AD"
    $e2.metadata.log_type = "AZURE_AD"
    $e2.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $e2.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    $e2.security_result.detection_fields["authenticationStepResultDetail"] = "MFA requirement satisfied by claim in the token"

    $e1.principal.ip != $e2.principal.ip
    $targetUserProductObjectId = $e1.target.user.product_object_id
    $targetUserProductObjectId = $e2.target.user.product_object_id
    $correlationId = $e1.security_result.detection_fields["CorrelationId"]
    $correlationId = $e2.security_result.detection_fields["CorrelationId"]

  match:
    $correlationId, $targetUserProductObjectId over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 65
    $vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    $product_name = "Azure AD"
    $event_count = count_distinct($e1.metadata.id)

    $victim_name = array_distinct(strings.coalesce($e1.target.user.userid, $e1.target.user.email_addresses, $e1.target.user.product_object_id))
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct(strings.to_lower($e1.principal.ip))
    $result = "success"
    $result_time = min($e2.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $total_failed_login_attempts_due_to_mfa_failure = count_distinct($e1.metadata.id)
    $unique_asns = count_distinct($e1.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.asn) + count_distinct($e2.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.asn)
    $unique_browsers = count_distinct($e1.principal.resource.attribute.labels["Browser"]) + count_distinct($e2.principal.resource.attribute.labels["Browser"])

  condition:
    $e1 and $e2 and $total_failed_login_attempts_due_to_mfa_failure >= 3
}
rules.description: Detects potential successful MFA fatigue attacks by identifying users with multiple failed push notification MFA login attempts within a short period, followed by a successful login in the same session.

    severity = "Low"

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)

    $victim_name = array_distinct(strings.coalesce($e.target.user.userid, $e.target.user.email_addresses, $e.target.user.product_object_id))

    $total_failed_login_attempts = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $source_ip_addresses = array_distinct($sourceIpAddress)
    $unique_victim_account_id_threshold = 10

  condition:
    $e and $unique_victim_account_id_count >= 10
}

rules.text:
rule ttp_azure_entra_id_brute_force_ropc {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Azure Entra ID Successful Brute Force ROPC"
    description = "Detects successful Azure Entra ID brute force attacks using the legacy Resource Owner Password Credentials (ROPC) grant type by correlating multiple failed authentication attempts with a subsequent successful login. A successful login following multiple failures suggests a threat actor has successfully guessed a user's password, granting them direct access to the account via a legacy protocol that often lacks modern security controls."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0006"
    technique = "T1110.001"
    reference = "https://www.wiz.io/blog/recent-oauth-attacks-detection-strategies"

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = /AZURE/
    $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $e.metadata.description = /NonInteractiveUserSignInLogs|^SigninLogs$/ nocase
    $e.security_result.detection_fields["errorCode"] = /^(0|50126)$/
    (
      $e.security_result.detection_fields["authenticationProtocol"] = "ropc" or
      (
        $e.security_result.detection_fields["authenticationMethodDetail"] = "Password in the cloud" and
        $e.principal.application = "Mobile Apps and Desktop clients"
      )
    )
    $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region != ""
    $e.principal.ip != ""
    $e.target.user.userid != ""
    $e.network.session_id != ""
    $e.network.http.user_agent != ""
    $e.target.user.userid = $target_userid
    $e.target.application = $target_application

  match:
    $target_userid,$target_application over 1h

  outcome:
    $vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    $product_name = "Azure AD"
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $risk_score = 35
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.target.user.userid)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.target.user.userid)
    $failure_event_sum = sum(strings.count_substrings($e.security_result.detection_fields["errorCode"], "50126"))
    $successful_login_check = max(if(re.regex($e.security_result.detection_fields["errorCode"], "^0$") nocase, 1, 0))
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $e and $failure_event_sum >= 5 and $successful_login_check = 1
}
rules.description: Detects successful Azure Entra ID brute force attacks using the legacy Resource Owner Password Credentials (ROPC) grant type by correlating multiple failed authentication attempts with a subsequent successful login. rule ttp_azure_entra_id_suspicious_device_login_associated_with_device_code_phishing {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Azure Entra ID Suspicious Device Login Associated with Device Code Phishing"
    description = "Detects Azure Entra ID suspicious device logins by observing correlated device name and user agent indicators previously observed with Device Code phishing attacks. Organizations should confirm whether the user expected to register a new device and review for unusual indicators such as suspicious login events and characteristics such as IP or VPNs "
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0001"
    technique = "T1566.002"
    reference = "https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/active-directory/authentication/microsoft-authentication-broker"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN" or
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "Sign-in activity"
    )
    (
      $e.principal.application = "Mobile Apps and Desktop clients" or
      $e.principal.application = "Microsoft Authentication Broker" or
      $e.target.application = "Microsoft Authentication Broker" or
      $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["App Id"] = /29d9ed98-a469-4536-ade2-f981bc1d605e|04b07795-8ddb-461a-bbee-02f9e1bf7b46|d3590ed6-52b3-4102-aeff-aad2292ab01c/ or
      $e.target.resource_ancestors.attribute.labels["app_id"] = /29d9ed98-a469-4536-ade2-f981bc1d605e|04b07795-8ddb-461a-bbee-02f9e1bf7b46|d3590ed6-52b3-4102-aeff-aad2292ab01c/ or
      $e.intermediary.application = "Device Registration Service" or
      $e.target.resource.name = "Device Registration Service" or
      $e.security_result.category_details = "NonInteractiveUserSignInLogs"
    )
    (
      $e.network.http.user_agent = /Dsreg\/10\.0 \(Windows 10.0.19041.928\)/ nocase or
      $e.network.http.user_agent = /^node$|undici|axios\/1\.\d{2}\.\d/ nocase or
      $e.network.http.user_agent = /python-requests\/2\.3/ nocase or
      $e.network.http.user_agent = /^Deno\// nocase or
      $e.network.http.user_agent = /Microsoft\.OData\.Client\/7\.12\.5/ nocase or
      $e.network.http.user_agent = /MSTokens-PRT\/1.0\// nocase or
      $e.target.resource.name = /Graphspy/ nocase or
      $e.principal.hostname = /Graphspy/ nocase
    )

    $device_name = strings.coalesce(
      $e.target.hostname,
      $e.principal.hostname,
      $e.target.resource.name,
      $e.target.asset.attribute.labels["target_displayName"]
    )
    $device_name = /(DESKTOP-|work pc|microsoft-[a-f0-9]{6,8}|^WIN-[A-Z0-9]{6,12})/ nocase
    $e.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type != "UserLoginFailed"

  match:
    $device_name over 10m

  outcome:
    $vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    $product_name = "Azure AD"
    $event_type = array_distinct($e.metadata.event_type)
    $product_event_type = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_event_type)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $risk_score = 65
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)
    $logid = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_log_id)
    $device = array_distinct($device_name)
    $user_agent = array_distinct($e.network.http.user_agent)
    $additional_info = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["AdditionalInfo"])
    $service = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["loggedByService"])
    $correlation_id = array_distinct($e.additional.fields["properties_correlationId"])

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_azure_command_interpreter_login_after_multiple_failures {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Azure Command Interpreter Login after Multiple Failures"
    description = "Detects a successful login to Azure Powershell, Azure CLI or Azure AD Powershell after 9 or more failed attempts to log in to any Azure services within the past 1 hour."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1098"

  events:
    $e1.metadata.vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    $e1.metadata.log_type = "AZURE_AD"
    $e1.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $e1.security_result.action = "BLOCK"
    $e1.security_result.summary = "Failed login occurred"
    $e1.security_result.rule_id != "50140"
    $e1.security_result.detection_fields["errorCode"] != "50140"

    $e2.metadata.vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    $e2.metadata.log_type = "AZURE_AD"
    $e2.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $e2.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    (
      $e2.target.application = "Microsoft Azure PowerShell" or
      $e2.target.application = "Microsoft Azure CLI" or
      $e2.target.application = "Azure Active Directory PowerShell"
    )
    $targetAccountId = strings.coalesce($e1.target.user.userid, $e1.target.user.email_addresses, $e1.target.user.product_object_id)
    $targetAccountId = strings.coalesce($e2.target.user.userid, $e2.target.user.email_addresses, $e2.target.user.product_object_id)

  match:
    $targetAccountId over 1h before $e2

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 50
    $vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    $product_name = "Azure AD"
    $event_count = count_distinct($e1.metadata.id)

    $failed_logins_count = count_distinct($e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $victim_name = array_distinct(strings.coalesce($e1.target.user.userid, $e1.target.user.email_addresses, $e1.target.user.product_object_id))
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e1.principal.user.userid)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $successful_logins_count = count_distinct($e2.metadata.id)
    $target_applications = array_distinct($e2.target.application)
    $security_result_summaries = array_distinct($e1.security_result.summary)
    $failed_logins_count_threshold = 9

  condition:
    $e1 and $e2 and $failed_logins_count >= 9
}
rules.description: Detects a successful login to Azure Powershell, Azure CLI or Azure AD Powershell after 9 or more failed attempts to log in to any Azure services within the past 1 hour.

rules.text:
rule ttp_azure_cli_repeated_login_failure {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Azure CLI or Powershell Access Failures"
    description = "Detects 9 or more failed login attempts for an Azure account to access Azure CLI or Azure Powershell within 24 hours."
    severity = "Info"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1651"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    $e.metadata.log_type = "AZURE_AD"
    $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN"
    $e.security_result.action = "BLOCK"
    $e.security_result.summary = "Failed login occurred"
    $e.security_result.rule_id != "50140"
    $e.security_result.detection_fields["errorCode"] != "50140"
    $e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.location.country_or_region != ""
    (
      $e.target.application = "Microsoft Azure PowerShell" or
      $e.target.application = "Microsoft Azure CLI"
    )

    $targetAccountId = strings.coalesce($e.target.user.userid, $e.target.user.email_addresses, $e.target.user.product_object_id)

  match:
    $targetAccountId over 24h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 10
    $vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    $product_name = "Azure AD"
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

    $victim_name = array_distinct(strings.coalesce($e.target.user.userid, $e.target.user.email_addresses, $e.target.user.product_object_id))
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $result = "failed"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $failed_login_attempts = count_distinct($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:

rules.text:
rule ttp_azure_entra_id_potential_device_code_phishing {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Azure Entra ID Potential Device Code Phishing"
    description = "Detects Azure Entra ID Device Code Flow (DCF) abuse by correlating interactive sign-ins with non-interactive polling, identified by User-Agent inconsistencies or geographic mismatches within a single session. This pattern indicates a potential phishing attack where a threat actor hijacks a user's session to obtain an access token, granting them the same permissions as the authenticated user without needing their password. A 50199 error followed by a successful sign-in may indicate potential device code phishing by marking the temporary pause where an automated login attempt waits for a victim to enter the code and complete authentication."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0006"
    technique = "T1528"
    reference = "https://www.wiz.io/blog/recent-oauth-attacks-detection-strategies"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.description = /NonInteractiveUserSignInLogs|^SigninLogs$/ nocase or
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "Sign-in activity" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "USER_LOGIN" or
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "UserLoggedIn" or
      $e.metadata.product_event_type = "UserLoginFailed"
    )
    $error_code = strings.coalesce(
      $e.security_result.detection_fields["errorCode"],
      $e.additional.fields["resultType"],
      $e.security_result.detection_fields["azure_error_code"],
      $e.additional.fields["ErrorNumber"]
    )
    $error_code = /^(0|50199)$/
    (
      $e.principal.application = "Mobile Apps and Desktop clients" or
      $e.principal.labels["client_identifier"] = "Mobile Apps and Desktop clients" or
      $e.target.application = "Microsoft Authentication Broker" or
      $e.principal.labels["client_identifier"] = "Microsoft Authentication Broker" or
      $e.security_result.detection_fields["ApplicationId"] = "29d9ed98-a469-4536-ade2-f981bc1d605e" or
      $e.additional.fields["ApplicationId"] = "29d9ed98-a469-4536-ade2-f981bc1d605e" or
      $e.additional.fields["ApplicationId"] = "d3590ed6-52b3-4102-aeff-aad2292ab01c"
    )
    (
      $e.additional.fields["originalTransferMethod"] = "deviceCodeFlow" or
      $e.additional.fields["original_transfer_method"] = "deviceCodeFlow" or
      $e.additional.fields["ErrorNumber"] = "50199" or
      $e.security_result.detection_fields["RequestType"] = "Cmsi:Cmsi" or
      $e.security_result.description = /CmsiInterrupt/ nocase or
      $e.about.labels["RequestType"] = "Cmsi:Cmsi"
    )
    $session_id = $e.network.session_id
    $correlation_id = strings.coalesce($e.security_result.detection_fields["CorrelationId"],$e.security_result.detection_fields["correlationId"],$e.security_result.detection_fields["InterSystemsId"],$e.target.resource.attribute.labels["InterSystemsId"], $e.additional.fields["CorrelationId"])

  match:
    $session_id over 1h

  outcome:
    $vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    $product_name = "Azure AD"
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $risk_score = 65
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct(strings.coalesce($e.target.user.userid, $e.target.user.email_addresses, $e.target.user.product_object_id))
    $victim_name = array_distinct(strings.coalesce($e.target.user.userid, $e.target.user.email_addresses, $e.target.user.product_object_id))
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $unique_description_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.description)
    $errorcoddes = array_distinct($error_code)
    $unique_error_code_count = count_distinct($error_code)
    $correlation_ids = array_distinct($correlation_id)
    $useragents = array_distinct($e.network.http.user_agent)
    $unique_user_agent_count = count_distinct($e.network.http.user_agent)
    $unique_ip_count = count_distinct($e.principal.ip)

  condition:
    $e and $unique_error_code_count > 1 and ($unique_user_agent_count > 1 or $unique_ip_count > 1)
}

rule ueba_anomalous_total_bytes_by_user_object_id {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Anomalous Network Bytes Total By Object ID"
    description = "Detects anomalous (2 standard deviations away from the historical average, if the entity has a coefficient of variation < 0.1 and was observed for at least 9 of the last 30 days) network bytes total by user object ID."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0010"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"

    $object_id = $e.principal.user.product_object_id
    $object_id != ""
    optimization.sample_rate($e.metadata.id, 1, 10)

    $principal_ns = $e.principal.namespace

  match:
    $object_id, $principal_ns over 24h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $usage_past_24h = sum(10.0 * $e.network.sent_bytes + 10.0 * $e.network.received_bytes)
    $num_stddevs_away = max(2)

    $historical_stddev = max(metrics.network_bytes_total(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:stddev,
        principal.user.product_object_id:$object_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))

    $historical_avg = max(metrics.network_bytes_total(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:avg,
        principal.user.product_object_id:$object_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))

    $historical_max = max(metrics.network_bytes_total(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:max,
        principal.user.product_object_id:$object_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))

    $historical_observations = max(metrics.network_bytes_total(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:num_metric_periods,
        principal.user.product_object_id:$object_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))

    $historical_coefficient_of_variation = max(
      metrics.network_bytes_total(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:stddev,
        principal.user.product_object_id:$object_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns) /
      metrics.network_bytes_total(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:avg,
        principal.user.product_object_id:$object_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))
    $observation_threshold = max(9)

    $coefficient_of_variation_threshold = max(1/10)

    $historical_threshold = max(
      metrics.network_bytes_total(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:avg,
        principal.user.product_object_id:$object_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns)+ 2 * metrics.network_bytes_total(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:stddev,
        principal.user.product_object_id:$object_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e and ($usage_past_24h > $historical_threshold) and ($historical_coefficient_of_variation < $coefficient_of_variation_threshold) and ($historical_observations >= $observation_threshold) and $event_count >= 100

  options:
    allow_zero_values = true
}

    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $usage_past_24h = sum(10.0 * $e.network.sent_bytes + 10.0 * $e.network.received_bytes)
    $num_stddevs_away = max(2)

    $historical_stddev = max(metrics.network_bytes_total(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:stddev,
        principal.user.employee_id:$employee_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))

    $historical_avg = max(metrics.network_bytes_total(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:avg,
        principal.user.employee_id:$employee_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))

    $historical_max = max(metrics.network_bytes_total(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:max,
        principal.user.employee_id:$employee_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))

    $historical_observations = max(metrics.network_bytes_total(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:num_metric_periods,
        principal.user.employee_id:$employee_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))

    $historical_coefficient_of_variation = max(
      metrics.network_bytes_total(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:stddev,
        principal.user.employee_id:$employee_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns) /
      metrics.network_bytes_total(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:avg,
        principal.user.employee_id:$employee_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))
    $observation_threshold = max(9)

    $coefficient_of_variation_threshold = max(1/10)

    $historical_threshold = max(
      metrics.network_bytes_total(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:avg,
        principal.user.employee_id:$employee_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns)+ 2 * metrics.network_bytes_total(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:stddev,
        principal.user.employee_id:$employee_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e and ($usage_past_24h > $historical_threshold) and ($historical_coefficient_of_variation < $coefficient_of_variation_threshold) and ($historical_observations >= $observation_threshold) and $event_count >= 100

  options:
    allow_zero_values = true
}
rules.description: Detects anomalous (2 standard deviations away from the historical average, if the entity has a coefficient of variation < 0.1 and was observed for at least 9 of the last 30 days) network bytes total by user employee ID.

rule ttp_gcp_migmasquerading {
  meta:
    rule_name = "GCE MIG Masquerading"
    description = "Identifies GCE Instances which are attempting to masquerade as being tied to a Managed Instance Group. This behavior could be intended to mask malicious activity carried out within the 'Managed Instance Group'."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1036.005"

  events:
    (
      $e1.metadata.product_name = "Google Compute Engine" or
      $e1.metadata.product_name = "GCP Compute Engine"
    )
    $e1.metadata.event_type = "RESOURCE_CREATION"
    $e1.metadata.event_type = $event_type
    $e1.metadata.product_event_type = /compute\.instances\.insert/
    $e1.target.resource.name = /\/instance\-group\-/
    $e1.target.resource.name = $resource_name
    $e1.security_result.action = "ALLOW"
    strings.coalesce($e1.target.cloud.project.name, $e1.target.resource_ancestors.product_object_id) = $proj_name
    (
      $e2.metadata.product_name = "Google Compute Engine" or
      $e2.metadata.product_name = "GCP Compute Engine"
    )
    $e2.metadata.event_type = "RESOURCE_CREATION"
    $e2.metadata.event_type = $event_type
    $e2.metadata.product_event_type = /compute.instanceGroups.addInstances/
    $e2.principal.resource.attribute.labels.key = "Request_instances_instance"
    $e2.principal.resource.attribute.labels.value = $instance_value
    $resource_name = re.capture($e2.principal.resource.attribute.labels.value, `.*googleapis\.com\/compute.*instances\/(.*)$`)
    strings.coalesce($e2.target.cloud.project.name, $e2.target.resource_ancestors.product_object_id) = $proj_name

  match:
    $resource_name, $event_type, $proj_name over 10m after $e1

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.product_name)

    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e1.target.resource.product_object_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e1.target.resource.name)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e1.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e1.principal.user.email_addresses)

    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

    $e1_email_address = array_distinct($e1.principal.user.email_addresses)
    $e2_email_address = array_distinct($e2.principal.user.email_addresses)
    $e1_ip = array_distinct($e1.principal.ip)
    $e2_ip = array_distinct($e2.principal.ip)

  condition:
    $e1 and !$e2
}

rules.display_name: Azure Defender for Cloud: Suspicious WindowPosition registry value detected
rules.text:
rule ttp_azure_defender_for_cloud_suspicious_windowposition_registry_value_detected {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Azure Defender for Cloud: Suspicious WindowPosition registry value detected"
    description = "Analysis of host data on (Compromised Host) detected an attempted WindowPosition registry configuration change that could be indicative of hiding application windows in nonvisible sections of the desktop. This could be legitimate activity, or an indication of a compromised machine: this type of activity has been previously associated with known adware (or unwanted software) such as Win32/OneSystemCare and Win32/SystemHealer and malware such as Win32/Creprote. When the WindowPosition value is set to 201329664, (Hex: 0x0c00 0c00, corresponding to X-axis=0c00 and the Y-axis=0c00) this places the console app's window in a non-visible section of the user's screen in an area that is hidden from view below the visible start menu/taskbar. Known suspect Hex value includes, but not limited to c000c000"
    severity = "Low"
    reference = "https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/alerts-reference"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    (
      $e.metadata.log_type = "MICROSOFT_GRAPH_ALERT" or
      $e.metadata.log_type = "MICROSOFT_DEFENDER_CLOUD_ALERTS"
    )
    $e.security_result.rule_name = "Suspicious WindowPosition registry value detected"

    $product_event_type = $e.security_result.rule_name

  outcome:
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $risk_score = max(0 +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "HIGH", 85, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "MEDIUM", 65, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "LOW", 35, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "INFORMATIONAL", 10, 0)
    )
    $event_count = 1
    $product_urls = array_distinct($e.security_result.url_back_to_product)
    $security_result_summary = array_distinct($e.security_result.summary)
    $security_result_description = array_distinct($e.security_result.description)
    $security_result_severity = array_distinct($e.security_result.severity)
    $security_remediation_details = array_distinct($e.security_result.action_details)
    $security_result_threat_name = array_distinct($e.security_result.threat_name)
    $adversary_names = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.userid, $e.principal.hostname, $e.principal.resource.name))
    $adversary_uid = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.product_object_id, $e.principal.asset_id, $e.principal.resource.product_object_id))
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $victim_names = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.target.user.userid, $e.target.hostname, $e.target.resource.name))
    $victim_uid = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.target.user.product_object_id, $e.target.asset_id, $e.target.resource.product_object_id))
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.target.ip)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: Analysis of host data on (Compromised Host) detected an attempted WindowPosition registry configuration change that could be indicative of hiding application windows in nonvisible sections of the desktop. This could be legitimate activity, or an indication of a compromised machine: this type of activity has been previously associated with known adware (or unwanted software) such as Win32/OneSystemCare and Win32/SystemHealer and malware such as Win32/Creprote. When the WindowPosition value is set to 201329664, (Hex: 0x0c00 0c00, corresponding to X-axis=0c00 and the Y-axis=0c00) this places the console app's window in a non-visible section of the user's screen in an area that is hidden from view below the visible start menu/taskbar. Known suspect Hex value includes, but not limited to c000c000

    rule_name = "Azure Defender for Cloud: Detected suspicious use of Pcalua.exe to launch executable code"
    description = "Analysis of host data on (Compromised Host) detected the use of pcalua.exe to launch executable code. Pcalua.exe is component of the Microsoft Windows Program Compatibility Assistant, which detects compatibility issues during the installation or execution of a program. Attackers are known to abuse functionality of legitimate Windows system tools to perform malicious actions, for example using pcalua.exe with the -a switch to launch malicious executables either locally or from remote shares."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    reference = "https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/alerts-reference"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    (
      $e.metadata.log_type = "MICROSOFT_GRAPH_ALERT" or
      $e.metadata.log_type = "MICROSOFT_DEFENDER_CLOUD_ALERTS"
    )
    $e.security_result.rule_name = "Detected suspicious use of Pcalua.exe to launch executable code"

    $product_event_type = $e.security_result.rule_name

  outcome:
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $risk_score = max(0 +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "HIGH", 85, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "MEDIUM", 65, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "LOW", 35, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "INFORMATIONAL", 10, 0)
    )
    $event_count = 1
    $product_urls = array_distinct($e.security_result.url_back_to_product)
    $security_result_summary = array_distinct($e.security_result.summary)
    $security_result_description = array_distinct($e.security_result.description)
    $security_result_severity = array_distinct($e.security_result.severity)
    $security_remediation_details = array_distinct($e.security_result.action_details)
    $security_result_threat_name = array_distinct($e.security_result.threat_name)
    $adversary_names = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.userid, $e.principal.hostname, $e.principal.resource.name))
    $adversary_uid = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.product_object_id, $e.principal.asset_id, $e.principal.resource.product_object_id))
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $victim_names = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.target.user.userid, $e.target.hostname, $e.target.resource.name))
    $victim_uid = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.target.user.product_object_id, $e.target.asset_id, $e.target.resource.product_object_id))

    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

    $target_nat_ip = array_distinct($e.target.nat_ip)
    $target_port = array_distinct($e.target.port)
    $target_hostname = array_distinct($e.target.hostname)
    $target_user_userid = array_distinct($e.target.user.userid)
    $target_application = array_distinct($e.target.application)
    $target_url = array_distinct($e.target.url)
    $target_location_country_or_region = array_distinct($e.target.location.country_or_region)
    $metadata_product_event_type = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_event_type)
    $metadata_description = array_distinct($e.metadata.description)
    $network_direction = array_distinct($e.network.direction)

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)

rule ueba_anomalous_inbound_bytes_by_user_employee_id {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Anomalous Network Bytes Inbound By Employee ID"
    description = "Detects anomalous (2 standard deviations away from the historical average, if the entity has a coefficient of variation < 0.1 and was observed for at least 9 of the last 30 days) network bytes inbound by user employee ID."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0010"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"

    $employee_id = $e.principal.user.employee_id
    $employee_id != ""
    optimization.sample_rate($e.metadata.id, 1, 10)

    $principal_ns = $e.principal.namespace

  match:
    $employee_id, $principal_ns over 24h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $usage_past_24h = sum(10.0 * $e.network.received_bytes)
    $num_stddevs_away = max(2)

    $historical_stddev = max(metrics.network_bytes_inbound(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:stddev,
        principal.user.employee_id:$employee_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))

    $historical_avg = max(metrics.network_bytes_inbound(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:avg,
        principal.user.employee_id:$employee_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))

    $historical_max = max(metrics.network_bytes_inbound(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:max,
        principal.user.employee_id:$employee_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))

    $historical_observations = max(metrics.network_bytes_inbound(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:num_metric_periods,
        principal.user.employee_id:$employee_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))

    $historical_coefficient_of_variation = max(
      metrics.network_bytes_inbound(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:stddev,
        principal.user.employee_id:$employee_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns) /
      metrics.network_bytes_inbound(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:avg,
        principal.user.employee_id:$employee_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))
    $observation_threshold = max(9)

    $coefficient_of_variation_threshold = max(1/10)

    $historical_threshold = max(
      metrics.network_bytes_inbound(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:avg,
        principal.user.employee_id:$employee_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns)+ 2 * metrics.network_bytes_inbound(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:value_sum, agg:stddev,
        principal.user.employee_id:$employee_id,
        principal.namespace:$principal_ns))

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e and ($usage_past_24h > $historical_threshold) and ($historical_coefficient_of_variation < $coefficient_of_variation_threshold) and ($historical_observations >= $observation_threshold) and $event_count >= 100

  options:
    allow_zero_values = true
}

      $e.metadata.product_event_type

    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

rule ueba_excessive_activity_blocked_by_user {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Excessive Blocked Actions by User"
    description = "Detects excessive blocked events by a user in a 4 hour window, where the blocked events are to at least 3 different products."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0006"
    technique = "T1110"

  events:
    $e.security_result.action = "BLOCK"
    $e.metadata.event_type = "GENERIC_EVENT"
    $user = strings.coalesce(
      strings.coalesce(
        strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.product_object_id, $e.principal.user.userid),
        strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.email_addresses, $e.principal.user.windows_sid)
      ), $e.principal.user.employee_id)
    $user != ""
    $event_product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $event_product_name != ""
    $application = $e.target.application
    $application != ""

    $principal_ns = $e.principal.namespace

  match:
    $user, $principal_ns over 4h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $event_threshold = max(200)
    $num_distinct_product_names = count_distinct($event_product_name)
    $product_name_list = array_distinct($event_product_name)
    $application_list = array_distinct($application)
    $principal_user = array_distinct($user)

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e and ($event_count > $event_threshold) and ($num_distinct_product_names >= 3)

  options:
    allow_zero_values = true
}

rule ttp_aws_new_account {
  meta:
    rule_name = "AWS New Account Created"
    description = "Detects when a User creates a new Account within an AWS Organization. Attackers may use additional accounts to evade detection or establish persistent access."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1136"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"

    $e.metadata.event_type = "RESOURCE_CREATION"
    $e.metadata.product_event_type = "CreateAccountResult"
    $e.target.resource.attribute.labels["req_states"] = "SUCCEEDED"

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $vendor_name = "AMAZON"
    $product_name = "AWS CloudTrail"
    $event_count = 1
    $principal_ips = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $principal_users = array($e.principal.user.userid)
    $recipient_account_ids = array($e.principal.resource.attribute.labels["Recipient Account Id"])
    $cloud_regions = array($e.target.location.name)
    $product_event_types = array($e.metadata.product_event_type)
    $network_org_names = array($e.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.organization_name)
    $target_resource_names = array($e.target.resource.name)
    $user_agents = array($e.network.http.user_agent)

    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_azure_defender_for_cloud_api_requests_spray_from_a_single_ip_address_to_an_unusually_large_number_of_distinct_api_endpoints {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Azure Defender for Cloud: API requests spray from a single IP address to an unusually large number of distinct API endpoints"
    description = "A single IP was observed making API calls to an unusually large number of distinct endpoints. Based on historical traffic patterns from the last 30 days, Defenders for APIs learns a baseline that represents the typical number of distinct endpoints called by a single IP across 20-minute windows. The alert was triggered because a single IP's behavior deviated significantly from the historical baseline."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0007"
    reference = "https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/defender-for-cloud/alerts-reference"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Microsoft"
    (
      $e.metadata.log_type = "MICROSOFT_GRAPH_ALERT" or
      $e.metadata.log_type = "MICROSOFT_DEFENDER_CLOUD_ALERTS"
    )
    $e.security_result.rule_name = "API requests spray from a single IP address to an unusually large number of distinct API endpoints"

    $product_event_type = $e.security_result.rule_name

  outcome:
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $risk_score = max(0 +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "HIGH", 85, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "MEDIUM", 65, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "LOW", 35, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.severity = "INFORMATIONAL", 10, 0)
    )
    $event_count = 1
    $product_urls = array_distinct($e.security_result.url_back_to_product)
    $security_result_summary = array_distinct($e.security_result.summary)
    $security_result_description = array_distinct($e.security_result.description)
    $security_result_severity = array_distinct($e.security_result.severity)
    $security_remediation_details = array_distinct($e.security_result.action_details)
    $security_result_threat_name = array_distinct($e.security_result.threat_name)
    $adversary_names = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.userid, $e.principal.hostname, $e.principal.resource.name))
    $adversary_uid = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.principal.user.product_object_id, $e.principal.asset_id, $e.principal.resource.product_object_id))
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $victim_names = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.target.user.userid, $e.target.hostname, $e.target.resource.name))
    $victim_uid = strings.to_lower(strings.coalesce($e.target.user.product_object_id, $e.target.asset_id, $e.target.resource.product_object_id))
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.target.ip)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds

  condition:
    $e
}

    description = "A suspicious SQL statement was used to query a container in this Azure Cosmos DB account.  The injected statement might have succeeded in exfiltrating data that the threat actor isn't authorized to access.  Due to the structure and capabilities of Azure Cosmos DB queries, many known SQL injection attacks on Azure Cosmos DB accounts can't work. However, the variation used in this attack may work and threat actors can exfiltrate data."

rules.display_name: ATI Active Breach Rule Match for File IoCs (target.process.file.md5)
rules.text:
rule active_breach_ioc_eg_target_process_file_md5 {
  meta:
    rule_name = "ATI Active Breach Rule Match for File IoCs (target.process.file.md5)"
    description = "This rule matches indicators of compromise from Google Applied Threat Intelligence."
    severity = "Critical"
    feed = "gti"

  events:
    $gti.graph.metadata.product_name = "GTI_IOC"
    $gti.graph.metadata.vendor_name = "GTI_IOC"
    $gti.graph.metadata.entity_type = "FILE"
    $gti.graph.metadata.source_type = "GLOBAL_CONTEXT"
    $gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.gti_verdict = 16
    $ioc = $gti.graph.entity.file.md5
    $ioc = $e.target.process.file.md5

    $gti.graph.entity.file.md5 != ""
    $e.target.process.file.md5 != ""
    $e.metadata.product_name != /RECORDED_FUTURE_IOC/ nocase
    $e.metadata.product_name != /stix/ nocase
    $e.metadata.event_type != "ENTITY_RISK_CHANGE"
    (
      $gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.gti_update_time.seconds <=
      (timestamp.current_seconds() - (7 * 24 * 60 * 60)) OR
      $gti.graph.metadata.collected_timestamp.seconds <=
      (timestamp.current_seconds() - (7 * 24 * 60 * 60)) OR
      $gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.reviewed = true
    )
    $e.target.process.file.md5 != $e.principal.process.file.md5

  match:
    $ioc by 1h

  outcome:
    $active_ir_pwn = max(if($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.active_ir = true, 1, 0))
    $active_ir_confidence_score = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.mandiant_analyst_confidence)
    $global_customer_count = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.global_customer_count)
    $global_hits_count = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.global_hit_count)
    $attributed_malware = max(if(any $gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.attributed_malware.name != "", 1, 0))
    $attributed_actor = max(if(any $gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.attributed_threat_actors.name != "", 1, 0))
    $pwn_event_time = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $pwn_added_time = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.active_ir_first_tagged_time.seconds)
    $pwn_time_diff = $pwn_event_time - $pwn_added_time
    $exclusive_label = max(if($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.exclusive = true, 1, 0))
    $exclusive_actor = $exclusive_label + $attributed_actor
    $gti_verdict = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.gti_verdict)
    $gti_severity = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.gti_severity)
    $gti_threat_score = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.gti_threat_score)
    $commodity = max(if($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.osint = true, 1, 0))
    $active_ir = if($active_ir_pwn = 1, 1, 0)
    $high_prevalence = if($global_customer_count >= 3, 1, 0)
    +
    if($global_hits_count > 50000, 1, 0)
    $attributed = if($attributed_malware = 1, 1, 0)
    +
    if($attributed_actor = 1, 1, 0)
    $pwn_old = if($pwn_event_time - $pwn_added_time > 7689600,1,0)
    $exclusive = if($exclusive_actor = 2, 1, 0)
    +
    if($attributed_malware = 1, 1, 0)
    $blocked = max(0 +
      if(any $e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.action = "QUARANTINE", 1, 0)
    )
    $entity_type = array_distinct($gti.graph.metadata.entity_type)
    $event_time = array_distinct($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $log_source = array_distinct($e.metadata.log_type)
    $asset_hostname = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)
    $user_id = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $ioc_value =  array_distinct(strings.coalesce($gti.graph.entity.file.md5, $gti.graph.entity.file.sha256))
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $risk_score = max(95)
    $priority = if(
      $gti_verdict = 16 AND
      $gti_severity = 16 AND
      $high_prevalence != 2 AND
      $active_ir = 1 AND
      $blocked = 0 AND
      $exclusive >= 1,
      4,

rule ttp_gcp_scc_bruteforce_ssh_with_context {
  meta:
    rule_name = "SCC: Brute Force: SSH"
    description = "Detects when a successful brute force of SSH occurs on a host."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0001"
    technique = "T1078.003"
    reference = "https://cloud.google.com/security-command-center/docs/how-to-investigate-threats#brute_force_ssh"

  events:
    $alert.metadata.product_name = "Security Command Center"
    $alert.metadata.description = "Event Threat Detection"
    $alert.metadata.product_event_type = "Brute Force: SSH"

    $principal_ip = $alert.principal.ip
    $target = $alert.target.resource.name
    $user_name = $alert.security_result.about.user.userid

  match:
    $principal_ip over 15m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(45)

    $attacker_ip_list = array_distinct($principal_ip)

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($alert.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($alert.metadata.product_name)

    $result_time = min($alert.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($alert.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $alert.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($alert.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $alert and $risk_score > 0
}
rules.description: Detects when a successful brute force of SSH occurs on a host.

rule ioc_cryptomining_ip_communication {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Cryptomining IP Communication"
    description = "Detects communication with known cryptomining IPs."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0040"
    technique = "T1496"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
    $mining_ip_to_match = $e.target.ip

    $gcti.graph.metadata.entity_type = "IP_ADDRESS"
    $gcti.graph.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Cloud Threat Intelligence"
    $gcti.graph.metadata.product_name = "GCTI Feed"
    $gcti.graph.metadata.threat.threat_feed_name = "Cryptomining IPs"
    $gcti.graph.entity.ip = $mining_ip_to_match
    $gcti.graph.entity.ip != ""

  match:
    $mining_ip_to_match by 1h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(85)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.target.ip)
    $entity_type = array_distinct($gcti.graph.metadata.entity_type)
    $event_time = array_distinct($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $log_source = array_distinct($e.metadata.log_type)
    $asset_hostname = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)

    $user_id = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $matched_ioc = array_distinct($gcti.graph.entity.ip)
    $ioc_type = "Cryptomining IP"
    $ioc_source = "GCTI Feed"
    $target_hostname = array_distinct($e.target.hostname)
    $target_ip = array_distinct($e.target.ip)
    $mitre_attack_tactic = "Impact"
    $mitre_attack_tactic_id = "TA0040"
    $mitre_attack_technique_id = "T1496" // Resource Hijacking

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), max(if(any $e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and any $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2, 0)) + max(if(any $e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1, 0)))

  condition:
    $e and $gcti and $result != "failed"
}

rules.display_name: High Volume Connections to Tor Exit Node
rules.text:
rule ioc_high_volume_connections_to_tor_exit_node {
  meta:
    rule_name = "High Volume Connections to Tor Exit Node"
    description = "Detects a high volume of outbound connections from a single host to Tor exit nodes."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1090.003"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
    $host_ip = $e.principal.ip
    $tor_ip_to_match = strings.coalesce($e.target.ip, $e.intermediary.ip)

    $gcti.graph.metadata.entity_type = "IP_ADDRESS"
    $gcti.graph.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Cloud Threat Intelligence"
    $gcti.graph.metadata.product_name = "GCTI Feed"
    $gcti.graph.metadata.threat.threat_feed_name = "Tor Exit Nodes"
    $gcti.graph.entity.ip = $tor_ip_to_match

  match:
    $host_ip by 1h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(35)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $connection_threshold = max(100)
    $entity_type = array_distinct($gcti.graph.metadata.entity_type)
    $event_time = array_distinct($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $log_source = array_distinct($e.metadata.log_type)
    $asset_hostname = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)

    $user_id = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $matched_ioc = array_distinct($gcti.graph.entity.ip)
    $ioc_type = "Tor Exit Node IP"
    $ioc_source = "GCTI Feed"
    $target_hostname = array_distinct($e.target.hostname)
    $target_ip = array_distinct($e.target.ip)
    $mitre_attack_tactic = "Command and Control"
    $mitre_attack_tactic_id = "TA0011"
    $mitre_attack_technique_id = "T1090.003"

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if(any $e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and any $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if(any $e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e and $gcti and #e > 100 and $result != "failed"
}

rule ttp_auditpol_disablelogging {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Auditpol Disable Logging"
    description = "Detects use of the auditpol command to disable logging or clear the audit policy. Threat actors often disable logging in an attempt to prevent or delay detection."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1685.001"
    false_positives = "Use of auditpol to disable logging could potentially be legitimate administrator activity."

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $e.target.process.command_line = /auditpol/ nocase
    ($e.target.process.command_line = / \/clear/ nocase and
      $e.target.process.command_line = / \/y/ nocase) or

    ($e.target.process.command_line = / \/remove/ nocase and
      $e.target.process.command_line = / \/allusers/ nocase)
    $e.principal.process.command_line != /LGPO/ nocase
    $e.target.process.parent_process.command_line != /LGPO/ nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $event_count = 1
    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname

    $vendor_name = array($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array($e.metadata.product_name)

    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
  condition:
    $e
}

rule ttp_icacls_disablemonitoring {
  meta:
    rule_name = "ICACLS Disable Monitoring"
    description = "Detects use of icacls to deny the user permissions to antivirus, logging, and diagnostics tools. This behavior has been observed being used by malicious actors to delay detection and prevent remediation."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1222"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    ($e.principal.process.command_line = /icacls/ nocase and
      $e.principal.process.command_line = /\/deny/ nocase and
      $e.principal.process.command_line = /\(OI\)/ nocase and
      $e.principal.process.command_line = /\(CI\)/ nocase and
      $e.principal.process.command_line = /F\)?$/ nocase) or

    ($e.target.process.command_line = /icacls/ nocase and
      $e.target.process.command_line = /\/deny/ nocase and
      $e.target.process.command_line = /\(OI\)/ nocase and
      $e.target.process.command_line = /\(CI\)/ nocase and
      $e.target.process.command_line = /F\)?$/ nocase)
    $e.principal.process.command_line = /360safe|AdwCleaner|AVAST Software|AVG|Avira|ByteFence|Cezurity|COMODO|Enigma Software Group|ESET|Grizzly|iediagcmd\.exe|Indus|Kaspersky Lab|KVRT_Data|Malwarebytes|MB3Install|McAfee|Norton|Panda Security|SpyHunter/ nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1

    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e

  options:
    suppression_window = 10m
}
rules.description: Detects use of icacls to deny the user permissions to antivirus, logging, and diagnostics tools. This behavior has been observed being used by malicious actors to delay detection and prevent remediation.
rules.author: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence

    $e.target.process.file.full_path = /system32\\dism/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line = /online/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line = /disable-feature/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line = /windows-defender/ nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 35
    $event_count = 1
    $hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $target_process_file_path =  $e.target.process.file.full_path

    $vendor_name = array($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array($e.metadata.product_name)

    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: An attacker with appropriate privileges can abuse the legitimate binary Dism.exe to disable Windows Defender, allowing them to potentially remain on the system undetected.

rules.text:
rule ueba_ws_anomalous_drive_views_edits {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Anomalous Google Drive Views/Edits Total by a Privileged User"
    description = "Detects anomalous (13 standard deviations higher than the user's 30 day historical average) Google Drive views/edits total by a privileged user."
    severity = "Low"

  events:
    $e.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Workspace"
    $e.metadata.product_name = "drive"
    $event_product = $e.metadata.product_name
    $product_event_type = $e.metadata.product_event_type
    (
      $product_event_type = "view" or
      $product_event_type = "edit"
    )
    $userid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $user_email = $e.principal.user.email_addresses
    $resource = $e.target.resource.name
    $e.principal.user.attribute.roles.type = "ADMINISTRATOR"

  match:
    $userid over 24h

  outcome:
    $usage_past_24h = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $num_stddevs_away = max(13)

    $historical_avg = max(
      metrics.workspace_total_change_actions(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum,agg:avg,
        principal.user.userid:$userid,metadata.product_event_type:$product_event_type, metadata.product_name:$event_product))

    $historical_stddev = max(
      metrics.workspace_total_change_actions(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum,agg:stddev,
        principal.user.userid:$userid, metadata.product_event_type:$product_event_type, metadata.product_name:$event_product))
    $historical_threshold = max(
      13*metrics.workspace_total_change_actions(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:stddev,
        principal.user.userid:$userid, metadata.product_event_type:$product_event_type,metadata.product_name:$event_product)
      + metrics.workspace_total_change_actions(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:avg,
        principal.user.userid:$userid, metadata.product_event_type:$product_event_type, metadata.product_name:$event_product))

    $user_email_addresses = array_distinct($user_email)
    $files = array_distinct($resource)
    $risk_score = 45

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $result = array_distinct(if($e.security_result.action="ALLOW", "succeeded", "failed"))
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $e and ($usage_past_24h > $historical_threshold) and $historical_threshold > 0
}
rules.description: Detects anomalous (13 standard deviations higher than the user's 30 day historical average) Google Drive views/edits total by a privileged user.

rule ueba_ws_anomalous_drive_copies_after_unsafe_chrome {

    description = "Detects anomalous (8 standard deviations higher than the user's 30 day historical average) Google Drive File Copies total by a user after an unsafe/dangerous event in Chrome by the same user."

  events:

    $e.metadata.product_name = "drive"

    $event_product = $e.metadata.product_name
    $product_event_type = $e.metadata.product_event_type

      $product_event_type = "copy" or
      $product_event_type = "source_copy"
    )

    $user_email = $e.principal.user.email_addresses
    $resource = $e.target.resource.name

    $d.metadata.product_name = "Chrome Management"
    (
      $d.metadata.product_event_type = "badNavigationEvent" or
      $d.metadata.product_event_type = "UNSAFE_SITE_VISIT" or
      $d.metadata.product_event_type = "dangerousDownloadEvent"
    )
    $d.principal.user.email_addresses = $user_email
    $target_url = $d.target.url

  match:
    $user_email over 24h after $d

  outcome:
    $usage_past_24h = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $num_stddevs_away = max(8)

    $historical_avg = max(
      metrics.workspace_total_change_actions(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum,agg:avg,
        principal.user.email_addresses:$user_email,metadata.product_event_type:$product_event_type, metadata.product_name:$event_product))

    $historical_stddev = max(
      metrics.workspace_total_change_actions(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum,agg:stddev,
        principal.user.email_addresses:$user_email, metadata.product_event_type:$product_event_type, metadata.product_name:$event_product))
    $historical_threshold = max(
      8*metrics.workspace_total_change_actions(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:stddev,
        principal.user.email_addresses:$user_email, metadata.product_event_type:$product_event_type,metadata.product_name:$event_product)
      + metrics.workspace_total_change_actions(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:avg,
        principal.user.email_addresses:$user_email, metadata.product_event_type:$product_event_type, metadata.product_name:$event_product))

    $user_email_addresses = array_distinct($user_email)
    $files = array_distinct($resource)
    $sites_visited = array_distinct($target_url)
    $risk_score = max(45)

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)

    $result = array_distinct(if($e.security_result.action="ALLOW", "succeeded", "failed"))

rules.text:
rule ttp_gcp_ws_freemail_sensitive_shares {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Workspace: Sensitive File Share to a Freemail Account"
    description = "Detects when a file labeled as Sensitive is shared to an external freemail account."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0010"
    technique = "T1567"

  events:
    $label_event.metadata.product_name = "drive"
    $label_event.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Workspace"
    ( $label_event.metadata.product_event_type = "label_added" or
      $label_event.metadata.product_event_type = "label_added_by_item_create" or
      $label_event.metadata.product_event_type = "label_field_changed" )

    (
      $label_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["label_title"] = "Secret" or
      $label_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["label_title"] = "Sensitive" or
      $label_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["label_title"] = "Confidential" or
      $label_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["label_title"] = "Restricted"
    )
    $label_event.target.resource.name = $file_name
    $label_event.target.resource.product_object_id = $document_id
    $label_event.principal.user.email_addresses = $user_who_applied_label
    ( $share_event.metadata.product_event_type = "change_user_access" or
      $share_event.metadata.product_event_type = "change_document_visibility" or
      $share_event.metadata.product_event_type = "change_acl_editors" )
    $share_event.metadata.product_name = "drive"
    $share_event.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Workspace"
    $share_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["visibility"] = "shared_externally"
    $share_event.principal.user.email_addresses = $user_who_shared
    $share_event.target.resource.name = $file_name
    $share_event.target.resource.product_object_id = $document_id
    $share_event.target.user.email_addresses = $target_user

    $origin_domain = re.capture($share_event.principal.user.email_addresses , `@[a-zA-Z0-9\.]*`)
    $target_domain = re.capture($share_event.target.user.email_addresses , `@[a-zA-Z0-9\.]*`)

    $origin_domain != $target_domain
    ( $target_domain = "@gmail.com" or $target_domain = "@aol.com" or $target_domain = "@ymail.com" or $target_domain = "@hotmail.com" or $target_domain = "@outlook.com" )

  match:
    $document_id over 15m after $label_event

  outcome:
    $users_who_shared = array_distinct($user_who_shared)
    $file_names  = array_distinct($file_name)
    $target_users = array_distinct($target_user)
    $origin_domains = array_distinct($origin_domain)
    $target_domains = array_distinct($target_domain)
    $risk_score = max( 50
      + if ($share_event.principal.user.attribute.roles.type = "ADMINISTRATOR",10)
      + if ( $share_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["new_value"] = "owner",20)
      + if (($share_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["new_value"] = "editor" or
          $share_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["new_value"] = "can_edit"),15)
      - if (($share_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["new_value"] = "can_view" or
          $share_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["new_value"] = "viewer"),5))
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($label_event.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($label_event.metadata.product_name)
    $result = array_distinct(if($share_event.security_result.action="ALLOW", "succeeded", "failed"))
    $result_time = min($share_event.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $label_event and $share_event
}
rules.description: Detects when a file labeled as Sensitive is shared to an external freemail account.
rules.author: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence

rules.text:
rule ttp_gcp_ws_suslogin_downloadaction {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Suspicious Workspace Actions Observed after a Successful Suspicious Login"
    description = "Detects when suspicious actions such as file shares, downloads, sensitive label removals and account creations happen after a user's login was detected as suspicious."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0009"
    technique = "T1074.001"

  events:
    $login_event.about.labels["is_suspicious"] = "true"
    $login_event.metadata.product_name = "login"
    $login_event.metadata.product_event_type = "login_success"
    $login_event.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Workspace"
    $ip = $login_event.principal.ip
    $user = $login_event.target.user.userid
    $ip_country = $login_event.principal.location.country_or_region
    $suspicious_event.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Workspace"
    $suspicious_event.metadata.product_name = "drive" and
    $suspicious_event.metadata.product_event_type = "download"

    $login_event.target.user.userid = $suspicious_event.principal.user.userid
    $event_type = $suspicious_event.metadata.product_event_type
    $target_resource = $suspicious_event.target.resource.name
    $target_email = $suspicious_event.target.user.email_addresses

  match:
    $user, $ip over 1h after $login_event

  outcome:

    $events_observed_after_login = array_distinct($event_type)
    $target_resources = array_distinct($target_resource)
    $doc_types = array_distinct($suspicious_event.src.resource.attribute.labels["doc_type"])
    $target_emails_if_any = array_distinct($target_email)
    $ips = array_distinct($ip)
    $risk_score = max( 55
      + if($suspicious_event.principal.user.attribute.roles.type = "ADMINISTRATOR",7)
      - if(($suspicious_event.principal.user.attribute.labels["isDelegatedAdmin"] = "true"),2)
      + if($suspicious_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["visibility"] = "private",9)
      + if($suspicious_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["visibility"] = "shared_internally",6)
    )
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($login_event.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($login_event.metadata.product_name)
    $result = array_distinct(if($suspicious_event.security_result.action="ALLOW", "succeeded", "failed"))
    $result_time = min($suspicious_event.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $login_event and $suspicious_event
}
