rules.display_name: Sensitive Drive File Shared Externally or Access Given to an External User
rules.text:
rule ttp_gcp_ws_sensitive_external_share {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Sensitive Drive File Shared Externally or Access Given to an External User"
    description = "Detects when a sensitive file is shared externally or if access to a sensitive document is given to an external user."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0010"
    technique = "T1567"

  events:
    $alert.metadata.product_event_type = "DlpRuleViolation"
    $alert.metadata.product_name = "Google Workspace Alerts"
    $alert.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Workspace"
    $user = $alert.principal.user.email_addresses
    $document_id = $alert.target.resource.product_object_id
    $event.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Workspace"
    $event.metadata.product_name = "drive"
    (
      $event.metadata.product_event_type = "change_document_visibility" and
      $event.target.resource.attribute.labels["old_value"] = "none" and
      (
        $event.target.resource.attribute.labels["new_value"] = "public_on_the_web" or
        $event.target.resource.attribute.labels["new_value"] = "public_in_the_domain"
      )
    ) or
    (
      $event.metadata.product_event_type = "change_user_access" and
      $event.target.resource.attribute.labels["old_value"] = "none" and
      (
        $event.target.resource.attribute.labels["new_value"] = "owner" or
        $event.target.resource.attribute.labels["new_value"] = "editor"
      ) and
      (
        $event.target.resource.attribute.labels["visibility"] = "shared_externally" and
        $event.principal.user.email_addresses != $event.target.user.email_addresses
      )
    ) or
    (
      $event.metadata.product_event_type = "publish_change" and
      $event.target.resource.attribute.labels["old_publish_visibility"] = "nobody" and
      (
        $event.target.resource.attribute.labels["new_publish_visibility"] = "public_in_the_domain" or
        $event.target.resource.attribute.labels["new_publish_visibility"] = "public_on_the_web"
      )
    ) or
    (
      $event.metadata.product_event_type = "change_document_access_scope" and
      $event.target.resource.attribute.labels["old_visibility"] = "private" and
      (
        $event.target.resource.attribute.labels["visibility"] = "public_in_the_domain" or
        $event.target.resource.attribute.labels["visibility"] = "public_on_the_web"
      )
    )
    $event.principal.user.email_addresses = $user
    $event.target.resource.product_object_id = $document_id
    $event.target.resource.name = $document_name
    $event.metadata.product_event_type = $workspace_activities
    $event.target.user.email_addresses = $secondary_email_address
    ($alert.security_result.rule_labels.key = "detector_name" and $alert.security_result.rule_labels.value = $detector)
    $alert.security_result.rule_name = $dlp_rule_name

  match:
    $user, $document_id over 5m

  outcome:

    $dlp_detectors = array_distinct($detector)
    $dlp_rules = array_distinct($dlp_rule_name)
    $files_affected = array_distinct($document_name)
    $drive_events = array_distinct($workspace_activities)
    $secondary_emails_observed_if_any = array_distinct($secondary_email_address)
    $risk_score = max( 50
      + if( $event.principal.user.attribute.roles.type = "ADMINISTRATOR", 10)
      + if( $workspace_activities = "change_user_access" and $user != $secondary_email_address , 9)
      + if( $event.target.resource.attribute.labels.value = "public_on_the_web",20)
      - if( $event.target.resource.attribute.labels.value = "public_on_the_domain", 5)
    )

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($alert.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($alert.metadata.product_name)
    $result = array_distinct(if($alert.security_result.action="ALLOW", "succeeded", "failed"))
    $result_time = min($alert.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $alert and $event
}
rules.description: Detects when a sensitive file is shared externally or if access to a sensitive document is given to an external user.
rules.author: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence

rules.display_name: Workspace: File Shared Externally or Publicly by user of a potentially High Risk Organization
rules.text:
rule ttp_gcp_ws_external_share_sensitiveorg {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Workspace: File Shared Externally or Publicly by user of a potentially High Risk Organization"
    description = "Anomalous number of files (greater than 5 standard deviations from mean) shared externally or publicly by a user from a potentially high risk organization, department or user title."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0010"
    technique = "T1567"

  events:
    $share_event.metadata.product_name = "drive"
    $share_event.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Workspace"
    (
      $share_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["visibility"] = "shared_externally" or
      $share_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["visibility"] = "public_on_the_web"
    )

    $product_event_type = $share_event.metadata.product_event_type
    (
      $product_event_type = "change_document_access_scope" or
      $product_event_type = "change_document_visibility" or
      $product_event_type = "change_user_access"
    )

    $user = $share_event.principal.user.email_addresses
    $event_product_name = $share_event.metadata.product_name
    $file_name = $share_event.target.resource.name
    $document_id = $share_event.target.resource.product_object_id

    $origin_domain = re.capture($share_event.principal.user.email_addresses , `@[a-zA-Z0-9\.]*`)
    $target_domain = re.capture($share_event.target.user.email_addresses , `@[a-zA-Z0-9\.]*`)
    $origin_domain != $target_domain

    $user_context.graph.metadata.vendor_name = "Google"
    $user_context.graph.metadata.product_name = "Cloud Identity"
    $user_context.graph.metadata.entity_type = "USER"
    $user_context.graph.entity.user.email_addresses = $user
    ( $user_context.graph.entity.user.department = "HR" or
      $user_context.graph.entity.user.department = /Human Resources/ or
      $user_context.graph.entity.user.department = /Finance/  or
      $user_context.graph.entity.user.department = /Legal/ or
      $user_context.graph.entity.user.title = /^[Cc]hief/ or
      $user_context.graph.entity.user.title = /admin/ )

  match:
    $user, $product_event_type over 24h

  outcome:
    $usage_past_24h = count_distinct($share_event.metadata.id)
    $num_stddevs_away = max(5)

    $historical_avg = max(
      metrics.workspace_total_change_actions(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum,agg:avg,
        principal.user.email_addresses:$user,metadata.product_event_type:$product_event_type, metadata.product_name:$event_product_name))

    $historical_stddev = max(
      metrics.workspace_total_change_actions(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum,agg:stddev,
        principal.user.email_addresses:$user, metadata.product_event_type:$product_event_type, metadata.product_name:$event_product_name))
    $historical_threshold = max(
      5*metrics.workspace_total_change_actions(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:stddev,
        principal.user.email_addresses:$user, metadata.product_event_type:$product_event_type,metadata.product_name:$event_product_name)
      + metrics.workspace_total_change_actions(
        period:1d, window:30d,
        metric:event_count_sum, agg:avg,
        principal.user.email_addresses:$user, metadata.product_event_type:$product_event_type, metadata.product_name:$event_product_name))

    $users_who_shared = array_distinct($user)
    $user_departments = array_distinct($user_context.graph.entity.user.department)
    $file_names  = array_distinct($file_name)
    $origin_domains = array_distinct($origin_domain)
    $target_domains = array_distinct($target_domain)
    $risk_score = max( 50
      + if ($share_event.principal.user.attribute.roles.type = "ADMINISTRATOR",10)
      + if ($share_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["new_value"] = "owner",20)
      + if (($share_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["new_value"] = "editor" or
          $share_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["new_value"] = "can_edit"),15)
      - if (($share_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["new_value"] = "can_view" or
          $share_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["new_value"] = "viewer"),5))

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($share_event.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($share_event.metadata.product_name)
    $result = array_distinct(if($share_event.security_result.action="ALLOW", "succeeded", "failed"))
    $result_time = min($share_event.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $share_event and $user_context and ($usage_past_24h > $historical_threshold) and ($historical_threshold > 0)
}

rules.text:
rule ttp_gcp_ws_public_sensitive_share {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Google Drive File with Sensitive Label Shared Publicly"
    description = "Detects when a file is shared publicly by a user after being labeled as sensitive by another user. The sensitive labels applied only include labels that are given by default as part of the 'Badged Label' feature in GDrive."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0010"
    technique = "T1567"
    false_positives = "User A finds a public doc. Unshares it and labels it as sensitive. User B realizes that that was a mistake, un-labels it as sensitive, and then re-shares it. We don't detect that between it being labeled as sensitive, it got un-labeled as sensitive"

  events:
    $label_event.metadata.product_name = "drive"
    $label_event.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Workspace"
    ( $label_event.metadata.product_event_type = "label_added" or
      $label_event.metadata.product_event_type = "label_added_by_item_create" or
      $label_event.metadata.product_event_type = "label_field_changed" )

    (
      $label_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["label_title"] = "Secret" or
      $label_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["label_title"] = "Sensitive" or
      $label_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["label_title"] = "Confidential" or
      $label_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["label_title"] = "Restricted" or
      $label_event.additional.fields["label_title"] = "Secret" or
      $label_event.additional.fields["label_title"] = "Sensitive" or
      $label_event.additional.fields["label_title"] = "Confidential" or
      $label_event.additional.fields["label_title"] = "Restricted"
    )
    $file_name = $label_event.target.resource.name
    $document_id = $label_event.target.resource.product_object_id
    $user_who_applied_label = $label_event.principal.user.email_addresses
    $share_event.metadata.product_event_type = "change_document_visibility"
    $share_event.metadata.product_name = "drive"
    $share_event.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Workspace"
    $share_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["new_value"] = "public_on_the_web"
    $user_who_shared = $share_event.principal.user.email_addresses
    $file_name = $share_event.target.resource.name
    $document_id = $share_event.target.resource.product_object_id

    $origin_domain = re.capture($share_event.principal.user.email_addresses , `@[a-zA-Z0-9\.]*`)
    $target_domain = re.capture($share_event.target.user.email_addresses , `@[a-zA-Z0-9\.]*`)

    $share_event.principal.user.email_addresses != $label_event.principal.user.email_addresses

  match:
    $document_id over 1h after $label_event

  outcome:
    $users_who_shared = array_distinct($user_who_shared)
    $users_who_applied_label = array_distinct($user_who_applied_label)
    $file_names  = array_distinct($file_name)
    $origin_domains = array_distinct($origin_domain)
    $target_domains = array_distinct($target_domain)
    $risk_score = max( 65
      + if ($share_event.principal.user.attribute.roles.type = "ADMINISTRATOR", 10)
      + if (($share_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["old_value"] = "private" or
          $share_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["old_value"] = "shared_internally"),20)
    )

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($label_event.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($label_event.metadata.product_name)
    $result = array_distinct(if($share_event.security_result.action="ALLOW", "succeeded", "failed"))
    $result_time = min($share_event.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $label_event and $share_event
}
rules.description: Detects when a file is shared publicly by a user after being labeled as sensitive by another user. The sensitive labels applied only include labels that are given by default as part of the 'Badged Label' feature in GDrive.

rule ueba_ws_anomalous_drive_prints {

rules.text:
rule ttp_gcp_ws_suslogin_shareaction {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Google Drive File Share Actions Observed after a Successful Suspicious Login"
    description = "Detects when file shares happen from Google Drive after a user's login was detected as suspicious."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0010"
    technique = "T1567"

  events:
    $login_event.about.labels["is_suspicious"] = "true"
    $login_event.metadata.product_name = "login"
    $login_event.metadata.product_event_type = "login_success"
    $login_event.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Workspace"
    $login_event.principal.ip_geo_artifact.network.organization_name != "google" nocase
    $ip = $login_event.principal.ip
    $user = $login_event.target.user.userid
    $ip_country = $login_event.principal.location.country_or_region
    $suspicious_event.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Workspace"
    (
      $suspicious_event.metadata.product_name = "drive" and
      (
        $suspicious_event.metadata.product_event_type = "change_user_access" or
        $suspicious_event.metadata.product_event_type = "change_document_visibility" or
        $suspicious_event.metadata.product_event_type = "change_acl_editors" or
        $suspicious_event.metadata.product_event_type = "change_access_scope"
      )
    )
    $login_event.target.user.userid = $suspicious_event.principal.user.userid
    $event_type = $suspicious_event.metadata.product_event_type
    $target_resource = $suspicious_event.target.resource.name
    $target_email = $suspicious_event.target.user.email_addresses

  match:
    $user, $ip over 1h after $login_event

  outcome:

    $events_observed_after_login = array_distinct($event_type)
    $target_resources = array_distinct($target_resource)
    $doc_types = array_distinct($suspicious_event.src.resource.attribute.labels["doc_type"])
    $target_emails_if_any = array_distinct($target_email)
    $ips = array_distinct($ip)
    $ip_countries = array_distinct($ip_country)
    $risk_score = max( 45
      + if($suspicious_event.principal.user.attribute.roles.type = "ADMINISTRATOR",8)

      - if(($suspicious_event.principal.user.attribute.labels["isDelegatedAdmin"] = "true"),2)
      + if($suspicious_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["new_value"] = "owner",11)
      + if(($suspicious_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["new_value"] = "editor" or
          $suspicious_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["new_value"] = "can_edit"),9)
      - if($suspicious_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["visibility"] = "private",2)
      + if($suspicious_event.target.resource.attribute.labels["visibility"] = "public_on_the_web",15)
    )
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($login_event.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($login_event.metadata.product_name)
    $result = array_distinct(if($suspicious_event.security_result.action="ALLOW", "succeeded", "failed"))
    $result_time = min($suspicious_event.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $login_event and $suspicious_event
}

rules.text:
rule ttp_gcp_create_delete_firewall_default {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Create and Delete Firewall in Default Network"
    description = "Detects a firewall created and deleted quickly in the default network, which could be indicative of an attacker attempting to allow traffic to or from a malicious endpoint. The GCP default network is already permissive upon creation."
    severity = "Low"

  events:
    $create.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Cloud Platform"
    $create.metadata.product_event_type = /compute\.firewalls\.insert/ nocase
    $create_firewall_name = $create.target.resource_ancestors.name
    re.regex($create_firewall_name, `\/default$`) nocase

    $delete.metadata.vendor_name = "Google Cloud Platform"
    $delete.metadata.product_event_type = /compute\.firewalls\.delete/ nocase
    $delete_firewall_name = $delete.target.resource_ancestors.name
    re.regex($delete_firewall_name, `\/default$`) nocase

    $create.principal.user.userid = $delete.principal.user.userid
    $create_firewall_name = $delete_firewall_name

  match:
    $create_firewall_name over 1h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = max(60)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($create.metadata.vendor_name)
    $principal_users = array_distinct($create.principal.user.userid)
    $product_name = array_distinct($create.metadata.product_name)
    $target_resource_names = array_distinct($create.target.resource.name)
    $result_time = min($create.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(if($delete.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $delete.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2))
    $tmp2 = max(if($delete.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $create and $delete
}
rules.description: Detects a firewall created and deleted quickly in the default network, which could be indicative of an attacker attempting to allow traffic to or from a malicious endpoint. The GCP default network is already permissive upon creation.

rule ttp_linux_node_spawns_shell_base64 {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Node.js Spawns Shell Executing Base64 Payload"
    description = "Detects a Node.js process spawning a shell (sh or bash) that decodes a base64 payload and pipes it to another shell for execution. This behavior is commonly associated with reverse shells or initial access payloads."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059.004"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"
    )

    (
      any $e.principal.process.file.names = /^node$/ nocase or
      any $e.target.process.parent_process.file.names = /^node$/ nocase or
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `/node$`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.parent_process.file.full_path, `/node$`) nocase
    )

    (
      any $e.target.process.file.names = /^(sh|bash)$/ nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `/(sh|bash)$`) nocase
    )

    re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `base64\s+(-d|--decode)\s*\|\s*(sh|bash)`) nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.hostname
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = ""

    $principal_process_file_full_path = strings.coalesce($e.principal.process.file.full_path, "")
    $principal_process_file_names = array_distinct($e.principal.process.file.names)
    $target_process_command_line = strings.coalesce($e.target.process.command_line, "")
    $target_process_file_full_path = strings.coalesce($e.target.process.file.full_path, "")
    $target_process_file_names = array_distinct($e.target.process.file.names)
    $target_process_parent_process_file_full_path = strings.coalesce($e.target.process.parent_process.file.full_path, "")
    $target_process_parent_process_file_names = array_distinct($e.target.process.parent_process.file.names)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result_time = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2, 0))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1, 0))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: Detects a Node.js process spawning a shell (sh or bash) that decodes a base64 payload and pipes it to another shell for execution. This behavior is commonly associated with reverse shells or initial access payloads.
rules.author: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence

    severity = "High"

      $command_line = /\.vscode-server\/bin\// nocase and

  match:

  outcome:

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)

rules.text:
rule ttp_node_js_spawn_shell_download_execute {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Node.js Spawning Shell to Download and Execute Remote Code"
    description = "Detects a Node.js process launching a shell (/bin/sh, /bin/bash, /bin/dash) that then uses wget or busybox wget to download and execute a file from a remote URL. This pattern is often associated with the exploitation of web applications and the deployment of additional malware."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    (
      re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, `/node$`)
    )
    re.regex($e.target.process.file.full_path, `/(sh|bash|dash)$`)
    (
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `(busybox\s+)?wget\s+http(s)?:\/\/.*&&\s*(ba)?sh\s+`) nocase or
      re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `(busybox\s+)?wget\s+(-q\\s+)?http(s)?:\/\/.*\s+-O\\s+-\|\s*(ba)?sh\b`) nocase or
      (
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `(busybox\s+)?wget\s+http(s)?:\/\/`) nocase and
        re.regex($e.target.process.command_line, `chmod\s+([0-9]{3,}|\+x)`) nocase
      )
    )

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_file_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $suppression_key = $e.principal.hostname
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct(
      if($e.principal.platform = "WINDOWS",
        $e.principal.user.windows_sid,  // Value if TRUE
        $e.principal.user.email_addresses       // Value if FALSE (covers LINUX and MAC in this case)
      )
    )
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: Detects a Node.js process launching a shell (/bin/sh, /bin/bash, /bin/dash) that then uses wget or busybox wget to download and execute a file from a remote URL. This pattern is often associated with the exploitation of web applications and the deployment of additional malware.
rules.author: Google Cloud Threat Intelligence

rule ttp_linux_grep_passwd_shadow_user_discovery {

    description = "Detects attempts to query /etc/passwd or /etc/shadow using grep -q from standard shells (sh, bash, zsh, dash) to check for the existence of privileged usernames (root or admin).     severity = "Medium"

    $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /\b(dash|zsh|bash|sh)$/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line = /grep\s+-q\s+['"]?\^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]*(root|admin):['"]?\s+\/etc\/(passwd|shadow)/ nocase

  outcome:

    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line

    $source_ip = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $cloud_action = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_event_type)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.principal.asset.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.windows_sid)
    $principal_command = array_distinct($e.principal.process.command_line)

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e
}

rule m_hunting_execution_linux_docker_pipe_to_shell_1 {
  meta:

    not $command_line = /https:\/\/microk8s\.io\/install\.sh/ nocase and

    not $command_line = /deb\.nodesource\.com/ nocase and
    not $command_line = /raw\.githubusercontent\.com\/nvm-sh\/nvm/ nocase and
    not $command_line = /aka\.ms\/InstallAzureCLIDeb/ nocase and
    not $command_line = /dot\.net\/v1\/dotnet-install\.sh/ nocase and
    not $command_line = /opencode\.ai\/install/ nocase and
    not $command_line = /claude\.ai\/install\.sh/ nocase and

    not $command_line = /tailscale\.com\/install\.sh/ nocase and
    not $command_line = /webi\.sh/ nocase and
    not $command_line = /get\.sdkman\.io/ nocase and
    not $command_line = /ai-coding-guild-docs\.prod\.rxrx\.io/ nocase and
    not $command_line = /github\.com\/loft-sh\/vcluster/ nocase and

    not $command_line = /raw\.githubusercontent\.com\/anthropics\/claude-code/ nocase and

      $e.target.process.file.full_path = /docker$/ nocase and

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

rules.text:
rule ttp_network_netscaler_webshell_http_request {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Citrix NetScaler Masqueraded Webshell HTTP Request or PHP Error Telemetry"
    description = "Detects HTTP requests and Apache error telemetry (httperror-vpn) associated with masqueraded Citrix NetScaler webshells observed in UNC7160 intrusions, including requests to /vpn/scripts/linux/*.sig or *.deb, AliasMatch triggers (/vpn/media/nsgclient.ico, /vpn/media/sednau.ico), anomalous HTTP 404 responses with multi-KB payloads or curl user-agents on /vpn/media/*.ico, Apache [php:error] logs attempting to execute .sig/.deb files as PHP scripts, or custom webshell C2 headers (NSC-LDAP, NSC-CLIENTTYPE, X-UX)."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1505.003"

  events:
    (
      (
        (
          $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_HTTP" or
          $e.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
        ) and
        (
          $e.target.url = /\/vpn(s)?\/scripts\/(linux|vista|mac)\/(nsginstaller[0-9]*\.deb|nsepa\.deb|nsgclient\.sig|sednau\.sig|[a-f0-9]{8}\.sig)(\b|$)/ nocase or
          $e.target.url = /\/vpn(s)?\/media\/(nsgclient|sednau)\.ico(\b|$)/ nocase or
          $e.target.url = /\/LogonPoint\/receiver\/images\/common\/(nsgclient|sednau|[a-f0-9]{8})\.sig(\b|$)/ nocase or
          $e.target.url = /\/logon\/LogonPoint\/custom\/(\.ctxs\.receiver|receiver\.min(\.[0-9a-f]+)?\.css)(\b|$)/ nocase or
          (
            $e.target.url = /\/vpn(s)?\/(media\/[^\/?#]+\.ico|scripts\/(linux|vista|mac)\/[^\/?#]+\.(sig|deb))(\b|$)/ nocase and
            (
              $e.network.http.user_agent = /^curl\// nocase or
              (
                $e.network.http.response_code = 404 and
                (
                  $e.network.sent_bytes > 2048 or
                  $e.network.received_bytes > 2048
                )
              )
            )
          ) or
          $e.metadata.description = /\b(HTTP_NSC_LDAP|NSC-LDAP|HTTP_NSC_CLIENTTYPE|NSC-CLIENTTYPE|HTTP_X_UX_[0-9]+|X-UX-[0-9]+|NSC_TASS)\b/ nocase
        )
      ) or
      (
        (
          $e.metadata.log_type = "CITRIX_NETSCALER" or
          $e.metadata.log_type = "NIX_SYSTEM"
        ) and
        (
          $e.security_result.summary = /\/vpn(s)?\/(media\/(nsgclient|sednau)\.ico|scripts\/(linux|vista|mac)\/(nsginstaller[0-9]*\.deb|nsepa\.deb|nsgclient\.sig|sednau\.sig|[a-f0-9]{8}\.sig))\b|\/logon\/LogonPoint\/custom\/(\.ctxs\.receiver|receiver\.min(\.[0-9a-f]+)?\.css)\b/ nocase or
          $e.metadata.description = /\[php:error\].*script\s+'\/(var\/netscaler\/gui|netscaler\/ns_gui)\/vpn(s)?\/scripts\/[^']+\.(sig|deb)'\s+not\s+found\s+or\s+unable\s+to\s+stat/ nocase or
          $e.metadata.description = /AH00128:\s+File\s+does\s+not\s+exist:\s+\/netscaler\/ns_gui\/vpn(s)?\/media\/(nsgclient|sednau)\.ico\b/ nocase or
          $e.metadata.description = /"(GET|POST)\s+(\/vpn(s)?\/(media\/(nsgclient|sednau)\.ico|scripts\/(linux|vista|mac)\/(nsginstaller[0-9]*\.deb|nsepa\.deb|nsgclient\.sig|sednau\.sig|[a-f0-9]{8}\.sig))|\/logon\/LogonPoint\/custom\/(\.ctxs\.receiver|receiver\.min(\.[0-9a-f]+)?\.css))\b/ nocase
        )
      )
    )

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result = "attempted"
    $result_time = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $principal_ip = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)
    $target_ip = array_distinct($e.target.ip)
    $target_url = array_distinct($e.target.url)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.target.hostname)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.target.ip)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: Detects HTTP requests and Apache error telemetry (httperror-vpn) associated with masqueraded Citrix NetScaler webshells observed in UNC7160 intrusions, including requests to /vpn/scripts/linux/*.sig or *.deb, AliasMatch triggers (/vpn/media/nsgclient.ico, /vpn/media/sednau.ico), anomalous HTTP 404 responses with multi-KB payloads or curl user-agents on /vpn/media/*.ico, Apache [php:error] logs attempting to execute .sig/.deb files as PHP scripts, or custom webshell C2 headers (NSC-LDAP, NSC-CLIENTTYPE, X-UX).

      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"

    $e.target.process.command_line = /\b(?:exec|eval)\s*\(\s*(?:base64\.|__import__\s*\(\s*['"]base64['"]\s*\)\.)?b64decode\s*\(/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line = /(?:^|[\s'"])(?:(?:[\\\/]private)?(?:[\\\/]var)?[\\\/]tmp|[\\\/]dev[\\\/]shm)[\\\/]\.[^\s'"\\\/]+/ nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id

rule m_hunting_execution_linux_kubectl_download_tmp_exec_1 {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Kubectl Exec Curl or Wget to Tmp and Execute"
    description = "Detects potentially malicious activity within a Kubernetes container initiated via 'kubectl exec'. This rule looks for files downloaded via curl or wget to the /tmp directory, made executable, and then run."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059.013"
    false_positives = "Legitimate software might be installed this way. Review the URL, downloaded file, container context, and namespace."
    reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/013/"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $e.principal.hostname = $hostname
    $command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    not $command_line = /Copyright \(c\)/ nocase and
    not (
      $command_line = /\.vscode-server\/bin\// nocase and
      $command_line = /node -e / nocase and
      $command_line = /remoteCloudGuesser\.js\.map/ nocase
    ) and
    not $command_line = /curl -fsSL https:\/\/bun\.sh\/install \| bash/ nocase and
    not $command_line = /curl --proto "=https" --tlsv1\.2 -sSf https:\/\/sh\.rustup\.rs \| sh/ nocase and
    not $command_line = /curl -L https:\/\/microk8s\.io\/install\.sh \| sh/ nocase and
    not $command_line = /curl -sfL https:\/\/get\.k3s\.io \| sh/ nocase and
    $e.target.process.file.full_path = /kubectl$/ nocase and
    $command_line = / exec / nocase and
    not $command_line = /--(namespace|-n) (dev|test|qa|staging|sandpit|nonprod)/ nocase and
    $command_line = /(curl|wget) (-o|-O) \/tmp\/.*\s*(?:&&|;)\s*(chmod \+x .*\s*(?:&&|;)\s*.*\/tmp\/)/ nocase

  match:
    $hostname over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0

    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $e

    $e.target.process.command_line != /https:\/\/raw\.githubusercontent\.com\/anchore\/grype\/main\/install\.sh|https:\/\/get.maestro.mobile.dev\/install\.sh|https:\/\/downloads.slack-edge.com\/slack-cli\/install\.sh/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line != /--model\s+claude-\d+\.\d+\-opus\-high.*\.cursor\/skills\/coding-standards\/SKILL\.md/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line != /curl\s+-fsSL\s+https:\/\/gh\.io\/copilot-install\s+\|\s+bash|curl\s+-sSL\s+https:\/\/aka\.ms\/getvsdbgsh\s+\|\s+bash|https:\/\/download\.newrelic\.com\/install\/newrelic-ebpf-agent\/scripts\/nr-ebpf-check\.sh/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line != /\.tech\.gov\.sg\b|https:\/\/get\.rvm\.io\b|https:\/\/d2lang\.com\/install\.sh|https:\/\/cursor\.com\/install|https:\/\/rvm\.io\/mpapis\.asc|https:\/\/dl\.run\.gdai\.dev\/install\.sh|https:\/\/gh\.io\/copilot-install|https:\/\/antigravity\.google\/cli\/install\.sh/ nocase

    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1686.001"
    false_positives = "System administrators may create s groups with 0.0.0.0/0 to allow all traffic."

    $e.principal.process.command_line = /Inbound/ nocase
    $e.principal.process.command_line != /\-\-source\-address\-prefixes\s+10\.0\.0\.0\/8/ nocase
    $e.principal.process.command_line != /\-\-source\-address\-prefixes\s+172\.16\.0\.0\/12/ nocase

    $e.principal.hostname = $command

    $hostname, $command over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)

    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)

    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

rule ttp_linux_httpd_custom_conf_restart_chained_chmod {
  meta:
    rule_name = "HTTPD Custom Configuration Restart Chained with Permission Modification"
    description = "Detects the Apache/HTTPD web server binary invoked to restart or reload a configuration file (-k restart/graceful/start -f <config>) chained with a file permission change (chmod/chown) or shell execution. Adversaries use this pattern on appliances and web servers to reload modified web server configurations (such as enabling CGI/webshell paths) while simultaneously planting SUID shell backdoors."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1505.003"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"
    )
    $e.target.process.command_line = /(?:^|[\s'"(&;|`]|[\\\/])(?:httpd|apache2|apachectl)\b.*?(?:&&|;|\|\|?)\s*(?:[\\\/]\S+[\\\/])?(?:chmod|chown|sh|bash)\b/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line = /\s-k\s+(?:restart|graceful|start)\b/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line = /\s-f\s+[^\s'"|;&)]+/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line != /Wired the patch permanently into.*tpl-builds\/httpd\/build-httpd\.sh/ nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $tmp1 = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1
    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: Detects the Apache/HTTPD web server binary invoked to restart or reload a configuration file (-k restart/graceful/start -f <config>) chained with a file permission change (chmod/chown) or shell execution. Adversaries use this pattern on appliances and web servers to reload modified web server configurations (such as enabling CGI/webshell paths) while simultaneously planting SUID shell backdoors.

rule ttp_linux_citrix_netscaler_suspicious_command_in_web_or_config_directory  {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Citrix NetScaler Suspicious Command in Web or Config Directory"
    description = "Detects suspicious commands targeting sensitive Citrix NetScaler web directories, configuration files, or cryptographic keys. Adversaries abuse this behavior to deploy webshells, modify web server configurations, harvest credentials, or establish persistent access."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0003"
    technique = "T1505.003"
    reference = "https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/threat-intelligence/citrix-zero-day-espionage/?e=48754805, https://cloud.google.com/blog/topics/threat-intelligence/defending-against-active-exploitation-of-citrix-netscaler-adc-and-gateway-appliances?e=48754805"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"
    )
    $e.target.process.command_line = /(\/(?:flash\/)?nsconfig\/(?:ns\.conf|httpd\.conf|\.F[12]\.key|keys)|\/var\/vpn\/|\/var\/python\/|\/(?:var\/)?netscaler\/(?:ns_gui|logon|portal|gui\/vpns?)\/)/ nocase
    (
      $e.target.process.command_line = /(\b(base64|base64_decode|openssl|eval)\b|<\?php|PD9waHA)/ nocase or
      $e.target.process.command_line = /\b(cat|echo|printf)\b.*(>|\btee\b)/ nocase or
      $e.target.process.command_line = /\bchmod\s+([ugo+]*[sx]|[0-7]*[1357][0-7]*)\b/ nocase or
      $e.target.process.command_line = /(Add(Handler|Type)\s+['"]?application\/x-httpd-php|php_flag\s+engine\s+on|AliasMatch)/ nocase
    )
    not $e.principal.process.command_line = /\.(claude|codex)\b/ nocase
    not $e.target.process.command_line = /\.(claude|codex|codex-computer-use\.exe)\b/ nocase
    not $e.target.process.command_line = /Citrix confirms active exploitation of CVE-2026-88771/ nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = $e.principal.user.windows_sid
    $tmp1 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(
      strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2
    )
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1
    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $likely_security_testing = if(re.regex($e.principal.process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend|safebreach|attackiq|\/sb-sim-temp)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.parent_process.file.full_path, /(verodin_backend|safebreach|attackiq|\/sb-sim-temp)/) nocase, 1, 0) + if(re.regex($e.principal.process.command_line, /(verodin_backend|safebreach|attackiq|\/sb-sim-temp)/) nocase, 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e

  options:
    suppression_window = 10m
}
rules.description: Detects suspicious commands targeting sensitive Citrix NetScaler web directories, configuration files, or cryptographic keys. Adversaries abuse this behavior to deploy webshells, modify web server configurations, harvest credentials, or establish persistent access.

rules.text:
rule ttp_linux_citrix_netscaler_crontab_path_scrubbing {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Citrix NetScaler Crontab Installation Path Scrubbing"
    description = "Detects command-line execution referencing both a Citrix NetScaler VPN directory path (such as scripts, media, theme, themes, help, or logon) and /etc/crontab. Adversaries exploiting Citrix NetScaler ADC vulnerabilities use this technique to scrub malicious installation paths and scheduled persistence entries from /etc/crontab before initiating an appliance reboot."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0005"
    technique = "T1070"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"
    )
    $e.target.process.command_line = /(?:^|[\\\/])vpn(s)?[\\\/](scripts|media|theme|themes|help|logon)/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line = /(?:^|[\\\/])etc[\\\/]crontab/ nocase
    not $e.principal.process.command_line = /\/\.claude\/shell-snapshots\/snapshot/ nocase
    not $e.target.process.command_line = /(\/\.claude\/shell-snapshots\/snapshot|automated flags above:.*CLUSTER #1 IS MALICIOUS|signature CAMPAIGN MATCH:.*identical TTPs to the Sep 2026 NetScaler webshell)/ nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $tmp1 = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1
    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname
    $rule_category = "methodology"
    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    $target_process_file_full_path = $e.target.process.file.full_path
    $asset_is_server = if($e.principal.asset.type = "SERVER", 1, 0)

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: Detects command-line execution referencing both a Citrix NetScaler VPN directory path (such as scripts, media, theme, themes, help, or logon) and /etc/crontab. Adversaries exploiting Citrix NetScaler ADC vulnerabilities use this technique to scrub malicious installation paths and scheduled persistence entries from /etc/crontab before initiating an appliance reboot.

rules.text:
rule ttp_network_netscaler_epa_prefixlist_memory_probe {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Citrix NetScaler EPA PrefixList Memory Probe"
    description = "Detects Citrix NetScaler Gateway requests carrying a crafted Endpoint Analysis (EPA) PrefixList value, which threat actors use to probe for memory exposure (CVE-2026-88778). A match indicates an exploitation attempt, not a confirmed compromise. Review the source IP for follow-on authentication or session activity and confirm the appliance is patched."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0001"
    technique = "T1190"
    false_positives = "Internet-wide vulnerability scanners send PrefixList probes; the most common all-zero scanner value is excluded, but other scanners may vary the value."

  events:
    $e.metadata.log_type = "CITRIX_NETSCALER"
    $prefix_list = re.capture(
      strings.coalesce($e.target.url, $e.metadata.description),
      `PrefixList\s*=\s*(M[0-9A-Fa-f]{7})`
    )
    $prefix_list != ""
    $prefix_list != /^M0{7}$/

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $event_count = 1
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $result = "attempted"
    $victim_uid = $e.target.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.target.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.target.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $adversary_netid = array($e.principal.ip)

    $prefix_list_value = $prefix_list
    $target_url = $e.target.url

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: Detects Citrix NetScaler Gateway requests carrying a crafted Endpoint Analysis (EPA) PrefixList value, which threat actors use to probe for memory exposure (CVE-2026-88778). A match indicates an exploitation attempt, not a confirmed compromise. Review the source IP for follow-on authentication or session activity and confirm the appliance is patched.

rules.text:
rule m_hunting_execution_linux_kubectl_pipe_to_shell_1 {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Kubectl Exec Downloaded Content Piped to Shell"
    description = "Detects potentially malicious activity within a container initiated via 'kubectl exec'. This rule looks for the output of 'curl' or 'wget' being piped directly to shells like bash, sh, or zsh."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059.013"
    false_positives = "Some legitimate installers or scripts use this pattern. Common safe installers are excluded. Review the URL, user, container, and namespace context."
    reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/013/"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $e.principal.hostname = $hostname
    $command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    not $command_line = /Copyright \(c\)/ nocase and
    not (
      $command_line = /\.vscode-server\/bin\// nocase and
      $command_line = /node -e / nocase
    ) and
    not $command_line = /https:\/\/bun\.sh\/install/ nocase and
    not $command_line = /https:\/\/sh\.rustup\.rs/ nocase and
    not $command_line = /https:\/\/microk8s\.io\/install\.sh/ nocase and
    not $command_line = /https:\/\/get\.k3s\.io/ nocase and
    not $command_line = /deb\.nodesource\.com/ nocase and
    not $command_line = /astral\.sh\/uv/ nocase and
    not $command_line = /tailscale\.com\/install\.sh/ nocase and
    not $command_line = /claude\.ai\/install\.sh/ nocase and
    not $command_line = /dot\.net\/v1\/dotnet-install\.sh/ nocase and
    (
      $e.target.process.file.full_path = /kubectl$/ nocase and
      $command_line = / exec / nocase and
      not $command_line = /--(namespace|-n) (dev|test|qa|staging|sandpit|nonprod)/ nocase
    )
    and
    (
      $command_line = /(curl|wget)[^|]+\|\s*(bash|sh|zsh)\b/ nocase
    )

  match:
    $hostname over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)
    $user_id = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $command_lines = array_distinct($command_line)
    $process_paths = array_distinct($e.target.process.file.full_path)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: Detects potentially malicious activity within a container initiated via 'kubectl exec'. This rule looks for the output of 'curl' or 'wget' being piped directly to shells like bash, sh, or zsh.

rule m_hunting_execution_python_b64_blockchain_1 {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Python Inline Base64 Execution with Blockchain API Call"
    description = "A Python process was observed executing inline base64-decoded code, in conjunction with network connections to public blockchain API endpoints. This pattern is associated with techniques like EtherHiding, where malware fetches payloads or C2 instructions from the blockchain."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0011"
    technique = "T1102"
    false_positives = "Rare legitimate uses of Python to interact with blockchain APIs might exist, but the combination with inline base64 execution is suspicious. Analyze the decoded script content."

  events:
    $e1.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $e1.principal.process.file.full_path = /python(w)?([\d\.]+)?(\.exe)?$/ nocase
    (
      $e1.principal.process.command_line = /exec\(\s*base64\.b64decode\(/ or
      $e1.principal.process.command_line = /eval\(\s*base64\.b64decode\(/
    )
    $hostname = $e1.principal.hostname
    $pid = $e1.principal.process.pid
    $e2.metadata.event_type = "NETWORK_CONNECTION"
    $e2.principal.hostname = $hostname
    $e2.principal.process.pid = $pid
    (
      $e2.target.hostname = /api\.trongrid\.io$/ or
      $e2.target.hostname = /fullnode\.mainnet\.aptoslabs\.com$/ or
      $e2.target.hostname = /bsc-dataseed\.binance\.org$/ or
      $e2.target.hostname = /bsc-rpc\.publicnode\.com$/ or
      $e2.target.hostname = /rpc\.ankr\.com$/
    )

  match:
    $hostname, $pid over 5m

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e1.metadata.id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($hostname)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e1.principal.ip)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e2.target.ip)
    $target_domains = array_distinct($e2.target.hostname)
    $process_commandline = array_distinct($e1.principal.process.command_line)
    $result = "succeeded"
    $result_time = min($e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $e1 and $e2
}

rule ttp_linux_hidden_backup_sensitive_files {

rules.text:
rule ttp_network_netscaler_saml_prefixlist_overflow_nsaaad_crash {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Citrix NetScaler AAA Daemon Crash Loop (CVE-2026-88779 SAML Exploitation)"
    description = "Detects repeated crashes and restarts of the Citrix NetScaler AAA daemon (nsaaad) on one appliance within an hour. In October 2026, threat actors sent malformed SAML requests with an oversized PrefixList to /cgi/samlauth (CVE-2026-88779), crashing nsaaad until the appliance rebooted. The same requests have carried CVE-2026-88771 command-injection strings in the SAML NameID. A match indicates an exploitation attempt, not a confirmed compromise. Confirm the appliance build and whether the vendor SAML mitigation policy is applied, and check the appliance for follow-on activity."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0001"
    technique = "T1190"
    false_positives = "The AAA daemon may restart once after a legitimate upgrade or configuration change. Repeated crashes outside a known attack window may indicate an unrelated software defect."

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.log_type = "CITRIX_NETSCALER" or
      $e.metadata.log_type = "NIX_SYSTEM"
    )
    (
      $e.metadata.description = /\bnsaaad\b.{0,40}(crash|died|signal|segfault|core)/ nocase or
      $e.metadata.description = /\bnsaaad\b.{0,80}restarts\s*\([2-9][0-9]*\)/ nocase
    )

    $appliance = strings.coalesce($e.intermediary.hostname, $e.principal.hostname, $e.observer.hostname)

  match:
    $appliance over 1h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $result = "attempted"
    $result_time = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $victim_uid = array_distinct($e.target.asset.asset_id)
    $victim_name = array_distinct($appliance)
    $victim_netid = array_distinct($e.intermediary.ip)
    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip)

    $restart_message_count = sum(if($e.metadata.description = /restarts\s*\(/ nocase, 1, 0))
    $max_restarts_reached = max(if($e.metadata.description = /maximum number of restarts/ nocase, 1, 0))
    $first_seen = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $product_event_types = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_event_type)

  condition:
    $e
}
rules.description: Detects repeated crashes and restarts of the Citrix NetScaler AAA daemon (nsaaad) on one appliance within an hour. The same requests have carried CVE-2026-88771 command-injection strings in the SAML NameID. A match indicates an exploitation attempt, not a confirmed compromise.     severity = "Critical"
    tactic = "TA0001"
    technique = "T1190"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"
    ) and
    not $e.target.process.file.full_path = /\/(u|f|e)?grep$|\/rg$|\/sed$|\/g?awk$/ nocase and
    not $e.target.process.command_line = /\.(claude|codex)\b/ nocase and
    (
      $e.target.process.command_line = /\bfind\s+[^\r\n]*\/var\/core\s+-name\s+NSPPE[^\r\n]*([;&`$><#]|\$\(|\$\{IFS\}|\|[^\r\n]*-print)/ nocase or

      (
        $e.target.process.command_line = /\bfind\s+[^\r\n]*\/var\/core\s+-name\s+NSPPE/ nocase and
        not $e.target.process.command_line = /\s-print\b/ nocase
      ) or
      (
        $e.principal.process.command_line = /ns_monuploadd_err\.pl/ nocase and
        (

rule m_hunting_collection_gcp_gcloud_sql_export_1 {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Cloud SQL Export"
    description = "This rule looks for consecutive exports of Cloud SQL databases or instances using the gcloud CLI command, which can be used to detect a data collection attempt. Instances or databases can be exported to files (bak, csv, sql, tde) in a cloud storage bucket."
    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0009"
    technique = "T1213.006"
    false_positives = "Legitimate backup processes may trigger this rule."
    reference = "https://docs.cloud.google.com/sdk/gcloud/reference/sql/export/sql"

  events:
    ($e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" OR
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED")
    $e.target.process.command_line = /gcloud( alpha| beta)? sql export (bak|csv|sql|tde)/ nocase
    $instance_name = re.capture($e.target.process.command_line, /sql export (?:bak|csv|sql|tde) ([^\s]+)/)
    $database_name = re.capture($e.target.process.command_line, /(?:-d |--database=)([^\s]+)/)
    $user = $e.principal.user.userid

  match:
    $user over 1h

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)

    $adversary_uid = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $adversary_name = array_distinct($e.principal.user.user_display_name)
    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e.principal.ip[0])

    $instances = array_distinct($instance_name)
    $databases = array_distinct($database_name)

    $principal_process = array_distinct($e.principal.process.command_line)
    $target_process = array_distinct($e.target.process.command_line)

    $result = array_distinct("attempted")
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

  condition:
    $e and (#instance_name > 1 or #database_name > 1)
}
rules.description: This rule looks for consecutive exports of Cloud SQL databases or instances using the gcloud CLI command, which can be used to detect a data collection attempt. Instances or databases can be exported to files (bak, csv, sql, tde) in a cloud storage bucket.

rule m_hunting_execution_linux_kubectl_base64_to_shell_1 {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Kubectl Exec Base64 Encoded Command Piped to Shell"
    description = "Detects potentially malicious activity within a container initiated via 'kubectl exec'. This specific rule looks for base64 encoded commands being decoded and piped directly to shells like bash, sh, or zsh."
    severity = "High"
    tactic = "TA0002"
    technique = "T1059.013"
    false_positives = "Legitimate scripts or tools might occasionally use this method, though it is uncommon. Review the decoded command, user, container, and namespace context."
    reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/013/"

  events:
    $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH"
    $e.principal.hostname = $hostname
    $command_line = $e.target.process.command_line
    not $command_line = /Copyright \(c\)/ nocase and
    not (
      $command_line = /\.vscode-server\/bin\// nocase and
      $command_line = /node -e / nocase
    ) and
    not $command_line = /https:\/\/bun\.sh\/install/ nocase and
    not $command_line = /https:\/\/sh\.rustup\.rs/ nocase and
    not $command_line = /https:\/\/microk8s\.io\/install\.sh/ nocase and
    not $command_line = /https:\/\/get\.k3s\.io/ nocase and
    not (
      $e.principal.process.file.full_path = "/opt/anthropic/bin/telemetry_wrapper" and
      $command_line = /sphinx-devbox/ nocase and
      $command_line = /coo-container/ nocase

      $e.target.process.file.full_path = /kubectl$/ nocase and
      $command_line = / exec / nocase and
      not $command_line = /--(namespace|-n) (dev|test|qa|staging|sandpit|nonprod)/ nocase
    )
    and
    (

  match:

    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)

rule ttp_linux_copy_usr_share_to_hidden {
  meta:
    rule_name = "Suspicious Copy from Usr Share to User Hidden Directory"
    description = "Detects shell execution (such as bash, zsh, or sh) launching 'cp -a' to copy files from the /usr/share/ directory into a user's hidden file under /home/. Attackers may leverage this to stage sensitive tools, system dictionaries, or configurations in hidden locations to evade basic directory listings and detection."
    severity = "Medium"
    tactic = "TA0009"
    technique = "T1074.001"

  events:
    (
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" or
      $e.metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_UNCATEGORIZED"
    )
    $e.principal.process.file.full_path = /\b(dash|zsh|bash|sh)$/ nocase
    $e.target.process.command_line = /\bcp\s+-a\b.*\/usr\/share\/.*\s+\/home\/[^\\\/]+(\/[^\\\/]+\/)?\.[^\\\/]+/ nocase

  outcome:
    $risk_score = 0
    $vendor_name = $e.metadata.vendor_name
    $product_name = $e.metadata.product_name
    $victim_uid = $e.principal.asset.asset_id
    $victim_name = $e.principal.asset.hostname
    $victim_netid = array($e.principal.ip)
    $adversary_uid = $e.principal.user.userid
    $adversary_name = $e.principal.user.user_display_name
    $tmp1 = max(if($e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2))
    $tmp2 = max(if($e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1))
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded", ","), $tmp1 + $tmp2)
    $result_time = $e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds
    $event_count = 1
    $principal_hostname = $e.principal.hostname

    $principal_process_command_line = $e.principal.process.command_line
    $principal_process_file_full_path = $e.principal.process.file.full_path
    $target_process_command_line = $e.target.process.command_line

}

rule medium_ioc_eg_network_dns_questions_name {
  meta:
    rule_name = "ATI Medium Priority Rule Match for Domain Name IoCs (network.dns.questions.name)"
    description = "This rule matches indicators of compromise from Google Applied Threat Intelligence."
    severity = "Medium"
    feed = "gti"

  events:
    $gti.graph.metadata.product_name = "GTI_IOC"
    $gti.graph.metadata.vendor_name = "GTI_IOC"
    $gti.graph.metadata.entity_type = "DOMAIN_NAME"
    $gti.graph.metadata.source_type = "GLOBAL_CONTEXT"
    $gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.gti_verdict = 16
    $ioc = $gti.graph.entity.hostname
    $ioc = $e.network.dns.questions.name

    $gti.graph.entity.hostname != ""
    $e.network.dns.questions.name != ""
    $e.metadata.product_name != /RECORDED_FUTURE_IOC/ nocase
    $e.metadata.product_name != /stix/ nocase
    $e.metadata.event_type != "ENTITY_RISK_CHANGE"
    (
      $gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.gti_update_time.seconds <=
      (timestamp.current_seconds() - (7 * 24 * 60 * 60)) OR
      $gti.graph.metadata.collected_timestamp.seconds <=
      (timestamp.current_seconds() - (7 * 24 * 60 * 60)) OR
      $gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.reviewed = true
    )

  match:
    $ioc by 1h

  outcome:
    $active_ir_pwn = max(if($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.active_ir = true, 1, 0))
    $active_ir_confidence_score = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.mandiant_analyst_confidence)
    $global_customer_count = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.global_customer_count)
    $global_hits_count = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.global_hit_count)
    $attributed_malware = max(if(any $gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.attributed_malware.name != "", 1, 0))
    $attributed_actor = max(if(any $gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.attributed_threat_actors.name != "", 1, 0))
    $pwn_event_time = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $pwn_added_time = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.active_ir_first_tagged_time.seconds)
    $pwn_time_diff = $pwn_event_time - $pwn_added_time
    $exclusive_label = max(if($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.exclusive = true, 1, 0))
    $exclusive_actor = $exclusive_label + $attributed_actor
    $gti_verdict = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.gti_verdict)
    $gti_severity = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.gti_severity)
    $gti_threat_score = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.gti_threat_score)
    $commodity = max(if($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.osint = true, 1, 0))
    $scanner = max(if($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.scanner = true, 1, 0))
    $active_ir = if($active_ir_pwn = 1, 1, 0)
    $high_prevalence = if($global_customer_count >= 3, 1, 0)
    +
    if($global_hits_count > 50000, 1, 0)
    $attributed = if($attributed_malware = 1, 1, 0)
    +
    if($attributed_actor = 1, 1, 0)
    $pwn_old = if($pwn_event_time - $pwn_added_time > 7689600,1,0)
    $exclusive = if($exclusive_actor = 2, 1, 0)
    +
    if($attributed_malware = 1, 1, 0)
    $blocked = max(0 +
      if(any $e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.action = "QUARANTINE", 1, 0)
    )
    $entity_type = array_distinct($gti.graph.metadata.entity_type)
    $event_time = array_distinct($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $log_source = array_distinct($e.metadata.log_type)
    $asset_hostname = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)
    $user_id = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $ioc_value =  array_distinct($ioc)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $risk_score = max(65)
    $priority = if(
      $gti_verdict = 16 AND
      $gti_severity = 12 AND
      $high_prevalence != 2 AND
      $active_ir != 1 AND
      $exclusive >= 1,
      2,
      0
    )

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if(any $e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and any $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if(any $e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e AND $gti AND $priority = 2
}

rules.text:
rule medium_ioc_eg_principal_ip {
  meta:
    rule_name = "ATI Medium Priority Rule Match for Ip Address IoCs (principal.ip)"
    description = "This rule matches indicators of compromise from Google Applied Threat Intelligence."
    severity = "Medium"
    feed = "gti"

  events:
    $gti.graph.metadata.product_name = "GTI_IOC"
    $gti.graph.metadata.vendor_name = "GTI_IOC"
    $gti.graph.metadata.entity_type = "IP_ADDRESS"
    $gti.graph.metadata.source_type = "GLOBAL_CONTEXT"
    $gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.gti_verdict = 16
    $ioc = $gti.graph.entity.ip
    $ioc = $e.principal.ip

    $gti.graph.entity.ip != ""
    $e.principal.ip != ""
    $e.metadata.product_name != /RECORDED_FUTURE_IOC/ nocase
    $e.metadata.product_name != /stix/ nocase
    $e.metadata.event_type != "ENTITY_RISK_CHANGE"
    (
      $gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.gti_update_time.seconds <=
      (timestamp.current_seconds() - (7 * 24 * 60 * 60)) OR
      $gti.graph.metadata.collected_timestamp.seconds <=
      (timestamp.current_seconds() - (7 * 24 * 60 * 60)) OR
      $gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.reviewed = true
    )

  match:
    $ioc by 1h

  outcome:
    $active_ir_pwn = max(if($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.active_ir = true, 1, 0))
    $active_ir_confidence_score = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.mandiant_analyst_confidence)
    $global_customer_count = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.global_customer_count)
    $global_hits_count = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.global_hit_count)
    $attributed_malware = max(if(any $gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.attributed_malware.name != "", 1, 0))
    $attributed_actor = max(if(any $gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.attributed_threat_actors.name != "", 1, 0))
    $pwn_event_time = max($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $pwn_added_time = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.active_ir_first_tagged_time.seconds)
    $pwn_time_diff = $pwn_event_time - $pwn_added_time
    $exclusive_label = max(if($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.exclusive = true, 1, 0))
    $exclusive_actor = $exclusive_label + $attributed_actor
    $gti_verdict = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.gti_verdict)
    $gti_severity = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.gti_severity)
    $gti_threat_score = max($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.gti_threat_score)
    $commodity = max(if($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.osint = true, 1, 0))
    $scanner = max(if($gti.graph.metadata.ati_prioritization.scanner = true, 1, 0))
    $active_ir = if($active_ir_pwn = 1, 1, 0)
    $high_prevalence = if($global_customer_count >= 3, 1, 0)
    +
    if($global_hits_count > 50000, 1, 0)
    $attributed = if($attributed_malware = 1, 1, 0)
    +
    if($attributed_actor = 1, 1, 0)
    $pwn_old = if($pwn_event_time - $pwn_added_time > 7689600,1,0)
    $exclusive = if($exclusive_actor = 2, 1, 0)
    +
    if($attributed_malware = 1, 1, 0)
    $blocked = max(0 +
      if(any $e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1, 0) +
      if(any $e.security_result.action = "QUARANTINE", 1, 0)
    )
    $entity_type = array_distinct($gti.graph.metadata.entity_type)
    $event_time = array_distinct($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $log_source = array_distinct($e.metadata.log_type)
    $asset_hostname = array_distinct($e.principal.hostname)
    $user_id = array_distinct($e.principal.user.userid)
    $ioc_value =  array_distinct($ioc)
    $event_count = count_distinct($e.metadata.id)
    $risk_score = max(65)
    $priority = if(
      $gti_verdict = 16 AND
      $gti_severity = 12 AND
      $high_prevalence != 2 AND
      $active_ir != 1 AND
      $event_count > 2 AND
      $blocked = 0 AND
      $exclusive >= 1,
      2,
      0
    )

    $vendor_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.vendor_name)
    $product_name = array_distinct($e.metadata.product_name)
    $result_time = min($e.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
    $tmp1 = max(
      if(any $e.security_result.action != "BLOCK" and any $e.security_result.action != "UNKNOWN_ACTION", 2)
    )
    $tmp2 = max(
      if(any $e.security_result.action = "BLOCK", 1)
    )
    $result = arrays.index_to_str(strings.split("attempted,failed,succeeded,succeeded"), $tmp1 + $tmp2)

  condition:
    $e AND $gti AND $priority = 2
}

rule ttp_gcp_gke_suspicious_stdout_stderr {

    severity = "Low"
    tactic = "TA0004"
    technique = "T1611"
    false_positives = "These strings could also be caused by normally privileged containers running in a less privileged environment."
    reference = "https://github.com/earthquake/chw00t/blob/master/Presentations/Balazs_Bucsay_PHdaysV2015_chw00t.pdf"

  events:
    $e1.security_result.detection_fields["mute"] != "MUTED"

    $e1.metadata.vendor_name = "Kubernetes"
    $e1.metadata.log_type = "KUBERNETES_NODE"
    $e1.target.resource.resource_subtype = /k8s_/
    $e1.metadata.url_back_to_product = /stdout|stderr/
    (
      $e1.about.labels["textpayload"] = /mkdir: can't create directory '\/sys\/.*': Read-only file system/ nocase OR
      $e1.about.labels["textpayload"] = /mount: mounting cgroup on \/.* failed: Permission denied/ nocase OR
      $e1.about.labels["textpayload"] = /mount: mounting \/dev\/.* on \/.* failed: Permission denied/ nocase OR
      $e1.about.labels["textpayload"] = /error creating block device: No such file or directory/ nocase OR

      $e1.about.labels["textpayload"] = /\/etc\/sysctl\.conf: Permission denied/ nocase OR
      $e1.about.labels["textpayload"] = /(?:sysctl|modprobe): command not found/ nocase

    $project_name = $e1.target.resource_ancestors.attribute.labels["project_name"]
    $cluster_name = $e1.target.resource_ancestors.attribute.labels["cluster_name"]
    $namespace = $e1.target.namespace

    $product_name = array_distinct($e1.metadata.product_name)

    $adversary_netid = array_distinct($e1.principal.user.email_addresses)

    $result = "failed"
    $result_time = min($e1.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
